document: Sappe. cuisine: Thai Bars Barbeque. located in Manhattan. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text:
I Had a wonderful experience at Sappe Restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious — beautifully presented, incredibly fresh, and full of rich, well-balanced flavors. Every dish was thoughtfully prepared, and you could truly appreciate the quality of the ingredients in every bite.

A special thank you to Be Be, my waitress, who made the experience even more exceptional. She was attentive, professional, genuinely kind, and provided such warm, thoughtful service throughout the evening.

Highly recommend — I’ll definitely be back!

I had my first experience with Sappeisan last night and it was amazing! The food was great- my table ordered the curry prawn, braised spicy ribs and 4 pc skewers. My favorite is the curry prawn, it’s just so tasty! I also like the dessert a lot - a whole coconut with ice cream and sticky rice. My server, whose name is Noon is awesome! He’s funny, easy-going and just so nice! He helped me scooped out the coconut flesh from the coconut. Highly recommend this place and will come here again to try new stuff next time.

Sappeisan is hands down the best Thai restaurant I’ve ever been to (and Thai is my favorite cuisine). Don’t waste your money at Thai Diner or Thai Villa. They don’t have the “usual” dishes of curries and drunken noodles. Rather, it felt more authentic. My favorite was the rice noodles (Sen Yai Buk)— made in a tomato based sauce with a very deep flavor. Slight spice, slight sweetness. And the Khao soi was almost as good as I’ve had in Surat: hearty coconut curry with tender noodles. The fried quail eggs were a delicious appetizer: boiled and fried in a wafer-like crisp (not super hard or crunchy). The savory dipping sauce had a very familiar flavor that I couldn’t put my finger on. The drinks themselves well exceeded my expectations. The miss dolly and rue were both very, very well-balanced cocktails with unique flavor profiles. All the right ingredients in the right portions. I would come back here just for the drinks, and definitely for the food!

Some dishes were great while others weren’t our favorites. We were a group of 3 and came pretty hungry so we were ready to order a lot of items. We started with the wings zaab which were amazing! The seasoning was perfect and it was so flavorful and delicious. As items were ready they would bring them to the table. We had the yum pu dong which was fermented blue crab, Mok kala which was a thick crab curry/paste, Pla rim khong which was branzino, green curry with grilled chicken, and Lek plara gai which was a noodle dish with chicken.

Out of everything the wings and Lek plara gai were my favorites. The noodles were delicious and a really good sauce mixed in. I also did like the green curry but it was a typical curry dish. The rest of the dishes weren’t our favorite, but they have such a large menu that I’d be open to coming back and trying more

I really like eating at Sappeisan. The food never misses, and the atmosphere is really fun. The restaurant is always bustling, so definitely make a reservation in advance. My friend and I ate here on a Friday night at 8:30 pm and, even with a reservation, had to wait a couple minutes for a table to be set up. We both ordered a Thai iced tea, which tasted amazing and super creamy. We shared a wing zaab as an appetizer. The fried marinated chicken wings were tangy and sweet at the same time. We also split a mama e-la and a khao soi gao yang. The mama e-la was garlicky and well-seasoned. The beef melted in my mouth! The khao soi gao yang is probably my favorite dish from here. The chicken is always tender, and the sauce is perfectly nutty and creamy. I would highly recommend this restaurant to all my friends!

name: Russ & Daughters
document: Russ & Daughters. cuisine: Bagels Bakeries Seafood. located in Manhattan. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
I finally got a chance to stop by Russ & Daughters, and now I totally understand why it’s such an iconic New York institution. Stepping inside, the whole place has this classic, timeless, old-school deli vibe, like walking back into a genuine piece of history. All the beautiful fish and items displayed behind the counter are stunning. In true New York fashion, they move fast, so definitely come prepared to order!

The food quality here is absolutely next level. Everything they serve is incredibly fresh and flavorful. I went with a classic, getting the salmon sandwich on an everything bagel, and the fish was just exceptional—so fresh, packed with flavor, and sliced generously. The classic bagels and spreads are a perfect complement, with the cream cheese being so good it honestly steals the show! You truly get a lot of food for what you order, making the whole experience feel completely worthwhile and a great value.

I did notice that because they are so popular, the service can feel slightly slow when they are slammed, but honestly, the quality of the smoked fish and the authentic atmosphere more than make up for any wait time. Russ & Daughters is a must-visit for anyone who appreciates top-tier smoked fish and an authentic deli experience. It’s sought out by locals for a reason, and I can't wait to go back.

The lox here was good, but the bagel was not

When people bring up the best bagel & lox sandwich in NYC, this place comes up occasionally. However, having had it, when you only do half that
equation well, I don't think you can be in consideration

On the positive side, the smoked salmon was pretty appetizing. It tasted very fresh and had a great salt level. It did feel a bit thin in the context of the bagel, though,
like there wasn't that much of it. The cream cheese was fine, but nothing out-of-this-world.
The bagel was where I had a big problem. It was so chewy, so not-fresh, that it was not easy to eat. I could tell after my first bite that this was nothing like the other fresh bagels I've had in the city. It just tasted like it was baked a long time ago, and transported to the restaurant.
I had to give up on eating this as a sandwich and eventually had to eat it like an open-faced bagel on each half, because of how I just couldn't deal with having that much bad bagel in a single bite. It was just not good.

The other thing I've heard people say is the right thing is just to buy the smoked salmon from here, buy a bagel from somewhere else, and make your own DIY bagel & lox. After having this, I would recommend that as well.

It cost $18 - which is not terrible, and the portion size is pretty good, but I wouldn't call this a value either

Overall, it's some good lox mixed with a pretty bad bagel. 5/10

Just heaven on earth!
I recently visited Russ & Daughters and had the most unbelievable Pastrami Russ. The pastrami-cured salmon on an everything bagel, paired with mustard and sauerkraut, was an absolute revelation, bold, perfectly balanced, and unforgettable. I even brought some of their chocolate-dipped coconut macaroons back home to Texas and can’t wait to try them. Truly a must-visit and highly recommended!

Take a number when you walk in the door. The bagels here are top notch and there are plenty of high end options for toppings, take home items and sides. The pickles are some of the best I've ever had and the lox cream cheese is unbelievable. We are our bagels across the street in the park, it's take out only.

I researched where a NY visitor could find a classic Jewish deli and Russ & Daughters did not disappoint.  This deli has been around since the 1920’s with fun memorabilia to show the history.  On a Friday at 11am, we had no wait because we sat at the bar, but there was not much of a line for a seat. The menu had many yummy dishes almost all included salmon and other traditional cured fish.  If you love fish in your food, you will love Russ & Daughters as they do not skimp on the portions.  This was a great NYC breakfast icon that is worth the trip.

document: Zou Zou’s. cuisine: Mediterranean Cocktail Bars New American. located in Manhattan. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: Five stars all around, genuinely one of the most memorable dining experiences I’ve had. Amazingly delicious food, great service, lively ambience and beautiful decor. You can’t go wrong with anything here. We came here for a birthday brunch and had the best time. Would recommend for special occasions, especially if you happen to be seated at the booths!

For three dishes totaling over $85 after tax, I expected a level of quality and professionalism that was simply not delivered.

The tuna tartare clearly had freshness issues. It had a strong fishy smell and taste, and the seasoning did nothing to balance or mask it. Fresh tuna should taste clean and delicate — this did not.

The cheese had an obvious burnt smell and a noticeable bitter flavor, likely from being overheated. The appearance was messy and unappetizing, showing little care in preparation and presentation.

The sweet potatoes were severely overcooked, falling apart into a mushy paste. There was no real plating effort — sauce was sloppily scattered, and even the sweet potatoes themselves looked low quality and irregular.

Overall, the food showed a lack of professionalism and care from the kitchen. Serving dishes like this at this price point is completely unacceptable. I would not return, nor would I recommend this restaurant to others.

google_reviews.text: We had dinner at La Grande Boucherie last night and had an amazing experience! Our appetizers and entree were cooked to perfection, and the cocktails were fantastic! For our appetizer, we ordered the Soup À Lòignon and the prime steak tartare. For our entree, we had the Côte de Boeuf Pour Deux with pommes purée as a side. For dessert, we ordered the crème brûlée. Everything was wonderful! Our server was so sweet and very attentive! The restaurant is gorgeous inside. The perfect date night spot in NYC! I highly recommend La Grande Boucherie and look forward to visiting again soon!

La Grande Boucherie offers a beautiful dining experience (hello vaulted ceilings!) that blends atmosphere, service, and standout dishes. We were lucky to have Daniela as our server, and she truly made the evening special—warm, attentive, and genuinely kind throughout the meal.

The beef bourguignon was absolutely amazing: rich, deeply flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The salmon was also very good and well-prepared. Unfortunately, the lobster pasta fell short of expectations—it was quite bland and not worth the price point, especially compared to the other dishes.

The drink menu deserves special praise. They offer both alcoholic and non-alcoholic cocktails, and both were excellent—creative, balanced, and clearly crafted with care.

Lastly, the view elevated the entire experience. We sat upstairs, yes the tables were really squished in so my back was almost right against the person behind me, but the setting was really beautiful, adding a sense of elegance and charm to the meal. Overall, La Grande Boucherie is a wonderful spot with great service, memorable food highlights, and a stunning atmosphere, even if one dish missed the mark.

The restaurant is very stylish and unique. The music and ambiance are great. I definitely recommend making a reservation in advance.

We chose the Caesar salad and the prime NY steak & frites. The fries were amazing, the steak was cooked exactly as we requested, and the accompanying sauce was outstanding.

For dessert, we had crème brûlée and profiteroles — both were delicious. The only thing I didn’t enjoy was the “La Vie en Rose” cocktail; it lacked flavor.

Other than that, the food, atmosphere, and service were excellent. Special thanks to Mr. Ozzy for his warm hospitality and for taking such great care of us.

Such an amazing experience. This restaurant is absolutely beautiful, the patio has beautiful indoor views, especially with the holiday decor, but be aware that the patio is very cold during the winter time, even though it is "in doors" it is not very temperature controlled. Inside there is also great seating in front of the bar and upstairs with views below. The food was also deliscios but the drinks stole the show, they were very uniquely crafted and insanely good. Our server Ryan provides us great recommendation and amazing service. There is a lot of great food in NYC but this has now become one of my favorite places, I will be back.

We had the most beautiful dinner at La Grande Boucherie in New York City. Tucked like a dream between Sixth and Seventh Avenue, Boucherie feels almost unreal at first sight, a shimmering mirage of old-world Paris in the heart of Midtown.

Inspired by the free-spirited charm and artistry of the Belle Époque, Boucherie blends the indulgence of a classic steakhouse with the elegance of a refined French brasserie. Founder Emil Stefkov imagined a space where craftsmanship means something, where French artisanship and American architecture could meet and make magic. It feels both timeless and modern, full of intention and reverence, a place where good food is treated like a celebration of life itself.

I’m a sucker for a prix fixe menu, so of course we went that route. Caesar salads to start, perfectly made, complete with that tiny sardine perched on top the way it’s meant to be. I ordered the steak Diane, TJ went for steak and frites, and both were perfection. The desserts were unforgettable, but I’ll be dreaming about that crème brûlée.

TJ had a Manhattan, and I ordered the Phoenix from the cocktail menu. Every sip felt like a warm, sweet burst of fire, a little moment of alchemy. The staff was wonderful too, and I even left with a small gift, a beautiful book about La Grande Boucherie that made the night feel all the more special.

One of the best dining experiences we’ve ever had in New York City, especially in Midtown. A perfect evening in every way.

google_reviews.text:
In the city for Christmas, we opted for a change of pace in cuisine, and are so glad we walked into Nerai on East 54th St. Marketed as "refined Greek cuisine", we now know what they mean! A beautiful interior with clean lines and subdued lighting, this is visually a gem. Our waitress Marina was delightfully bubbly and helpful as we navigated the menu.  We took the hightop tables by the bar, which were booth-like with amply sized oval tables.
The bar served up two excellent margaritas and Old Fashioneds, just the way we like them. We started with the thinly-sliced fried zucchini chips, which were some of the best we've ever had: feather light & crispy. Our mains were seared salmon,  cooked perfectly to temperature, served with a rice/spinach mix that was such a nice pairing; and the diver scallops, grilled with porkbelly - so savory and delicious! - served with corn and red pepper were amazing! For dessert, we thoroughly enjoyed their hand-rolled baklava served with pistachio ice cream, plus cappuccinos.
Overall, the restaurant had a very upbeat vibe that was supported by a super friendly staff (Marina, plus hostess Kristiana among the stars). We will return after the holidays to sample more of the menu and spend time with our new friends!

We walked into Nerai on a Saturday evening with no reservation and had an absolutely incredible experience!

The ambiance is cozy, chic and there is enough room to move throughout the restaurant freely (so many NYC restaurants are too tiny). The servers were very attentive and kind.

I got the loukoumi drink which was incredible. It’s heavy on the rose so it was very floral-y. I enjoyed it. The complimentary bread with olive dip was insanely addictive. We aren’t even fans of olives and we loved it.

We started with the spanakopita. Flaky, savory and the tzatziki added a nice freshness. The grilled octopus was our favorite dish. The caramelized onions and peppers added sweetness, paired with the charcoaled octopus and santorini fava… the dish was so well balanced and every flavor complimented one another. Absolute must order.

The salmon entree was cooked perfectly as well. There was a nice crisp on top and crispy leeks, on a bed of spinach rice. Adding the santorini fava from the grilled octopus dish = FIRE!

They brought out a complimentary piece of cake for my birthday, which was very sweet. This is a great place to dine and I highly recommend it!

My husband and I were there to celebrate our anniversary! The food was amazing!! Everything on the menu was amazing from our appetizer to our starter to our entrée! I left there, knowing that I would come back and definitely eat here again!… all the staff was friendly and did an amazing job too!

document: Chubby Cattle. cuisine: Barbeque Japanese. located in Manhattan. with 4.3 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: Chubby Cattle was such a fun experience for my first hot pot! We couldn’t reserve a table for 2 but were able to be seated right away on a Saturday evening. The staff took the time to explain the iPad ordering and the self-serve station, which was helpful. Though, for first-timers, it would help to have a sheet or guidebook for tips on how to have a successful hot pot experience (ex: order of vegetables versus meat versus noodles, timing, etc.) Thankfully, I was with an expert and we hade a great time. We got the basic package and got the wagyu, pork and chicken with a lot of veggies (loved the pumpkin the most) and udon. The flavors were perfect from the broth and the staff was very kind in providing extra utensils, like tongs and forks. And, the cocktails were super delicious and priced really affordably (I’d recommend the apricot and the lychee drinks). I would love to return with a larger group and try more broths and use more of their self-service items!

The Food

The quality of the meat was top-tier. Everything was incredibly fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. If you are looking for high-quality Wagyu and a unique hot pot/BBQ experience, this is the place to be.

The Service (Shout-out to Nicolas!)

What made the night truly special was the service. A huge thank you to Nicolas! He went above and beyond to make sure we had a great time. He was extremely helpful, providing clear explanations of the menu and guiding us on how to get the best flavors out of our meal.

I went to Chubby Cattle in November 2025, as I liked the idea of being able to eat good-quality meat at a relatively affordable price. Unfortunately, my experience took a turn when I was served raw fried chicken. I had already eaten about half of it before realizing it was undercooked, which is obviously a serious food safety issue.

I told the server right away, to which he took the dish back and gave me a 20% discount. I felt slightly nauseous afterward and completely lost my appetite, so I wasn’t able to enjoy the rest of the meal I had paid a lot of money for. Given the situation, the 20% discount did not feel adequate. The server also barely apologized, which added to my frustration.

The AYCE wagyu concept is appealing, but this experience made me very concerned about how food is being handled. I asked to speak with a manager at the restaurant, but none were available. I also called a few days later to request a callback from a manager and never heard back.

The broth was good, we got the house special and SukiYaki. The meat options were good. Good service. We got the basic hot pot deal. It is pricy but ultimately worth the money. Good option for foreigners and English speakers. The tablet used to order, if you haven't done it before, is a little hard to learn but someone will walk you through. Overall great experience. The only downside was the quality of the bathroom. It did not flush twice and the other did not have soap. There are two gender neutral bathrooms.

Meat quality is incredible and the servers are very nice, however, I think we caught Chubby Cattle late on a bad night. Various machines and serving stations were down, so we couldn't get bubble tea, most sodas or rice and certain items on the menu weren't available. Most of what we were able to get was very good, but at more than $100/ per person, I would expect that we would be able to get everything the restaurant has to offer, not most of it. We were also warned that some seating options would not be large enough to accommodate the meal, which I found strange. I've heard that the sushi restaurant above Chubby Cattle is excellent, so I'll have to give that a try next.

google_reviews.text: Absolutely, undeniably, incredibly spectacular!! We had 7:30PM reservations on 12/27 with two adults and three kids. Joe was so nice and kind; he knew us by name because we made the reservation directly with him. Nonna Maria herself greeted us and told us a bit about her. She was delightful! We ordered her perfectly made meatballs and scrumptious lasagna. We also ordered from the Puerto Rican menu (fried fish cod — it was delicious). The food was fantastic, the wait staff precise and friendly and the atmosphere was everything we expected. Our recommendation is to contact them via phone because reservations are always needed (and rightfully so — the food and people are amazing). This is worth every penny and we will be coming back again!  Remember!! It’s cash only! Thank you Joe & company!

We came in during the snowstorm getting lucky calling for a last minute reservation. If you have not been here please go. What a  idea to have different foods prepared by Nonnas. A delicious opportunity to try unique dishes from all over the world. The service was just beyond warm and inviting. I cannot wait to come back- already looking at the Nonnas calendar. YUMIKO thank you for coming and chatting with us- the chicken Katsu just wow- it was a privilege to meet you. We loved seeing you in the kitchen prepping!!  Everyone there was lovely. The burrata was so beyond creamy, basil so fresh, the meatballs were like my grandma made them - really I do not have enough words for this review !!!! Please go try. Staten Island gem.

I first heard about this place from a documentary, then saw the movie last year, had to make sure I got over to Staten Island for a bite. The food offered today was Italian, Japanese and Sri Lankan. It all looked amazing. The owner is still taking non-stop calls for reservations.  I was lucky to have gotten in since I came in on my own. I was sat at the counter and enjoyed watching all of the hustle and bustle in this cozy kitchen. The size helps you feel like you're waiting for your Mama to finish cooking your meal as you watch.
I ordered the lasagna which was very good, but really, the star of the meal was the fresh banana pudding. Never have I enjoyed such a delicious, creamy, well-balanced and fresh pudding. It was divine.
The cost is a little high but it is so worth it for the freshness. They serve some alcohols but they offer good pairings for the meals offered.
I am so happy to have been able to enjoy this meal I had waited so long for.
They only take cash and for now reservations are done in person or by phone. From what I heard they will soon have an online platform to do these. Also, they only take reservations on a rolling, monthly basis. If you get to go, I hope you enjoy it too.

The heart warming film staring an amazing cast made us want to come here to see it in ‘real life’ all the way from the UK 🇬🇧
It did not disappoint. We were greeted by the fabulous owner ‘Joey’ and we got to meet today’s ‘Nonnas’ who were cooking.
The food was of the highest quality and the service was second to none.
We had the Mozzarella starter which was beautifully presented and tasted superb.
For mains we had the lasagna and meatballs again absolutely top notch!
THIS FOOD IS MADE WITH LOVE ❤️ and that’s the difference…….
The wine is of excellent quality and it truly represents great value for money 💰
The service again gets a 10 out of 10 for us so well done 👏
We enjoy good  food and wine and Nonnas was as good if not better than anything we could ask for! Thank you Joey for your beautiful concept and following your dreams!
You are an inspiration.

Imagine a simpler time. You’re at your Italian friend’s grandmother’s house, where dinner is made the slow way because there’s nowhere else to be. It’s a long weekend, time is generous. You’ve already had her signature tipple, the one she still argues about with her doctor, and a little wine she schlepped back from Napoli.
Her Trini friend drops by, bringing family recipes and big energy, sharing stories and food with her adopted New Yorker grandkids (you and your goober friends). This table is everything: cozy, welcoming, eclectic.
You eat a hearty meal. She teaches you how to eat lamb brains, how to get every last bit of meat from the head. When you finish, she tells you she’s proud of you.
Then the bill comes, and some of the magic slips away. You take a little home with you.
This is what the world is supposed to be: a place where people are welcomed in, where differences are shared, and where you leave more open, more curious, more human than when you arrived. There’s plenty for everyone. We just have to learn how to share.

google_reviews.text:
Ubani is an NYC gem. Excellent, inviting ambiance. The staff here are professional, excellent, top-notch. (Georgian) wine, beer and global cocktails entirely on point. The food is incredibly fresh, flavorful and beautifully presented.

On top of all this, they perfectly weave in a bit of education about their food and culture, one which is beautiful and unique.

Where to begin, let’s just say when you go to Albani it’s more than just any other restaurant. It’s almost like becoming part of their family. The OWNER, Manager and every person that works there makes you feel right at home. The food is delicious, the service is exceptional. The experience is unlike any other. And let’s face it, there’s not many Georgian options in NYC. This is one of the best! And let’s not forget there’s always live music on Saturday nights to make this a special evening for friends, family, or a special date. Highly recommended.

I rarely if ever am surprised by new foods and flavors these days. Holy cow did that change with Ubani! The atmosphere is great, w live music and low lighting. Wait staff are all actual Georgians, and they were supremely helpful in ordering (needed because we had zero idea what to get). Food was incredible. I cannot recommend this enough. GO!!!!!

There seems to be a new Georgian restaurant every month these days. Ubani is a fine dining establishment with excellent service and great ambiance.

The wine list is extensive and varied, tried a terragon lemondade unique taste. A variety of cheesy Khachapuris on the menu to share, the sides are more typical american, Kharcho soup hit the spot in this cold weather. Waitress pushed the appetizer platter, but probably would have been too much for our table of 5 as many of the ladies needed doggie bags for their entrees.

The roasted chicken with pomegranate instead of blackberry sauce was delcicious, crispy skin, moist and sweet. Honey cake is not too sweet, nice and layered without needing to be soaked in syrup.

Our experience with Mariam was absolutely wonderful! She greeted us so warmly and made us feel right at home. Her service was perfect — friendly, professional, and full of care. You could feel her positive attitude in every little detail.

The food was fantastic! Everything tasted fresh and homemade, and the presentation was beautiful. The whole place had such a nice, cozy atmosphere, and Mariam’s kindness made it even better.

We truly appreciated her attention and the way she made the evening so special for us. Thank you, Mariam, for your kindness and for making our dinner unforgettable!

Raku: A Timeless Experience Defined by Consistency and Excellence

​Raku Japanese restaurant isn't just a place we eat; it's a true culinary constant in our lives. Having been loyal patrons for many years, we can confidently attest that the quality here has been unfailingly high—it’s been consistently good every single time, a rarity in the dining scene.

​The entire dining experience begins with the atmosphere. The ambiance is wonderfully cozy, creating a relaxed and intimate space that feels both welcoming and refined. Matched perfectly with the setting is the excellent service. The staff is attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely focused on making every visit special, which is a major reason for our lasting loyalty.

​While every dish at Raku is prepared with care, our personal gold standard—the dish we measure all others by—is the Tuna Tartare. We've tried this classic appetizer at countless other highly-regarded restaurants over the years, but they are simply not the same. Raku’s version achieves a perfect balance of texture and flavor that is unmatched, proving its uniqueness and mastery in preparation. It’s an absolute must-try for any first-time visitor.

​For anyone seeking exceptional Japanese cuisine backed by years of unwavering quality, fantastic service, and a dish that truly stands out, Raku is the place to be.

On the other hand it has some very impressive artwork and if it matches your budget they are more than happy to pack them up for you.

This is a very nice Asian fusion Chinese restaurant with a great atmosphere, but you need to make reservations in advance. Overall, the flavors are very solid.

I highly recommend their Foie Gras Custard (Foie Gras Steamed Egg) — it was incredibly rich, and the addition of mushrooms enhanced the overall umami.

However, the Foie Gras on Toast set had a slight flaw: the toast was a bit over-charred, which slightly overpowered the dish, and the Eel component was hard to taste.

The Lamb Ribs were decent but nothing extraordinary. The strong barbecue glaze slightly masked the natural flavor of the meat, though the preparation was quite creative.

The Kung Pao Quail was tasty and innovative — so tender that you wouldn’t even guess it was quail.

The Black Cod Clay Pot with Rice was rather average, nothing remarkable.

Overall, this restaurant is quite innovative. The flavors and techniques are authentic while keeping the creative fusion style. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a unique dining experience.

I went here with my friends, and everything this restaurant served deserves a standing ovation!
The food is amazingly good—every dish comes with beautiful presentation, and you can really tell they use high-quality ingredients. I loved everything; even their simple cucumber salad was incredible—spicy, fresh, nutty, and perfectly balanced.

I absolutely love this place! The ambience is great, and our server was very friendly and attentive. If you’re looking for a restaurant that serves food made with love, you must visit 53.

Shout-out to Chef Mark, Chef Adam, and the entire team for the amazing food. Highly recommended! ❤️

The food and environment were very nice tho overpriced imo. It’s not a quiet place so expect to talk loudly. Unfortunately the main negative was the spotty service. A restaurant like this needs to do better than with accommodating guest food restrictions by making the experience feel seamless. My partner is Celiac, so gluten is an absolute no. When booking, I made sure to add that to the dietary restrictions section. The lady at the front acknowledge that when we walked in. I would expect that at a restaurant like this, our waiter would also know by the time we get to the table, but he didn’t and we told him ourselves, no problem. He was kind enough to outline on the menu which items he thought were gluten-free, so we only ordered from his list. When the clay pot arrived with table side finish, I had a hunch and decided to triple check with the chef if the soy sauce was infact gluten free… it wasn’t… that is unacceptable considering the potential severity of reactions that Celiacs can have to gluten. The chef was kind enough to take the dish back and remake it with GF soy sauce. It was quite disappointing to see that not only the staff failed to communicate such details, but when specifically told, our waiter failed to communicate that to the kitchen.

I don’t think I expected too much considering that it’s a health concern and this is not a cheap restaurant. I would not expect this at a small casual spot. But a $$$$ restaurant needs to do much better on service to justify its prices on a bowl of rice with a small pice of fish.

Interesting restaurant with good food and friendly staff. I really liked the ground-floor interior — simple yet elegant.
The main dining area, however, is two levels down, so it feels like a basement with no windows or fresh air. While the design is tasteful, you do get the sense of sitting in a box.
The staff were genuinely helpful and warm, not robotic, which made the experience pleasant. The food was tasty and well-prepared.
Overall, it’s a nice place for a business dinner or a quiet evening meal.

Excellent experience at this restaurant. We went for dinner, feom the beggining we loved the ambience and look of the place. We ordered cucumber salad as a starter and followed ordering  4 more dishes, our server explained very well the menu options and her suggestions were perfect in taste and quantity. Everything was delicious, we ended our dinner with an exquisite dark chocolate desert accompanied by a famous monk coctail. Will return on future trips to NY to keep trying other menu options.

My experience at Mēdüzā Mediterrania was truly outstanding. From the moment we arrived, the ambiance was elegant yet comfortable, creating the perfect setting for a memorable dining experience.

The food was absolutely incredible. In fact, it was so good that I could barely take pictures before I started eating. Every dish was beautifully presented and full of rich Mediterranean flavors. It was clear that a lot of attention and care went into both the preparation and presentation of each plate.

The service made the experience even better. Petty, our server, was spectacular—attentive, professional, and very knowledgeable about the menu. Collin, the back server, was also amazing and made sure everything at our table ran smoothly throughout the night. In addition, the management team was always attentive, checking in regularly to make sure everything was going well, which showed how much they care about their guests’ experience.

As a side note, they also have a Macallan 25 available, which is definitely a must-try. It complements the overall dining experience perfectly and is something any whisky enthusiast would appreciate.

Overall, Mēdüzā Mediterrania provides exceptional food, excellent service, and a very welcoming atmosphere. It is definitely a place I would recommend to anyone looking for a high-quality Mediterranean dining experience.

Went for dinner Thursday night and enjoyed everything! The ambience was amazing and the food made it even better. Everything was delicious. Also, Alfredo was attentive and kind. We had reservations and had to wait at the bar for everyone to arrive before being seated. Once everyone arrived, we still waited approx 15min. The Violinist was a lovely touch as well! She was very kind and played lovely! I would highly recommend for a date night vibe or a group outing.

Finally found a Halal upscale restaurant to spend birthday’s & special events! We orders the garlic hummus, wagyu kafta, chicken Milanese, ribeye top cut(the only steak option that’s halal), batata parra, and espresso noir. Everything was delicious but could’ve skipped batata parra as side. We were so full but finished the dessert within few minutes. Would recommend coming here!

We had a really lovely dinner at Mēdüzā.

The space itself is beautiful, the textured walls look like frozen waves, and it already sets the mood before the food arrives.

Our server was a huge plus!! She explained the menu in a very thoughtful way and helped us build the meal around the mains, which made the whole dinner feel well-paced and intentional.

The hamachi was a great start, clean, delicate, with olive oil, herbs, fried capers, and tomato bringing in layers of texture and freshness. The spiced prawns were smoky, firm, and clearly very fresh. The petite filet was simple and elegant, seasoned only with salt and truffle, and cooked perfectly, though the portion is on the smaller side for the price. The grilled branzino was a standout: crispy on the outside, moist and flavorful inside, definitely more delicious than it looks.

For dessert, the olive oil cake was sweet and addictive, with orange and cardamom, which was light, fragrant, and not overly sweet.

Overall, a very solid Mediterranean spot with thoughtful service and well-executed dishes. Would definitely come back.

Really nice spot for a date night. The space is cozy and beautiful with great lighting and atmosphere. Loved the filet (super tender), the hamachi was fresh, and the wagyu kafta was really flavorful. The olive oil cake for dessert was so good too. Would definitely come back.

name: Forgione
document: Forgione. cuisine: New American. located in Manhattan. with 4.7 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
Everything was so perfect.
The breakfast before dinner concept with a mini bagel as pre-appetizer…
The crunchyness of the bread for duck in a jar.
The chewiness of the pasta.
The ambiance.
The service!
Thank you so much for a wonderful experience!!

I’m not sure why the signage & menu’s say Forge & online it’s called Forgione.  I know it’s the owners name.  This was really the only hiccup I had.

I decided to meet up here upon advice, and with a close friend who, like me are pseudo foodies with a carnivorous appetite that day.  I’ve read great reviews and was impressed that this chef has/had Michelin Star ratings.

You’ll spend serious green back here, so be prepared.  Although some plates are in the triple digits, it’s really not that uncommon…at least with steakhouses.  For some it included several pairing dishes.  This would make great location for a power lunch during the day or date night.

This lower Manhattan location is well kept and quite close to other sites.

I found the pacing & some typical etiquette slightly off key in some cases.  It’s really not a big deal, but it stuck out.

Food wise a lot of detail went into plating & rich savory dishes that were certainly bespoke.  The Tomahawk steak shareable was impressive as it was timed well and rendered in a nice blend of butter, oil, & spices…memorable.  We didn’t order a lot of dishes, but enjoyed what we had.

The menu selection is small, yet offered a nice balance of poultry, beef, & fish.  It’s a bit comical as the food section felt hidden amongst the drink selection.  Note, you’ll find an wider, higher end range of spirits to pair or enjoy solo.

Would I go here again and recommend?  Yes.  I’m no Andrew Bourdain, however like him I’ve traversed the globe several times, trying to savor the taste of the different regions.  This isn’t my first Michelin-esque eatery.  I’ll say this, impressive.  Enjoy.

Since 2016, we have had the pleasure of dining at your original location on Reade St. This visit marked our first experience at the new location, which is truly breathtaking. Our friends from Ireland, who joined us for dinner last night during their honeymoon, said it the finest dinner they had ever had. We wholeheartedly agree. The cuisine was absolutely exquisite! The service, food, and ambiance were, as always, exceptional and consistent. Our server, Molly, was outstanding and charismatic. She kept us laughing throughout the evening and was on top of asking about food allergies, which was very important since I recently developed allergies to hazelnuts. The entire team, including the lovely hostesses that greeted us with a warm welcome, Mez, Griffin, Darren, and Robert, provided attentive service, ensuring our every need was met. Your team is truly exceptional. We eagerly anticipate our next visit. Excellent job, Chef Forgione!

We really enjoyed our dinner at Forgione last night. Loved the chili lobster as well as the rabbit tartare appetizer special. The monkfish and pork chop were excellent as well. Great seasonal drinks and fun vibrant atmosphere. Service was attentive and friendly. We will definitely return.

We had an amazing experience at Forgione. From the moment we walked in, the host set the tone with a warm welcome and great service that carried through the entire evening.

The food was outstanding; the ravioli and spaghetti were perfectly prepared, the steak was cooked beautifully, and the egg dessert was one of the highlights of the night (creative, delicious, and memorable). Every dish felt thoughtful and elevated, and the atmosphere was relaxed yet special.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for incredible food paired with genuinely attentive service.

name: The Thonglor New York
document: The Thonglor New York. cuisine: Thai. located in Manhattan. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Hadn’t planned the visit but wow we were very happy we did! Amazing food probably the best and most flavoursome masaman curry we have had and that’s from the UK versus US. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend - will definitely return

We were headed to another restaurant entirely when we passed this place and my Husband was interested in checking it out. We popped on Google and checked the reviews. Plans changed and we suggest you make this place part of your plans. Everything was delicious and they were so friendly! The apps were crispy and filled with flavor. The salad was very refreshing and the beef cooked so well. I can't rave about the soup enough, I love broth and pork belly and it was perfect and spicy and just sooo good. The menu is huge, I suggest you just go with your gut and make a quick decision. I'm sure the whole menu is amazing and can't wait to go back and try more.

We absolutely love this place. The food is very authentic. It’s a small location, but they do a great job of getting you your order relatively quickly. Everything is very delicious and some people were even waiting outside because of how good the food is. There were also a lot of delivery orders we could see your people coming for takeout. I highly recommend you trying this place. It can get very busy around dinner time so come before then or a little bit after like around 7:30 p.m..

A great spot for newcomers to Thai cuisine—the spice levels are mild, making it easy to explore the flavors without feeling overwhelmed. That said, as someone who enjoys more authentic Thai heat, I found the curry lacking the punch I was hoping for. The dish was still tasty, but I was left wanting deeper, more complex flavor notes.

The atmosphere is cheerful and inviting, with golden decor and traditional Thai music that help create a culturally immersive experience.

The staff were exceptionally friendly and attentive, adding to the overall warmth of the visit

Super cute small place restaurant in Hell’s Kitchen. The food was delicious and had a lot more variety in the menu. I ordered the Khao Soi Moo Krob (pork belly thai curry noodles) and Kaeng Phed Ped Yang (crispy duck red curry).

The Khao Soi Moo Krob was so delicious, a perfect balance of sweet, spicy, and tangy. The pork belly stayed crispy in the broth.

Loved the Kaeng Phed Ped Yang too. The bell peppers and pineapple kept the curry sweet and flavorful. The duck was nice and tender.

There are a lot of fancy/fusion thai restaurants in the city now, but ThongLor keeps the authenticity at an affordable price and adding a lot of unique dishes. Need to try more dishes!

name: Parker & Quinn
document: Parker & Quinn. cuisine: New American Bars Breakfast & Brunch. located in Manhattan. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Parker & Quinn was a total win. We started with espresso martinis and they were perfect, smooth, strong, and not overly sweet. Easily some of the better ones I’ve had.

The PQ Burger was unreal, cooked perfectly with great flavor and the fries were on point. The Hangover Hash bowl was just as impressive, hearty, packed with flavor, and exactly what you want when you’re craving something satisfying.

Service was excellent from start to finish and the bar atmosphere is awesome. Great energy without feeling chaotic. Definitely a spot I’d go back to anytime I’m in NYC.

We had a great dinner here. We were quickly seated and drink order taken. Service was beyond incredible with great recommendations and quick service. Every food item ordered was delicious. We stayed for cappuccino and dessert. The steak frites, burger, cheesecake and churro cake were all amazing.

Cute place! Came here they have a small but good menu. The Mac n cheese with bacon was so good! Creamy and flavorful and lots of sauce! The spinach artichoke was the BEST I have had. They added garlic and a nice crumble on top. Soooooo good! Super creamy. My steak frites were cooked perfectly and super flavorful! My husband got the burger and he liked it. The brussel sprouts were good too until the end where I tasted balsalmic. I’m not a fan of that but before I tasted it they were sooo good with the maple! The mashed potatoes were so soft and delicious! My BIL steak was delicious! The tomatoes on the vine were just lush! My MIL braised ribs were so tender! The pinapple frizz drink was super resheshing! The cookie skillet was wonderful and gooey! The churro cake wasn’t my thing but it was good. Lots of cinnamon. The cheesecake was good too but not my fave bc of texture. I’m a picky and sensitive eater. Would def come back!

Parker & Quinn has quickly become one of my favorite spots in NYC. The atmosphere is incredible—warm, stylish, and full of character. The vintage-inspired décor, cozy lighting, and beautifully designed space make it feel both timeless and inviting. It’s the perfect blend of classic New York charm and modern comfort.

The food is outstanding. Every dish we tried was excellent—from the perfectly blistered Margherita pizza to the sliders, mac & cheese, and charcuterie board. We also had the cowboy steaks and some cocktails (no photos of those), and they were equally fantastic—rich, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. You can tell the kitchen really cares about quality and flavor. It’s the kind of place where you start planning your next visit before you’ve even finished your meal.

If you're coming with a group, the raised booths are fantastic—comfortable, private, and spacious, making them ideal for birthdays, dinners with friends, or just a more intimate night out. The bar seating and counter by the open kitchen also add a great energy to the space.

The staff is equally impressive. Everyone we interacted with was friendly, attentive, and incredibly responsive. Drinks arrived quickly, plates were timed perfectly, and they were always nearby if you needed anything without ever feeling intrusive. Excellent service really does elevate the whole experience, and Parker & Quinn nails it.

Whether you're looking for a relaxed dinner, a lively night out, or just a beautiful setting with consistently great food and service, this place checks every box. Highly recommend!

We needed a place to have lunch before we seeing  Sean Hayes’s Broadway show - The Unknown. After a quick on-line search and checking reviews we ended up at Parker and Quinn.

We made a reservation and arrived on-time. Upon entering P&Q, we waiting at the hostess stand as TWO people stood behind the stand talking and DID NOT acknowledge us for what seemed like 5 minutes.

The 5 star service review is for our server. She was kind, patient and beyond accommodating.

P&Q would have received an overall 5 star review had we been greeted immediately -

The food is good. The omelette was picture perfect and the fluffiest omelette you could ask for.

The atmosphere has a cool vibe.

I don’t live in the city, if I did, P&Q is not a place I would go to a second time.

Maybe this experience was just a one off, or maybe it wasn’t.

Your call 😎

name: Il Corso
document: Il Corso. cuisine: Italian Wine Bars. located in Manhattan. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: We recently stumbled upon this charming little spot, looking for a quick pre-theater dinner, and were pleasantly surprised. We sampled the homemade pasta pomadoro and homemade pappardelle with lamb Ragu. Both were excellent. The side of broccoli rabe was prepared perfectly and very tasty. We finished with a homemade pistachio tart with a scoop of vanilla gelato. It was absolutely delicious. A great experience!

Walked in with very high expectations based on the reviews—and not only did the restaurant deliver, it exceeded every one of them. The space is cozy, the staff is amazing, and the food was outstanding from start to finish.

We began with appetizers, and the zucchini fries were simply amazing. The fritto misto platter could have used a bit more calamari, but what was there was cooked to perfection. The pasta dishes were perfectly portioned, and the entrées were absolutely beautiful when they arrived—every dish was spot on.

We had our hearts set on tiramisu for dessert, but unfortunately they had run out for the night. That aside, I truly don’t have much to suggest in terms of improvement—other than maybe a little more calamari.

I’m already looking forward to coming back in the summer or when the weather is nicer to try more items on the menu. After chatting with a few regulars who assured me this place lives up to the hype, I can confidently say they were right.

Keep up the great work—you should be incredibly proud to deliver this level of service and food, especially on Christmas Eve!

Fantastic! We came here after the parade on Thanksgiving, and even on a busy day they didn’t miss a beat. This is the cutest little Italian restaurant. And our meal and service was perfection from start to finish. The worst part about dining here is trying to decide what to order on their amazing menu. They have so many great choices, and unique dishes that are different from other typical Italian restaurants. We truly enjoyed our experience here, and are looking forward to returning.

Gennaro and his incredible team continue to out perform themselves. This was my second time visiting NYC and of course, it would not be a trip without dining at Il Corso. Absolutely incredible experience, cocktails, and food is authentic and delicious. I truly cannot thank them enough for their wonderful hospitality. Looking forward to the next visit! Thank you!!

This restaurant is absolutely incredible! I had the best pasta of my life here - every bite was pure perfection. The flavors, the atmosphere, the attention to detail - everything was just outstanding. It truly deserves all the Michelin stars in the world. I can’t wait to come back!

google_reviews.text:
Cassie’s the best bartender. Can’t hate unless you make up reasons to be a hater!

Food is always fantastic beer selection if phenom!

perfect place to stop for a beer before a show

Lilly’s Craft and Kitchen was an incredible experience and the perfect way to end our trip to NYC. We visited during the holidays and this was our final brunch before heading home. The food was amazing and I still think about the banana foster pancakes to this day. They were absolutely unforgettable.

Our waitress was outstanding and kept the mimosas coming. We never had an empty glass the entire time we were there. The service was warm, attentive, and truly made the experience even better. I really wish I remembered her name because she was that memorable. My friends all tipped on their cards but I had planned to leave a cash tip and completely forgot. After we left, I actually called the restaurant in tears asking if I could send it to her through Cash App or another way. She insisted it was fine, which made me appreciate her kindness even more. The mimosas definitely got to me that day but I genuinely hope to return and thank her properly.

The prices were also exceptional and worth every penny. From the food to the drinks to the service, everything was spot on. I highly recommend stopping by if you are looking for a standout brunch spot in the city.
The bartender Cassie was on point..service was great , food delicious, drinks strong & plentiful. Come by with those you love & drink , eat & be happy.🍺🍻🍷🍸🍹🥂🍔🌭🌮🌯🥙🥗

We went to Lilly’s for bottomless brunch with a group of 9 and had the best time! Riley and Katie are the best server/bartender duo! It is obvious that they love what they do and they made our experience truly amazing. Also highly recommend the prosciutto benedict!

Really nice and chill spot on the West side. We were pleasantly greeted when we walked in the door by our server. The food was excellent and very reasonable for a family of 5 to enjoy a nice meal. We would definitely go back. Quick walk from TSQ as well.

name: The Smith
document: The Smith. cuisine: New American Breakfast & Brunch Cocktail Bars. located in Manhattan. with 3.9 stars (good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text:
Food here was really good. Stopped by with a friend on a random weekday and this place was packed. We ordered everything from the calamari, spicy salmon tartare, braised short rib mafaldine, bistro burger and the honeycrisp apple pie. The calamari had some surprising additions, but very delicious and a must order if you love calamari. The salmon tartare was really fresh and tasty. The mafaldine was cooked al dente and the short rib you could tell was slowly braised for hours.

My friend and I really enjoyed our experience here. The ambience is very warm, bright and definitely loud. If you want a private more intimate place this may not be it unless you have a private dining room. The servers were attentive and I loved how they bring out still water and sparkling. Highly recommend making reservations in advance.

My family and I visited The Smith on a busy Sunday around 5 pm. Thankfully we had reservations, otherwise it may have been a bit of a wait. The atmosphere was lively, and the food was solid across the board.

We ordered the calamari, kids cheeseburger, the Smith burger, and the braised short rib mafaldine. Everything was well prepared, with the short rib mafaldine standing out as rich and comforting.

A nice touch was the fresh bread service and the option of house still or sparkling water. Our server was friendly, though service slowed at times due to the crowd.

Overall, The Smith is a reliable choice for good food.

My wife and I had dinner here on Thursday and had a wonderful time. We had great service. Allyne took great care of us during our meal.
Our cocktails were excellent. I had a Whiskey Sour and My wife had the Yozu Gimlet. Both were well-made and perfect.
We started with the oyster sampler and it was fantastic. If you like oysters, you should give it a try.
We shared the ribeye and it was perfectly cooked, flavorful, and very tender.
Dessert was the Sticky Toffee Pudding, which was to-die-for. Rich, but not too sweet, it was a great way to end the meal.
Overall, it was a good experience and well worth the visit.

This feels like the place to go for business dinners and celebration occasions, yet it's comfortable enough for friends to meet or a nice date night.

The food is really good.   It's not a huge menu, but what is served is really good.

We had two vegetarians in our group and each person had something different, and our burger loving friend was super happy.   My husband really loved the muscles...so lots of options for everyone.

The drink menu is extensive a d we all tried something new.  The ladies tried the elegant cocktails, the gentlemen, the whiskeys and bourbon.  Everyone enjoyed their drinks.

I would definitely recommend trying The Smiths the next time you need a great restaurant and a really good cocktail!

After a day at the Mall, we went to The Smith for lunch. We were seated immediately, and our server greeted us as we sat down although it was busy. The sourdough bread was very good. I opted to get the veggie burger which was moist and flavorful. The fries were crisp. My friend had the Vanilla Bean French Toast. I ordered the Cucumber Mule mocktail which was delicious. We went during brunch but would have loved a few more options on the menu. Overall the food, staff and atmosphere were impressive. Definitely recommend.

name: SUGARFISH | Midtown West
document: SUGARFISH | Midtown West. cuisine: Japanese Sushi Bars. located in Manhattan. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: Incredible sushi spot with amazing service and seriously fun, creative sushi bites. Everything was super fresh and beautifully prepared. What makes this place stand out is the Sugarfish menu concept you choose a set “path,” trust the chef, and enjoy the ride. Each course flows perfectly and keeps getting better. The unagi was served warm and absolutely incredible, and the toro nigiri was a true highlight. We loved it so much that during our trip we ended up coming back three times. The staff is attentive, explains everything clearly, and makes the whole experience feel effortless. After finishing the menu, you can also reorder any favorites from the regular menu, which is a great touch. The vibe is lively yet intimate a perfect spot for a date night. Highly recommended.

The sushi here is incredible! The sashimi is unbelievably fresh sweet, flavourful delicious. I also tried the unagi nigiri, and it was so tender that it genuinely took me by surprise. I’d absolutely order it again.

I also had the bay scallop and yellowfin cut rolls, and both were good. Even the seaweed stood out for its great texture and taste. Highly recommend this spot for anyone craving quality sushi!

I will note that we did wait over an hour for a table.

Great value for the quality you get. I do wish there were more fish variations, including unique options like squid. My only complaint is that I felt a bit rushed to finish each dish before the next one arrived. Overall, I enjoyed the food and would dine here again.

Great value for money with their “Nozawa Trust Me” lunch menu. Whilst the sushi was fresh, there were no real stand-out items; the New Zealand Sea Bream sushi with citrus salt and the Blue & Dungeness Crab hand roll were perhaps the closest. The sushi rice also disintegrated easily when picking up which was disappointing. Apple / Google Pay not accepted so ensure you have your physical cards or cash to pay with at the end.
Highly recommend the bay scallops handrolls and yellowtail handrolls! Would definitely be back for these two. Also tried the specials for the day, toro sashimi and anago. Both are delicious!

document: 1915 Lanzhou Hand Pulled Noodles. cuisine: Noodles Chinese Soup. located in Manhattan. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
I can definitely see why this place is a favorite. If you come around rush hour, expect a long line outside because it’s very popular. The food was so good and full of flavor. I ordered the signature Lanzhou beef noodle soup, and it was delicious with a very big portion, I couldn’t even finish it. The Langya fried potato strips were amazing and very tasty. The traditional pan pork fried buns were also delicious.
I also tried the beef Chinese hamburger and it was good. The sliced beef with chili sauce was very flavorful, and the meat was cooked perfectly.
They also have beer, sake, and soju if you want something to drink with your meal. The service was great even when pack and busy. I can see why this place is always packed and busy. I will definitely come back the next time I’m in Chinatown.

Arguably one of the hardest spots to get a seat at in Chinatown, Lanzhou definitely lives up to the hype. They open at 11 am, and we tried to get inside at 10:45 but were told to wait until 11, probably to keep everyone in line. The place quickly filled up after they opened the doors, but the staff was diligent and served us quickly. For a mini appetizer (but more so just cause I wanted to try it) we had the Chinese burger, which was great and super tasty. If I was to come back the burger would definitely be something I’d get again. For our noodles, we did pretty much one spicy version and one traditional version. I loved the flavor of the spice, and I found the balance with the broth to be perfect. The portions were great too, with more than enough to fill you up. The noodles had great texture, and you could taste the freshness in the rest of the ingredients. While coming back here is tricky with the crowds, I’d recommend it for someone trying to determine whether it’s worth it or not.

Best noodles I have ever had.  Perfectly aldente. Texture unmatched in all honesty. At first I was like oh should I have gotten a soup? Don't get me wrong the soups are great, but to really appreciate the noodles you don't need any broth. Very flavorful decent spice level. 👌 Will be back.

Walking around aimlessly in Chinatown was fun but I was looking for some grub when out of the corner of my eye 👁️ I spied this place and knew it was time..

Entered the establishment, it was very small but packed, not an empty seat in the house and a few people standing in the doorway, and sitting in the 5 chairs they have for incoming guests.

Was blown away by the vibe, the busy restaurant , the lively kitchen, the master noodle puller, the sight and smells were overwhelming.. I couldn’t wait to eat.. I wanted everything.  Food was hot and fresh, dumplings were stellar, pork filled buns were to die for, and that hot chili oil was  slappin.

Very impressed, would definitely go here again..

I checked in for the very first time a little while ago. I was really surprised by how good the food was. I ordered handmade braised beef noodles and a plate of potstickers. The noodle soup was extremely healing. The potstickers were clean and nice yet flavorful. The shop is small but the servers are helpful with keeping the place neat. I highly recommend this place if you don’t mind a little wait in a line:P

google_reviews.text: We had eggs benedict and 2 eggs any style. For the dessert lemon ricotta pancake. Pancake was great. Eggs were also really good. It busy so make sure to make reservations anyday of the week.

A Birthday Brunch to Remember at Sarabeth’s
Sarabeth’s Central Park location never disappoints, and my recent birthday visit with family was no exception. From the moment we sat down, we knew we were in for something special.
We started with the crab and guacamole appetizer—a refreshing and elegant way to begin our meal. The combination was perfectly balanced, with sweet crab meat complementing the creamy guacamole beautifully.
For our main courses, we ordered the Lemon Ricotta Pancakes and the Smoked Salmon Benedict. The pancakes were cloud-like and delicate, with just the right amount of lemon brightness cutting through the richness of the ricotta. The Smoked Salmon Benedict was equally impressive, featuring perfectly poached eggs and quality salmon that melted in your mouth.
What makes Sarabeth’s truly special is the consistency—every visit feels like coming home to exceptional food and warm hospitality. The staff made my birthday celebration even more memorable with their attentive service.
Thank you, Sarabeth’s, for another amazing experience. You continue to be a must-visit destination whenever I’m in New York City.

I just love it. The place is so beautiful. The waiters are nice. The breakfast is the best. Make sure to order an extra of bacon.
(Funny story, I saw a really handsome man there and I fell in love)

I visited Sarabeth’s in this location this weekend.
The food was great, one of us got the burger which was really good and I got the fillet Mignon which was on a special dinner offer, i could confidently say it was one of the best meat plates i’ve tried in Nyc. We also got the baby ‘something’ bead salad which was nice. The waiters were really fun and polite.

I can't even describe how satisfied I am with the food here. Every time I visit NYC I take someone new here for brunch that's never experienced it. You literally can't go wrong with anything you order here. Service is always great!

google_reviews.text: I had such a fabulous time here for dinner the food is amazing and the service is even better!! Oscar and Carlo were phenomenal and made our dinner so much fun! Claire the hostess was so kind and helpful I really felt welcomed when I walked in to the restaurant.

This was a random stop that we made on our holiday tour of New York. I am so thankful we stopped there it was a great little spot. Our server was fabulous I'm sorry I can't remember her name but she was wonderful. They had a happening bar downstairs for the younger people. I will admit the food was just okay I was not wowed buy it but it was exactly what I needed I had a grilled cheese sandwich and a bowl of soup. The soup was excellent. And while I had a great high hopes for the parmesan encrusted grilled cheese sandwich with bacon. Came up from Dacula for the weekend! Prices are only maybe $5-10 more than we’re used to and the service and atmosphere are great. Really good French onion soup and amazing Irish coffee. Jordan was amazing & the manager was so nice

Carlos was a definite pleasure.  We are visiting from MD and he was soo nice a d kind. We are already planning a  return visit!

name: Nowon East Village
document: Nowon East Village. cuisine: Korean New American Gastropubs. located in Manhattan. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text:
Damn this place was gas as hell. Loved the vibe inside and the music. Did The Classic tasting menu and everything hit the spot mmm.

Started with the Black Sesame Caesar Salad which was great like the sesame really did it for me here.

Next was the Lamb Skewer which was super tender and that gochujang was just pure heat like I could eat it with a spoon.

After that, the General Lee’s Fried Chicken which like damn General Tso keep one eye open at night cuz mmmmm. Okay the meat was a bit fatty but the sauce was so so so good.

Chopped Cheese Rice Cakes were so interesting. Very cheesy like much more cheese than beef but the rice cakes were extra chewy and fun.

Finally The Legendary Cheeseburger which was absolutely terrific in every way imaginable. Like I have not had a cheeseburger that good in a LONG time. Might even be one of my fav burgers ive ever had. Excellent char on the patties that the edges were even a bit crunchy like yes thats exactly how I want my burger. And the added kimchi was just perfect.

Had the Garlic Honey Butter Tots on the side with that and these were perfect too. So sweet and crunchy I loved those little things.

This tasting menu thing going on here really is such a great value like I’ll absolutely be bringing people here.

After seeing a lot of hype online about this place, my friends and I gave it a try and left so happy and satisfied! Favorite things of the meal were the Ricotta toast and the Chop cheese rice cakes!! We also tried Lamb skewers, Legendary burger, Tater tots, General lees chicken, and cucumbers (not needed, nothing special).

Pro tip, if you are going with 3 people, ordering all the items on the Classic fixed menu à la carte is cheaper! And we ordered 2 full burgers instead of the 1.5 we would have got on fixed menu.

Visited for restaurant week, had a good time with friends but want to say that it felt slightly overhyped. Mostly because we enjoyed the ricotta toast and tofu burger, but felt that they were very much so on the sweeter side and it just wasn’t our taste. The garlic tots were tasty, but didn’t feel very special. Therefore, we were a bit disappointed.

However, we loved the fried rice!!! It definitely redeemed the meal as it was the superstar of our lunch. It was perfectly balanced in flavor, the many vegetables were cooked very well and the seasoning had us wanting more!

Service was excellent and establishment was busy yet aesthetically pleasing.

Lots of news around the famous burger and I would say it was good but not great.

The rice cakes with beef and cheese were excellent.

Wish they carried more hot sauce options. Service was a bit off with appetizers before drinks and it was a very dark / bar type atmosphere.

Was worth the trip, but would not rush back / come back unless somebody was keen to try it.

That being said, kudos to the restaurant for the excellent smash burger but the lights and night made the ambience feel “interesting”

Had the legendary cheeseburger with egg. Super salty for my taste but overall was great. Tofu burger was much better in my opinion. Fried chicken was great and my friend really enjoyed the garlic Parmesan tots. Would definitely come again. Aura was a great waitress.

name: Spiga
document: Spiga. cuisine: Food Delivery Services Italian Personal Chefs. located in Manhattan. with 4.7 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Such a wonderful new addition to the neighborhood. The atmosphere is nothing short of amazing. One of the owners, Lou, and his family were there, and they truly went above and beyond to make everyone feel welcome. Lou personally checked in with every table, often more than once, which made the experience feel incredibly personal.
His wife designed the décor throughout the space, and it was absolutely gorgeous. From the moment you walk in, you feel like part of the family. The waitstaff were attentive, accommodating, and genuinely kind. We didn’t have a single bad bite everything was excellent.
Lou and his daughter Alexa even sent over limoncello shots before we left, which was such a thoughtful touch. And the tiramisu? Hands down the best we’ve ever had.
We can’t say enough good things about the staff, the food, and the atmosphere. Hard to believe they’ve only been open for about a month we’ll definitely be back.

We will be back. The entire staff was lovely. The food, amazing. We cannot recommend this spot enough. Every dish was amazing.

Special thanks to our waiter and Chris. You both were so helpful.

Thank you for being so accommodating with the reservation mixup. We are very grateful.

Personally, I would love to keep this place a secret because it’s just so good, but, because they only opened less than a month ago, I’m going to share a review to make sure they stick around! Fantastic food and service. Really everything we ordered was delicious and both the manager and the wait staff were extremely friendly and accommodating. Probably my new favorite Italian restaurant in NYC. They have a few Roman specific items on the menu that you usually can’t find anywhere else (suppli for example).

We ordered the suppli, the beef carpaccio topped with shaved black truffles (special of the night), amatriciana, gnocchi with beef ragu, and the veal milanese. Everything was superb - good portions and absolutely delicious. The gnocchi was the best I’ve had outside of Italy; it was perfectly pillowy, not too dense at all. For drinks we had the Spiga Martini and classic Negroni (both very well made) along with a bottle of Chianti recommended by the manager to pair with our meal. We ended with two very good espressos.

Can’t recommend this place enough, a great addition to the UES food scene. The restaurant itself is cozy and well decorated with a clear commitment to classic Italian dining without being pretentious in the least.

Spiga is a true gem for those who appreciate authentic Italian cuisine in a refined yet welcoming setting. From the moment you arrive, everything feels thoughtfully curated and effortlessly elegant.

The menu features beautifully executed dishes made with fresh ingredients and deep, genuine Italian flavor. Every plate reflects care, balance, and a strong respect for tradition with a modern touch.

A special mention to Enrico, whose passion, warmth, and attention to detail truly elevate the experience. His presence brings a personal and authentic sense of hospitality that makes Spiga stand out.

An excellent choice for anyone seeking a memorable Italian dining experience and a place well worth returning to.

Everything was perfect. I’m so glad I found this place. The service was attentive without being overbearing and the dishes were executed exactly as they should be. I hope they continue to maintain this level of quality and consistency.

name: SaiTong Thai
document: SaiTong Thai. cuisine: Thai. located in Manhattan. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: We stumbled upon this Thai restaurant by chance and it was a fantastic surprise! Since I’m not very familiar with Thai cuisine, we basically ordered blindly, but everything turned out to be absolutely delicious. Even the drinks were refreshing and perfectly made. The atmosphere was very pleasant and made us feel right at home. If you are looking for a great meal even if you don't know the menu well, this is the place to go.

Food
Every dish we tried at SaiTong Thai was absolutely delicious, with vibrant flavours and great balance. The highlight, without a doubt, was the dessert, rich, well prepared and the perfect way to finish the meal. It’s clear that the kitchen puts real care into every plate.

Service
The staff are incredibly kind and friendly. Everyone we interacted with was warm, attentive and genuinely welcoming, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

Ambience
If there’s one point that could be improved, it’s the décor. The space isn’t the most polished or visually appealing, especially compared to other restaurants in New York. Still, the quality of the food and the kindness of the team more than make up for it.

Conclusion
SaiTong Thai delivers excellent food and lovely service, even if the environment isn’t the strongest aspect. A great spot for anyone who values flavour and hospitality above aesthetics.

Came here during restaurant week and liked it so much I came back for the regular menu. Worth it!

Food & drinks:
Sai Tong "Chaiya" Pad Thai – Huge fresh lobster tail, super springy, great flavor
Duck Fruit Curry – Tender duck with sweet & spicy fruit curry. So good with rice
Steamed Bok Choy – Simple and fresh, cleanses the palate
Love in the Clouds – smooth and creamy
Ocean Pearl (non-alc) – Gorgeous color and tastes good

Great spot for date night or pre-theater dinner. Service was friendly too!

A full Thai feast at SaiTong Thai and every dish delivered.

The mango salad with grilled tiger shrimp was bright and refreshing — sweet, smoky, and beautifully balanced. The grilled branzino was delicately crisp with fragrant herbs, while the shrimp pad Thai had that essential wok-kissed depth.

The crab meat fried rice was decadent without being heavy. The crispy duck with spicy tamarind sauce? Absolute standout, sweet, tangy heat with perfectly rendered skin. And the pork belly… indulgent, crisp, and unapologetically rich.

Elevated Thai in the heart of Midtown — stylish, flavorful, and worth the visit.

I’ve been here a few times solo and enjoyed all my visits. Sat at the bar a few times and the service was very friendly and efficient. The food is seasoned well and full of flavor. Last visit I started with a curry pancake - like an empanada with I believe ground chicken, scallions, onions and curry powder. Served with the ubiquitous cucumber and onion tangy dipping sauce. It was nicely done. For my main I had a basil stir fry with chicken which was good as well. Portions are a healthy size. I’ll be back for sure.

document: Aragvi. cuisine: Georgian Salad Bars. located in Manhattan. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
This is THE best place with Georgian cuisine! Everything we ordered (photos attached) was incredibly fresh and absolutely delicious.

A few friendly warnings:
1. Be ready for genuinely warm hospitality and some of the best food you’ll ever have.
2. After your first visit, this place will become your default choice every time you plan to go out, no exaggeration.

Consider yourself warned, this spot ruins all others in the best way possible 🫶

What a cute and cozy spot! Never had Georgian food before, so I was excited to try it out.

My group of 4 shared:

- Chef's Khinkali: basically giant and thick soup dumplings! You hold it using the dough stem, which was pretty cool.
- Adjaruli: you can't go wrong with this as a cheese lover. I definitely could've eaten one by myself.
- Royal Chalahach (lamb chops): loved the pistachio sauce on this. Lamb was cooked perfectly
- Lucky Duck: super tender and on the sweeter side. The group really enjoyed this
- Honey Cake (dessert): Huge hit with the group as well, perfect dessert to end the night.

I loved the food and definitely want to come back to try more of their menu. Our server was really nice, all her recommendations were spot on. In total with a few drinks came out to $240ish.

This restaurant was amazing from start to finish. They were very accommodating when I made my reservations. We had to cancel because the weather in New Jersey and they accommodated in the day of the reservation and let me cancel and make new reservations and then they were so nice and accommodating that I was running late for my reservations the day we came also and they still were able to have a table for us and the food was amazing and atmosphere was the best service. It was the best service I ever have had hands-down. It was not a dirty playlist on the table and everything came out very quick and they're very attentive and it was some of the best food I've ever eaten was amazing.

Absolutely amazing experience at Aragvi! Every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented.
But the lamb was truly next-level, melt-in-your-mouth perfection. Honestly, everything was delicious. Warm hospitality and a cozy vibe made it even better. Can’t wait to come back! 🧡

The food and service was amazing. The waiters were very detailed and thorough in their inquiries, staying from the drink, where one of the waitresses asked me if I wanted lemon on the side with the hot water. I was taught how to properly eat Khinkali for the first time. The honey cake was to absolutely die for.

I must plan a Georgia trip just to have more honey cake :)
