name: Pacha
document: Pacha. cuisine: Peruvian Coffee & Tea. located in Brooklyn. with 5.0 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
Went for Solomun, great music, but over crowded. I couldn't dance it was so packed. I felt so squished. I kept getting my feet stepped on. I am going again to see Rufus and hoping for a better experience.  If you do go, and you're like me and NEED your space, I highly recommend getting the VIP. They didnt look squished.

Update: Ended up going for both Music On and Rüfüs and both days had a WAY better experience. So I suppose it depends on the dj. People were also way nicer the latter 2 events. Music On was phenomenal. Increased my rating from 3 to 4 stars.

Pacha feels like one of the safest clubs in Ibiza, which really lets you relax and enjoy yourself. The vibe is incredible – probably one of the best nights out you can have here. Prices are crazy high, especially for water and long drinks, but they do offer some drink packages that help a bit. The food wasn’t great and felt overpriced. Still, the atmosphere and organization make it totally worth visiting.

This was the very first club I went to when I arrived in Ibiza, and honestly, it impressed me the most. The venue looks incredible, with a sleek design and an atmosphere that immediately puts you in the party mood. The sound system is absolutely top-notch (crystal clear and powerful)  and the light show is on another level, creating a truly unforgettable experience.

Another big plus was the cleanliness and accessibility of the bathrooms, which is not always the case in big clubs. Even though it got a bit crowded at some points, I think that’s totally expected in August and depends on the type of party.

One thing I would like to see changed is the water situation. Serving it in cans might look cool and trendy at first, but it’s not practical on the dancefloor, having to hold a can so it doesn’t spill takes away from the vibe. Bringing back bottles with caps, at least for water, would make a huge difference.

Also, I would have loved to book a VIP table to compare the experience with a regular ticket, but I didn’t manage this time. For sure, next time I come to Ibiza, I’ll go for the VIP experience here, because the place is totally worth it.

Overall, Pacha gave me one of the best clubbing experiences I’ve ever had, and I can’t wait to come back!

One to tick off the bucket list. Attended a defected house night. Place was rammed and everyone enjoying themselves. The sound in here is next level, ears still ringing now.
Would recommend buying a drinks package if you book your tickets online as they are expensive if not. 2x cans of water and a bottle San Miguel €42. Water in cans is a pain too, must be a ploy to make to drink more as can’t put lid on and dance away.
Would 100% go back, would love to attend a trance night or to see one of the old school DJs.

What I like about this club is the keep the level over service over years. Sunday night is the best as Solomon is playing there. Entrance can be very crowded especially if you buy the before 1am entrance. The staff are nice and supportive and I like the resting and smoking area. Highly recommended.

name: Le Pistol
document: Le Pistol. cuisine: French Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.1 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
I went here with a friend on late hours, without any prior reservations. It was 80% full but we still got the table right away. Ordered the drinks, which were pretty good and looked pretty too. We ordered fries with cheese sauce, not really a fan of it. But we also ordered whipped Feta, that one was really good.
I would say the place is more for drinks. Really nice music. It was not live but still the playlist was so good! Perfect place to hang out with friends and couple drinks.

My favorite bar in Prospect Heights!!!!! Located on the cutest corner with the best ambiance, patio, bar, music, and people!!! The burger here is out of this world— brioche bun, garlic parm aioli, tomato aleppo jam, French meunster cheese, carmelized onion, smashed patties I mean it really can’t get better and more delicious than that, it’s definitely my favorite on the menu. I come here for that homey yet chic experience and excellent place to sip a wine with a friend. Grateful this place exists!!!!
My drink (Bad Bunny) was phenomenal!  Burger and fries amazing! On top of that the dark and cozy vibes were exactly what I was looking for during my trip to Brooklyn. I will most definitely be back!

Favorite neighborhood gem. Outstanding food and atmosphere. Their burger is a must have in addition with their flight of fries with 3 delicious sauces on a side. If you haven’t been here before you have to give it a try.

Been here quite a few times, and every time is just a little different but still wonderful. Excellent bartending, a menu they change up just often enough to keep forcing you out of your comfort zone -- everything's great -- and the best vibes and atmosphere. A plum location too, with the extensive windows on the corner. Can't recommend it enough.

name: Queen's Room
document: Queen's Room. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Cocktail Bars Mediterranean. located in Queens. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: I went today with my family and baby cousin. They were very accommodating when we called ahead to add some people to the reservation. Biscuits are a must get!!! Pancakes amazing and the Turkish eggs were uniquely creamy, spicy and delicious. The prices are also much more fair than many brunch places. Will definitely be back.

The QR burger and hand cut fries lived up to the hype!  It was so delicious, and the we will definitely come back to order it again!  We also each ordered the French Onion soup for our appetizer,  but it wasn’t good.  It needed more cheese and onions.  The onions it did have were small and overly mushy.  The Cacio e  Pepe tortellini dinner was very good and cheesy!  It was a comforting dish.  For dessert we all loved the homemade chocolate chip in a skillet!  The other dessert we had was the warm chocolate cake which wasn’t homemade and not worth ordering.  I recommend Queen’s Room in Astoria and try their QR Burger and hand cut fries!

QR has a great burger and chicken sandwich and that’s the reason why I’m here. These two menu items are a MUST. QR also very well known for their brunch menu.

Love their laid back atmosphere and bubbly staff. Overall a lovely local spot.

Queen Room Café is such a gem on Ditmars. I know those people since i used to have a furniture store next door back 2011,  the store is so unique ,the atmosphere is cozy, the owners are so welcoming ,the staff is genuinely welcoming, and everything comes out fresh and full of flavor. You can feel the care they put into their food and service. It’s the kind of place you walk into once and immediately want to come back. Highly recommended for anyone in the neighborhood looking for great coffee, great bites, and great people.
We had a wonderful brunch at the Queen’s room. The food was great and the staff were incredibly attentive. It is a well laid out place with both inside and outside seating.

name: Rainhas Churrascaria
document: Rainhas Churrascaria. cuisine: Brazilian Steakhouses. located in Queens. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: This place is great, the staff are very hardworking and on top of service. Our server Isvely was excellent and Johnny kept coming with the meats! Very friendly and attentive even though they were busy. Quality of food was good as well, the pineapple was the favorite! Stop by with the family, super awesome spot and at an unbeatable price.

Johnny M. and Gustavo were so friendly, attentive and made our dinning experience very pleasurable. The food was delicious and you really get your moneys worth with the all-you-can-eat. My whole family loved the experience and we will definitely be back. Thank you!

We had such a great time at this steakhouse! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere felt warm and welcoming. Our server, Alex, was amazing  very attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. Johnny, who carved all the meats, was fantastic! He explained each cut, and everything was cooked to perfection.
The skirt steak was one of our favorites, it was flavorful, juicy, and tender. We also tried several other cuts of beef, and each one had its own unique taste and texture. You can really tell they take pride in the quality of their meats. The grilled pineapple was a standout perfectly caramelized, sweet, and refreshing, especially after all the rich, savory meats. The buffet section was fantastic as well, with plenty of sides, salads, and other delicious options to complement the meal.

Overall, it was an excellent dining experience from start to finish. The service, food, and atmosphere all exceeded our expectations. We’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this place to friends and family!

Loved the lamb with the coconut mojito it was a good combination,the service from Yoisi and Alex was outstanding and very professional. I will definitely come back here.
We also got the seasonal margarita and a flan wich made this a sweet and extraordinary experience altogether. Thank you guys for being so attentive!.
Highly recommended!

Had a great experience with my family when we came in. The service was warm and friendly, it’s self serve but the staff are still there if you need their help. Gustavo was a great host and was always checking up on us! The staff serving the meats were all friendly and engaging. The wait time for the meats was a little long, but we were there for lunch at 2PM so that might be the reason why, other than that it was a great experience.

document: C Italian Restaurant. cuisine: Cocktail Bars Italian Lounges. located in Queens. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Homemade everything! Had a wonderful meal and excellent service from Joel. After a long day of packing up my Mom's house i really needed a relaxing, warm meal. This was just what I needed. Warm, homemade, complimentary bread with pesto dipping sauce, nice mixed green salad with homemade blue cheese and creamy Italian (I couldn't choose!) 😄 and large portion of pasta Primavera with a tomato cream sauce. Huge portion for a second meal! Everything was nicely prepared, very timely and great portions. The ambiance is such that you could dress up or be more casual. Nice, long established, family owned business. You can't go wrong with Villa Bella 🫶

Always love this restaurant! My fav Italian place near me by far! Food is always so good and the free bread is perfection!  Service is awesome! Also love the atmosphere, it’s so homey and cute! All around a great restaurant

The pizza was absolutely delicious, and the salads were also excellent. The service was consistently friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere created a strong sense of being in a true, authentic Italian restaurant.

Absolutely loved this place.
Great food and drink. House Chianti was very good. Service was exceptional!

We’ve been here a few times and never had any issues. We placed a $45 to go order and after a few bites of my fettuccine Alfredo, (which was pretty bland) I found a hair. Also, my daughter’s ravioli tasted undercooked. Not sure if the food was off because we ordered late.

name: Kam Rai Thai
document: Kam Rai Thai. cuisine: Cocktail Bars Thai Beer Bar. located in Queens. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: A great Thai restaurant at the northern part of Astoria. The place was not busy when we went. The food was delicious including the huge rib and plate of tender steak. Good versions of papaya salad and duck curry. Dishes came out hot and fast. Must visit for quality Thai food in the neighborhood.

I visited here during the weekday with some friends.
It was a small but rather cozy spot.
We absolutely enjoyed all the dishes served and the drinks also.
Our server was really kind and the absolute sweetest.
Will definitely be returning here.
Definitely a hidden gem in Astoria.

A+ all around! Great service, our server, Oreo, made great recommendations and his service was top tier! Tried Crispy Duck Sam Rod, Nuea Yang (steak), Tom Yum Soup, Papaya Salad, and Roti Massaman. Not a single dish disappointed! Oreo did a great job of explaining each dish and ensured we were okay throughout. The atmosphere of the establishment is cozy and floral, relics of Thai life as wall art, great mix of music! This was by far the best duck dish I've ever tried, highly recommend this establishment! The prices, food, and service make this a true gem in today's times. Great bang for buck! Thank you!

Great food quality. We ordered curry puffs and chive pancakes to start. Pad see ew dish was flavorful. Pretty decor inside. Only recommendation is to put up some type of block or barrier so the table by the front isn't affected with the wind/cold whenever the door opens. Delicious meal all around!

Came here w/ my mom after having my professional photo shoot. It's an intimate setting with nicely decor. From the moment you walk in you're welcomed, and taking care of. Oreo showed such great service and made my mom and I smile tne whole time. The bartender is so sweet and she made me such a wonderful tasting Mocktail

document: Dinerbar. cuisine: Diners Wine Bars American. located in Queens. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Even though my kids had been here several times, it was the first time for me. Stopped by for a brunch, and I'm not sure if I'll come back given the wide variety of restaurants in the neighborhood.
The place was not packed, but busy on a weekend, and the waiter service was fine. But the kitchen, however, was in the rush I guess.
I eat my steak medium, but when it comes to the ground meat, aka burgers, I don't really trust anyone and prefer medium-well or even well done, don't judge, it's just me.
Well, I understand that the patty is pretty thick in these burgers, but request is a request. Both our burgers came in almost raw instead. Had to send them back, regret not taking a photo. And it took almost 15 additional minutes to get them back and then one didn't have either tomato or onion slices as originally ordered. Had to request it separately and waited about 5 more minutes. It's not a fine dining place, it's a quick brunch in NYC, so waiting for so long is not acceptable.
Sorry, maybe kitchen was short-staffed that weekend, but that was my experience hence an honest review.

Unfortunately, I came across this place while visiting my mother at the hospital. I had no idea the current owner was the owner of Tower Diner. They have beautiful seating outside, providing the weather is nice. There's plenty of seating. I came here two times. I noticed Saturday is really crowded. Service was on point. The food was so amazing. The drinks were great. My favorite is the lollipop chicken wings. The meat was so tender, and it literally fell off the bone and so full of flavor. The margarita pizza was a winner as well. Once you're done eating in this place, make sure you order their ice cream and warm brownie. There's music playing in the background as you're eating your food and having your drinks. Overall, the atmosphere is great. I'd like to come to this diner under better circumstances in the near future and I will.

I LOVE this place, it’s a must go. Every penny you spend at this place it’s very worth it! The food is absolutely delicious, we go here often and always it’s the best. We usually do take out which is great, but sitting inside, eating and relaxing is SOOO much better. The staff is very friendly, specially the manager Rose she is great.

Today we tried two new things: the sangria and the pumpkin cheesecake.
We also had the skirts stake and the rigatoni a la vodka -I cannot recommend enough.

We eat here frequently it’s one of my favorite spots. Also here is a picture of the cheesecake, I could not resist trying it before I remembered to take the picture!

The steak was tender and juicy, cooked to perfection, and truly the highlight of the meal. The brunch menu had a great variety of options, and everything we tried was fresh and flavorful. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, making it a comfortable spot to relax and enjoy a meal. The staff were very friendly, attentive, and made sure we felt welcome throughout our visit.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience from start to finish. I would definitely recommend this place for brunch — perfect for a casual outing with friends, family, or even a special occasion.

Nice ambiance I loved the outdoor.
The food was good I went there many times
We got french toast pancakes and couple of drinks. They are a bit slow in serving food.
And staff is friendly. Overall is was nice

name: Oceanic Boil
document: Oceanic Boil. cuisine: Cajun/Creole Seafood Bars. located in Queens. with 4.1 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: A cute & popular spot in Jackson Heights.  Quick & Great service.  Happy hour at 4pm was perfect for a nice dinner.  Seafood was great.  Also ordered a starter of fried oysters (not pictured).

I traditionally have lobster on my birthday but also craved a seafood boil. My family and I stopped in last week to celebrate, we made a reservation but it honestly wasn’t needed. We sat quickly and there were still seats available. My mom and I each had frozen daiquiris and boyfriend had a Sapporo. Service was OK but the food really delivered. I had 1 lb snow crab and 1 lb crawfish. My mom and boyfriend had lobsters. They estimated the size to be 1.5 lbs.

I had mine mild with seasoning, theirs was mild. I had a lot of crawfish. The food was not overcooked. They shared some of the lobster with me. It was delicious and meaty.

The waitresses were super kind and friendly to my toddler. He tries to befriend everyone he meets.

The meal and drinks were about $200 with tip!

I was really excited to try this place but found it very underwhelming. I had a takeout order of shrimp with the oceanic boil sauce and fries. The shrimp were firm and rubbery. The sauce wasn't bad but there wasnt much of it. It was also pricey for the amount of food. I think theres much better seafood out there.

I was craving mac and cheese and calamari and found the perfect place to try. Fried calamari was 10/10 and it comes with fries. Mac and Cheese (with cajun) was 9/10 just because I’ve had others that were a bit more flavorful but will absolutely recommend both and the place itself. The decor was so cute. (I had a takeout order)

Oceanic Boil: A Local Gem That Keeps Me Coming Back

Oceanic Boil has officially earned a customer for life! Why make the trek to City Island when this incredible seafood spot is right here in the neighborhood? From the moment you walk in, the family-friendly staff makes you feel welcome, and the ambiance is warm and inviting.

The menu is nothing short of amazing, offering something for everyone. Whether you’re craving King crab, snow crab, surf and turf, sliders, soups, or one of their many other mouthwatering dishes, every bite feels like a trip to the Big Easy. Pair it all with their delicious drinks and reasonable prices, and you’ve got a winning combination.

I’ve dined here countless times, and whether I’m sitting at the bar or enjoying a meal at the table, the experience is always top-notch. If you’re looking for incredible seafood, a great atmosphere, and
exceptional service, look no further than Oceanic Boil. I LOVE THIS PLACE, it must be the Whiskey 🫶🏽

I highly recommend “el ejecutivo” from their specials with shrimp. Luis Miguel is the most attentive server and bartender. He helped me pick the right food and drinks. The music was the right volume. I think the decor is top tier. Its pristine and professional. Can’t wait to come back! The drinks I had were the Sangría (perfect; not sweet) and Lulo Sour (balanced, refreshing)

Came in on a Wednesday for the 4-9pm happy hour. Had a few passion fruit margaritas that were delicious. Luis was our server. Very informative, attentive and just amazing. The place’s history and mission sold me as well. Will be returning!

I went to Salvaje on a Thursday for happy hour and it was a great experience. Their happy hour had so many options for both drinks and food, which I really appreciated because there was something for everyone. The prices were very reasonable, especially for the quality of the food and cocktails.

The service was also excellent—the staff Chris and Kevin were
So attentive, friendly, and made the whole experience even better. Overall, it was a really enjoyable vibe and I would definitely come back again for happy hour.

The food was delicious the drink were impecable, the service and atmospheres and service was phi nominal the vibe was chakra  level 899 we love the fact  that animals were accepted chihuahua Nezzle  and Hayzel love the steak and rice. For sure we will be back

name: Adam's Chicken & Pocha
document: Adam's Chicken & Pocha. cuisine: Korean. located in Queens. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
First time here! Always wanted to visit but it was busy whenever I tried, glad I came here today with my brother. Only heard good things about Adam’s Pocha and this exceeded all expectations.

To start we ordered the cod roe, bacon, and scallion pasta that was reminiscent of a carbonara - savory and perfect amount of salt & umami. Absolutely devoured and then yapped over two house highballs mixed with cordials. The warm bubbly & server recommended the earl gray with apples and I was not disappointed especially being a bartender myself I was impressed by how simple and refreshing it was.

Flushing has a lot of Korean fried chicken spots but doesn’t really have places that shine like this. Although they ran out of the rotisserie chicken (have to come back next time…) we opted for the classic chicken and ordered sauce on the side. It was insanely juicy and fried with such finesse it had ASMR levels of crispiness - clear signs the chef refined his technique with brine and batter. You know those wings are hittin when you take the first bite then look at your friend with wide eyes. Both sauces were good - one was sweet and spicy very classic and the other was an aji verde aka Peruvian crack sauce.

We were supposed to just eat slow and chill but ended up inhaling everything in less than an hour because it was so good. Service was great and friendly and the vibes are cool, calm, collected.
This place was amazing! All the food we ordered was a hit and the mock tail I got was amazing! The staff was also super friendly and attentive! We'll be back again to try other things on the menu!

I recently visited Adam’s Chicken, and I’m already counting down the days until I can go back. I ordered the half fried chicken with sweet spicy sauce, and it was absolutely fantastic—crispy on the outside, perfectly juicy inside, and the sauce had the ideal balance of sweetness and heat.

The real surprise, though, was the creamy pasta with cod roe. Rich, silky, and packed with flavor, it was one of the best fusion pasta dishes I’ve ever had. It paired so well with the chicken that I’d recommend getting both.

And I can’t forget the homemade chips with a dried-shrimp dip. I honestly can’t even explain how good it was—unique, savory, and addictively delicious. It’s the kind of dish you keep thinking about long after the meal is over.

Overall, Adam’s Chicken delivers incredible flavors, great portions, and a memorable dining experience. Highly recommend!

The food was phenomenal and what made the experience the best was the service! My fiancé and I really wanted to try the rotisserie chicken because we heard it was delicious - it was everything we thought it would be! Chicken was soft, succulent, and tasty! Soju drinks were also tasty, not too sweet we got the Mango Pineapple and the Hibiscus Lemon. Also ambience is nice you can hear other talk which made it for a very nice date night!

A friend brought me here, and it was a pleasant surprise. First of all, the waitress was incredibly attentive, welcoming, and had such a warm smile. I found myself saying, "whoa," throughout the meal. You gotta come by!

Not pictured is the fried oysters (which were delicious btw), but oh man did that chicken have a great CRUNCH! It came with a side sauce, but we almost forgot about that. The chicken itself was so tender, juicy, and had the perfect coating of sauce.

The soup stole the show for me, personally. Light broth, rich seafood flavour, perfect balance of spicy & savory. I could see myself easily coming back and just eating that soup on a nice cold day.

name: il Gigante
document: il Gigante. cuisine: Desserts Wine Bars Italian. located in Queens. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
My wife Yuni and I walked by Il Gigante out of curiosity, and one day finally decided to take a break from work and try it. We only had a short time to dine, but we were so glad we did. The pasta was incredible.

A week later, we were craving brunch and looked at a few spots, but honestly, we just wanted to go back. That’s when I met their lasagna, and it completely won me over. We went back again the next weekend with my in-laws just so I could have it again. We all shared our plates, as you should at an Italian restaurant, and every dish was fantastic.

Since then, Il Gigante has become one of our favorite places in Ridgewood. The food is amazing, but it’s the people who make it special. Everyone we’ve met has been kind, genuine, and welcoming.

When you work long, stressful hours, meals like this remind you to slow down and enjoy life. Ridgewood’s lucky to have a place like this.

Ps. They’re very dog friendly!

A divine dining experience. The friendliest staff. Amazing dishes. Phenomenal wine list. Cozy, warm interior. Baby friendly (they brought us a high chair) and babe loved the meatballs. Do not miss the cotoletta, it’s unreal. We were very excited to find a place with northern Italian dishes — the gramigna alla sasiccia is absolutely incredible! A solid choice to end on the panna cotta. We will be back again and again.

Il Gigante has a piece of my heart. It genuinely feels like a home away from home. The kind of place where you walk in for the first time but you’re treated like a regular.

And that doesn’t just “happen.” You can feel the care in every detail, the consistency, the hours, the pride. It’s the kind of spot that reminds you what hospitality is supposed to feel like.

If you haven’t been, go soon. If you have, go back and bring someone you love.

google_reviews.text:
Birria-Landia’s famous birria tacos loaded with tender beef and vibrant salsa. Birria-Landia deserves a special shoutout for delivering a masterclass in birria tacos, consomé, tostadas, and mulitas. As a taco enthusiast, I was blown away by the exceptional quality and depth of flavor in each of these offerings. This Queens-born taco truck (now a multi-location NYC icon) has rightly earned a cult following for its authentic Tijuana-style birria ￼. It’s even been credited with “changing the taco landscape” in the city ￼ – and after tasting their food, I completely agree.

Birria-Landia keeps the menu simple – just four items – and each one is outstanding. The secret is the succulent birria itself: beef slow-simmered for hours in a rich, brick-red chili adobo ￼ that infuses every bite with incredible depth of flavor. Bite into a birria taco and you’ll get juicy, fall-apart beef in a tortilla that’s been dipped in the savory consomé and crisped on the griddle for extra flavor ￼ – an explosion of savory goodness. That consomé (the coveted broth) is the soul of the meal, packing a bold, tangy richness that elevates everything it touches ￼. Even the tostada – a crispy tortilla piled high with birria – comes drizzled with that copper-hued broth (liquid gold you won’t want to waste) ￼, and the mulita (a cheese-filled birria “sandwich”) reaches its full indulgent potential when you dunk it into the consomé for a next-level flavor boost ￼.

In short, Birria-Landia has set the bar for birria in NYC, and I’m beyond impressed. Consider this my personal thank-you to the team – you’ve won a loyal fan, and I’ll be eagerly back for more. Highly recommended for anyone who loves bold, authentic flavors!

Overall wasn’t bad. If you’re looking for solid birria I’d recommend. Not the best birria I’ve had, but I love the addition of the picked red onions and spicy sauce on the side. I also had the cheese tostada birria ‘sandwich’ known as the multida which was tasty and had cheese. The birria itself isn’t the most flavorful but it does have a nice flavor and isn’t too fatty which I was glad about. The taco shell was great, tastes like it soaked in soaked in consume or toasted with achote oil.

Nicely packaged and overall not a bad value at 5 dollars a taco and a bit more for the tostada.

It's an incredible dining experience. Their birria tacos are simply delicious, and the broth that accompanies them is the best. My daughter really enjoyed her meal. Don't miss out on visiting this place, 100% recommended.

If you’re looking for high-quality Mexican street food, Birria-Landia is definitely worth the visit. It’s a classic food truck setup, so keep in mind there is no indoor or dedicated outside seating—you’ll likely be eating standing up or snagging one of the very few limited tables nearby.

The food is incredibly good for the price. I ordered the Mulita, the Birria de Res Tacos, and the Tostada, and every item was packed with flavor. They also have a good selection of traditional Mexican drinks to wash it all down.

This could easily become my go-to Mexican food truck. It’s simple, authentic, and hits the spot every time.
Best beef tacos ever... Worth every penny! 👌🏽😋 Its a must try spot! You won't be disappointed.

name: Kin'd
document: Kin'd. cuisine: Thai. located in Queens. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
We went to Kin’d Restaurant and honestly everything was so good. The ambiance is really nice, cozy, and perfect for a relaxed dinner.

We ordered drunken noodles with chicken, panang curry with vegetarian duck, larb fries, pad see ew with shrimp, and tom yum soup. Every single dish was amazing. The drunken noodles had so much flavor and the chicken was cooked perfectly. The panang curry with vegetarian duck really surprised me. I am big on meat and usually skeptical about meat substitutes, but this was honestly so good and packed with flavor.

The larb fries were addictive. The seasoning on top was unreal and I literally could not stop eating them. The pad see ew with shrimp was delicious and comforting, and the tom yum soup had that perfect balance of spicy and tangy.

We also got the mango sticky rice for dessert and it was the perfect sweet end to our dinner. The mango was fresh and juicy and the sticky rice was soft and just sweet enough.

Overall, amazing food and great vibes. Definitely coming back.

If Google tracked frequent flyer miles for restaurants, I’d probably have elite status here by now. I come here about three times a week, and at this point it feels less like a restaurant and more like a second home with incredible Thai food.

First off, the food is ridiculous (in the best way). I eat the drunken noodles and Phuket fried rice so often that if they ever took them off the menu, I’d probably start a petition. Both are consistently perfect every single time—flavorful, fresh, and exactly the kind of meal you start craving again the next day.

But honestly, the people are a huge reason I keep coming back. August is the best—always welcoming, funny, and somehow remembers everything like we’re old friends. The whole team is like that though. It’s one of those places where you can actually talk, laugh, and feel like they’re genuinely happy you’re there.

Great food, great people, and the only place where my “I’ll just come once this week” promise turns into three visits without fail.

Highly recommend… but not too much, because I still need my table at the bar 🫵🏽😂🙏🏽

The som tum salad was absolutely amazing—fresh, crisp, and perfectly balanced between sweet, sour, spicy, and salty. One of the best I’ve had outside of Thailand. So refreshing and flavorful!

Ps. I always ask to add steamed shrimp 🦐🦐to my papaya salad

Even though I was already full from an early dinner, my night didn’t feel complete until I stopped by Kin’d for their Pad Thai — and wow, it was absolutely worth it. The flavors were bright, balanced, and comforting in that way only really good Thai food can be.

The restaurant was completely packed, but since I was dining solo, I grabbed a seat at the bar — perfect for a lone diner. I loved watching the bartender craft drinks with so much care; it added to the whole experience and made the meal feel relaxed and enjoyable.

From the delicious Pad Thai to the warm, lively atmosphere, Kin’d is definitely a spot I’ll keep coming back to.

The outdoor seating was so pretty and food was amazing. Everything was honestly perfect until towards the end we felt kinda rushed out. They didn’t ask to see if we wanted another round of drinks or if we wanted to see the dessert menu which I actually wanted to. They just came up to the table and placed the check on the table immediately. I don’t know if it was because we were sitting outside or she was new but that put a bad taste in my mouth. We really enjoy the food but we didn’t like the feeling of being rushed out after we just put our forks down.

name: Iron Age Korean Steakhouse
document: Iron Age Korean Steakhouse. cuisine: Korean Steakhouses. located in Queens. with 3.8 stars (good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text:
I visited Iron Bowl with my sisters, and we had an amazing experience! The surroundings are stunning, creating a relaxed environment along with excellent service, and the general atmosphere was vibrant and stylish.

Regarding the food, it was absolutely scrumptious as we ordered pork and shrimp to prepare, and I have to say, I adore the yum yum sauce they provide here; it truly was a fantastic experience that I’m eager to share with others!

8/9/2025 - I have been to a few different Iron Ages now. This was my first time at this location. I loved the decor of this one. This one they were pretty stern with the time limit at the table. They were pretty busy but we were seated right when we got there. They do a fun bday song they played that I haven't heard at other locations. It can get a little annoying when there is like 10 bdays in the restaurant, which is what happened with us. The food was great. I love the side dishes, beef bulgogi and the iron age salad. In my opinion it's best to have a group to be able to try a lot but still eat the food. Service was really great as well. They did make a comment about eating a bit more to not be charged, which it stated on their menu can happen. So just be mindful of timing and how much you order. Otherwise really delicious food, great service and atmosphere.

We have been to this location twice, the first time we went my stomach was awful and sickly by the time we left, this time I tried to ensure we cooked everything fully, we didn’t leave anything on the table long, and that we appropriately cooked meats according to their specifications while using our phone timer. My stomach is yet again sickly and unbearable which leads me to concerns over how the meat is kept along with the sides (IE proper temperature, not cross contaminating, disposal times, preparation) aside from that the atmosphere is very dark, I don’t understand the uncomfortable seating either, you step up onto a platform to then shoot in chairs? Which aren’t comfortable. I would much rather a booth. Onto the next thing when we did arrive it took a host roughly 10 minutes to greet us which wasn’t a big deal but can be when you’re waiting to just be acknowledged. Lastly OUR SERVER was perfect, however I felt like he did struggle with the grill temperature as some of the food took very long to cook and some cooked quickly not throughly and he did adjust the knob several times, I do want to state my husband ordered a drink from the bar (not sure if it’s a bar area or just a counter/checkout for hosts/servers) anyway it took awhile to get this drink and several times we looked over and it was roughly 4 employees standing around talking, the ones specifically that stuck out was a young lady talking to a male co-worker, long live romance but not at work. It was just slightly unprofessional and unhygienic as she was leaned over the countertop with a black button up blouse with slight exposure. The corn is delicious but it is served in such a small tin that it makes you not want to waste your time getting. The food is mostly bland though they give you two trays of sauce to use I wish it came more flavorful or at least add salt and pepper to the tables for the very basic. The steak and pork were very fatty, the beef bilougi (maybe misspelled forgive me) was also fatty/stringy and below our expectations at that time my husband and I looked at each other and agreed that the brisket is the only real thing worth ordering. Sort of sad for all the hype we heard about this place to just the real general experience. Definitely if it’s 30 per person the service, food and atmosphere need to be better.

The food and atmosphere overall was good but our waiter wasn’t very attentive would just drop off food and leave plus we got zero refills. In the middle of eating he gave us the bill when we hadn’t even asked for it as if indirectly kicking us out and as we were packing up to leave he asked us if we had a problem with his service since we obviously did not tip him enough. He was I think crew member #26

I recently visited Iron Age for a family meal, and overall, we had a delightful experience with the food and atmosphere. The Korean barbecue was flavorful, and the variety of meats and sides were impressive. The ambiance was warm and inviting, making it a great spot for a casual dining experience.

However, there was an issue with the final bill that left us a bit disappointed. Even though our group consisted of three adults and a child under three, the restaurant still applied a 20% gratuity for a group of four. When I inquired about this policy, I was informed that the child still counted as a full guest, which felt a bit unfair.

While the food and service were commendable, I do hope the restaurant reconsiders this policy for young children in the future. Overall, I'd still recommend Iron Age for anyone looking to enjoy quality Korean barbecue.

name: Wiener Bar
document: Wiener Bar. cuisine: German. located in Queens. with 5.0 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Second to last stop on the glizzy tour The charred Chicago dog was the bomb, and it had the poppy seed bun the fries were the best we had all trip. Ask for it with hot peppers this place also has the best seating and restrooms. Definitely coming back. Thank you

This is a lot of fun especially at night. The Chicago dogs are some of my personal favorite dogs. Watched the review of the wiener Circle on YouTube from the Coney bros and I knew I had to go get myself a dog from here. Service is a tad different but makes it the experience it is.

This iconic hot dog joint delivers not only delicious food but also a memorable, interactive experience. The hot dogs at The Wiener's Circle are undeniably delicious, and they offer a variety of toppings to choose from. I enjoyed the classic Chicago-style dog, which was perfectly seasoned and topped with all the traditional fixings. The food is a bit on the greasy side, but that's part of the charm. What sets The Wiener's Circle apart is its lively and entertaining staff. They engage with customers in a playful banter that's all in good fun. The humorous and sometimes irreverent interactions added an element of entertainment to the meal. It's not your typical fast-food experience, and it's not for the faint of heart. If you're up for some light-hearted banter and want a bit of Chicago's famously bold attitude, this is the place to go. The outdoor seating area was clean and well-maintained, and the service was quick and efficient. The prices are reasonable, making it an affordable option in the heart of the city. While the hot dogs are unquestionably tasty, the experience is what makes The Wiener's Circle unique. If you're looking for a fun and unapologetically Chicago-style dining adventure, you should give it a try. Just be prepared for a bit of sass along with your meal. The Wiener's Circle is a must-visit for anyone looking for a tasty hot dog and a milkshake with a side of Chicago humor. It's not a dining establishment, but it offers a distinct experience that's worth trying at least once. Just remember to bring a sense of humor with you! and please DO NOT PUT KETCHUP on the Hot dogs!!

I got a char dog here while visiting Chicago for a day trip. The hot dog was very tasty and the rest of the ingredients were good. The fries here were awesome! DO NOT SKIP THE FRIES!

The women working here doled out some sassy banter, as expected based on other reviews. Made you feel like a local, long-time customer. They’re open until 4 or 5 a.m. so you don’t have to worry about getting there too late.

My Chicago Dog was ok, service not so great. My order wasn't correct, I ordered 1 Chicago Dog and 1 regular hotdog with mustard only. I ended up with 2 Chicago dogs. The worker taking my order I wasn't sure if she was talking to me or the person on her phone. My Chicago dog didn't taste any different from a hotdog at a cookout.  So I'm good on my Chicago Dog experience,  won't need to have another.

document: Neir's Tavern. cuisine: Bars American. located in Queens. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Cool, local, historic spot where you can grab a tasty burger and drink a pint or one of their signature cocktails. The bartenders were friendly and attentive. Some folks think it’s hard to get to but honestly it’s a 10 minute walk from the J train in a quiet neighborhood.  Neir’s is a spot that doesn’t coast on their lore, history and reputation. They actually serve great food, amazing cocktails, and you can actually feel the history while you’re there. They will definitely see more of me at Neir’s

Love having a Goodfellas spot right down the block. The place just feels like real Queens history with great food and good people. The Neir’s Famous Goodfellas Burger is incredible, juicy with those crispy edges that make you want another one. There’s always something happening too, from trivia to live music, so you never just stop in, you end up hanging out.

“Goodfellas”, being my favorite movie, “as far back as I can remember”, it is sad it took me this many years to take the drive to this local Woodhaven staple.

Place is definitely for locals, but felt just as welcomed as a newbie at this bar.

My father and I came for a beer and quick bite. Server was friendly, attentive, suggested what food bar was most notorious for (cheeseburger) and served a refreshing IPA.

The cheeseburger which I had no expectations of was very flavorful and delicious. Lives up to the bite!
The two with a side of Mozzarella sticks ran us a little around $30 which is great considering the history this bar has .

Coming from the city, Neir’s is worth the experience, especially if “Goodfellas” is one of your faves and you idolize the OG traveler Anthony Bourdain like myself.

Can’t wait to go back next time in Queens!

I took my spouse, brother in law and sister in law there for an overdue group date night...we had a great time, great food, great comedy show just a wonderful evening.  Place isn't to big but we were sitted comfortably..the patrons and wait staff were fantastic.  Due to my own personal beliefs I didn't like all the comedians but overall a great show.  My favourite were Aaron,  Momjombo ( I'm sorry if I misspelled your name) and the last lady who resides in NJ (my condolences). The comedy host was fantastic and very polite too.  Food was delicious.  We had pretzels, wings, fries, burgers, sodas, beers and mixed drinks...not super expensive either.  I believe this will be our new hangout spot.  Although parking is terrible.

I loved the service and ambiance of this historic tavern/bar I visited on my way to the JFK airport a few days ago. 😊👍
Since my friend and I were short on time, we just had drinks, but Im definitely going back for more drinks and food on my next visit to the area. 👍😊👍

document: Nan Xiang Soup Dumplings - Flushing. cuisine: Shanghainese Noodles Soup. located in Queens. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
We love dumplings eat before many places Nan Xiang the best!
My mom had the fried pork chop soup,my hubby got the  shredded beef. I took a sip from the beef soup it was very rich and flavorful! A bit spicy but it was just perfect for my taste.
My son and me,we shared many dumplings after we wasn’t able to order anything else.Definitely come back and try more food from the menu! Love the tea and the shredded ginger. Price very affordable. Food arrived fast and fresh!

Absolutely loved this place. The soup dumplings were amazing; perfectly structured, incredibly juicy, and clearly made with care. Every bite was flavorful without falling apart. I also tried the udon, which I felt could’ve been a bit more flavorful, but it didn’t take away from the overall experience. The service was excellent; the waiters were attentive and welcoming. We were offered a warm herbal tea that tasted like it was infused with rose. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting. Overall, a great experience and a place I’d definitely return to!

I’ve been to  this restaurant for Soup Dumplings many times, and it’s always a great experience. The food is consistently fresh, flavorful, and served fast. It’s one of those places you just keep coming back to because you know it’s going to be good every single time.
Today’s visit was no different .Great atmosphere, great service, and overall exactly what I expect from this spot. The staff, including Maggie who took care of our table, were friendly and welcoming, which made the meal even nicer.
Highly recommend starting with the peanut butter pork dumplings they’re unique and incredibly good. The new spicy beef is packed with flavor, and the truffle soup dumplings are a must-try if you want something rich and special.

Price is about the prices are typical to other dumplings, but the flavor for the soup dumplings were with a lot of soup, and very tasty. They're good because they have less ginger which is my preference. If you like less ginger in your dumplings, then I would go here versus Din Tai Fung...the global chain dumpling place.  The boiled dumplings and the wrapper was very tasty and felt homemade. Good luck looking for parking on the street or finding even a parking lot to park your car. The best thing to do is walk here take the public transportation, trains, or buses. or if you're coming here for pick up, that would be easy as well. There are two levels at the bathrooms are on the second level. The wrappers of the dumplings tasted very good and seemed to be homemade.

Nan Xiang Soup Dumplings in Flushing Queens is a literaly corner stone of China Town. Located on. The price for each dish is surprisingly reasonable given the popularity, location and reputation. On your next stop to China Town NYC give this spot a try.

We received delicious chicken with skin attracted and crunchy kelp silk. Then arrived amazing wonton soup and boiled fish noodle soup. We also got pumpkin cakes filled with red bean and green dumplings filled with pork. My favorite had to be the boiled fish noodle soup, the noodles and broth were extraordinary! The dumplings and wonton soup left something more to desire and the chicken was a bit dry. The pumpkin cakes were very pleasant and the kelp silk was average.

Overall, we had some good dishes and one great dish for an incredible price! I would recommend this restaurant to any tourist. Next time, we will get the soup dumplings.

document: Salty Lunch Lady's Little Luncheonette. cuisine: Sandwiches. located in Queens. with 4.4 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
I was surprised by wait line just 20min after opening. The menu is short and simple. The chicky sandwich was really good. I wish I can say the same for tuna melt. It was just meh.
I wish I could try their strawberry lemon cake but they were out of it at the moment. It looked amazing.

I came across Salty Lunch Lady’s Little Luncheonette on YouTube one night when I was half awake / half asleep and saved it on my maps for my yearly trip to the city… and I’m so glad I did.

This place is the definition of a hidden gem. The food is next level — like the kind of good where you take one bite and immediately feel validated for saving it months ago. Everything tasted fresh, homemade, and made with actual care.

The dill party turkey was so good it literally disappeared before I could even take a pic. Gone. No evidence. Just a memory and zero regrets.

The cream corn sandwich was unreal — crispy, buttery, sweet + savory, and ridiculously satisfying. It’s one of those dishes that sounds simple but eats like something you’ll randomly think about weeks later.

And the fig pie? Perfect. Not too sweet, super flavorful, and honestly the kind of dessert that ends the meal on a high note like a mic drop.

Great neighborhood spot! Seems like it has a lot of the original fixings and charm. I had the chicky and a chocolate chip cookie. The cookie was divine! Always a long line on the weekends (sometimes out the door) but it moves quickly. Once you’ve ordered, be ready to wait 25-30 minutes for your sandwich though! It will be worth the wait. There is some outdoor seating too for the warmer months.

I absolutely love Salty Lunch Lady! I live around the corner and have been too many times to count. The rotating desserts are so so so good, in particular the passion fruit and raspberry ones I’ve had were mind blowing, and this place knows how to make a real good cookie.

The sandwiches are consistently excellent. I have a soft spot for the Chicky and Dill Party but the Sunday specials and all regular sandwiches are also really delicious. So glad you’re here!

I really wanted to like Salty Lunch Lady, but I honestly don’t get the hype.

The sandwiches are small, slow to come out, and expensive, ranging from about $14–$18, and there’s nothing about them that feels special. The ingredients might be good quality, but the execution is very basic. We tried the chicken sandwich and the turkey sandwich and both were just okay. Nothing memorable. The seeded sesame bun didn’t taste very fresh either, which is a big miss for a sandwich spot.

The service setup is also strange. You have to grab your own sandwich, your own utensils, and then bus your own plates and cups afterward. For those prices, that feels off. It’s not a casual deli price point, but it’s a self-service experience.

I will say, the desserts are excellent. The ginger cake was moist and the cream was delicious. But $12 for a single slice of cake is outrageous, even factoring in overhead. It just feels disconnected from reality.

Overall, this place feels overhyped. I don’t understand the glowing reviews. In my opinion, they need to either make the sandwiches bigger and better seasoned, lower the prices, or lean fully into the baked goods and rethink the pricing and service model. Even something as simple as having staff clear tables would improve the experience.

As it stands, I wouldn’t rush back.

🍽️ Dinner at 农耕记 — Food First, Drinks Later, With a 23-Year-Old “Lamp Post” 😂

Came to 农耕记 for a proper Chinese feast, and the food definitely stole the spotlight:

🔥 Grilled Eel (Roasted Chili Flavor)
Smoky, fragrant, and beautifully grilled. The roasted chili gave it that bold, addictive aroma without overpowering the eel. Tender inside, slightly charred outside — dangerous in a good way.

🍚 Wuchang Steamed Rice
Simple but premium. Fluffy, fragrant, and the perfect partner to soak up all the sauces. Sometimes, good rice makes ALL the difference — and this one delivered.

🍄 Dry Pot Velvet Mushrooms (Non-Spicy)
Earthy, savoury, and super satisfying. Even without spice, it was packed with wok hei and flavour. A great veggie dish that didn’t feel like a “side character.”

🥩 Stir-Fried Beef with Tea Oil
This one surprised me. Tender beef with a light, fragrant tea oil aroma — rich but not greasy. Unique flavour profile and very more-ish.

🥤 Drinks to Wash It All Down:

🍑 Jasmine White Peach (Less Ice)
Refreshing, lightly sweet, and perfect to cool down after all that savoury goodness. Peach + jasmine = dangerous combo (you keep sipping).

🫖 Hot Jasmine Flower & Fruit Tea (Refillable Pot)
A classy, soothing finish. Light, fragrant, and refillable — perfect for long chats and pretending to be healthy.

👨‍👩‍👦 Bonus: Had dinner with our younger son, aka the 23-year-old lamp post — tall, quiet, and mainly there for decoration… but good company nonetheless 🤣

Overall: Solid food, great flavours, and a fun family dinner. Will definitely be back for more grilled and dry pot action!

We decided to visit this restaurant last minute, and it was actually our first time , doing a walk-in we were pleasantly surprised to get a table right away. The service was very nice, and everyone was professional and welcoming.
The food was decent, though nothing particularly special. Drinks and coffee were okay, but we felt they could offer more variety or different flavors. Overall, it was a good experience.

After several trips to Baraki over the past few months, I can wholeheartedly say it is one of my favorite spots in NYC. From the cocktails to the food, everything is spectacular.
I can never get enough of the whipped feta and chicken baraki. The steak skewers and  (if I remember correctly) grilled cheese bites with vodka sauce were 10/10.
Beyond the food, Baraki has a creative and extensive cocktail list. Each cocktail is unique, flavorful, and colorful.
It’s a great restaurant with a beautiful outdoor space in the back.
Baraki is a great spot to spend an afternoon with friends sharing plates and trying out different cocktails!

I've been here a couple of times with my family and the food is delicious. This time I came alone and sat at the bar and it was cool as well. The bartenders were nice and made my "alone time" not feel so alone lol.

Appetizers were good. Milk and sugar needs to come with the coffee.
Food was good. We filled up on the appetizers so they give good portions. The music was lively and good. They need more servers.

name: Barkada Social Club
document: Barkada Social Club. cuisine: Filipino Wine Bars Cocktail Bars. located in Queens. with 4.4 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
If you’re craving authentic Filipino flavors, Bakada Social Club is a fantastic find. I stopped in recently for a fix and was not disappointed.

I ordered the Tapsilog (cured beef and egg) along with an order of Lumpia, and both were delicious and hit the spot. Beyond the food, the ambiance is a major plus—it’s stylish and welcoming without being overly noisy, making it a great place to actually hold a conversation. The staff provided excellent service, ensuring everything was taken care of throughout the meal.

I left feeling very satisfied and am already planning to bring a group of friends back next time.

I went here on a Sunday afternoon for brunch and it has to be one of my favorite places to eat. The place was quiet at first, but more people came in an it started getting quite lively. The food was not only delicious but also flavorful. The staff were kind and attentive. I highly recommend the brunch menu with the bottomless drinks. The Bellini was great, but keep in mind that they no longer serve Sangrias.

Delicious food in a lovely atmosphere. The Ube Espresso Martini is light unique and refreshing. The lumpia was crisp to perfection with a slight zing to their sweet chilli sauce. My wife loved the homemade shrimp paste that came with the kare kare. Meals were well portioned for an amazing price. Everything is done with touches of authentic Filipino culture

Filipino food in Astoria, how refreshing and just what the neighborhood needed. Centrally located off the MTA, close to everything. This is your new chill, delicious neighborhood Filipino restaurant spot to hang out! This is a date spot, a solo chill at the bar "Cheers"  spot, a bring your friends spot, a takeover the large back section and watch the game spot.

Let's get to the food. Barkada gives you traditional Filipino comfort AND twist. You can have one, the other or both. Really comprehensive menu without being overwhelming, all dishes we ordered were done well. The star for me, hands down Sinigang Wings (hello dry rub with so much flavor and juicy tender chicken). I've not seen this before, it was familiar yet not, and they did it well! Also loved the pork bbq skewers, so flavorful, juicy you will wish you ordered more. Beef Kaldereta is also a Filipino favorite, it lasted me for a few days, generous portion. Lovedddd the calamansi mule!

Staff was friendly and attentive, some staff Filipino and some not, which represents this neighborhood. It was a nice touch that the owner came by to say hello and thank us. It's clear this place wants to do stay long and keep people coming back.

Sure it's a Filipino restaurant, which is special alone, but it's more, it's a place for people to have delicious comfort Filipino food, but also a space for the culture to be shared and enjoyed by all. Giemay - you did your thing, I want to see you and your team win and will be back because I need to have silog brunch in my lifeeeeee

It’s been a long time coming, but Astoria finally has an authentic Filipino joint! The food is delicious and the drinks are crafted with care, but what truly makes this place shine is the atmosphere. It feels warm, welcoming, and unhurried; the kind of spot where you can relax, take your time, and enjoy great conversations with friends while soaking in the vibe.

name: Mis Tierras Colombianas
document: Mis Tierras Colombianas. cuisine: Colombian. located in Queens. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: My partner and I stopped by for a late-night dinner and were immediately struck by how lively and full of energy the place was. Clearly the spot to be! We ordered the carne encebollado, empanadas, a margarita, and the flan, and everything was cooked to perfection. Our waitress (I wish I got her name) was absolutely wonderful. She even helped my partner practice his Spanish! We’ll definitely be coming back and bringing friends next time.

Newly renovated. Awesome food great prices. Try the lunch specials more bang for the buck 😜. Lots of flat screens great place to watch the soccer ⚽ league games. There's a bar if that's your thing. The food was great on my visit. The restroom was very clean.  They accept card and cash. Great place to take a family for a Sunday meal.

Every time we have the opportunity to go to this restaurant, we take it, it is a must every time we go to Queens.

The restaurant is spacious and always has a festive atmosphere, so as soon as you enter you feel at home.
They always welcome you with good energy and a nice smile, most of the people who work there are Colombians so they know very well how to make you feel like you're back in Colombia. They also offer the possibility of booking for a large group of people or for an event.

The menu is extensive and offers a variety of price options, including a weekly menu that varies depending on the day.
They have something to share, from red meats, chicken and seafood in different presentations and preparations.
We have tried the bandeja paisa and the Fríjoles antioqueños (my favorite), and the portions are huge, so even with just one plate two can eat.
We also ordered the cheese and pineapple empanadas, which were super delicious.
The fried fish and the ceviche are pretty amazing too.
To have a lulo juice and a aguapanela with lemon, perfect for summer.
They also sell cocktails or liquor if you want to drink alcohol.

The staff is always very friendly, they know the menu very well and offer good recommendations, and they are always very attentive to everything.

Recommended 🇨🇴🫘🫓🍳🍲🍛🥟☕🍻🇨🇴

Great restaurants. The service was excellent and fast also severd with a smile. This is my go to place for a skirt steak.
I think it was the best skirt steak I ever had.
I highly recommend you give the place a try.
I can't say a bad word about this restaurant.

Great place to eat and good value. I can attest that the customer service here is exemplary. The restaurant is always kept nice and clean no food on the floor and the bathrooms are clean. I come here on Sundays and Weekdays. The food service is moderately fast and the cooking is with great seasoning. Parking around the area is good towards midnight.

document: Flame. cuisine: Asian Fusion Teppanyaki Sushi Bars. located in Bronx. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: I randomly found this place while searching for somewhere that was open on a Monday night and found this! This place is reasonably priced and has very nice customer service. The man at the cashier was very helpful with explaining dishes and making small talk. I got a hibachi combo with noodles, chicken, and shrimp and a dancing shrimp roll. The hibachi combo was overall pretty good but the vegetables were a bit soggy. The roll had shrimp and crab and was good. I don't live around the area but if I did I would come back!

I shouldn't write a review yet because I didnt get a hibachi or a bento box, but I got the spicy shrimp and crab roll and tempura shrimp.

The shrimp came from the same dealer that makes these tempura shrimp and sells them to restaurants. The maki roll was a little underwhelming, but their yum-yum sauce saved it. It was weirdly tight and squared, so I think it was machine made in some way.

I will get a hibachi soon, because of the other good reviews.

My only wish right now is that they had miso soup. I love a good miso soup before my japanese entree.

​I recently visited Flame Japanese Hibachi in Falls Church, and I was absolutely blown away! While the hibachi experience is always fun, the real star of the show for me was an appetizer that deserves its own spotlight: the Boneless Chicken Wings.
​Seriously, if you go to Flame, you must try these. They aren't your average appetizer—they are absolutely enormous! The size is incredibly generous, making them feel like a main dish. More importantly, the taste is delicious and perfectly executed. They are wonderfully crispy on the outside, incredibly juicy on the inside, and coated in a savory sauce that strikes just the right balance of sweet and tangy.
​From the friendly service to the exciting cooking show at the hibachi tables and, of course, those phenomenal, big, and delicious boneless chicken wings, Flame Japanese Hibachi is a must-visit spot in Falls Church. Highly recommended!

Finally got to try this halal-certified hibachi restaurant. Safe to say I was not disappointed. I got the chicken and beef combo with noodles and vegetables — the flavor was so strong. Cheesecake smoothie was good. Customer service was fantastic, they brought us the food, explained the menu, and were attentive to any needs. Definitely coming back and highly recommend you to try!

This place makes dog food appealing by comparison. The meat is all gristle and the website pictures are deceiving…see my pics.

The guy there immediately asked for a good Google review when I picked it up and said he’d give me an extra yum yum sauce if I gave 5 stars.

But this isn’t “yum yum”; it’s “yuk yuk” so 1 start. Avoid this place like the plague.

name: Seafood House
document: Seafood House. cuisine: Seafood. located in Bronx. with 3.8 stars (good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
A fantastic spot to gather with family and friends, where the vibe is lively and welcoming. The seafood is impeccably fresh.

The cream of crab soup is a must order — luxuriously rich and loaded with sweet crab meat in every spoonful. Truly unforgettable as you savor slowly the whole bowl.

The lightly battered fried calamari arrives golden and crisp, delicate rather than heavy — best enjoyed piping hot when the exterior still crackles and the inside stays tender. A place that delivers both comfort and coastal indulgence in every bite. Friendly and attentive staff.

Casual and decent seafood options known for their crab but too bad when we visited (January)  they were out! Place is fairly large with a large bar area and TVs all around that’s great for a sports game. The must order is definitely the crab cakes which were juicy and meaty. Everything else tastes typical at best. The old fashioned was made on the stronger side- which all alcoholics can appreciate. The seafood egg-rolls were are tasty, albeit a bit pricey at $23 for 4 pieces ( really 2 cut in half). Just a shame we didn’t get to try to blue crabs.

The restaurant is right on the water. The view is pretty good! The food is to die for! It was so fun to crack open the crabs. The crush drinks are delicious!! The stuffed shrimp with crab is soooo good!! And the fries and rice! It was absolutely sp good!! Maria was THE BEST waitress EVER!! She taught us how to crack the crabs open and everything. She made us feel comfortable and at ease. She was amazing! She made the visit even better!! I wish we lived in the state ap we could come back! Parking can be tough, but there is valet parking for just $10! The place was packed Sunday morning, but there was a Ravens game so it cleared out quickly!

Nice little spot on the water away from the traffic of the city.  Would be very chill spot in the summer time but since I came when its freezing out , I dont knownwhat thr overall atmosphere is.

The food is decent..staff is nice and place is clean. I had the grilled salmon that could have used some seasoning but it was ok.

Nick’s is well known for a reason. The space and waterfront vibes are great. The food is fantastic, and the drinks are also really good. We enjoyed both the shrimp mac and cheese and the crabcake. This is a great option for gameday or happy hour!

Now here on a Sunday afternoon & Nate the bartender is a vibe too! Great service & the brunch hit the spot! 100 star service both times up in here! Stop through and tell them Dave from Charlie’s Bar & Kitchen sent you!!!

name: San Gennaro Trattoria Restaurant Bar
document: San Gennaro Trattoria Restaurant Bar. cuisine: Italian Mediterranean. located in Bronx. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
My culinary quest led me to San Gennaro on Arthur Avenue, which is a charming, small spot in the heart of the Bronx's Little Italy—a great location for a weekend brunch or afternoon espresso.

Unfortunately, my experience with both the quality of the food quality and service was sadly disappointing.

For appetizers, I ordered the Burrata and Calamari Fritti, (both were very nice)followed by the server-recommended main, the Paccheri Genovese. Despite only one other table being seated, the main course took approximately 30 minutes to arrive and was delivered at roughly room temperature. While the meat in the dish was well-cooked, the accompanying sauce lacked any distinct flavor to activate the dish.

Even granting grace that this may have been an off day for the staff, the combination of the significant wait time, the lukewarm food, and the overall poor service prevents me from recommending this restaurant.

We met here for a family dinner and it was an amazing choice! They were even able to accommodate our reservation when we arrived earlier than expected. If we are back in the area we will return! The affogato was amazing and the kids loved the Lemon gelato.

Had the special of the mussels so so amazing. Gabbi our server was so sweet and funny and just made the whole meal. Love the atmosphere and the service was pretty fast, didn’t have to wait too long for our food. Also perfect for anyone with a gluten issue they have a full gluten free menu

We ventured into Arthur Av for lunch after hitting the NY Botanical Gardens. Thankfully, San Gennaro had available tables since it was Mother's Day. The restaurant is cozy, sitting for less than 40 people, including the tables outside. The staff are super friendly, prompt, and helpful. We started with the fried meatballs and the burrata salad with Prosciutto presuito. The burrata is homemade, and it's creamy and delicious. The salad was amazing. The meatballs were excellent. They were served in a little skillet with onions, garlic, and red peppers. For our mains, we ordered the ravioli alla bolagnese and the cavatelli with Italian sweet sausage & sauteed broccoli rabe. The cavatelli was light in flavor, but good. However, the winner was the ravioli. The bolagnese sauce was probably the best bolagnese sauce I've ever had. It was rich, bold, and so full of amazing flavor it was awesome. This place is a gem. I highly recommend you stop here and get anything with their bolagnese sauce.

Cozy space with warm ambiance.
Friendly staff.
Delightful and delicious meals eggplant parmigiana and gnocchi alla sorrentina

document: A TASTE OF SEAFOOD BRONX. cuisine: Seafood Breakfast & Brunch. located in Bronx. with 3.1 stars (decent).

google_reviews.text: On 12/23, I ordered from A Taste of Seafood via Uber eats for me and a family member. I spent $48. My family got a fish sandwich $8 which came with 3 pieces of whiting and, I got  the four piece lobster tails with a side of collard greens $40. My family said that the fish sandwich was good and they would eat it again. My lobster tails were ok; the tail itself contained more flavor and batter vs the actual lobster; it's possible that the lobster wasn't fully battered/coated or that the coating came off is the grease; this led me to really missed that crunch and flavor. The collard greens had turkey meat in them, and were extremely salty; I even let my family try to make sure it wasn't just my taste buds. I was able to save the greens by adding the greens to a bowl and covering them in water and then reheating them in the microwave, then tossing the water; the flavor was preserved and I took away some of the salt. name: Dakota’s On The Cove
document: Dakota’s On The Cove. cuisine: Seafood Cocktail Bars New American. located in Bronx. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Dakota on the Cove in the Bronx with my brother, and it was an absolutely unforgettable experience from start to finish! This hidden gem on the water offers a perfect blend of cozy ambiance, stunning views, and top-notch Italian-inspired cuisine that left us raving for days.
We kicked things off with drinks at the bar, and they did not disappoint. I opted for the local Bronx Brewery Pilsner, which was crisp, refreshing, and perfectly balanced— a true nod to the neighborhood’s brewing scene. My brother went for the White Mistletoe specialty cocktail, a festive, smooth concoction that had just the right hint of holiday cheer without being overpowering. It set the tone for a relaxed and enjoyable evening.
For appetizers, we shared the mozzarella en carozza, which was golden, crispy on the outside, and oozing with melty cheese inside—pure comfort food elevated to gourmet levels. The Caesar salad was fresh, tangy, and generously topped with shaved Parmesan and crunchy croutons, making it the ideal light start.
Our mains were showstoppers: the glazed salmon was flaky, perfectly cooked, and drizzled with a sweet-savory glaze that paired beautifully with the sides. My brother’s chicken cutlet pasta with linguine was hearty and flavorful, with tender cutlets in a rich sauce that had us both stealing bites. Every dish was prepared with care, using fresh ingredients that shone through in every bite.
We couldn’t resist ending on a sweet note with the cannoli—crisp shells filled with creamy ricotta, dusted with powdered sugar, and just the right amount of chocolate chips. Divine!
The service was impeccable; our server was attentive, friendly, and full of great recommendations without being intrusive. The whole staff made us feel like family. If you’re in the Bronx looking for a spot to impress or just unwind, Dakota on the Cove is a must-visit. We’ll be back soon—five stars all the way!

My new favorite dinner date spot. Iris and her team of professionals made our #1stDate experience wonderfully perfect. On a chilly autumn 🍂 evening the temperature, lighting, mood, and ambiance of this casual dining room offered us the right amount of music volume to allow us to speak and really get to know each other and the staff made us feel at home and delivered timely service, accurately executed, hot & delicious offerings. We kept it simple by splitting the tuna tostado, tonight's special harvest salad and the crab cakes. The portions were great and the flavors were outstanding. A little pinot noir 🍷 some sparkling Saratoga water with lemon & lime 🍋 wedges and that's all we needed to satiate & satisfy our palates. The newly decorated outdoor seating with fire pit tables were the right touch to cap off the evening with a lil' romantic spin. Thank you everyone for putting an exclamation point on an already terrific date and night out. We will be back!! #LocalGem #GoodEats #theresthatfoodie #AVTeats

The inside of the restaurant has an updated, really cute, modern look overlooking the water, and the service and food were great! Everyone was so kind and it seems they have put considerable effort into curated menus (including a Valentine’s themed drink menu) and events!

We stopped in to Dakota's on the Cove tonight on a whim. Driving home from P.A., stuck in massive traffic on the C.B.E. ( shocker) and starving, I checked my GPS to see what restaurants were nearby. Lucky enough we were a quarter mile from the last exit before the Throgsneck bridge because as soon as you got off, the restaurant was within View.
Talk about timing....We were able to get a seat in a booth by the bar. The view of the sunset on the bridge was spectacular. They also have an outdoor deck with seating and a HUGE beautiful Biergarten with a bar, picnic tables, Adirondack chairs , fire pits and a big screen TV.!
Our drink order was taken and a basket of bread placed on the table. Our drinks came immediately and we placed our dinner order. We ordered the Fried Shrimp basket which came with french fries and the Herb Grilled chicken which came with vegetables and roasted potatoes. Everything was delicious. document: Areitos Lounge and Grill. cuisine: Latin American Spanish. located in Bronx. with 4.9 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: After viewing a promotion for Ladies Night on Thursdays, a group of us gathered after work for Karaoke and Happy Hour here. We arrived about 7:30 ish and the place was empty. Our group didn’t mind, the weather wasn’t the best and we figured it’s still newly promoted. We were greeted and taken care of by Shanti. Our server was friendly, sweet and polite! We asked about karaoke and made a prior reservation but she said the band equipment would not make it. I recommend calling after 7pm to ensure that it will be available if you are only going for karaoke. Aside from that , the food was delicious! Everything we had tasted great! I highly recommend the chicharrón if that’s your thing. The drink specials were good.. we had lemon drop cocktails and for ladies night, we enjoyed a round of shots! Shanti played great music and we danced like the place belonged to us. In overall, I would definitely recommend coming here. I’ve heard and seen Areito on a weekend and it gets packed! They have bottle and hookah specials and the music never fails. I hope ladies night can make it! It would be a great addition.

Visited in the middle of the afternoon and was greeted with a warm smile 😊—our server was genuinely kind and helpful throughout.✨ The food? Freshly made to order and absolutely delicious 😋—you could taste the quality in every bite! 🍽️ Sadly, we were short on time and had to take it to go 🏃‍♀️, but it was still worth every moment. Parking was a breeze with both street spots and garages 🅿️ nearby, which made the whole experience even smoother. The atmosphere had a lively & uptempo vibe🌿 I’ll definitely be back for a longer, more relaxed visit 💫. I recommend if you’re in the area! 🌟

I just have to share this incredible experience with all of you!

First, the service: From the moment we walked in, the welcome was warm and fast. Even though the place was full, they managed to find us seats and made space out of nowhere—it honestly amazed me!

Second, the food: Oh. My. God. The Latin cuisine here is out of this world! We ordered a variety of dishes, and every single one was delicious and authentically made. We were so hungry and excited that we completely forgot to take pictures—oops! Definitely try the mixed grill, fish with coconut and fried yucca, Alfredo pasta, and shrimp mofongo. Everything was spot on!

Third, the atmosphere: The place is spacious and vibrant. As you walk in, there’s a wall with artistic paintings under UV light—really cool touch. The DJs get the crowd going, playing music for everyone, and the staff truly make you feel like you’re partying at home.

Bonus tip: It’s great for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The food quality is consistently excellent, and they even have live bands on Thursdays and Sundays!

Highly recommended—whether you’re hungry or just looking for a fun night out, this place has it all!

document: Fratelli. cuisine: Italian Seafood. located in Bronx. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Fratelli is hands down my favorite spot for authentic Italian cuisine. From the moment you sit down, the bread service sets the tone—warm, fresh, and delicious.

I ordered the special red snapper with scallops and shrimp over fettuccine, along with the lobster bisque. Both were absolute perfection: the pasta was packed with flavor, and the bisque was rich and creamy.

We also tried the ossobuco, which was melt-in-your-mouth tender and generously portioned—I had enough to take home!

And of course, dessert is a must. Their whole selection is tempting, but the pistachio cake is my favorite.

Fratelli has become our go-to date night spot and I can’t recommend it enough!

I typically don’t make reviews, but had to let the Googleverse know that Fratelli’s is our Sunday brunch tradition or basically WHENEVER my family & I crave Italian/stellar service. Favorite for me is their creamy mushroom soup during this frigid weather.
