name: Master Huang
document: Master Huang. cuisine: Taiwanese. located in Queens. with 4.4 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
I’ve finally found my favorite Taiwanese restaurant in the east coast. This spot is the spot to try if you want real authentic Taiwanese food with extensive menu items. My eyes lit up when I saw the menu. The owners are from Tainan, Taiwan which is often consider the culinary capital of Taiwan with many iconic traditional dishes and flavors.

The restaurant is spacious but it does not have many table seatings (3-5 tables?). When we came it wasn’t busy so we got a spot but we did see many people coming in for their takeout orders. The oldies they play at the restaurant take me back to my childhood. The place is structured very interestingly where it’s an open kitchen so you can actually easily see how they prep the food in the back.

We ordered:
- oyster omelette pancake
- mung wort kueh (4 pieces)
- danzai noodle
- mixed spice platter

The oyster omelette was the highlight! The bottom is crispy and they use a generous amount of oysters. It’s the most authentic oyster pancake I’ve had in the east coast. Alot of other “Taiwanese spots” don’t make it correctly.

I also love the mung wort kueh (hard to find places that sell this) - it’s a fun snack to take to go. It’s a savory mochi bun with shredded radish as the main ingredient.

The danzai noodle is an iconic dish from Tainan. Its main star consists of the one shrimp and the marinated ground braised pork. Although I would prefer the dry version but they serve the soup version here. The broth tastes very clear and clean, doesn’t feel like it’s dosed with salt and MSG.

We got the mixed platter - an iconic street food in Tainan is 滷味 (Lou Wei) which is consist of different ingredients tossed and braised in a soy-based spice sauce. They have a nice selection of Lou Wei options and the platter we got had pork belly, duck neck, tofu skin, and lotus roots. The spicy duck neck can be intimidating for those that have never had it but it is fun to eat.

There are so many items on there that I can’t wait to try. For first timer, definitely get the oyster pancake and Luroufan! I can’t wait to come back and try more of the traditional Taiwanese dishes. They also have frozen dumplings that you can buy to go. 50 pieces for $28-$30 is a pretty good price!

The best braised pork rice I’ve had in a very long time. Their salt and pepper chicken was super tender and the rice sausage/taiwanese sausage was so good! The braised dishes were ok.
Only complaint is the beef noodle soup; we waited waited 20 mins and for $16 you get three pieces of meat. It was average noodle soup and definitely not worth the price.

I recently discovered Master Huang, a new restaurant in town. While some might find the owner stern, I see it as a sign of solemn professionalism. It's heartwarming to see the owner working diligently alongside his elderly parents—a true family collaboration. The food is well-flavored and definitely worth a try.

Cannot believe that after living in Queens for over 10 years I just now discover this diamond in the rough.  Had the typical braised pork rice滷肉飯, pork meatballs in clear soup貢丸湯, and fried glutenous rice bun filled with meat & pickled veggies肉圓。All are delicious! Dreaming about traditional Taiwanese food all the time, I’m going to have to bike here from afar just to be able to burn off the calorie I’ll be consuming every time.  There’s only one small table of two and a large table of six people… I was lucky went at off lunch/ dinner time.  Most people walked in just had their meals to go.
Found this GEM driving by, the taste reminds me when I was in Taiwan, closest comparison in Flushing. I would recommend this restaurant to all Taiwanese! Awesome 台灣小吃！

document: Smash House Burgers Queens. cuisine: Burgers. located in Queens. with 3.9 stars (good).

google_reviews.text:
My favorite Smash Burger Place!
Had a wonderful time with the family at Smash House Queens. The manager Ben is amazing! He made sure my family and I had everything we needed! Excellent service! Definitely will be coming back soon! Must trys are the Loaded Smash, Dirty Fires and Philly Cheese steak! Definitely want to try the rest of the items on the menu!

I genuinely wanted to like this place, but unfortunately, it didn’t live up to the hype it has on TikTok. At this point, I’m beginning to wonder if some of those glowing TikTok videos are paid promotions, because the food was simply not up to par.

Upon entering the establishment, we were not greeted, which immediately set the tone and the fact there's waa a bit of trash on the tables and floors. When we attempted to ask a few questions, the young man at the front seemed preoccupied with his cellphone and was not attentive, even after a fewl attempts to get his attention. He was polite once engaged, but first impressions matter — especially in hospitality — and this one fell flat.

Pricing is another concern. For the quality provided, the menu feels overpriced. We ordered three items, and the total came to just over $60 — quite steep for what is essentially fast food. To make matters worse, there are additional charges for minor add-ons: lettuce, for example, costs extra, as does any additional sauce (50 cents each). Even asking for garlic mayo on a sandwich adds another 50 cents to the bill.

On a positive note, the food was served promptly. We began with the Dirty Fries — seasoned fries topped with BBQ brisket, more BBQ sauce, and two additional sauces. While the portion was generous, the overall flavor profile leaned excessively sweet, lacking the balance needed to make it enjoyable. The dish could benefit from some acidity or spice — perhaps jalapeños or another vegetable element — to offset the overpowering sweetness of the BBQ sauce.

Next came the Schnitzel Sando. The chicken itself was juicy, but the sandwich as a whole lacked flavor and depth. It desperately needed a built-in sauce to complement the protein, or the chicken should have been more boldly seasoned. While there were plenty of side sauces available, I didn’t feel this particular sandwich should rely on add-ons to deliver its flavor.

Finally, we tried the Loaded Smash. 11/2/25 This item had potential — the concept works — but it was overwhelmingly salty. I even had to ask the staff to take it back so the turkey bacon could be fried longer, as it was initially very chewy.

In the end, after spending over $60, we left feeling rather unsatisfied.  As per other reviews about the lack of PROPER customer service  it seems like this is an on-going issue. While the speed of service was commendable, the experience as a whole didn’t justify the price or the online hype.

document: Pho Bang. cuisine: Vietnamese. located in Queens. with 3.3 stars (decent). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: One of my old time old school favorites been coming here for 15 years at least, it’s a no fuss great pho free hot tea kind of spot. Great fast service fair prices for the area and they never change a thing! A proper institution!

The food was great. The service is not that good, they gave my fried chicken to another family and then when I asked about it, they tried to return it back to us. I told them that we’d like a new one. The older man in the front is efficient, but everyone else seems a bit lost and untrained. Overall, this place is tasty. But they also had a few flies around the place. This is one of those places where the food is great, but everything else is not. I’m conflicted.

Ran into this place randomly one night and ran into Rich Brian lol. The food was pretty decent t with big portions. The restaurant is more of a modernized asian cuisine with attentive staff. The menu has tons of unfamiliar items, if you feel confused just ask the staff they’ll explain it to you quickly. But I will say this, they have a very good selection on protein options.

The food isn’t anything to rave about. It’s decent at best. Or maybe I just came on the wrong day. It was a Sunday afternoon with not many patrons. As we entered we were greeted promptly and seated . They do need to work on training their staff instead of yelling and demanding the waitress. We found that pretty rude.
The waitress was nice. The food came out on time. The summer rolls were okay. The pork in the summer rolls tasted a bit odd. The shrimp in the summer rolls were good.
Also ordered the vermicelli noodles with grilled pork. It’s what I usually get at Vietnamese restaurants. Wasn’t blown away by the taste. The portion sizes on all dishes were great. But the flavor lacked on all the dishes.
What disappointed the most were the fried spring rolls. They tasted super stale.
My girlfriend got a seafood soup dish with noodles that she seems to enjoy, but she did mention the broth was pretty bland.
Overall we had a decent experience. Nothing to rave about. We left with full tummies , but disappointed in the lack of flavors in the dishes.
Staff was nice (except for the management yelling at the waitress in front of patrons) , interior is what’s expected for a hole in the wall.
Probably wouldn’t come back here with there being much better options in the area.
Exactly the type of broth to warm your soul on a cold day. Some of my favorite pho in the city.

document: Taverna Kyclades. cuisine: Seafood Greek Mediterranean. located in Queens. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: Such a delicious meal!!!! The oysters were so fresh; all of their seafood is super fresh. The grilled octopus was cooked perfectly it was soft with a slightly crispy outside from being char grilled. It had a great char flavor paired with the olive oil and vinegar was perfect. The pork souvlaki was my favorite of the night. The pork was juicy and had great flavor. I really like their tzatziki it’s very fresh with lots of cucumber. The lamb chops were also pretty good. I don’t usually like lamb because it’s gamey but this wasn’t and it was also cooked perfectly. They also gave delicious bread with a mashed olive dip at the start and a custard baklava type dessert for free! 8.5/10

This is the place to get seafood.  Very busy, but do t let that discourage you because at the end you'll be rewarded with some real, real fresh and delicious seafood. The octopus is simply fenomenal, the special combo seafood for two is amazing and the stuff filet  of sole very tasty.  All this complemented with a glass of sangria. Can't beat it. If you don't have reservation get ready to wait for at least 45 minutes, but it will be worth it.

This elegant, authentic greek seafood restaurant constantly has a 45 minute wait on Friday and Satueday nights. The meal is worth it, crispy olive bread with tapenade in olive oil, greek salads, a dozen varieties of fish including shark and swordfish as well as beef, chicken and lamb. The seafood pasta and the salmon were exceptional. Greek sides such as chard and lemon potatos follow the large entree portions. Excellent wine selection. Complementary house dessert with every meal. A staple of Ditmars, Tavern Kyclades never disappoints.

We visited Taverna Kyclades and had a wonderful experience. The service was impeccable—every staff member, even those who weren’t our primary server, made sure we had everything we needed.

For appetizers, we enjoyed crab cakes with fried zucchini. For dinner, my husband had a white fish stuffed with crab meat, while I had a pasta dish featuring five types of seafood: octopus, mussels, clams, scallops, and shrimp. Every bite was full of flavor, and the portions were incredibly generous—we had to take half of our food home and enjoyed it for a couple more days!

Overall, the combination of excellent service, delicious food, and large portions made this a truly delightful dining experience.

We have been wanting to go here for a very long time, but just never quite made it. That was a mistake! They don't take reservations so we waited for a while. It was fine the area has a lot to see and do, so we walked around. We had the village salad, Kyclades special (seafood platter),grilled chicken, rice, and potatoes. There was only 2 of us, and enough food to feed 4! Each bite was better than the next! All the food was fresh and delicious, and reasonable! We will be going back a lot! Great Greek food!🇬🇷

Small restaurant hence not many tables (and it’s half service where you make your order at the counter, and they will serve it to you) but I really appreciate that they used proper bowls and utensils as opposed to single used ones. Will definitely be back again to try other dishes! Also liked their cute simple deco with drawings!

Regular that’s been coming for a long time and their food always hits the spot everytime. Their fried salt and pepper chicken cutlet is sooo good, crispy and goes so well with the rice. If I’m feeling something slightly heavier their braised pork over rice is a must get yall the pickled vegetables and the peanuts on the side goes well with the whole dish. The popcorn chicken is also chef’s kiss🧑‍🍳💋. I love coming here with others so we can share food! The chef is also a native Taiwanese person, so I love knowing that it’s authentic! I even saw Drew Barrymore come to this place wow! Big fan!! Definitely come check this place out.

******
What a lovely place! An extra star must be added manually compared to other noodle places.

The beef noodle soup was delicious — perfectly cooked noodles and big chunks of tender beef shank. The broth was so flavorful. I didn’t finish it, so I saved some for the next day, and it still tasted great.

I also ordered the fried sticky tofu, which
was amazing — honestly, it tasted even better the next day.

The server is a very polite and friendly young man, and the owner/chef is a lovely lady. The restaurant is very clean as well. If I wasn’t trying to stay on a diet, I would visit them every week!

Name of the restaurant does not indicate it's a Taiwanese restaurant but the quality of the food certainly does. Their beef noodle soup has thick cut meat and solid broth. Their oyster pancake is ok, the fried chicken reminds me of the night market big star chicken, a must try. If you dine in, they provide peanuts and a small amount of cold veggies to munch on while they prepare the food. The cafe is very much like a Taiwanese style mom and pop cafe. Pricing is one of the best also!

Great experience at this Taiwanese restaurant! The service is excellent, and the food is absolutely delicious. I especially love that they have chili sauce, such a nice touch! Portions are generous too, so you definitely leave satisfied. I really enjoy coming here!

document: Arepas Cafe. cuisine: Venezuelan Breakfast & Brunch Cocktail Bars. located in Queens. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: The best Venezuelan food in town! The chicken soup was amazing, and the mini platter was absolutely delicious. The service was exceptional. I will definitely come back for more!

Consistently the most delicious arepas, cachapas and chicken soup. I’ve been coming here for almost 20 years now, from being an Astoria resident years ago to now making the trip from out East, the excitement I get when walking into this family owned business is unmatched. The sangria is always delicious and the service is always so pleasant. So happy to see this family owned business is still surviving & thriving. Do yourself a favor and come taste the authenticity and love in their dishes and sauces.

**🌽 Arepa Café – A Flavor Explosion in the Heart of Astoria! 🌟**

If you're not already obsessed with Venezuelan food, prepare for a serious love affair. I just had the pleasure (no, the privilege) of dining at **Arepa Café** in Astoria, and let me tell you — my tastebuds are still doing a salsa dance. 💃🌶️

First up: the **Arepa Pabellón**. Imagine slow-cooked shredded beef that's so tender it practically melts into the arepa, paired with sweet plantains that feel like nature’s candy, black beans for that earthy richness, and a hit of salty white cheese to tie it all together. Every bite was a *FLAVOR BOMB* — the kind you wish you could rewind and experience all over again. 🌋💥

Then came the Mami de Pernil, which honestly should be illegal for being this good. Juicy, seasoned roasted pork stacked high, garlic mojo dripping off every corner of the arepa, and just enough sauce to make it messy in the best possible way. One bite and I was like, “Okay, who’s the culinary genius back there??” 👏🐷✨

The place itself? Cozy, colorful, and full of warmth — like walking into a Venezuelan hug. Whether you're rolling in with family, catching up with friends, or trying to impress a hot date, Arepa Café sets the mood and delivers the goods.

**Pro tip**: Bring an appetite and maybe a napkin or three — things get juicy fast. 😋

🔥 10/10 — Worth crossing boroughs for.
💛 Flavor: off the charts
🎉 Vibes: immaculate
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Great for: everyone, always

Love this place. Already planning my return. 💥

Probably the best brunch I’ve had in Astoria so far. My bf and I LOVE food, and this is GOOD FOOD. Omg, I’ve been dreaming about the cachapa since I had the first bite.

Service is extremely friendly, feels like a neighborhood spot. Owners are super nice and personable. Music is fun. If you’re hispanic you’ll probably love it here. 🇻🇪 Try the passion fruit mimosa on a Saturday morning with an empty stomach because my goodness, you WILL be full. 🤩 Fair prices too. We left fat and happy.

Food was ok, but some of food is just basic stuff with different names to make it sound unique but it's not😅 The mini cachapas are overpriced, should be half the price for how little you get. Some of the other prices seemed ok but mini cachapas aren't worth $10.  Atmosphere was too casual, felt like I walked into someone's living room. Overall was ok but it seemed better in the pictures

name: Taco King Mexican Grill
document: Taco King Mexican Grill. cuisine: Mexican. located in Queens. with 3.9 stars (good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
Interesting that 108th Street offers myriad kosher and halal eateries; just walking here makes me feel holier than thou. I stop at Taco Kings, whose prices seem untouched by inflation since I left the neighborhood a few years ago. An underrated virtue of the place is that it works just as well for gathering with friends as for reading and studying alone.

Over two excellent veg tacos, I read a Times editorial in which centrist economist Jason Furman confessed he couldn’t read the economic tea leaves—too many conflicting signals. He’s one of those one-handed economists LBJ once lamented. Whatever the macro outlook, I can say without hesitation: I love this taco place.

This is the best go to for healthy, delicious food, family owned business! I go here a couple of days a week. Their steak quesadilla is amazing and their black bean tacos for $2.25 is fantastic and delicious. I highly recommend Taco King!

Still a great place to get tex-mex food. They take credit cards now and are on food delivery apps but I suggest calling and ordering delivery directly from them.
They use skirt steak for their steak dishes. The Tortillas are fresh also. I love their salsa/sauce (the not spicy one). Food takes a bit to make, def not a bad thing. I suggest calling and ordering in advance. Very limited seating. Very busy place. People are always calling in or picking up an order.

Taco King Mexican Grill is definitely one of our favorite spots in the neighborhood when we are craving for taco or nacho.

They serve various cheap Asian Mexican food with decent quality and good flavors. We got their Nacho with Steak, Regular Chili Taco and side orders of shrimp & chicken to share with a group of two.

It’s overall delicious and our favorite was their steak, which was grilled properly & tender. However, their chicken was kind of dry and chewy.

Money Cheap but not Food Cheap! Alot of food for the money & tastes awesome! They are very fast too, i never waited more than 10min for my orders! Can't order without getting a side of Guac or Chilli.

name: The Monster Crab
document: The Monster Crab. cuisine: Cajun/Creole Seafood Cocktail Bars. located in Queens. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: The mussels, fried pickles, lobster rolls, steamed veggies, and clams were declious. As a salad lover you can pass on the salads. The drinks were well worth it. It was a bit noisy but a fun experience nevertheless. Highly recommend and will be coming back.

5/5. The waitress was friendly and continuous gave us new gloves before we even have to ask for them. The bathroom was clean. The food was really yummy! We came during lunch time ($29.99 AYCE) and that was enough for us. We got the snow crab legs and Dungeness crabs for an extra $5 per order and it was worth it. I would recommend you coming here and trying it out.

Friday night and no wait is a rare situation so it was great. Service was awesome and so was the food which came out hot and fast. The drinks were strong and nicely mixed. The price point was good if you are on a budget for their seafood offerings.

Food is very good. You can choose your own boil or share one with your family.
The servers are super attentive!! They also supply bibs, gloves, scissors, and crab crackers. The seafood always tastes fresh and you can adjust the spiciness level to your taste. Raw oysters and clams included in AYCE dinner menu, so worth it if you're like me and can eat 60 in one sitting 🤣 I would come more often if it was more affordable. The star off for atmosphere is that it is super dark inside the restaurant - difficult for older adults to see what they're eating.

The monster crab was very clean and well-kept, which made for a great first impression. The atmosphere was really nice,comfortable, welcoming, and perfect for relaxing or enjoying a meal with friends. The food was prepared very well and tasted fresh and flavorful. Overall, it was a great experience, and I’d definitely come back again! Especially for the oysters and fried chicken wings !

name: Empanadas Mix
document: Empanadas Mix. cuisine: Venezuelan Empanadas Hot Dogs. located in Queens. with 4.3 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
Just had a serious Venezuelan feast at Empanadas Mix 🇻🇪 and I’m still recovering like a champ. 💪
Walked in hungry… walked out questioning my life choices (in the best way). The Pepito Mix sandwich loaded with beef and chicken was basically a heavyweight champion between two pieces of bread. Then came the arepas—thick fried cornmeal shells stuffed with carne asada, pork belly, sweet plantains, special sauce, and a mountain of shredded queso. That’s not a snack… that’s a strategy for survival. 😅
Washed it down with fresh passion fruit juice and a cold Maltín Polar like a true gentleman of culture.
Shoutout to my waitress Paola, who patiently guided me through the menu while I pointed at everything like a kid in a candy store. The place is small, cozy, full of Venezuelan music, and the staff are incredibly kind.
Moral of the story:
Came for empanadas… stayed for the Venezuelan flavor knockout. 🥊🔥
I’ll definitely be back. Hungry. Again.

First time coming to this place! Lots of choices on their menu we didn't know what to pick! Amazing and friendly staff. Kuddos to the cashier who suggested the empanada, my husband loved it. The burger burrito, OMG , it was so good, it definitely filled me up and the passion fruit juice was delicious. We will definitely return!

Keilyn was absolutely wonderful from the moment we walked in. She was attentive, kind, and genuinely made us feel welcome the entire time. You can tell everyone there takes pride in what they do, after all is my childhood comfort food— everything felt smooth, thoughtful, and cared for. We truly appreciated the service and the empanadas, tequeños and cachapa. Is so good that is never enough.
Is also a good reminder that whenever we go, we’ll find in every way the warmest comfort to our home 🇻🇪 and the nicest people that represent us. Our gratitude again to Empanadas Mix (our forever place) and Keilyn for the best hospitality and service.
Ordered Burrito Pabellón with chicken and it was delicious. The house sauces had great flavor and everything was well put together. Highly recommend and I will be back to try different menu items
Amazing! The staff was very friendly and attentive. Hands down the best Venezuelan food in the city. Every bite was perfect. I can’t wait to come back.

document: PaPa Chicken. cuisine: Chicken Shop Burgers. located in Queens. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: I went there with my bf and he said it was pretty good a year ago when he tried it so we tried it together this year. I didn't know what to expect, but the person at front was very nice! And it only took 15 minutes to cook which was a really reasonable time. When the food came it looked amazing and tastes amazing too! It was super affordable and it's very filling as well!

We have been here ten times at least. The deals are great and the food is incredible. Really fresh, hot, delicious, something for everyone. Highly recommend. They have more than just fried chicken too! Fish, grilled and amazing whole chicken in a special sauce.

This place is absolutely the go-to for chicken lovers! We tried soo many of their dishes and they’re all delicious. Very clean, not too oily or breaded, flavorful seasoning, and fresh. Super affordable prices.

Really great chicken, very generous portion sizes. Chicken was well spiced and very juicy, with a great crunch. They give you an absolute ton of fries and onion rings, which were both good as well. Owner/staff were very friendly and dedicated, being there late at night in the snow.  For 23 bucks (2 sandwich combos) we got a huge amount of food

Read very good reviews for PaPa Chicken and also wanted to support the local small business. First of all, very good service by its friendly staff. Ordered the paprika chicken sandwich where the chicken breast was nicely coated and crispy, mostly thumbs up for the flavorful sauce. Very generous side order portions and the fries were also coated flavorfully, done just right. As for the honey roasted chicken wings, I personally would have preferred if the honey and soy marinated flavors are more prominent in the wings. Overall, a good experience. Keep up the good food and friendly service.

document: Cute Cat Cafe. cuisine: Breakfast & Brunch Coffee & Tea Juice Bars & Smoothies. located in Queens. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
Really nice spot. The lady was really sweet.. The only thing was I said no cheese and they brought it with cheese, they brought it back to me but, looked like they just tried to take off the cheese instead of making it over. They ended up making it over afterwards but had to wait a little longer. Bagel was good, I guess they don’t have actual bacon, I think it was turkey bacon.
Hot chocolate was good.
Outdoor seating.
Indoor felt cozy too.
Restroom inside.

June 2025: While I've been here much more over the last year, today's visit was disappointing. Ordered a pistachio boba tea and was just not good.
Boba is just tapioca that's soaked and sits in water until it's soft and ready. Today's tea, instead of it being soft like it should be, it was hard. There were also pieces of pistachio mix, on the bottom of the cup. The same in my daughter's as well. We ordered the same thing. While I love their hot foods and other coffees, this was definitely a miss.
Don't order the boba teas 😟.
But don't let boba stop you from coming here. Service is great, it's a very comforting place, food is really good.

June 2024: While looking for a new coffee place to go to while working on computer I decided on CCC.
Good reviews and lots of tables. Took a chance and glad I did. Will definitely be back! The one thing to note, they do not have AC. Their back and front doors were open and they have fans and today was warm but inside it was comfortable.
So if you must have AC, it won't be available here.
The women behind the counter today were super nice and brought my bagel to me. Nice touch.
Highly recommend this little coffee shop.

Love this place! It’s so unique and welcoming. The barista ladies are very sweet and friendly. The coffee and cookies here are great. I haven’t tried their food yet (besides the cookies), but I saw waffles served that looked so delicious. The backyard area is so cute.

This is one of my favorite cafes in Queens! I’m so happy they opened up again. Definitely feels cozier! I will say tho, I miss the high tables. I like switching between sitting and standing when I do work 😢 I hope they reconsider and bring some back.

Visiting Cute Cat Café was such a special experience for me. My cat had just passed away last Saturday, and honestly, I wasn’t sure how I would feel walking into a place filled with reminders of him. But from the moment I arrived, I was surrounded by such a comforting environment — portraits, statues of cats, and an atmosphere filled with kindness from both the staff and even the other guests. It really set the tone for a beautiful and healing experience.

While I was there, I even got to see one of the cats come out, and it felt so therapeutic just to sit there, enjoy my breakfast, and take it all in.

If you’re into mixing a cozy breakfast (or a hot or cold drink) with the joy of seeing adorable cats, this is definitely the place to be. I’m so grateful for spaces like this!

Had a great time tonight at Mojitos. Francisco is a great server. We came in with a large party and he handled everything and everyone well. He was also very patient, kind and got the orders correct.

The restaurant is very small but the decor is pretty and the atmosphere brings nice vibes.

Got there on time for happy hour! So I had the passion fruit mojito,which was delicious! Had the burger bites which were on point, then shared a lunch special which consisted of grilled chicken with noodle soup ,amazing! Definitely made me want to go back for more.

shrimp rice noodle roll with cilantro and chili oil 😮‍💨 gas

spot is small so can be hard to find a seat. if it’s too busy and the weather is nice, take it one long block to eat on benches outside the natural history museum

name: Dim Sum Bloom
document: Dim Sum Bloom. cuisine: Chinese. located in Queens. with 4.1 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
Surprisingly delicious dumplings, and even surprising that they have a good amount of options for vegetarians!

Sunday walk-in got us a decent window seating and noise levels were on the lower end. Our order consisted of Canton Wonton Soup, Shanghai Soup Dumpling, Four Colorful Soup Dumpling, Truffle Vegetable Shumai, and Lotus Leaf Rice w. Vegetarian Chicken (2 pieces).

With the exeption of the Lotus Leaf dumpling, everything was perfect. Food was packed with flavor! Menu is very well priced, and service was fantastic. Food arrived within 10 mins of placing the order.

Will be our go-to place in the neighborhood when craving dumpling!

We tried this restaurant after attending a church service nearby
We ordered:
TRUFFLE SHRIMP sio mai. I didn't taste much the truffle, looked dry. But the shrimps were fresh and medium size. The taste was average, 3/5
FRIED PORK DUMPLINGS. Mildly flavored that my friend didn't finish it. 2/5
DUCK SPRING ROLLS. Crispy wrapper but lacking in umami taste. 2/5
SHRIMP DUMPLINGS have fresh medium sized shrimps. This was what we enjoyed. Tho a little bland, the sauce of soy and vinegar carried the weight to perk up your appetite. 4/5
PEA SHOOTS vegs. They were fresh but had some hard stems. We liked it so much that we weren't able to touch the rice, 4/5
The tea was mild, too
We had 2 glasses of Chardonay that made our lunch complete.
We will come back to trynotyer dishes

High quality, creative ingredients make for high quality, memorable food! We were extremely happy with our meal here. Hot and Sour Soup had a kick and the beech mushrooms were an interesting touch. The Tiny Dumplings are TINY—they don’t mess around with the dish naming there. The citrusy side sauce was also a unique addition. The Three Cup Chicken was perfectly cooked and the choice of chicken thighs made the whole dish. The Honey Walnut Shrimp was, as my husband put it, “the best I’ve ever had, I think, let me have one more bite…” The sauce on this one was a bit thick and too opaque in my opinion, but the longgan and the pineapple were a hit. I wouldn’t have served it on iceberg lettuce with tomatoes, but I honestly can’t think of an alternative to suggest that simultaneously preserves the distinctiveness and authenticity of the dish, so I guess they win.

The service was well done. They catered to us as a family, added a complementary mango sorbet, and supplied kids utensils and chopstick helpers which were a hit. We could have used more water refills and had a hard time flagging for the check even with two crying tired kids (should be obvious that we’re trying to get out of there) but those are easily improved.

A novelty place with original takes on classic dishes!

document: Velma Tavern. cuisine: American Salad Burgers. located in Queens. with 4.3 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
I thought the food was excellent and the service was top notch. They offer a small menu with a little something for everyone. Prices may be a bit high, but I think that's just the trajectory of the neighborhood, and New York in general.

If I had one complaint, maybe the music volume and selection at 5PM could have been a bit better, but it wasn't enough to deter me from enjoying my meal or coming back.

Very sad to say that this place has seen better days. I will never be ordering from here again the food was not only lackluster in flavor but quality as well. I’ve eaten from here before, twice and both takeout, I don’t know what happened but the spicy vodka pasta which has been delicious in the past was hard and inconsistent in texture while lacking flavor it also tasted old. The mussels, which I was most excited about, were so spicy that I could not even bare to take more than three bites. I am no stranger to spice I love it on and in everything but this felt like the kind of spice you spill everywhere to compensate for an overall bad sauce. I actually had to try and add tomato purée to quell the spice so that I could taste the sauce even for a second but that did absolutely nothing. The pasta for this dish was 4 dollars extra and I even asked twice if they had it down but they still gave me the wrong pasta which was annoying but fine until I tasted the dish and realized it was inedible and also had a weird aftertaste once the spice subsided. The calamari was fine but rubbery and didn’t really carry much to it, I would buy this from a more modest place for half the price and would probably be more satisfied to be completely honest. When I called back to let them know that at the very least they got my order wrong the phone would not pick up and the voicemail was full. It felt like an utter scam tbh and for 60 dollars this was not worth my money and really was disappointing.

VELMA’S IS GRRREAT. Pasta is perfectly Al dente and the Velma salad is PERFECTION. I’m a sucker for a good vinaigrette and the lemon vinaigrette here is so refreshing and has this super lemony goodness. Love love love it here. Will be back, highly recommend!

Walked in with a friend on Friday night for dinner. It was busy but they were able to seat us quickly.

Beautiful space. A lot of thought and intentionality was put into the flow of the space, with different types of seating and an “m” shaped bar which is a welcome alternative that allows the flow of people to be uninterrupted when people gather, and gives good visual space markers between the bar area and table area. Decor is cute, and with old italian style red checkered table clothes with paper on tol, lots of deep greens and great use of texture in the space. Behind the bar is reminiscent of scorpion records but organized, with old license plates, trucker hats and electicisms.

Good wine list, and drinks are appropriately priced for the neighborhood.

My friend and I ordered meatballs, the velma salad, and the vodka lumache. Meatballs were excellent, exactly what we were looking for- great texture, excellent slightly spicy and appropriately salted meat, and classic red sauce that makes you want to lick the dish. Bread with meatballs was perfect for the dish. The velma salad was ok- it could have been either better dressed or just salted before tossing for better flavor. The spicy vodka lumache was good- but not a pasta I would order again. It wasn’t particularly spicy nor did it have the creamy classic vodka sauce taste. Still, the flavor was good, just not what we expected. Pasta was cooked perfectly al-dente. I would definitely order the meatballs again.

Overall, great atmosphere and good experience. Will be back to try their other offerings

Nothing special. Average food. Average drinks. Nothing to rave about . Completely over priced. Decor is nice. Staff is cool.
….
Super mediocre. Many more spots locally that you can go, spend the same amount and have a better meal / experience.
Glad I was able to check them out, but wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.
For the price you’re paying you’re expecting something above average, guess my expectations weren’t met.

document: Chicken Spot. cuisine: New American. located in Bronx.

google_reviews.text:
Wonderful service and excellent food.  Chef was like a balder, fitter Fieri.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Jeffress Club is the kind of place you’d walk past a hundred times and never know it’s a restaurant unless you’re truly local. No sign screaming “fried chicken lives here.” No frills. It’s in the cut. And that’s how you know it’s legit.

The fried chicken and waffles? Superb. Like “why is this so good and why isn’t everyone talking about it” good. Crispy, juicy, perfectly seasoned—this chicken didn’t come to play.

Pro tip: order the special and you basically get to kiss the chef (emotionally… unless you’re bold). Speaking of the chef—head chef is incredibly handsome, which somehow makes the food taste even better. Science probably backs this.

This is now a place I plan on frequenting any time I’m in Fairfax. Low-key spot, elite food, unexpected heartthrob in the kitchen. 10/10. No notes.

Loved the food! 10/10
I thought this was a ghost kitchen, but when I went in, it was a completely renovated house.
This is probably the best chicken I have ever eaten in my life.
And the interior was more than perfect!
Some of the best food i've ever bought from a chicken spot. I could instantly tell this was house made fresh as the chicken was so juicy. Mr. Jeffery was so nice to my kids and gave them free pies!

Seeing the chef at Jeffress Club for Fried Chicken work is like watching Hannibal Barca command his Carthaginian forces — if, instead of war elephants, his forces were chicken parts expertly disassembled and dredged in seasoned flour. Here, Hannibal isn’t crossing the Alps or staring down the Roman Republic. He’s stationed behind a stove, wielding a cast-iron skillet and gallons of cooking oil, to conquer your taste buds. Each piece lands with military precision: crispy phalanx on the outside, shock-and-awe juiciness within. The crunch hits like a surprise flank maneuver that will have your New Year’s resolution waving a white flag. The seasoning blend feels less like a recipe and more like a carefully executed campaign - strategic, relentless, and wildly effective. Resistance is futile and frankly, delicious. Long live Jeffress Club for Fried Chicken.

I've been going here for over thirty years. I am the white girl that orders in Spanish so I get the correct order.
Today is the last day I'm ever going there. The older dark skin waitress is constantly passive aggressive, takes no responsibility for screwing up your order, and then tells you the client that you were rude. They never speak like this to darker skinned people. Let me be really clear that it's not everybody there: just the one older, taller, dark-skinned waitress who is low key racist.
I let it go because one of my friends works there and I told her about our experience. But i'm never going back there , and they need to denounce her behavior as unacceptable. Malecon is across the street and there is another Dominican spot that just opened around the block on W. 231.
And yes , we tipped her twenty percent , and she didn't even say thank you. So, adios.

This was a great place! As the name suggests, you can eat a lot for a great price. Everything was so savory and authentic. I found the seasoning salty, but I normally eat low on salt, so just be aware that this is how Dominican food usually is. They have a wide menu selection and everything seems to be cooked right and fresh. Highly recommend this place!
I ate a Steak Sandwich at El Economico Restaurant and it was very tasty. Absolutely delicious.

Wonderful inexpensive real Dominican food and ambiance. Love the food, the counter top seating (although there are tables in the back and upstairs), the drinks (fresh orange juice, coffee more like an extra large expresso... for less than 2.00$..take that Starbucks...ice cold Caronas with the slice of lime). There's all kinds of delicious food; I love chicken and rice and beans. Also the stew. Feeds me for 2 days... maybe 3 for 7.00$  Where can you beat that in NYC? It's always super busy but the noise just comes with the territory; gives the place more flavor. I've been eating here since 1998. Not much has changed and that's one of the things I love about El Economico. I can always count on excellent food at affordable prices. I don't speak Spanish and not once has anyone gotten my order wrong over that 20 year span nor have I ever waited more than 5 - 10 minutes to be served. They even deliver. What's not to like? It's easy to get here situated on the Broadway just shy of 231st St. I highly recommend El Economico.
Food was really good. The women there are very nice and funny.

document: La Reina Restaurant. cuisine: Spanish Dominican Puerto Rican. located in Bronx. with 4.0 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: We've been to a lot of Mexican restaurants and this is the only one that gives you 6 different salsas with chips. That's right, SIX!  They are all delicious and their beer and mixed drink prices are very reasonable.   The food is good, and the service is fast and friendly.   I highly recommend this place.  I had the California Burrito and my husband had chicken wings and a side of rice.

We waited quite awhile for a table.  We were waiting for the Buddhist Monks to leave and continue their Peace walk to DC.  It was pretty packed.  Thought the staff handled the chaos quite well.  Looks to be like a old Dennys they've remade into a Mexican restaurant.  Once sat you get some chips with 3 dips!  Salsa, Mango Salsa and bean dip.  All were tasty especially the Mango!  Food was pretty quick.  Overall it was pretty good.  Solid food.  Unfortunately they batter thier Chile Relleno, which I peeled off, but it left that soggy egg batter taste, ugg.  Everyone else said their food was good.  Ordered a small beer and got a giant mug!  Think it was a mix up, but at $6 it was a deal.  Would definitely go back just for the dips though.
The food here is fresh and so tasty. The service is fast and accurate. If you are lucky enough to be helped by Akash, you'll find that he's always especially kind and hospitable. We love La Reina!

The dishes were dirty, menus were dirty, the walls were gross, the ceiling had an alarming amount of mold growing above us… wouldn’t come back because of how dirty it is. The food was good, drinks were good too & service. It was weird that we had 3 different “servers” come up to us. One took our food order & delivered food, one asked for our drinks & got confused. One came & got our bill.

I waited toooooo long to try this place.  We've lived in Chester for a year now and we've tried many of the Mexican restaurant options in the area.  I don't know why, but we kept passing this place up.  Well we will now be regulars!  I ordered something I wouldn't normally order (shrimp enchiladas on the lunch menu) to really test and see if it would be good enough to make me return.  It was soooo good I had to really use self control to save my leftover for the next day.  The only reason I had leftovers was because the chips and dip (including complimentary bean dip) was so filling I was full by the time my meal came out.  They bring you three dips and they are all delicious.  I can't comment on the drinks because I was there for lunch and it was a little too early for me, but they brought a margarita out to a table next to us and it was gigantic.  So if you're going for size then you will not be disappointed.  I am so excited we finally found a place in the area we feel is worth returning to.

google_reviews.text: We dropped into this little pizzeria on William Street while visiting the old haunts. The place was terrific. We went during the week so parking wasn’t a problem. The prices are reasonable and we bought a X-Large chicken rosemary and had enough for two meals. Tasted as good the next day as the first! Highly recommend and will be visiting again. Kudos is Liberty Brewery is situated just behind this little restaurant so we plan to combine a night out of brews with good food from Primavera!!

What happened? I've been coming hear for over a decade. I've recommended Primavera to hundreds of people. Now something has changed. I ordered a pizza with half tomato and half mushroom. You would think that would mean 4 slices of each, like EVERY OTHER restaurant does. What I had was 3 tomato, 3 mushroom, and 2 slices with both. This was absolutely lazy. With all of the competition around, you would think that they would pay attention. I also ordered some fried mushrooms. They were all smashed in the box, and the batter was undercooked leaving then all gummy.
Perhaps it's time for Primavera to close their doors. If they can no longer provide a quality product, perhaps it's time to but their losses.

They gave it out in take out containers so we could take it home, but there’s an option for glasses and plates too, but you’re gonna need the container because for like 8-12$ per person you get enough extremely tasty food to last the next 2 meals too! Best option on the menu in my opinion: Pu Pu Tray, that’s some crazy good stuff, and it’s just an appetizer! We’re gonna come here again for sure, also the waiter was so friendly and nice, everyone there is! Plenty of seating available and they accommodate large parties

I am very particular about my Chinese food, and how it tastes. So I am always very leery about trying out a new restaurant. I decided to take a chance on Happy Garden and I am so happy that I did. Their food is absolutely amazing. I ordered chicken fried rice and steamed dumplings and it was absolutely delicious. Definitely one of my new favorite places to eat.
This place never disappoints! Every time I go here, There’s always an amazing experience. Very nice people, restaurant is clean, and the food is always fresh and hot! 10/10 would recommend.
The food here was delicious! My husband ordered Kung Pao and I ordered Chicken lo mein. Both were piping hot and savory. The customer service was great, too.

Excellent crispy beef! The PuPu Platter was delicious as well! The service was great! They have more take out and less dine in, which is probably due to parking & the after effects of the pandemic. If you’re looking for good food you need to try it! Everything we had was fresh and made to order!

google_reviews.text: Nice joint. The gal that served me was very friendly and helpful. She also helped me set up wifi on my iPhon. Then I was able to ask for what I was desiring, salted coffee. They don’t offer salted coffee, ca phê muối. I’ll be back. I found it very comfortable
Ok

I was impressed by the wall at Saigon Coffee, which had a nostalgic, old-fashioned feel reminiscent of the old town. The atmosphere was great and lively. As someone who loves exploring and evaluating coffee, I'd rate Saigon Coffee's drinks quite well. On a scale of 10, the coffee gets a 7 out of 10. The coffee is strong with a slightly bitter taste, typical of robusta coffee... The staff were very enthusiastic and helpful.

I visited this coffee shop in Saigon and was generally quite satisfied. The space is spacious and airy, and when you enter, you immediately feel comfortable, not overwhelmed or cramped like many shops in the city. The shop is located right at the corner of 2 facades, so the natural light is quite beautiful, and you can sit anywhere with ease. In the evening, the wind blows very cool, creating a relaxing feeling even though the shop is located in a crowded area. 

The tables and chairs are arranged comfortably, the distance between the tables is moderate so it is not too noisy or too close together. The shop is simply decorated but clean, comfortable, suitable for those who like light coffee, not fussy but still has highlights. 

As for the drinks, they are relatively ok, well-made, clear taste, not too sweet. The menu is also quite diverse. The price is also reasonable compared to the location and space of the shop. 

The staff is a bit inattentive to customers. The plus point is that the music is my taste 🫰 

In conclusion, this is a spacious, airy cafe with a beautiful and comfortable view. Very suitable for sitting and chatting, meeting friends or simply finding a comfortable place to relax in the middle of crowded Saigon. ☕🌿✨

The cafe is right on the main road, with a spacious and cool outdoor area and a pond in the middle, which is quite relaxing.
The drinks are reasonably priced, but the only drawback is that the staff don't proactively refill the tea for customers.

name: Lobel's
document: Lobel's. cuisine: Butcher Burgers Sandwiches. located in Bronx. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Amazing quiet place to get away from the crowds and enjoy a freshly done sandwich, at the best dinner style - or just the absolute perfect Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookie with a nice cup of coffee! The staff was so kind and attentive that made me forgot it was 3PM in a busy Wednesday! This is the perfect stop for your visit to 5th avenue shops or to the Rockefeller rink - and they got even a kids Menu and plenty of space to big families as well!

Lobel’s in Yankee stadium is hands down the best food stand in the stadium! Their staple is the steak sandwich. It was everything you want in a steak sandwich. Meat is succulent, tender, and tasty. The bun is soft and holds it well, and the horseradish sauce takes it to another level!
The roast pork broccoli rabe was one of the best I’ve had in a really long time! Love that the pork was shredded and not sliced. The bite from the broccoli rabe and a dash of heat from the chili flakes set this sandwich off. The sesame bastone was top notch and a perfect vehicle for the sandwich.
The filet mignon steak fries looked amazing and heard people saying they were great. And will definitely have to check out the 99 burger next time.
Great quality food and great customer service as well!

Lobel’s sets the gold standard for butcher shops. The quality of their steaks is absolutely unmatched, the filets I picked up were beautifully cut, perfectly tender, and packed with flavor. Even cooking them at home, the result was better than most steakhouses I’ve been to.

The staff is knowledgeable and takes the time to guide you through the best selections. You can tell they take pride in offering only the finest cuts, and it really shows in the experience and the final product.

If you’re serious about steak, Lobel’s is worth every penny. It’s the kind of quality that turns a home-cooked meal into something unforgettable.

I have been a loyal customer of Lobel's for over 5 years.  I have always received the highest quality cuts and product that far exceed other purveyors.   This post is also to state that I can confidently say they have a tremendous customer service team dedicated to their customers satisfaction.

Lobel's Prime Meats is an absolute gem of a food joint, nestled right by third base in Yankee Stadium. The staff is warm and welcoming, and the food is out of this world. I had the pleasure of indulging in their new meatloaf sandwich/burger, and let me tell you, it was a divine experience. The meatloaf was delicious, cooked to perfection, with just the right amount of seasoning and with crunchy onions on top, the combination melted in my mouth.

And let's talk about those steak fries! They were a work of art. They complemented my burger so well that it was a match made in heaven. Although the steak fries alone were enough to fill me up.

I have to commend Lobel's Prime Meats for bringing their A-game to the ballpark. The quality of the food and the service was top-notch, especially given the bustling atmosphere of Yankee Stadium. This is the kind of food that elevates the stadium experience and makes it truly memorable.

Overall, if you're looking for a fantastic meal at the ballpark, Lobel's Prime Meats is a must-try. Their meatloaf burger and steak fries are 10/10, and the entire experience is simply outstanding. Don't miss out on this incredible culinary gem at Yankee Stadium!

google_reviews.text: Visited here, ordered a standard triple smash burger. Portion size was great. Really hefty burger. Although didn't really have much flavor and was very greasy to the point there was a little bit of grease just building up in the container. My friend got the their signature mushroom double smash burger. Said he didn't really taste much mushroom and the sauce overpowered the burger. Definitely recommend that they start to season their meat a bit more. One negative that I had was we ordered some wings. Once receiving them we requested some ranch and the cashier said "honey im going to have to charge you" and we already just spent close to $40 and yet she still needs more for a simple cup of ranch. Didn't sit right with me. Wouldn't come back in my opinion

I stopped by this burger spot , it was late but this was actually a solid meal. The beef felt high quality and had a real nice sear on it, plus the bun didn't fall apart or get soggy by the time I finished. Honestly, in a sea of overpriced "specialty" places that usually disappoint, this was a relief.

The only thing that really tripped me up was that they don't do bacon. Its such a weird choice for a place that clearly knows their way around a grill. I'm all for keeping a menu focused and simple, but omitting a staple like that just feels like they're being difficult for no reason. Its a good burger, missing that one obvious thing that would've made it great.

Dave’s smash burgers spot is a must visit! The burgers are done just right..crispy edges with that juicy flavorful center. The chicken tenders are another win super crispy outside, tender inside, and perfect for dipping. And the milkshakes? Thick, creamy, and absolutely delicious. Everything on the menu feels like it’s made with care. A fantastic addition to the neighborhood!

I ordered a double smash burger with curly fries and a Fruity Pebble shake, and everything was excellent. The burger was juicy, flavorful, and cooked perfectly with that classic smash burger crisp on the edges. The curly fries were hot, crispy, and seasoned just right. The Fruity Pebble shake was the perfect finishing touch: creamy, sweet, and packed with flavor. Great portions, great quality, and everything tasted fresh. This will be my new late night spot, Highly recommend!

I was craving a burger, just strolling around, when Tadaaaaaaa—like a burger genie, the perfect spot appeared right in front of me!
It was one of the juiciest smashed burgers I’ve ever had. But here’s the best part: it cost less than a BK meal! Better quality, expertly cooked, packed with flavor, and absolutely delicious.
The service was top-notch—friendly staff, quick delivery, and you could really tell they care about what they’re serving.
Don’t hesitate—stop by and treat yourself to a double or triple. You won’t regret it!

name: La Catrina Mexican Bar III
document: La Catrina Mexican Bar III. cuisine: Mexican Bars Event Planning & Services. located in Bronx. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
My friends and I visited the restaurant/lounge on Saturday night to celebrate a birthday. We arrived after 10 p.m. and went straight to the lounge. Unfortunately, from the moment we walked in, the experience started off poorly.

At the entrance, there was a female and male security guard. The female guard immediately had an attitude—using exaggerated hand gestures as if she couldn’t speak instead of simply asking for my ID. When she finally spoke, she rudely told me she needed to check my purse. There was no professionalism or courtesy.

After passing security, we stopped briefly to take photos by the beautiful wall near the entrance. My friend had never been there before, and I had recommended the place. Instead of letting us enjoy the moment, the same guard gave us attitude again just for taking pictures.

Upstairs in the lounge, we were seated and greeted by a waitress who was initially pleasant, but the service quickly went downhill. She was on her phone most of the time and seemed irritated whenever we needed assistance. We actually had to ask a different waiter to let her know we wanted to order more and continue spending money. It felt like she didn’t care at all—possibly because gratuity was already included.

To make matters worse, one of the female security guards in the lounge pushed a guest who accidentally bumped into her while dancing. The place was packed, and that kind of behavior was completely unnecessary and unprofessional.

The only highlight of the night was the music—the DJs did an excellent job and kept the dance floor full all night.

Overall, I was extremely disappointed. Management really needs to address the behavior of employees who clearly don’t want to deal with customers. The venue has so much potential, but the rude staff completely ruined the experience.

Headed there to check out bachata dancing on a Tuesday night.  “Alert” for the ladies there were tons of a guys looking for dance partner, so I decided to skip the dancing and have three tacos instead.  The special was $3 per taco, but they automatically include the tip so the total price was $11 and some change.  I ordered the barbecoa (rich and tasty), Al pastor (moist and tender topped with chopped pineapple), and the carnitas (which was a little too dry for me).  All were topped with diced onions and cilantro.  The tacos were served with two sauces a mild and spicy one but did not include radishes or jalapeños.  They were set atop what tasted like fresh tortillas unfortunately the tortillas were cold and not heated.  Overall two out of the three were a treat, the other one not so much.
Great food & drinks! If you’re ever looking for an amazing happy hour spot this the place to be! Ask for Mabel she’s super sweet, makes great drinks ! & gives great customer service .

We had a large group of about 15 people, but unfortunately to serve it took 30+ mins for food and drinks and unfortunately they charged us for a drink that was given to someone without checking their ID and then took instead of letting the adults know and still charged us for it! They were willing to lose a group for one drink.  customer service is subpar…. update: we went to the lounge and they wouldn’t let us sit in a booth and spend a combined amount of two hundred plus only if we bought a bottle and to sit in the regular tables you have to pay $100. Mind you it is a small place not a huge club. We left asap.

We had our 45th HS reunion at La Catrina last night.  We were so busy mingling that I can't vouch for the food - but it is an excellent venue for something like that.  They were easy to work with. The space is big and open, with just the right number of tables and seats. Great lighting; they even had lights pointing up the walls in our school colors. Just-right decor, and they let us hang some posters and balloons. A dance floor, stage, film screen and very nice DJ. A big bar.  Really perfect for what we needed. We had just under 50 of us and it could've comfortably handled 3x that. But do be ready to leave by the cut-off time (I think 11) bc they crank the tunes way up and all the young folk start pouring in!

name: Unique Fusion Restaurant
document: Unique Fusion Restaurant. cuisine: Asian Fusion Thai. located in Bronx. with 4.7 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
If you’re craving the perfect Thai food in New York City, Unique is the place to go. Famous for their authentic Thai cuisine, this spot delivers an incredible dining experience that feels both comforting and indulgent.

Over the years I’ve tried most of their dishes, drunken noodles(I love as “spicy”) with ice Thai tea latte, or Salmon steak with Coconut rice (or Jasmine rice if you like the sauce over the rice) are my favorites. But all their dishes are nothing short of amazing. Every bite had that satisfying flavors followed by melt-in-your-mouth goodness.

The portions were just right generous enough to leave you satisfied but not overly heavy, allowing you to fully enjoy every component of the meal without feeling overwhelmed.

Unique doesn’t just serve great food it perfects a classic Thai dish with premium ingredients, expert execution, and thoughtfully portioned meals. Whether you’re a longtime Unique fan or trying it for the first time, this is a spot that will leave you completely satisfied and eager to return.

Unique is a fantastic spot for lunch! They offer a great lunch special that includes an appetizer, a soft drink, and a main course
All at a very reasonable price. The restaurant is vegetarian-friendly and accommodating for those with allergies.

The portion sizes are generous and filling, and though some dishes come with a bit of spice, I found it to be mild enough (personal preference). The food itself was absolutely delicious.

The atmosphere at Unique really stands out. The place has a cozy, welcoming vibe, super clean and nicely decorated. Overall, it’s a great choice for a tasty, satisfying, and enjoyable lunch!

I simply cannot emphasize enough just how incredible this Thai food haven truly is! The staff here are absolutely phenomenal - they go above and beyond to make your experience exceptional. The art displayed throughout the venue is breathtaking and adds to the overall ambiance, creating a vibe that is both inspiring and welcoming.

The authentic Thai cuisine served here is beyond compare. Each dish is crafted to perfection, with a focus on quality and taste that is truly unparalleled. The flavors are rich and vibrant, transporting you straight to the streets of Thailand with every bite. The drinks are not only refreshing and delicious, but they also offer an amazing value for the exceptional quality you receive.

In summary, this establishment is the epitome of top-notch Thai dining, and I wholeheartedly encourage everyone to treat themselves to the extraordinary experience it offers. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!

EXCELLENT!! EXCELLENT!! EXCELLENT!!
We ordered a chicken noodle soup.....the brothers was amazing.  And Massaman Chicken....great proportions  and excellent flavor.

The waitress was nice too. She even explained the proper way to heat up the leftovers.  Highly recommend!!

A hidden gem in Inwood. Service was quick, food was hot and delicious. Lots of great Thai staples on the menu as well as some variety options. I definitely recommend dining in! Beer and wine are now on the menu!

The servers are super friendly and the environment is lively and bustling. We came on Saturday night and waited less than an hour. It’s a fun spot to hang out with friends and family. Everything tasted fresh and flavorful, but the beignets were definitely a highlight—so yummy and the perfect way to end the meal. We’ll definitely be coming back!

Absolutely deserving of 5 stars!

Portion of the food is enormous, definitely a sharing kind of food, tasted delicious, reasonably priced. A must try from me!
One of the legend chinese food resto in Bandung. Still good, the hotplate kangkung, crispy squid and fried noodle is a must

Whenever in Bandung, I would eat kangkung hotplate, usually I ate at Ah*ng, roadside chinese food, but this time, decided to try a certain chinese resto recommend by a certain blogger.

Parking spot are not too hard, parking is within the road side, and the road is big. Not much could say for interior since this is an old type chinese restaurant. Place are spacious has many tables.

They serve full and half portion which is a point plus for me.

We order the kangkung hotplate (IDR 65k) half portion, portion are enough for two people, taste sweet savory, generous fillings of beef and quail egg. This is probably the only decent dish I've ordered here.

The cingkong (IDR 100k ish) half portion consist of 4, is nothing but a tiny bit of crab meat coated with crab cake dough and sweet red sauce . Texture of the dough is hard and cold, barely any crab meat, very fishy , kinda lack seasoning the sauce didn't help.

The udang telur asin (IDR 100k ish ) for half portion consist of 4 big prawn. This is the worse experience I've had in Bandung. The prawn dish is the type of the prawn not peeled and just directly dip into the batter and deep fried, makes the prawn looks big but actually not. The telur asin is definitely not the salty egg sauce you meet everyday, like literally the real telur asin, fried and crumbled into pieces poured over the shrimp.  Which is okay for me. But the prawn is not properly clean, and there is blue color as in picture , I feel disgust already, not feel like eating it anymore.  And this prawn is so tasteless , the fried egg didn't even help seasoning it.  And since I'm the type of person that eats peeled shrimp, this is not for me.

The waiters when asked why the color blue, he just casually said "I DONT KNOW"

And the madam at the casher makes excuses as if saying " it's not our fault, sometimes it is just bad luck finding prawn like that among hundreds of prawn we cook, not poisonous just color "
hellow, I pay for your food here, not eating it free. And imagine eating something you usually see white flesh, has blue color within it.

Gosh, definitely wont came back here ever.
If not because of the Kangkung Hotplate, I would have rate it 1, 0 if possible.

Many other chinese restaurant here in Bandung, and should better explore other.
This restaurant might be too cocky because of a certain food blogger loves it, but definitely doesn't fool me.

Delicious Chinese food restaurant. Provided not only seafood dishes (such crab and prawn) but also other dishes (such pork, kangkung cah and other hakka style dishes). Good food, fast served and fair price.
Parking lot will become a bit problem as the parking space only available across the street.

Cingkong was made from prawn and crab meat. The sauce lacks flavour to enrich the taste of cingkong. However, cingkong itself was already delicious without the sauce. Fried noodle was the star for me and reminded me to my childhood.

google_reviews.text:
Jose’s, tucked inside the Grande Prairie Farmer’s Market, offers a cozy spot to grab a bite and stroll among fresh produce, meats, and local goods afterward—a lovely bonus to any meal.
🥞 Breakfast
While the flavors are solid, the breakfast portion left me wanting more. It’s simply not enough to fuel a proper morning, so I’d recommend ordering an extra portion or pairing it with something from the market. The quality is there, but the quantity needs a boost.
🐟 Lunch – Fish Tacos
Now this is where Joe’s shines. The fish tacos are a standout—made with hand-pressed corn tortillas and packed with flavor. The fish is fresh, the seasoning is spot-on, and the overall taste is fantastic. However, the tortillas were quite wet and fell apart easily, making it tough to enjoy them the traditional Mexican way: with your hands, no cutlery required. It’s a small detail, but one that matters when authenticity is part of the experience.

☕ Atmosphere & Extras
Being inside the farmer’s market adds charm. After your meal, you can wander through stalls offering fresh fruit, coffee, meats, and more. It’s a great way to extend your visit and soak in the local vibe.

🔄 Final Thoughts
Jose’s has potential, especially with its flavorful lunch offerings. I’ll be trying a second option next time, and I’ve noticed a few other Mexican spots nearby that I’m curious to compare. For now, Jose’s earns points for taste and location—but could improve on portion size and tortilla texture.

document: Ripe Kitchen & Bar. cuisine: Caribbean. located in Bronx. with 3.9 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
I recently visited Ripe Kitchen & Bar near the Bronx, and it turned out to be a really memorable dining experience. The restaurant has a warm, intimate atmosphere with dim lighting and a relaxed island vibe that makes the place feel cozy and unique.

The food focuses on authentic Jamaican and Caribbean flavors, and everything I tried was rich and satisfying. One of the standout dishes was the jerk ribeye steak, which is actually one of the restaurant’s most popular items. The seasoning had a great smoky jerk flavor that paired perfectly with the tender meat.

The drinks were also a highlight. Their rum punch and tropical cocktails complemented the food really well and added to the overall Caribbean atmosphere. The menu includes other favorites like oxtail, jerk chicken, and Rasta pasta, giving plenty of flavorful options to choose from.

Service felt friendly and relaxed, and the whole place had a lively neighborhood feel. Overall, Ripe Kitchen & Bar is a great spot if you’re looking for bold Caribbean cuisine, strong cocktails, and a laid-back island vibe just outside New York City. I’d definitely come back again.
Food was amazing! I had the Jerk Ribeye. Wifey had Oxtails. Atmosphere was nice. Will definitely be coming back again.

Friday  November 7th was my first time at the restaurant. Myself and 5 members of my family  went there for my birthday dinner. There was no wait time to be seated as per reservation. Here is what I have to say:
1. For an expensive restaurant no one welcome you. Attendants were quite militant.
2. For starters we ordered codfish spring roll and It was Extremely salty.
3. Big Ass Steak: I ordered medium well and I got well done. In addition, 1/3 of the steak is fat. Serving a customer steak with so much fat is indicative of lacking attention to details.
4. Jerk chicken: this is clearly not jerk chicken. It is salt and pepper. …it has no flavor and the size of the wings (very large) is an indication of poor quality.
4. Fried fish: while the texture is good it has absolutely no seasoning.
5. Curried goat: Of all the foods it has the best flavor, but very spicy. You cannot assume that everyone likes spicy food. It should be noted on the menu “hot”.
6. Rasta pasta: lacks flavor and the pasta is not good quality.

This restaurant is over rated and my family and I were greatly disappointed.  For a celebrity  chef restaurant the food should be better quality. In addition, the staff are very impersonal and operate as if the business is a production line. The business lacks supervision. The person who  cleared the table didn’t ask if we’re finished. During dining no one ask how is the food?. After paying, no one acknowledges our presence by thanking us for coming. I will not come back to this restaurant and I will tell other relatives and friends to stay away.

Ripe Kitchen & Bar is described as a “glorified hole in the wall” by its owner.  It surely is, and it’s a whole vibe!

Ripe is the vision of chef Nigel Spence, a Jamaican native who complete his degree at the Culinary Institute of America, following with time working at the Food Network, most notably Bobby Flay.  In fact, his Jerk ribeye steak beat Bobby on his own show.

On my first visit, I had to try the steak, which according to the menu has sold close to 150,000 plates.

The steak is 16 oz.  It’s a mix of lean and fat, and the menu is VERY clear about that.  I would say the steak is probably about half and half, or maybe 60/40.  I stuck to the lean, but that’s a me thing, not a them thing.  The flavor is something I can’t describe, maybe because I’ve never had jerk flavor on a charcoal grilled steak before.

I thought it was delicious—grilled and seared on the outside, medium to medium rare inside.  I requested medium, and it might have been a little on the rarer side of that, but it really was just perfect.

It came with tasty rice and beans as well as a refreshing green salad.

I also got a side order of spicy fries, which were hot and seasoned, in a huge portion.

I had the rum punch, which is quite strong.  I was surprised, but their mojito is one of the best I’ve had.  All of their drinks are simple—nothing fancy—tropical—things that make you feel like you’re on island time.

The decor also makes you feel like you’re on island time—bright reds, plants, photos of Jamaica.  Spence has said in his own words that this will never be a white tablecloth establishment; he wants it unpretentious and wants his crowds tipsy and inclined to sing and dance at any moment.  This is more than a restaurant, it’s a community!

Prices are super crazy reasonable.  The steak meal was 32 dollars.  Drinks 13-15.

Service laid back, but welcoming.  You could tell they didn’t care who you were or where you came from, they were just glad you were there!  The owner/chef himself bussed my table and was there helping his staff, and that means a lot to me.

The menu also has oxtail (only certain days), Rasta pasta, jerk chicken, a jerk chicken quesadilla, various iterations of plantains, shrimp, curry.  I think next time I’ll either try to quesadilla or the pasta (which can be served with shrimp, chicken, or vegetarian).

The parking is street parking.  The outside is pretty unassuming and you can pass right by if you’re not paying attention.  On warm evenings they open their patio and have live music, otherwise they play reggae overhead.  I went around six on a Saturday and was seated immediately, though there were already several tables occupied (it’s a fairly small place).  I spent a couple hours there and by the time I left, several more people had come to the party.

It was all locals here.  And everyone besides me was Black.  That tells me I was in the right place.  Can’t wait to go back.

My first experience here was wonderful. My significant other introduced me to this restaurant, and I was blown away by the customer service, the quality of the food and drinks, and how efficient everything was.

Unfortunately, my second—and final—visit was the complete opposite. I wasn’t greeted when I walked in, and after I seated myself, the bartender/hostess dropped off a menu and a glass of water before walking away. When she returned with utensils, I asked her a question, which she answered quickly before leaving again.

I ended up sitting there for about 15 minutes, waiting to place my order and debating whether I should just leave and take my business elsewhere.

This second experience was terrible, and I will not be returning.

document: Caroline’s Tavern. cuisine: New American Cocktail Bars. located in Staten_Island. with 3.9 stars (good).

google_reviews.text: So glad we went here. Had the pierogi appetizer which wasn't much pierogi but pierogi-ish. Also had the truffle chicken wings which were super good.
