google_reviews.text: So good - took me right back to Japan with their delicious coffee/specialty drinks! I didn’t love how the iced drinks were served in hot paper cups though - drinking and iced cold brew out of a cup with no straw for $7 is not my preference but otherwise the drinks are delicious! I tried the matcha latte and cold brew - both phenomenal.

Very cute inside. Had an excellent oat milk latte with one of the variant matcha teas. It was more earthy than standard matcha which I loved.
This is more of a grab and go. There is one bench inside that could sit max 2 people.

Lovely coffee, very good quality. Staff were not so welcoming or polite & I was given a a not so nice look when I asked for my drink to be in a mug rather than a paper cup! It’s a shame they don’t have bar stools by the window to enjoy your coffee inside, there is ample space for the. The decor is very quaint, green & beautiful.
Super cute tiny Japanese run cafe with solid coffee. A little on the brighter / acidic side for my taste but would def come back. Also love the dine-in cups.

Nice local cafe. GREAT matcha from Japan! I think the owner (or someone who works there) is actually from where the matcha is imported from. Highly recommend going if you’re in Williamsburg, BK, New York. This place is a hidden gem. Also I love the interior plant decor and rustic charm.

document: Blue Bottle Coffee - Dean St. cuisine: Coffee & Tea. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: My neighborhood Blue Bottle. Hey, what can I say? It’s a Blue Bottle. Good, albeit overpriced, coffee. Small. Limited indoor seating. No restrooms. I enjoy sitting outside at one of the tables on a nice day. Knocking a few stars off because there is a barista (ginger guy) at this location who is quite rude and really should not be working in a customer-facing job.

This spot was super chill great staff that are friendly and the coffee is delicious.  I got the Lavender Yuzu Latte with Oatmilk and I gotta say wow that was amazing. Plenty of flavor but not too sweet it was just right I definitely recommend this place.
Great staff, not so great coffee. Burnt and over extracted Cortado and the milk was not properly steamed. I would stick to a pour over next time
I know this is a chain but this particular store gave off quaint neighborhood cafe vibes. Place was small but cozy, and the service was impeccable. Loved the iced NOLA!

Very small hole in the wall place. You can’t even tell it’s there because there’s no business sign except for a blue bottle on the wall. Service was excellent. Not crazy about their coffee. It’s very strong. They make cappuccino with oat milk.

name: Marcy & Myrtle Cafe
document: Marcy & Myrtle Cafe. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Breakfast & Brunch. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: Great food, friendly baristas, and a lovely sense of community. We’ve been coming here for years and I always look forward to the (very unique) egg & cheese and the matcha latte, which I get with almond milk! I’m picky about matcha but I really love the one they use here.

This is the greatest coffee shop of all time you will not be disappointed. I have a goat cheese sandwich every morning, every single day of my life. I’m in love with everything here. I Would give my life for Marcy Myrtle. I would go to war for this place. No cap.

Really nice to find a cafe in the area. There’s the usual selection and some specials. Tried their hojicha latte and peanut butter latte. Hojicha was ok, it’s on the lighter side flavor-wise but the peanut butter latte was delicious.

There’s no indoor seating but there’s a bench and some seating outside.

Every single time I come in here, I notice how differently I’m greeted and addressed. It’s a very noticeable difference how this older white woman treats anyone who isn’t white. I’ve come here a few times and every single time it’s been horrible customer service whereas anyone else is met with a smile and overall a happier introduction. As others have stated, it’s crazy for them to be acting this way in a historically Black neighborhood. I usually go for the convenience since it’s a 3 minute walk but I’d rather walk a mile than pay $10 for a drink with an unwelcoming attitude. Go literally anywhere else
So glad I found this place! The atmosphere here is always warm and welcoming and I especially appreciate the consistency. My coffee comes out exactly how I like it every time.

name: Cafe Cotton Bean
document: Cafe Cotton Bean. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Cafes. located in Brooklyn. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
Hey friends! This review is about sustainability.

I so appreciate your signage in shop, that communicates to folks that they can order their drink for here, to prevent creating waste. I also appreciate the fact that you offer real spoons to mix milks into coffee, and provide a receptacle for used, reusable dishes. And that you have real glasses for coffee and for the water refill station. As a customer, it means a lot to me to be able to support local businesses that are doing more to promote reusable, circular coffee habits.

By 2050 there will be more plastic in the ocean than fish, and over 95% of the plastic that we used does not actually get recycled.

To customers, reading this, if you are dining in house, you have the option to create less trash! No need to have your coffee on their lovely porch without a reusable. Thanks to the clear signage and options provided by cotton bean! Much appreciated.

Cotton Bean is an excellent place in that is a simple coffeeshop, without gimmicks , without expanding their offerings beyond what is reasonable. Its a reasonable place. A logical place. A small simple operation pumping out delicious coffees in a very nice clean shop with friendly staff. It’s wonderful. Its precisely what a coffeeshop should be. I’ve encountered 3 coffeeshops like this one, the other two being Gotham and Olas where the coffee is spectacular, the service wonderful and the shop simple. Could offering no wifi be the secret to the enchantment of these places. Perhaps.
Id like to think so. Sit down, read a book, have a conversation, pretend its the 90’s… which for many was peak civilization.

I love the aesthetic of this place, the food, and the calm vibes. They taught me a bit of words in Japanese, which was fun! Whether you take a sandwich, soup, or ice cream, you will always feel welcomed. It is super peaceful (they chose a good spot in front of the tree)!

This is the only coffee shop I’ve been to that charges an extra dollar for an iced version of the same drink. When I asked why they’re charging another dollar for ice the owner told me delis do the same thing. Okay. If you want your coffee shop to feel like a deli then go ahead. If you want people to feel scammed than sure, continue to up charge for alt milks and temperature while we’re at it too. As a former barista I know it takes less time and effort to make an iced drink. I know you’re doing it because iced drinks are popular. Not only does upcharging for temperature seem questionable and greedy, it leaves a bad impression, even if the rest of the menu is outstanding. Absorb that cost elsewhere,  raise the jalepeno biscuit fifty cents if you have to. Selling premium food and beverages is one thing, but let’s not price-gouge for frozen water

Once was an amazing cafe. With great coffee, food, and customer service. The coffee is still good but is severely overpriced. A large drip is about 6$ a cold brew is 8$ .. the drip I just ordered wasn’t hot and they weren’t happy about asking to have it served full.

google_reviews.text: got the black sesame pie of the month for a cny party, which was my favorite out of the three (black sesame, hojicha, and black bottom oat). black bottom oat was not good. been getting pies from here for the past few years and it seems like the quality has shifted a bit
All of the pies I have tried are great. My one complaint is that I have tried on numerous occasions to get a matcha slice to no avail.
a must-visit for pie lovers 🥧. The crusts are buttery and flaky, and the creative seasonal flavors make each slice special. A cozy spot that always feels like a treat.

I wish I had a better photo of the rhubarb pie - it’s beautiful and most importantly it tasted amazing. Finding just rhubarb pie is hard and finding it out of season in late September is even harder. I am so glad I could pre order this for my boyfriend’s birthday. It’s his favorite that his mom makes and he is so picky about pies but was really happy with one. Sweet and tart with perfect crust and crumble. Thank you guys for making it a great birthday

I really love this spot and none of their pies ever miss. Every single thing I’ve tried has always been fantastic. And I always make it a priority to support all the local businesses that make New York great. If you want pie, this is always the first place I suggest to people.

name: Yafa
document: Yafa. cuisine: Coffee & Tea. located in Brooklyn. with 5.0 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
We recently had the pleasure of dining at Yafa Grille, a hidden gem serving authentic Mediterranean cuisine that's sure to transport your taste buds to the sun-kissed streets of the Middle East. Located in a cozy setting with a lovely patio, this restaurant is perfect for a casual dinner or lunch with friends and family.

The star of the show was undoubtedly the shawarma. I opted for the chicken shawarma, which was cooked to perfection and served in a warm pita with a generous toppings. The flavors were expertly balanced, and each bite was a masterclass in texture and taste. The beef shawarma and gyro were equally impressive, with tender meat and a depth of flavor that had us scraping the bottom of the plate.

The falafel was crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, with a delightful crunch from the sesame seeds. Served with a side of creamy hummus, this was the perfect accompaniment to the shawarma.

The patio seating area was a lovely oasis, with comfortable seating and a warm atmosphere that made it easy to linger over a meal. The service was friendly and attentive, with our server happy to answer questions about the menu and offer recommendations.

If you're a fan of Mediterranean cuisine or just looking to spice up your dining routine, Yafa Grille is an absolute must-visit. With its delicious food, charming patio, and excellent service, this restaurant is sure to become a new favorite. Don't miss out on the shawarma and falafel – your taste buds will thank you!

Food was high quality and had amazing flavor. My dish was a beef+lamb shawarma rice bowl with tomato cucumber salad, roasted eggplant, olives and hummus, dressed with cilantro salsa and toum.
The side pita was fresh and delicious.
Service was great: friendly and attentive.
Wish I had one closer to my home or work!

Skip the chain fast food restaurants and come to Yafa!

I was in the area for work and needed a quick lunch. Was not expecting the level of both service and quality 🤌🏼

The owner(?) and chef(?) were so welcoming and accommodating. The guy who took my order took the time to explain all the available options. I didn’t feel like I was in a fast casual restaurant, almost like fine dining.

The food is so fresh, everything from the protein to the vegetables! Relative to the price, the portion sizes are refreshing since everywhere skimps you on extras. I stuffed my face with a protein, vegetable and pita bowl!

My only regret is I don’t live closer because this was a fresh experience and I would come here weekly, if not, daily.

In today’s world it’s nearly impossible to find quality and service like this without breaking the bank. Incredible 🙌🏼

Incredible Mediterranean restaurant near the highway! Got the chicken kebob salad bowl and the flavors were incredibly deep. The build your own bowl format is super quick/convenient and all the ingredients are very fresh. To top it off the service was wonderful, they are so nice! Will be coming back on our next roadtrip!

The food was excellent! I was in the Marine Corps for 8 years, traveled the Mediterranean countries, and Yafa is authentic Mediterranean food!

Thank you guys for the wonderful meal.

I ordered a Pita-Pocket with Gyro meat, tomato-cucumber-onion mix, red onions, tsatsiki sauce, and a few other items. It reminded me of my time in Greece, Jordan, and Italy. These guys know what they are doing.

document: Cuppa Hive Coffee. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Bakeries. located in Brooklyn. with 5.0 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
Incredible coffee shop with delicious coffee and pastries, ample space for chatting, reading, or working, and the most pleasant staff you will find. Seriously, the people here are unbelievable kind and courteous.

Free wifi and a large communal table is perfect for solo laptop users. There’s a bathroom, too. Great place to get some work done before or after a visit to ALCOVE nearby where you can have work calls in private.

Wish I could give it 6 stars.
Great coffee and a really nice cozy spot. The coffee was rich, fresh, and perfectly made. Definitely a place I’d come back to for a good cup of coffee. ☕️

Cuppa is wonderful refuge. The cafe is clean and relaxing, offering a variety of seating whether you’re looking to relax or you’ve come to work.  WiFi is very reliable. The baristas are friendly, polite and skilled. I love the drinks and the food!  Many of the patrons are familiar because many are regulars. Definitely a testament for their feelings about the place.

Oh man, the hype is real. My good friend opened this coffee shop, and he’s absolutely perfected it. From the moment you walk in, everything feels just right—the welcoming vibe, the thoughtful menu, the incredible coffee, and the fresh pastries.

The music is spot on too, making it the perfect spot to read, get some work done, or even enjoy a casual date.

This place nails it: neighborhood coffee shop charm with the feel of a true espresso bar. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!

I got their flat white, it was delicious.
There is wifi but somehow the day I went it didn’t work.
They don’t have a lot of outlets so be mindful of that if you want to use your laptop.
There is a restroom (a big plus for me).
Overall, a great place to spend your quiet time or hang out with friends!

name: Milk Crate Coffee
document: Milk Crate Coffee. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Desserts Sandwiches. located in Brooklyn. with 4.8 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Didn’t like the quality of the coffee can’t really recommend. Paid almost $8.00 for a flat white that didn’t even had foam or taste.

Went out here on chanukah for a small brunch and wow was I in for a treat! Being in the midst of boro park I had assumed it would be a very heimish experience, I was pleasantly surprised that as soon as I entered I felt like I was transformed to a place miles away from 13th Avenue, the vibe was hip and subtle and I though I was in parks slope!

Beautiful decor adorns the store and hip millennial artwork painted on the walls contribute to this feeling.

The actual food is incredible as well, we tried the breakfast for days as well as their grilled cheese. The Breakfast for days was amazing and the fresh toasted sourdough combined with sweet butter was out of this world, the eggs were cooked perfectly and the salad was fresh, fragrant and had a deliciously astringent dressing to wrap it up. My wife had the grilled cheese and she was absolutely floored by how good it was, the luscious so fresh sourdough combined with high quality cheeses and melted to perfection absolutely delivered!

From there we go into the drinks and with both of us getting hot lattes I can say the coffee was excellent, it was fresh, smooth and had a very fragrant rich flavor while not being over powering.

Overall this is a incredible place to get breakfast that transforms you to a hip coffee shop with delicious food from the second you enter. Would highly recommend!

Ended up in the area by accident and desperately needed coffee. A short search turned up Milk Crate. I purchased the Lavender Lemonade and added raspberry because the gentleman said it'd be even better. They also ask for your desired sweetness level, which was nice. I really walked over for coffee, so I got the Cinnamon Toast Latte hot. It was not overtly sweet, and the cinnamon complemented instead of overpowered. Wish I had more time to eat because it smelled delicious in there! I'd say it's worth a trip if you're in the area.
Amazing service great breakfast place 10/10
Very cool and hip! Coffee is great! Fork and bowl salads yum! Grilled paninis delicious! Cinamon danish for dessert, totally heaven!

document: Shepherd’s Cup. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Breakfast & Brunch Desserts. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
Excellent coffee, espresso and food here. I came by here for a meeting and was blown away. There is so much space in here to connect with someone or even to work remotely if needed. The espresso was perfect and delicious. I tried a sandwich here as well and the food was very high quality and tasted great. This coffee shop is truly a gem 💎 and I’d say it’s one of the best coffee shops I’ve tried in all of New York City area since I arrived. I definitely will come back soon to enjoy the incredible coffee and vibes!

The staff here was very friendly and helpful. The WiFi also was great as well! All around great experience and I’d highly recommend coming here.

This café is one of my favorite places to study and relax. I absolutely love their drinks — especially the cold brew coffee — and their avocado sandwich is amazing. I also recently discovered their London Fog tea, and now it’s one of my favorites.

The staff is always friendly and welcoming, they greet you with a smile, and the atmosphere is calm and pleasant. The food is not only delicious but also healthy, with unique recipes you don’t find anywhere else — I’ve tried everything, and it’s all been great.

I come here all the time to study, unwind, and enjoy the cozy, home-like vibe. Highly recommended! ✨

Shepherds Cup Cafe is one of my favorite cafés in Brooklyn. The staff is incredibly kind and welcoming, and the service is always excellent.
The food is fresh, healthy, and delicious — I especially love the avocado toast, almond croissant, and roast beef sandwich.
The Rosemary latte is absolutely amazing and truly unique.
Such a cozy, warm place. Highly recommend!

Very nice place! I had a breakfast with friend in the morning. Take cappuccino and Avocado toast with salmon cheese and tomato. It was huuuge) and delicious 😋

Recommend this place

The most amazing staff, service, food, drinks & atmosphere. Every time I enter I am instantly happy. Everyone in there is so warm and welcoming. I also feel so in touch with my faith being there and to me, that’s so important. May I add they make the best hot matcha latte ever! I also enjoy their yogurt parfaits made fresh & their egg and cheese on a croissant that’s served with a mini arugula salad when you get it in house. I also love their freshly baked chocolate chip cookies and delicious almond croissant. They have bibles in all different languages and books to read and you can sit there to work, meet with friends or just enjoy a solo coffee date. No matter what your religion is or beliefs are, all are welcomed in with a big smile. My favorite place for many reasons.

name: The Four Horsemen
document: The Four Horsemen. cuisine: Wine Bars New American. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Sublime. We ordered every dish on the menu except the clams and it was consistently excellent across very single dish - I don’t remember the last time I had a meal like that, because most restaurants have clear stars in their menus and then other dishes are just ok, but here everything was a banger. Favorites - scallop and leek custard, egg and blue crab, wagyu crostini, and the panna cotta (I don’t even like panna cotta and yet this was one of the best desserts I’ve ever had). Can’t wait to come back for dinner or in another season!

Bravo. I’ve determined that this would officially be my last meal. Everything was perfect. The restaurant itself is super cosy. The service was excellent, relaxed. The food was interesting and flavourful. We tried a number of fun wines that paired well our food.

My only complaint is how hard it was to get a reservation 😆

An excellent operation with a chill vibe and a creative menu, taking amazing meals up a notch in unique ways. The Tartare Crostini is well formed and very flavorful, the salad’s cream and seasonings took some mixing up to get used to but that was good. Brown butter Crab with bread was great, and my two favorite starters the Grilled Octopus and the Seafood Rice. The octopus had perfect char and a sweet delicious taste paired great with the egg. The Seafood Rice was a great blend of fish stocked rice and cold fish as a topping. Then the Pork Collar, I loved this it’s a perfect preparation. Great portion with a beautiful seasoned top layer and a wonderful fatty center. We didn’t care much for the side, which for a dish this pricey you’d like solid side as a base but this gets a pass. Lastly to finish off the Panna Cotta was straight up great, safest dessert option.

Yes, it is hard to get in. But once you are in, good lord it is great. First off, you are made to feel like you are a regular at a neighborhood eatery. Then every course is perfect and beautiful. The suggested wines were outstanding and unique. The bartender, Sam, obviously enjoyed talking to me about the pairings even though I was a stranger. Sure didn't feel like one!

Four Horsemen feels like stumbling into a very well kept secret that somehow never tries to impress you… and still does.

I decided to try getting in without a reservation and luckily they thoughtfully keep bar and window seats available for walk-ins. The best approach is to line up right when the kitchen opens, or wait until the initial 5pm dinner rush tapers off and secure a seat at the bar.

The dining room is quietly romantic but a bit snug nonetheless creating a relaxed, understated atmosphere. Service is genuinely warm and technically precise without a hint of theatrics, striking an ideal balance of professionalism and ease.

The menu consists of tapas-style plates that are intentionally restrained. With minimal ingredients and thoughtful execution, each dish allows the quality of the product to shine rather than relying on excess or embellishment. The result is food that feels confident, focused, and deeply satisfying.

Four Horsemen is refined without feeling formal, and thoughtful without being precious, making it a place worth the effort, even on short notice.

name: Sunken Harbor Club
document: Sunken Harbor Club. cuisine: Cocktail Bars Tiki Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: An amazing hidden gem. Was recently at a Tiki Bar Speakeasy in Miami (Kaona Lounge) and the staff there sang the praises of Garrett Richard (The head mixologist here at Sunken Harbor Club). I had to come check it out. Sadly my first attempt was during a holiday weekend, and was told that the wait-list was full at 8pm on a Sunday, so I came back and few weeks later and grabbed the last bar seat that evening. The drinks were pure perfection. The vibe is absolutely surreal as you are quickly transformed from NYC to a true sunken harbor. The staff were wonderful, bartenders answered every question I had about different rums with precision and deep knowledge. The playfulness of the crowd interactions when certain drinks are ordered (EL DIABLO!) was always enjoyable. The lounge area looked like a great place for a date night, so I came back once more on Halloween for a wonderful date night. Even arriving 30 minutes after opening, we were told it would be a 90 minute wait, but well worth it. Drinks were again on point and the vibe made for a wonderful night. Can't wait to come back again (hopefully I'll be smart enough to make a reservation next time)

Is this the best Tiki bar in New York? I would say yes! There was a line before it opened, so its reputation is known, but it delivers to its lofty expectations. The interior design is a fantastic nautical theme, small place but the feeling is grand. The bartenders are true professionals and is a joy to watch them work. The food is decent, but the cocktail menu is exceptional. The way the alcohol menu is split is clever, from the In The Shallows section which starts with “softer” drinks, to The Twilight Zone where the punch is ramping up, to The Abbys where the dangerous stuff comes up. I had one of each zone, the Batida Dourada which uses cachaca/passion fruit and touch of black pepper. The Comeback Special my favorite drink by far which uses peanut butter washed rye, banana and pineapple in an amazing concoction which I could drink and smell all day. The PKNY is a painkiller variation, and does it work! Strong stuff. If you are into top Tiki drinks, or just great cocktails in general I strongly recommend.

What a FANTASTIC place! Small space but very cool atmosphere, think intimate Tiki bar. Drinks were fantastic, we tried some classics as well as some of their own creations. Had some of the best french fries I had in a while (to help with alcohol absorption). The young woman that guided us through the drink menu and took care of us, Victoria, was an absolute delight. I would recommend Sunken Harbor to my most discerning friends in a heartbeat. Can't wait to return

It was a great surprise! After the period-setting that is Gage and Tollner downstairs, you are transformed into quite literally the Sunken Harbor Club.

The dedication to the theme was perfect without being too on-the-nose. From the menu categories to the individual restrooms and a very unexpected (into the twilight) show. I won't give it all away. But think, sights and sounds.

The drinks were very tasty and not to overcomplicated matters but there's also off-menu options to explore. Our waiter, Tommy, was great! He was so personable, constantly checking on us, and again! he too was dedicated to the theme - 'welcome aboard!'

From beginning to end, it was an exciting and much enjoyable experience.

**if you have light sensitivities/not a fan of fog machines, do check to see if this will be happening while you're there. Not sure if it's timed.

By far the chillest bar I’ve been to! Service was impeccable; honestly the drinks were so strong and a bit of struggle to get through 😭 but I’m glad they didn’t rush us or anything. The staff here were nothing but kind, genial, and hospitable.

The comeback special with the peanut butter is also something I would reorder. Really enjoyed the Shrimp toast + Spam Banh Mi as well! I didn’t expect the food to be that great. Fun vibes all around! Definitely revisiting. 💯

google_reviews.text:
PLS HIRE NEW BARTENDERS WHO ACTUALLY KNOW HOW TO BARTEND!

Dear owner have your bartender complete the ATAP / Responsible alcohol service training and highly recommend they complete the TIPS certification (or other alcohol server certificate)
As a bartender myself who was off on nye night for the first time in 5 years. I came here on nye and waited about 15 minutes to talk to someone about a drink - no biggie it’s a holiday and super busy BUT the chopped female bartender who’s tall and looks south asian saw me waiting and being patient/polite and the bartenders offered free champagne to everyone who came after me for a drink and everyone who came up around me were helped first even though she saw me. After 15 mins still not helped the ball dropped and it was officially 2026! No biggie that we still haven’t gotten drinks yet at that point but pls take care of people in order especially if you saw them first. I waved hi to her when she saw me and she rudely couldn’t say it to my face but told the short white bald heavy bartender to come over to us instead (I’m only being rude cuz their attitude was unacceptable) he came over first and I asked if there was champagne left - and I was willing to pay for it and he said “no” and walked away and continued to pour champagne for himself and his coworkers behind the bar fully ripping shots with his coworkers while on the clock and sipping champagne that a customer had asked and wanted to pay for. So the chopped south Asian girl bartender walks over finally and YELLED mimicking my hi and wave back  3 times and waved her dirty hand in my face. Please have the owner or HR check the security footage at 12:06am of 01/01/2026 right side of the bar closest to the dj set, and strongly recommend to correct this behavior. I waved right back and she said, “happy new year what do you want.” I said “happy near year” back and looked at my boyfriend who was about to order a beer and i had a cash $100 tip in my hand to just treat the hardworking bartenders for the holidays and instead told my bf “lets go somewhere else” so glad I saved that for someone else who deserved it. We live behind the street of this bar and have heard from neighbors that it’s very weird in there and the bartenders have super weird energy and discriminate you if you don’t have a certain vibe like them. I’m legit a poc as well and just wanted to have a nice night out close by and I’ll never be back thanks to the rude bartender girl who doesn’t know how to bartend like how can you be both chopped and rude please pick a struggle.

TLDR; was called a liar and had money pocketed by bartender for being confused.

Editing to note that I have been to Coyote Club once before. I was really looking forward to this evening. We walked in with a large group, about 20-ish people all doing a bar crawl; when we arrived, the bar was not busy. Our host had reached out via DM several days in advance to give a heads up that a large amount of people would be showing up, but was not responded to. We do not arrive in a loud manner. Several of us notice the bartender with the shaved + tattooed head was visibly annoyed. We set our things down and my partner goes up and orders a beer, a shot, and hot dog. He’s told there’s a wait for the hot dog and says “No problem!” I go up shortly after and order a Blue Moon and hot dog. Again, 15-20 min. I say “no worries! Thank you.” He doesn’t tell me a total, but I know everything is decently priced, so I hand him a $20. He hands me my change and tbf, I wasn’t paying attention to the amount of change. I had been drinking since 2:30 and it was about 7:30 at this point, but in no way am I being a rude drunk patron. So, I leave all the singles he hands me for the tip. ($3?) was that enough for hot dog and beer? No, not even at their good prices but again, I am drunk! I assumed he put it on my “tab” because several other people in this group have ordered hot dogs already and were told there is a wait.

About 20 minutes later, my friend gathers his food, so I go check for my order. The other bartender with a black bob is available, “Hi. We ordered some hot dogs earlier, are they ready?” They walk away and grab 2. They come back and I say thank you but they say something I don’t quite hear. While I’m picking up the trays, I hear “$8 for the hot dogs.” “Oh! I thought we had paid for them earlier?” They walk away to ask the #1, and he says no. My partner is telling me he definitely paid for his, but at this point, it’s a couple bucks and I don’t find a need to argue or try to figure out what happened—I just I take their word for it, because I know I am drunk at the end of the day, so I hand them a $10 bill. #2 takes the money from me, starts laughing and says: “Oh so you lied. I just caught you in a lie.” She continues to loudly exclaim, “You said you paid, but you’re giving me money. So you know you didnt pay.“ “I’m gonna be honest, I’ve been drinking since 2:30. I wasn’t paying attention to how much cash I was given.” #2 walks away with my $10 and doesn’t return my change. My partner and I are standing there asking what just happened to ourselves, and I frantically grab a menu to double check our math. My partner is frustrated and lost, so he tries to speak with #1 who took both of our orders and he doesn’t do much explaining. When we try to clarify the situation, #2 very angrily says “it’s a cash bar. We don’t have tabs.” And tries to brush it off that it’s “not a big deal” (while being the one who made it a big deal).

I’m an honest person. I am not going on bar crawls to try and pull a fast one on a bar over a hot dog. I was willing to pay twice, since I truly believed I had paid for everything I ordered but they immediately accused me of lying in front of the entire bar.

I understand if I was in the wrong, but never in the exchange was I insistent I had paid for anything, nor was I angry in any capacity. I do not understand why someone who is clearly not being aggressive would be met with such a reaction. All they could have done was ask me how much I paid earlier/what I ordered.

Other individuals in our group were met with terrible attitude and I cannot stress enough how none of us were being rude or belligerent. At the next bar, I heard several people talking about how poorly they were treated. Our host for the crawl is a regular and had never seen these bartenders before, nor had anyone else who frequents.
Good vibes, pinball, happy hour, ca$h is king, never feels "too" crowded. 💯

A very cute spot with good vibe and good music inside. The interior is super cute and very aesthetically pleasing to the eyes. It really gave off a Stranger Things vibe. Lots of drinks to choose from and they have a beer + shot combo.

Once you get past the bouncers, who frequently look like they want to stab you and only refrain because they are getting paid not to kill you, it's an interesting, quirky neighborhood dive bar. Cash only, prices ok, good bathrooms, a few pinball machines, open late. Would go back, but seriously, someone should tell security they'd be so pretty if they smiled more.

google_reviews.text:
This is one of our favorite bars, we come here at least once a week. The drink menu has a little bit of everything: cocktails, beers, seltzers, margarita pints!

It’s a great place to hang out for a few hours, play some board games, and just chill. The décor is exactly what you’d expect from a place called Boobie Trap.

It’s rarely too crowded, so you can almost always grab a seat at the bar or one of the tables. They open at noon (yes, noon, early drinkers, rejoice!), and there’s an amazing pizza spot right across the street if you get hungry.

Just be nice to the staff, they’re awesome and they’ll treat you the same way.

Bar stool chairs are TOO SHORT!!!!! I threw my back out standing up to grab my drink off the bar, then my PLASTIC still fell back with my jacket draped on the back! Contacting management immediately. Do better! Service however was incredible. Holden, best bar maid in bushwick, Brett also was like so caring and attentive. I’ll be back, but I’ll stand in the back. Headed to the chiropractors in the morning. Boobie trap, fix this! Love you!

Just the best place. Same bartender who's there just about always, super kind and inclusive. Immaculate decor. Banger drinks. You really can't go wrong with this place. Play some games and get an electric lemonade :) ... I think that's what it's called (it did the job so the name is a little fuzzy)

Overall rating: 3.8

Definitely more of a Sunday afternoon energy than a late night bar hop. A Saturday late night at around 8pm was not it. It was very dead and a little sad. There’s a credit card minimum which I wish we knew before we ordered.

I came here a few years ago PC (pre-Covid), but the place has changed a bit.

Not sure if this is the place for me.
It's a fun cool place. I wish it were larger! They have plenty of games that make you feel like a kid again. Definitely will return!

The selection is huge—whether you’re in the mood for soft serve, hand-dipped flavors, or their fun sundaes, there’s always something for everyone. The portions are generous, the prices are fair, and the staff is always friendly and welcoming. The shop has that classic hometown charm that makes it a perfect stop after dinner, on a hot summer day, or just whenever you need a pick-me-up. Carousel has become a family favorite—we look forward to every visit!

I knew this place was going to be good as soon as I seen the food truck out back. 😊 Definitely the best ice cream I've found since I've moved here. I had the Dole Whip swirled with vanilla ice cream in a waffle cone with coconut. My bf had a classic hot fudge sundae. Definately check this place out if you get a chance. They also have deep fried Twinkies and funnel cakes, going to try their mozzarella sticks when I return!
Nice place to grab a snack. Friendly people, funnel cake, and a sundae on a pretty day. Nice atmosphere it's like being a kings dominonand just relaxing while you eat your treat.

Okay, this place CAN get a little congested at times, I'll admit. BUT, even so, I still give it all of my stars.

They have great food, amazing ice cream, and awesome decorative sense. They have a wonderful brick walkway all around the place that is surrounded with flowers and trees of all kinds (especially the white fringetree on the left side).

They have a few exotic flavors for the shakes, (one of which I'm very fond of. Ever heard of Irish Creme?) and I do appreciate the tiny umbrellas they stick in the drinks. Really makes me feel welcome there.

Oh! And the birds! The birds are always flying by and hopping on the tables! I think it's brightened up my experience every time I go there!

If that's not enough, they allow you to combine a shake and a sundae to create a magical treat called:

The Waterloo.

What a revolutionary concept! Always my go-to.

It's a great slice of nostalgia. Remembers of the Dairy Delights of childhood.  The wife had peacan and Carmel Sundae. I did a chili cheese dog with mustard and relish and my first ever disco fries.  The food was so good and hot , not the ice cream. Lol.
The decor is super funky and enjoyable. The wife loves the bubble blowing bear.
We make several trips here throughout the season.

It’s fun,clean, friendly, entertaining, with a great country atmosphere. We have been back several times now. We are moving back to my home place yaaa and we plan to make this a family night thing. name: The Lobby
document: The Lobby. cuisine: Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: My husband & I have been to Lobby Bar five or six times, from regular weekends to special celebrations with friends & family. Despite encountering issues a few times (some of which were beyond the restaurant’s control), the service has always been stellar, & the food & drinks are consistently good. Specifically, Sam as a hostess, & Raoul & Joe behind the bar, make for a really wonderful experience, with their attentiveness & friendliness. I have gotten the Lobby Bar version of a French 75 (Plenty of Fish in the Sea, served with a caviar-topped potato chip) every time we’ve been. The lobby nuggets & Wagyu pigs-in-a-blanket are also big hits. The only thing that could make it better would be (finally) getting matchbooks!

I went here for a fun dinner and got exactly that! It was a fun place, with a fun twist in classic foods (not in taste but in presentation and ordering). The cocktails were spectacular! The food was solid, but it is not upscale or must have, it’s much more of an environment for a fun good time with classic foods and home feels! I also loved the decor while there- it felt homey.

My friend and I went to the Lobby Bar last night. There's parking out front and nearby, but the system wasn't working properly for most of the guests. The host was super friendly and kept an eye on our cars. I made a last-minute reservation, but when my friend arrived, he was able to grab a seat at the bar, and soon after, another seat opened up. The place was packed -- it's pretty small, so it fills up quick. Luckily, the bar seats are first come, first served. Raul and Charlie were our bartenders, and they were awesome! We started with cocktails, then ordered a bunch of appetizers. My friend ordered  the Oaxaca Old-Fashioned, and I had the Gracias Poncho -- both were perfectly crafted. For apps, we ordered the lobby nuggets, lobby wing board, truffle parmesan fries, crab dip, and Wagyu pigs in a blanket. The nuggets, crab dip, and fries were the highlights of our meal. The wings and Wagyu pigs in a blanket were kind of a letdown -- the wings didn't have much flavor and relied too much on the sauces, and the pigs in a blanket were soggy and wet, making them pretty inedible. But the service was top-notch. Overall, we had a really good time with the cocktails and those few apps. If you're thinking of going, I'd suggest making a reservation or showing up early.

Make a reservation - it is a small space and seating is limited, so many people were not able to enjoy this adorable place because it was packed and the didn’t have a reservation!

Service - top notch as soon as you walk in.

Food - we opted for the girl dinner - it’s actually why we went there. It was so good, what a genius idea - it said for two but more like for three. I want to go again with my sister!!

Drinks - they were perfect Dirty Martinis.

Saw Lobby Bar on IG and had to try. It didn’t disappoint! They were accommodating with my toddlers stroller. Extremely welcoming just walking inside. British was our server. She was so sweet and gave great recommendations. Chef brought us out deviled eggs and we ordered the girl dinner as well which is a great deal $80 for a big platter and 2 drinks. Would definitely come back. 10 out of 10

google_reviews.text:
Let me tell ya. This was a wonderful meal. My waitresses, Jeni & Ellen were amazing. Menu knowledge was great. Outside tables were great and of course the weather cooperated, sunny 84° 2026/03/06.

Excellent service! Our server, Jenny, was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect the whole time. The food was good but she made the experience even better.

The Southern sandwich was a favorite. The Mac and cheese paired well with the chicken. Overall the flavors were exquisite and the chicken was fried perfectly.

The Sunday dinner wrap was also good. Very flavorful and decent size. It was filling and we liked that it came with two sides.

The Nashville sandwich was pretty good. Nothing exquisite but still good.

The steak and egg platter portion was small in my opinion but the steak was seasoned well and overall tasted delicious. The biscuit paired well with it.

I was also able to get a mocktail. Although it’s not advertised on their menu, they still did a good job creating something delicious and non alcoholic.

Overall we had a pleasant experience and enjoyed our brunch!

Our server Eden was amazing. She was fairly new, but she really took her time and got our order right? And provided great customer service. The bartender Katie was also amazing. She made our drinks wonderfully. The food was really, really, really good. Would refer to a friend?

We had a pleasant experience overall, especially with the service. We were seated quickly, and our server, Katie, was kind, attentive, and ensured our order was accurate. The 90s R&B playlist added a nice vibe.

As native Southerners raised on soul food, we come with a discerning palate. The restaurant’s motto, “Southern food done right,” sets a high bar—because to us, Southern food is rooted in love, tradition, and soul.

We ordered the turkey wings with gravy, greens, cornbread, and mashed potatoes. The greens and cornbread were good, but the gravy on the turkey wings was not to our taste, and the turkey wasn’t fall-off-the-bone tender. The mashed potatoes did not appear to be made from scratch.

We also tried the chicken biscuits with eggs, potatoes, and cheese grits. The fried chicken was juicy, but not generously smothered, and there wasn’t enough gravy for our liking. The gravy was thick and yellow-orange, not traditional Southern-style. The eggs and potatoes felt more like hotel-style breakfast, and the cheese grits were just okay.

We left feeling the restaurant has Southern-inspired elements—recipes, an R&B playlist, and atmosphere—but not yet the depth of upbringing, love, and soulfulness that truly define Southern food for us.

My Dad and I work in Roanoke and have been to this place twice. The  food has been amazing both times. I recommend the lamb chops or ribs with collard greens and creamed sweet potatoes. Well seasoned and delicious soul/southern dishes. Our waitress Katie was sweet and gave great service. Highly recommend when you’re in the area to try this place out!

name: Bad Luck Bar
document: Bad Luck Bar. cuisine: Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
Bad Luck Bar is one of the most unique cocktail experiences in Detroit. Entering through the alley sets the tone immediately—it feels hidden, intentional, and a little mysterious in the best way.

The space itself is very small and intimate, with only a handful of tables and a six-seat bar, but that’s part of what makes it special. The backlit bar is stunning, and the overall ambiance is moody, dark, and sexy. It feels like a true escape from the outside world.

The drinks are creative. They are definitely on the expensive side, but you can tell there’s real thought and craftsmanship behind them, which makes it part of the experience.

My only small note is that the bathrooms don’t quite match the design and atmosphere of the main space—I would love to see them carry through the same immersive aesthetic.

Overall, it’s a great spot for a special night out or when you want a memorable, elevated cocktail experience in Detroit.

These drinks are beyond normal drinks. Every cocktail was elevated to the next three levels. If you have a chance go check this small speakeasy. I loved the atmosphere as well. So chill inside and the bottles that have are off the chain.

We had a night out and decided to stop in to the Bad Luck Bar (how can you go wrong with a name like that?).  We made the rookie mistake of trying to follow Google maps, walked right past the alley and went on the other side of the block. Yes the entrance is from that alley.

When we arrived had to put our name on the list. We waited about 45 minutes before the call. My recommendation is to get there early. Once we were in, this is a great speakeasy, and a very intimate atmosphere. They have a very unique drink menu. I would suggest asking the waiter for advice, if you have any questions.

It was definitely an experience. We will go back.

The ultimate Speakeasy in downtown Detroit, the Bad Luck Bar is hidden in a nondescript alley not far from Campus Martius and half a block from Woodwood and State St.

I bought it out for a couple hours for a group event and the place is quite magical. The GM, Eric, has been there more than seven years and personally delivers the more sophisticated drinks and explains them in detail. We splurged on the $147 Japanese/Scotland fine whiskey selection with chocolates.

Prices for cocktails are over the top, most near $30 and single pours of average whiskeys are about the same. However, the house crafted cocktails are special and you are coming here as a special treat. Add the fact they do not serve food and seating is limited, they have to charge higher prices.

Overall, costly experience that is well worth it. Just hope when you knock on the door, they will let you in! Enjoy!!

Bad Luck Bar might be small, but it delivers a big experience. The space is intimate, moody, and thoughtfully designed, perfect for a night out that feels a little more personal. The steak was absolutely delicious—perfectly cooked and full of flavor. I also enjoyed my lemon drop, and the view from our table was really nice. We had a great view of the city, which honestly added a lot to the experience. The atmosphere and overall aesthetics of the restaurant are beautiful and definitely feel upscale.
However, while the steak was great, the sides were just okay. The creamed spinach and mashed potatoes were decent, but they weren’t very flavorful, which was a little disappointing for a restaurant at this level.
For a place with this reputation, some of the basics were pretty disappointing. Before I could even sit down, there were water droplets on the seat. The hostess tried to hand me napkins so I could wipe it myself, and my husband offered to do it, but I felt they should handle that since we were told our table was ready. I’m not bougie—it’s just reasonable to expect the table and seat to be clean.
On top of that, the window by our table was visibly dirty, like someone had drawn on it with greasy fingers. I had to ask twice before someone finally came to wipe it down, which took away from the experience.
As for the waiter, I don’t think he was necessarily trying to be rude. Because of where I was sitting, he probably didn’t want to reach across and may have thought it was fine to gently toss the menu my way. Still, it didn’t leave me with a great feeling. At a restaurant like this, I would expect the server to come to the guest rather than tossing something, even if the table setup makes it a little awkward.
The owner did come around, but by that point we were already eating, so I didn’t bring it up. What stood out to me is that we received a text saying our table was ready early, yet the area clearly hadn’t been fully checked or cleaned—between the wet seat and the dirty window.
The food overall was good, and in many ways the place feels like it should be a 4-star experience. But because of the service and cleanliness details, and the underwhelming sides, I’m giving this location a 3 out of 5. I’m not sure I’d return to this specific location, even though the steak itself was excellent.

google_reviews.text:
Everything was perfect from beginning to end.

Starting with the service, we arrived as a party of five and got seated immediately without a reservation. The waitress was quick with our order, and she even went out of her way to find me tea! She was very present with a warm energy for all her tables. We did not catch her name, but if you see the redhead with long hair and blue eyes, you can tell her she was awesome!

Second, with the food, we were also very impressed with the quality of the flavors and presentation. We got the fish and chips, two dark horse burgers, the seafood chowder and the Mushroom truffle flatbread. We then ended with two deserts, which were a bit small but still delicious. Everyone was full and please by the end of the meal. We would recommend all those options.

For the drinks, the ciders were very fresh and enjoyable.

For the ambiance, the colorful walls and smaller rooms made it very cozy. It looked like eating at a proper European restaurant, if not a European home. They even had a small photography gallery upstairs, promoting local artists. They are a clear, active member in the community and they make you feel welcome right away.

Especially for a restaurant located far away from the main roads, the quality of food and service was excellent.

We ate here for lunch on St. Patty's Day. I got the Guinness steak burger (which was a holiday special) and my partner got the shepherd's pie (with ground lamb). We also split a slice of carrot cake. Everything was delicious! My partner, who loves carrot cake, said it was the best she's ever had.

The service was prompt and polite. They were very busy, but we didn't have to wait long at all.

There is a small art gallery on the upper floor of the building selling photos and paintings by local artists. All of the works were for sale. It was neat to walk through and look at everything.

For its space, the menu is extensive and has something for everyone. My Virgin Mary was dekiciously spicy and the Reuben I ordered exceeded expectations. The side of wide fries were hot and crispy. The lamb burgers here are also excellent. I.look forward to returning and trying more menu options.
Empanadas are good but the Fish and chips were very well done, as well as their DH burger. Great customer service as well. Only wish I could have tried some more food!

This was the perfect place for a rainy day lunch. The restaurant has a lot of character, lots of seating, indoor and out. The service was very fast and friendly. We enjoyed our food and will be back again.

google_reviews.text: I've been to Honeycomb more than twenty times, easily, in the years since it opened - alone, in groups, on dates, any number of reasons.  The drinks are great, the music and sound system are fantastic, the bartenders are outstanding.  And the vibe WAS great.  Unfortunately in the last six months or so it has changed significantly, with the owner becoming infuriatingly controlling and ushering about who sits where.  I get that he's trying to curate a listening experience and a certain vibe, but if you're gonna own a bar (especially in a high-traffic area near Barclays Center, where people are coming in to drink off the street and may not have had you in mind as a destination), you have to chill out and let people have the bar experience that they want.  (This went as far as **locking the door** during bar hours the other day so that no one could sneak in un-chaperoned.)  Maybe I want to sit alone with a book at the corner and talk to the bartender.  Maybe I want to sit where I can catch the eye of someone cute nearby.  Maybe I don't want to sit at all.  This change has completely destroyed the vibes of the place, and it's a damn shame.  And yes:  maybe I want to have a louder conversation than you'd like.  Maybe we're having fun.  In reading other comments, his obsession with controlling the environment is leading to people feeling they're being treated poorly because of their race/gender/etc.  Not at all cool - this really has to change.
What an experience ✨ The DJ knows how to play at the listening bar and showed us the best music and vibes… The drinks are wonderful. I’m in love and I will definitely come back.
Such a cool bar with amazing vibes! The cocktails are fantastic, the music and sound system are incredible. Friendly staff and great service. Can’t wait to come back!

Overall, a great bar experience. The place is very nice, the cocktails are well-crafted and creative, and the atmosphere is original, intimate, and quite selective: definitely a spot that stands out in Brooklyn.

We did have a small issue with our bill during our first visit, but I really want to highlight how professional, reactive, and kind the team was. They responded quickly, acknowledged the mistake, and handled everything in a very classy way. When we came back, they even offered us drinks, which we really appreciated.

Mistakes can happen anywhere, what matters is how they’re handled, and in this case it was done perfectly.
Would absolutely recommend, and we’ll definitely be back.

My friend and I walked in the restaurant’s door (after walking past the outdoor seating area with a gravel floor, a stage for live entertainment, picnic tables, a couple of high top tables, plastic and wooden Adirondack chairs, all covered with stringed bulb lighting), and found ourselves a nice booth, and we sit.  We find ourselves in a high ceilinged industrial space that looks thrift store chic.  There are butcher block tables surrounded by mismatched chairs, live plants everywhere (the Christmas cactuses near us could’ve used a little sip of water), liquor basket, lighting, hanging from the ceiling, cactuses painted on the walls, along with some other, very interesting artwork, and a beautiful bar with 25 draft pull handles, a beer lovers dream.   Josh! I knew he was going to be great when he arrived at the table carrying two huge glasses of ice water. It was around noon, Texas afternoon and a water was just what we needed at that moment, beer would’ve been better, but we hadn’t gotten that far yet. We chatted with Josh about beer, we both started out with a Lager that had a beautiful coconut finish, that last flavor that comes through a few seconds after you swallow your beer.   The menu was plentiful and fairly priced, we ended up with roasted brussels sprouts, and a bacon, lettuce and tomato sandwich with avocado with a side of tater tots and queso. Joshua was great throughout our visit, keeping track of us, always there when we needed him, but not hovering, making sure that second beer came right away.

I thought I had way more pictures, but the two will lower the only ones I could find on my phone. I guess the rest are filed away in my memory.

If you’re looking for a chill,  laid-back place, to stop in for lunch, or dinner I imagine, give this place a shot. It’s definitely worth the time, the money, and I’m sure the staff will make you feel right at home.  Oh yeah, if the company you come with is a little boring they’re a bunch of games that they have that you can grab and play. Have fun!

Visited this establishment for the first time today and  it was amazing!!! The heartbreaker high tea was fabulous. The chips and queso and grilled cheese were off the chain! We loved the patio atmosphere and the throwback music…we will definitely be back..

This was such a great spot!! Love the open outdoor seating and live bands. We got to enjoy the beautiful Texas evening weather. Fun selection of drinks. The food options were so good that we all shared our orders so we could all try a few things! Our service was ok, our server seemed to not be overly interested in interacting with us. Barely made eye contact and got us our check as soon as we were ready… super fast. Would go back!

2 stars for a nice atmosphere. But the service was terrible. We ordered two drinks and watched for 15 minutes as they sat on the bar top, our server helping other people but repeatedly walking right past our drinks. By the time we got them, my beer was warm and flat.
We were then told that it would be a long wait for food, and our server recommended that we leave if we don’t want to wait more than 30 minutes. Weird interaction.
I’m sure people who got good service and servers enjoy this place. But I won’t be back. A place that advertises local beers proudly on a board should be able to serve them cold from the tap.
We shared the grilled cheese of the month which was dirty martini… absolutely delicious. The tots were perfect as well super crispy.

document: Bilt Bar. cuisine: Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: For professional truck drivers, the truck entrance is the North driveway on 600 E (Utah Valley Dr). There's a blue sign that says "Built Receiving". That road goes right by the Shipping & Receiving Office, there's blue signs. In the office, there's a few chairs, water cooler, and Keurig machine. 7 docks, only 6 functional. It may be a blind back, depending on what trucks are there and which dock you're in. There are several nice porta potties on a trailer by dock 7. Staff definitely don't have efficient procedures in place. The dock lights don't work. They don't take your phone number so once there's no more movement in your trailer, you need to go inside to see if your bills are ready. When I went into the office for my bills, they didn't even realize they were done. There was a line of trucks waiting for a dock when I left. For some reason, they left a few 4x4 sheets of plywood in my trailer, which I had to deal with. I arrived at 0900 on a Thursday and immediately got a dock. Waited in the dock for 2 hours before they even started unloading. Another 2 hours to finish unloading. About 4 hours on site to unload 29,000lbs, no OS&D noted on the bills. They definitely scheduled far beyond their capabilities. Plan for way more time here than you think.

I love built bars they are amazing. Did you know you can actually go to the factory off of 500 exit 275 and purchase your bars for less than $15 a box! Sure beats $3 and more gas station charge! Just love that place

Was delivering for the front desk and they were so kind and gave me several bars to try.  Had never had a built bar before.  They are so delicious and way different than I imagined a low calorie/high protein bar.  Was like a candy bar but only 140 calories.  Definitely recommend them!  They also have an amazing nascar racer that they have made into a cool couch in the lobby at American fork location!  Support our local companies!! Excellent product

Built Bars. These bars are delicious and taste like you are eating a chocolate bar, most of the bars contain only 130 calories and 17g of protein. That's a lot of protein for limited calories - most other bars are in the 200+ calorie range and don't have as much protein.

The flavors are amazing and they are constantly coming out with new seasonal flavors. Currently Candy Cane Brownie is my favorite flavor, along with any of the white chocolate flavors which were recently released.  October had Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookie flavor which was incredible too - and these are only some of the seasonal flavors. The staple flavors are also amazing!

My absolute go-to protein bar, which helped me meet my daily macro goals and ultimately lose 60 lbs in the process!  They are a nice change from the other chalky tasting protein bars on the market and there is no better protein product on the market!!

I've tried tons of protein powders and bars. I'm not a fan of any of them that use artificial flavors like sucralose and aspartame. I've tried Quest, Pure Protein, Premier Protein, Cliff, Kind, Go Lean, Lenny and Larry's, and many many more. Some were ok, but just that - "ok". The original Built Bars were by far the best tasting I'd tried so far. They were a little too chewy for me, but the low calorie and high protein made it worth it since they still tasted good.
THEN they came out with the new bars. 🤤🤤🤤🤤🤍🤎🤍🤎🤍🤎🤍
The flavor is still fantastic, buy not so chewy. They almost have a marshmallow texture which is more than fine with me. When they came out with White Chocolate Cookies N Cream 🤯 It tastes like a soft and thick version of a Cookies N Cream candy bar we all know and love!!!
I usually eat at least a bar a day. They help me keep my sweet tooth in check. These are definitely worth trying. Pictured is my 6 year old's favorite - Candy Cane Brownie!! The only downside is that certain flavors you HAVE to get them WHILE YOU CAN which is sometimes not very long!!

google_reviews.text:
I genuinely like this community. The layout is beautiful, and the front desk gentlemen are always respectful and professional. Overall, it’s a pleasant place to live, and in many ways I would recommend it.

However, the main issue is parking. It is quite expensive, and even when you pay for a parking spot, finding space late at night can still be difficult. During bad weather, especially when many residents work from home and the garage fills up, you often end up parking on the roof in snow or rain, which defeats the purpose of paying for covered parking.

There was also a particularly difficult situation during a month when I was laid off from my job. I requested to remove one of my vehicles from the parking list. I had always paid on time, and this request was made around the 12th or 15th of the month. I was told to bring back the sticker, which I did that same evening. However, I was not clearly informed about any towing policy or timeline. That night, my car was towed.

When I returned to the office, I did not receive a clear explanation. I asked to speak with the manager, and the interaction felt dismissive. I had to pay $180 for towing during a time when I was already facing financial stress. Although I was refunded that month’s parking fee, I felt that, given my history of consistent on-time payments, some additional courtesy or empathy could have been shown.

When I expressed that the situation made me reconsider renewing my lease next year, the response felt cold, simply stating that the lease terms would remain the same.

This is why I feel conflicted about recommending the community. It is a great place overall, and many staff members are wonderful. However, if an issue arises, the response may feel dismissive rather than understanding. I’ll let others form their own opinion based on this experience.

I love living at the Emerson. The community is well maintained and the staff is responsive to any needs you may have. They communicate early when there are upcoming changes to be aware of such as parking or required maintenance checks. I enjoy all the amenities they have to offer and so does my dog.

Basic things that should have been address they fail to provide. The apartment unit’s appliances  cabinets windows are deteriorating, and they refused to fix them. For a “luxury” standard building they cannot provide their tenants basic standards. You expect with such high rent to have a higher standard of living but this management falls short to provide you a living that other apartments complexes are providing with half the rent cost. The management also fails to answer you via emails , with endless follow ups and no answers

Parking here is a nightmare. We pay $80 per month and still can’t find spots because there are so few available. At night, residents wait for you to leave just to take your space, which feels uncomfortable and stressful. Management has also turned many spots into “reserved” parking to charge even more, instead of fixing the problem.

This feels like a cash grab rather than a real solution to the parking problem. Overall, the parking situation is stressful, poorly managed, and unfair to residents who are already paying a monthly fee. Also, make sure you get things fixed before moving in , because they treated me unfairly didn’t get the apartment fixed from prior resident,.  Xander kept saying they will fix it,  but still here and nothing has been fixed. Careful with the managment

Had a wonderful 4 years at the Emerson. The leasing team (Xander & Elijah are who I worked with the most) were extremely helpful and a real pleasure to work with. Maintenance requests were usually taken care of within a few hours. Common areas, especially the gym, were a great bonus and we used them regularly. Thanks again to the whole Emerson team! We will miss living here for sure.

name: Frog
document: Frog. cuisine: Wine Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: I have got to give this a 5 star cause the food is so damn good. They make everything from scratch to include the Ketchup but whether they do or don't I don't know how they get the food so good. Yes, it's pricey so is everywhere and for quality ingredients with quality food OK!. The burger, one of the best in all of the DMV. The BWF is a must have for anyone who comes into the area. It's not that far from 81 and somehow always has seats. Drinks are good and they even have Meade if you like it. I can't talk enough about this black bean sweet potato quesadilla OMG. The chicken pot pie all fresh and big. YO! If I lived here I would go at least weekly. Staff is friendly and could be more attentive but they do great food and great drinks. Check it out.

Just a few minutes drive off 81 and we experienced one of the best home-crafted meals we’ve had in ages. Everything is made from scratch and with love. My husband had a burger with bacon on their house made bun, from scratch ketchup and mayo and the accompanying garlic potatoes were perfection. I had the catfish tacos with to die for homemade strawberry habanero hot sauce (3 outta 10 heat), cilantro crema, and purple slaw that I could have eaten a bowl of by itself and grilled pineapple. We took the expresso banana cake to go but couldn’t resist a bit even though we were stuffed. It’s a must try so unique and delicious! We ordered a $20 bottle of wine that went perfectly with everything. Prices very reasonable for the quality and craftsmanship of their food. Service was a delight! We’ll be back.

Blue Wing Frog is a true gem in the VA mountains! The food was incredible, owners & staff delightful, & art by Rachel Fitzsimmons stunning! Definitely plan a visit to Strasburg or stop by (like I did) on your way to/from Washington DC on I-81. Strasburg is the best little town & gorgeous murals are everywhere!!

Words cannot describe how much I enjoyed the Blue Wing Frog. Absolutely unmatched hospitality from the owner Robert, we really enjoyed talking with him!  As a gluten free person, the menu was clearly labeled, and Robert was very knowledgeable and took it seriously.

The food was delicious. Pretty much everything on the plate was made from scratch, including the bun and sauces, and you could tell!

We live about two hours away and are planning on returning again to try more on the menu! I could not recommend it enough.

We had a great experience at Blue Wing Frog! We ordered the Blue Wing Burger and the Twisted Philly Roll, which were delicious.

The Blue Wing Burger had fantastic flavors: crispy bacon and a fresh, house-baked brioche bun. While the burger patty itself was a little dry, the homemade mustard, ketchup, and aioli more than made up for it—each one was delicious and added a great depth of flavor. The Twisted Philly Roll was outstanding, with tender pulled pork, gooey provolone cheese, and perfectly grilled peppers on a soft brioche roll.

The crispy garlic 'taters were some of the best we've had—crispy, well-seasoned, and addictively good. Everything tasted fresh and homemade.

On top of the great food, the service was excellent. Robert, the owner, was super friendly and welcoming, making us feel right at home. The cozy, laid-back atmosphere made for a perfect dining experience.

If you're in the area, Blue Wing Frog is definitely worth a visit! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

google_reviews.text:

I went here because my friends and I bought tickets to see a comedy show in the basement; it was sold out, but it was insane how many people were there considering there were only 50-ish tickets for sale. Doors for the show opened at 7, we got there at 7:15, and there were so many people that there was not enough standing room to see the show. We could only get standing room right next to the door, and even so the door wouldn’t have had enough room to close completely because we were legitimately blocking the hinges, half-outside of the basement.

We got stamped, tried to tough out the standing situation, but ended up leaving by around 7:30. It was so unenjoyable to be in there, aside from it definitely being a fire hazard, that we left. I don’t know how the venue allowed this situation to get as out of control as it did.

I think that the venue should sell the tickets directly in the future so they can track the attendance and cap it after a certain number. There were no less than 120 people downstairs, it was a dangerous situation at worst, and a disaster at best.

Like I said, the staff were nice. I’m sure the entertainment was great, I just hoped that my group would have been able to actually be in the room for an event that we paid to attend. 2/5 for poor event planning, everything else was good or passable

google_reviews.text: We love their Saturday brunch. It’s such a good deal @ $14.99 and they often do special events (trivia, drag book readings, etc). The staff is great and the environment is welcoming to all.
Omg !!! This places is so good!! We have fun. You need to pay 5 dollars for the ticket, but is not too bad. The show is amazing, people are very nice!!

My friend and I are regulars here. We work in the industry nearby and often come in on Sundays after work. We’ve always had positive experiences, especially with Poppy, who is consistently friendly and attentive. We have even spent Christmas Day here. That’s how comfortable we have felt in this space.
Last night completely changed that.
We arrived first while waiting for a group of friends. A server named James asked for our IDs when we ordered. I provided mine. My friend realized she did not have her physical ID but attempted to explain that she had a photo of her passport card. Before she could finish speaking, he abruptly walked away from the table.
After avoiding us for several minutes, he returned and stated, “If you do not have a valid ID you need to leave.” The tone was sharp and dismissive.
We understand and respect ID laws. If you cannot accept a photo, that is fine. The issue was not policy, it was the escalation.
No manager came to speak to us. When our friends arrived and attempted to order drinks for themselves, they were told that because they were with us, none of them would be served. We were then told that if we did not leave, the police would be called.
Threatening police involvement over what another server later described as a “misunderstanding” was an extreme and unnecessary escalation, especially toward two regular patrons who were not disruptive, intoxicated, or causing any issue.
We were the only two Black women in the space. To go from being longtime guests who have celebrated holidays here to being treated like a problem and threatened with law enforcement was deeply unsettling.
We left feeling humiliated, targeted, and shaken.
This situation did not require hostility. It did not require avoidance. It certainly did not require threats of police. It required communication and management presence, neither of which happened.
I sincerely hope ownership reviews how this was handled. No guest, especially a regular, should feel unsafe in a place they once enjoyed.

I go here once a year for my birthday.  We pick a different restaurant close by and then go see the drag show!  A total blast. If I lived closer (it's a 2 hour trip for me) I'd be there for a lot more of their festivities!

I really love the vibe of Freddie's. Went there Wednesday night for food and karaoke. It wasn't too crowded and everyone there was very welcoming from the staff to the other patrons. All things considered with the food, I would definitely recommend this place as the atmosphere is great and the staff is welcoming and seem to love working there.

document: We Got Company. cuisine: Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Best bar in Williamsburg. I stop by here everytime I am in town. They have the best Penicilin, and I always get their BBQ nuts mix with it…a killer combo. The staff has that BK cool, and the music is great. It’s the kinda bar you want to become a regular at.

Bonus tip: Try the “Thinking About You.” A very unique and beautiful drink

Cool cozy quiet unassuming bar. Very nice cocktails and my party of 4 middle of Saturday afternoon were delighted to have found this place.

Bartending staff were all very hospitable.

We rented the entire bar at “We Got Company” for my sister’s birthday, and I truly couldn’t have imagined a better experience. From the very beginning, we worked closely with Jify, who was incredibly comprehensive, thoughtful, and helpful throughout the entire process. He thought of so many details we wouldn’t have even considered, and the package we chose was perfect and very reasonable for the level of service and attention to detail!

The bartenders, Jeremy and Hailey (hope spelling is correct) along with the rest of the staff, went truly above and beyond. You could tell they were genuinely happy to be there, and the energy was amazing all night. They were SO flexible, personable, and kind, and made everyone feel so welcome. I was so stressed and they made the night so easy! The level of care and attention that went into every single drink was unlike anything I’ve ever experienced. Delish. The cocktails were so spectacular that this place is officially going to be a new staple for me.

They truly made my sister’s birthday unforgettable. Even though we just rented the space for her birthday, the experience felt so personal and special. I will absolutely be coming back. I couldn’t have wished for a better night. Such good vibes and ambience! Divine!

Thanks!

My fiancé and I recently hosted our engagement party at we got company, and I could not recommend them enough. Jify, Jeremy, Hailey and Brian are so easy to work with throughout the whole entire experience. They are professional, fun and so respectful towards our whole group. They made sure everyone was having a good time. The drinks were delicious and vibes were immaculate. Thank you for having us!!!!

If there’s such a thing as a “healthy” cocktail bar, We Got Company in Williamsburg would be it. A few friends spoke highly of it and took me here. The place turned out to an absolute gem. Great vibe, professional staff and drinks.

I tried three different cocktails, and each one had its own unique character. You could really taste the freshness of the ingredients, which made everything feel lighter and more vibrant than the usual cocktail bar experience. The standout for me was Thinking About You—a cocktail that balanced unique flavors so perfectly.

The atmosphere itself made the whole experience even better. It had that Brooklyn energy—laid-back but buzzing, stylish without being pretentious. I walked in curious and walked out knowing I discovered one of my favorite cocktail bars in the city. Highly recommended.
