document: Juliana's. cuisine: Pizza. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
🥘: 7.5/10. The first pizza that I have tried in New York City! We got a number 6 special Pizza, with grilled chicken, mozzarella, white cheddar and homemade guacamole! I really enjoy the thin crust, a nice smoky crunch and their distinctive oven taste are everything! The guacamole is smooth, flavorful and seasoned nicely! Me and my friend both think that it would be nicer if the pizza has more sauce to it tho. We got a large pizza for around $36. The two of us couldn't finish the whole thing and we have to take a couple pieces to go with us!

🧑🏻‍🍳: 7/10: nice service and all the waiters were very kind! We got in line around 5:15 in the afternoon and waited for around 30 minutes to get a table.

📍: 9/10: Very easy to find! Right in Brooklyn, close to time out market. I love their lighting inside a restaurant because it is dim, perfect for a date night and I do see a lot of couples there!

Possibly one of the best pizzas I've ever had in my life! We waited in the freezing cold to get a seat, but they did have heat lamps out front that helped out🥶 the wait was absolutely worth it and I would do it all over again for one of these incredible slices! Great presentation inside, staff were amazing, plus you got to see them cook right in front of you!! This was one of my highlights on the trip and made me feel like i was in Newyork! Great work guys 🇺🇸 Brooklyn!!!!!

We were one of the first customers seated, and right away we noticed how clean and welcoming the environment felt. The atmosphere was comfortable and inviting, which made the experience even better.

Our server, Yakima (I hope I’m spelling that correctly!), was such a sweetheart. She was attentive, patient, and incredibly helpful while we tried to decide what to order. We weren’t sure which pizzas to choose, and she suggested getting two small pizzas and doing them half-and-half — which was the perfect idea. One of them was half white and half traditional sauce with pepperoni and prosciutto.

You could truly taste the freshness in every bite. The ingredients were flavorful, high quality, and not overly heavy. It was satisfying without feeling too filling, which we loved.

Between the delicious pizza and Yakima’s kind customer service, we will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

What a great place! We were in NYC for our anniversary and had to narrow down the plethora of eating choices, we are so glad Juliana's made the cut! Great service, great tasting pizza, and the place was awesome! We got the white pizza and added arugula. They had a table when we got there, but they were pretty full. We walked the Brooklyn Bridge afterward, what a lovely way to spend the evening! Thanks for dinner

Hands down one of the best pizzas I’ve had in New York! The Margherita came out literally steaming — hot from the oven, with that perfect thin, blistered crust and fresh mozzarella melting into the sauce. The tomato flavor was bright and balanced, and the basil added the perfect touch. The meatballs were also incredible — tender, juicy, and drenched in rich tomato sauce.

The vibe is cozy, bustling, and authentically New York — you can watch the chefs working the red oven while the whole place buzzes with conversation. Totally worth the wait!

name: Di Fara Pizza
document: Di Fara Pizza. cuisine: Pizza. located in Brooklyn. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: I was in Brooklyn (visiting from Philly) for a work thing and finished early so I decided to bang bang Di Fara and Luigi‘s pizza. They’re very different, but both are pretty incredible. Di Fara does a more of a crushed (very slightly chunky) tomato sauce that’s distributed alongside the cheese rather than totally under. The cheese hits the dough in places where there isn’t much sauce, creating a more adventurous slice eating experience. Each bite is slightly different and I love that. The crust is crispy and chewy, the perfect balance, and together with the tangy sauce, fresh basil, and cupping pepperoni, you can’t go wrong. It’s a little pricey, but hey, NY prices! Worth it.

This incredible hole in the wall in Brooklyn had some of the most incredible pizza I’ve ever had. Crust was crisp, cheese was fresh? And sauce was just right. The guys behind the counter were incredibly friendly and willing to engage in casual conversation.

Service was great. Placed our order and got our slices in a reasonable amount of time. Not thing I could complain about. If you’re in the area, stop in for a slice. You’ll be incredibly thankful!

Omg. This is top 5 pizza in my life. 6 of us did a “pizza tour” in Brooklyn today, and this is the first stop. I think there is no way the next place is going to hold up to this.

Crispy crust, maybe the best sauce we’ve ever had.

Wonderful. Stop what you’re doing and go here today.

So worth the trip for a ny slice. The sauce was so delicious, I could have eaten a bucket of it, the basil and cheese ratio was perfect, overall the traditional slice of pizza was my favorite pizza ever! The square Sicilian slice was delicious too, just not so easy to eat; much thicker and heavier slice. Very little seating available, but we got lucky, it was a gorgeous day, and we sat outside on a 3 person bench and waited for our pizza,  the 1 table outside became available so we got to snag it. There's a window out front they can hand your order right to you.
The best pizza I’ve ever tried. Hand formed, with a perfect bake to the crust combined with a great ratio of sauce to cheese. Cheese they add fresh basil which really pushes this over the top.

name: Rome To Brooklyn Pizza
document: Rome To Brooklyn Pizza. cuisine: Pizza Italian. located in Brooklyn. with 4.8 stars (exceptional). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
This place is an absolute gem! From the moment you walk in, you can tell it’s run by people who truly care about quality and authenticity. The aroma alone makes you feel like you’ve stepped right into a small pizzeria in Rome.

The pizza is on another level – thin, crispy, and perfectly balanced between the sauce, cheese, and toppings. You can taste that everything is made with real ingredients and attention to detail. The panzerotti was out of this world – golden, perfectly fried on the outside, soft and flavorful on the inside, with just the right amount of filling. It’s not something you find often in New York, and they absolutely nailed it.

Service was warm and friendly, and the staff made me feel like a regular even though it was my first time there. You can tell they take pride in what they do. The place itself has a cozy, welcoming vibe – clean, comfortable, and full of good energy.

If you’re a true pizza lover, this spot is a must. It’s easily one of the best pizza experiences I’ve had in the city, and I’ll definitely be coming back again (and again!). Highly recommended!

Tried Rome to Brooklyn and ordered a Grandma, Cheese, a Meat Lovers, plus 4 garlic knots. Overall, really good pizza. The cheese and meat lovers were 🔥 flavorful, satisfying, and exactly what you want when you’re in the mood for solid NYC pizza. The garlic knots were also a win.

The Grandma slice, though? Looked beautiful, but flavor-wise it didn’t hit the same for me. Might just be personal preference, because everything else was on point.

Only other thing: it’s a little overpriced… but also, it’s Williamsburg, so what did I expect? Would come back, just might skip the Grandma next time.

Stopped for a late night bite on a Tuesday. Got the margherita slice and a garlic parm pinwheel. Slice was perfect and crispy and the pinwheel was super savory and garlicky. Awesome spot and great food. Will go back again for sure.

Oh my GAWDDD, THE BEST PIZZA EVER! they fell off for a lil bit but tonight I had to immediately write this review because I am totally enjoying this delicious margherita pizza ! It's perfect from tip to crusty top, the sauce is authentic, the mozzarella cheese taste homemade! Simply delicious 😋

This was a nice lil spot - there must have been a leech in my stomach bc I was eating every five seconds. And so of course once I past here and spotted the garlic knots, the Staten Island in me couldn't say no.
The price wasn't bad at all either. But given the size (and the fact that my stomach was about to burst) I only bought one.
Sadly, it wasn't the garlic knots of my memories. It was too dense - not light and fluffy like the smallies I was used to. Thought this was just larger but with the same airy taste.
But as mentioned, I finished it bc i had no self-control on this fateful day.
The service was great, and there was seating enough for about 6 people- nothing out of the ordinary.

We love Aces! Allie may is the best as a server or bartender (everyone is awesome though!) you have to get the garlic cheesy bread so good. document: Krispy Pizza . cuisine: Pizza. located in Brooklyn. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: I finally tried this place to see if their TikTok fame is warranted. They’re -genuinely- not famous enough. Their pizza is the best I’ve ever had: crispy, light, flavorful, filling. Their use of real, in-house ingredients really shows. Portions are very good, and their slice choices are numerous and very creative. Their pinwheels were fantastic too. I’m having lunch there tomorrow again

Stopped in to check out the pizza selection.  I have been following them on social media for a while so I had to check them out while in town for Christmas.  They definitely lived up to the hype and met all expectations. We even got to see Freddy on the the back counter cooking up the spesh. An added bonus i didn't even realize is they are a couple blocks down from Dyker Heights Christmas Lights.

We tried the plain cheese, vodka sauce, pesto pepperoni, and margarita. The margarita looked so good i got a whole pie to go. Everything was spectacular. Even distribush was on point, with no slop jallops. Each slice was a different experience, and a home run! Best margarita pizza and vodka sauce pizza I've ever had! I love the sweetness of their marg and the subtle Ness of the vodka sauce. The pesto pep gets an honorable mention.  And the plain cheese was realllly really really good for a plain cheese.

They have so much to choose from that I'll have to come back about 15 times to try everything I got my eyes on.  Grandma pie and sweet ricotta/roni are up next!!!

I went to krispy pizza all the way from California and it was definitely worth it! Hands-down, the best pizza I’ve ever had in my life and I’ll be back for sure! There’s something different about the pizza in New York, but I wish we knew what it was in California lol we’ve been around the whole city and tried more than a few types of different pizzas in New York while we were there, but this was number one by a far shot believe me!

Everything i hoped it would be! Been following them on instagram from STL and was so excited for the trip to NY to try them out! We got multiple slices and a salad, my personal favorite was the spicy vodka, hands down my favorite slice I may have ever had EVER.  The dough is chewy, but crisp and tender, how is that even an option??
Sauce flavor is perfect, the quality of the cheese is also great. The tiny cupped pepperoni may be the perfect meat...just sayin...
Salad was also great, the vinaigrette was awesome, just added a bit of parmesan to the salad and it was delicious and fresh!
Thank you!!!!!!!!!!

I went in wanting to try the Upside Down Square, but it wasn’t available at that time.  So I went with the Palermo Square instead. And let me say this. It’s the best square slice I’ve had since Peter’s Pizza moved to New Jersey. Even though they’re different styles, the pizza hits the same way: super crunchy (Krispy) on the bottom, light and fluffy in the middle, and top with really fresh and high quality ingredients. I also tried the garlic knots.  I haven’t had one this good in a very, very long time, clearly made with care.
Definitely a must-try.
Update: 2/19/26
The Spicy Vodka square absolutely blew me away. I wasn’t expecting it to be this good, but wow.   Every bite was packed with very flavors. The sauce was unlike anything I’ve ever tasted. Again, the bottom crunchy crust was absolutely perfect, and without a doubt, it was the best slice I’ve ever had. I’m still thinking about it right now!

name: Grimaldi's Pizzeria
document: Grimaldi's Pizzeria. cuisine: Pizza Desserts Beer, Wine & Spirits. located in Brooklyn. with 3.6 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Grimaldi's under the Brooklyn Bridge is where the New York pizza argument starts and ends for me. Coal-fired oven thin crust that has that perfect char and chew fresh mozzarella that stretches and pulls exactly right and a tomato sauce that is bright and balanced without overpowering the cheese. This is not fancy pizza. This is not artisan pizza with truffle oil and microgreens. This is New York pizza done the way it was meant to be done and it is perfect. The line out the door is legendary and yes you will wait but the wait is part of the experience. Standing on the cobblestones of DUMBO looking up at the Brooklyn Bridge while you wait for one of the best pies in the city that is a New York moment. Cash only no slices whole pies only. You commit to the experience and the experience rewards you. The dining room is simple and packed and the energy is fantastic families tourists locals who have been coming here for decades all sitting elbow to elbow enjoying the same thing. I have eaten pizza in Naples Rome Chicago and everywhere in between. Grimaldi's holds its own against all of them. The simplicity is the genius. Great dough great sauce great cheese great oven. Do four things perfectly and you do not need a fifth. That is Grimaldi's and that is New York.

We needed to recharge after a three hours walking tour in Brooklyn. As we entered, the inviting warmth of the restaurant. You can't beat the location or the flavor at Grimaldi's Pizzeria under the Brooklyn Bridge. We ordered the 18" split, with additional cost, featuring the signature BROOKLYN BRIDGE (ricotta, sausage, peppers--perfection!) and the beautifully simple MARGHERITA. The split was recommended by the server as we couldn't decide one toppings. The staff was wonderful! It was outstanding! Truly one of the best food experiences we had visiting New York!

Came here after waiting outside to enter another well known pizza joint nearby. At first I was a little concerned that Grimaldis would be a tourist trap at the expense of the food quality but I needn’t have worried. My 16 inch margarita pizza with mushrooms (kept it simple) came out steaming, with a crispy base and fresh tomato source. Can’t say like other reviewers whether it was the best pizza I’ve ever tasted, but it really was delicious. Servers were courteous and atmosphere nice.

Grimaldi’s serves traditional coal-fired brick oven pizza. This is the most famous Grimaldi’s location, right next door to its original location. I tried the Brooklyn Bridge, which comes with roasted red peppers, creamy ricotta, Italian sausage, mozzarella, and a tomato sauce base, and The Don, topped with Italian sausage, meatballs, pepperoni, mozzarella, and tomato sauce. The ricotta on the Brooklyn Bridge wasn’t really my thing, but The Don was delicious. I also had their red sangria, which was very refreshing, and finished off with the Oreo cheesecake for dessert. Highly recommend! They offer three pizza sizes: 12”, 16”, and 18”. We ordered two 18-inch pizzas to share between four people. Even though my friends were pretty hungry, we still ended up with leftovers. In hindsight, two 16-inch pizzas would’ve been the perfect amount. We went on a Saturday around 3 p.m. and waited about 30 minutes outside before being seated, so definitely expect a line if you visit on the weekend.

Great food, long wait. We got there early (about 11:15am on a Monday) and waited 10 minutes to be seated. However, we waited over an hour for our single pizza. Once we got it, the Chef special "The Don" was delicious!!! We also tried the cannoli--with the powdered sugar, it was very sweet! Cost was incredibly reasonable...one of our cheapest restaurants, including fast food. As we left around 12:45pm, the line extended about a half a block out the door.

name: Paulie Gee's
document: Paulie Gee's. cuisine: Pizza. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
I don’t have video proof of the pool table, record player, or funky 80s vibes, but I do have video proof of the SENSATIONAL square slice I had at @pauliegeessoulcityslice in Wash West 🍕🪩

I had some time to kill before I hit the highway last week, so I stopped in for an early dinner + some work. This simple slice shop is cooking some delish pies (vegan options available) and serving cold sodas and craft beers! I got the Sicilian slice, which was cooked upside down with fattttt slices of mozz on the bottom, sauce on the top, and a sesame-seeded dough. I also got a traditional slice with crispy sausage cups. If I had to go back, I would just order the Sicilian slices. They were top notch.

Whether you’re looking for an inexpensive dinner, a casual hang, or a no-frills date spot, go here 👍

I really loved this place! Affordable prices for outstanding pizza. It seemed like a cool place to hangout. I was visiting from the west coast, so I was there alone. But if I lived in the area or was visiting with friends, it would be a cool place to hangout late night and grab some pizza and drinks. I will say one critique is I noticed a fly in the glass case where the pizzas are kept 😂 but Im still giving this place 5 stars, it was really good service and really good food for good prices. Will definitely come back if Im back in the area.

One of the top pizzas in Philadelphia. Everything is cooked perfectly in the oven. My favorite is absolutely the square focaccia pie with honey crusted pepperoni. I don’t think I’ve found an equivalent yet in Philly. Even my Italian friend agrees this is the best pizza place in the city.

We ate at the bar. Bartender was very attentive to us. There’s also arcade games and billiard available. Will come back again!

Delicious pizza, great vibes, friendly service. Great place to grab a slice and a beer on the way home after an early night out. Big fan of the hot honey + sesame crust on the Hellboy2. Drinks are great, rotating taps. Retro vibe and chill crowd.

The real Michelin stars!!! We returned to PG's a couple weeks after posting the (original 3-star) review about the take-out slices in the photo. The owner reached out and wanted to make it right...but we insisted on remaining anonymous and just wanted PG's to make sure they were making it right day-in-day-out.  On that next visit we again ordered two take out Freddie Prinz slices and they were magnificent. We take them home and later re-heat them until they get a little burnt on top. Those slices, along with the chicken wings at Koreana, are two of the great flavor experiences in Philly. Thick, cheesy, saucy, chewy, crispy-burnt...they can send you into that special blissed-out zone. Good work PG.

============ (original review below)===========
Not up to the usual standard. Paulie Gee's has been our 'go to' pizza place since we moved (back) to Philly a few years ago.  The regular pie is great, but the Freddie Prinz has always been a stand-out.  A big...thick...saucy...cheesy delight. Unfortunately today we got a couple slices for take-out and got an unpleasant surprise when we got home and opened the box. The slices were about 20-25% smaller and a lot thinner (not sure if that shows up in the attached photo). It's just always disappointing when a really good place is consistent...but then inconsistent.  Please don't let this happen and get back on track...we need to know PG's will be there when we need them!  Thanks.

name: Frankie's of Bay Ridge
document: Frankie's of Bay Ridge. cuisine: Pizza. located in Brooklyn. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
If you’re in the mood for exceptional pizza, look no further than Frankies of Bay Ridge. This gem has become my favorite restaurant, and for good reason! From the very first bite, I was blown away by the quality and flavor of their pizza; it's truly the best I’ve ever had. The crust is perfectly crispy, the sauce is rich and flavorful, and the toppings are always fresh and generous.
The staff is consistently friendly and attentive, making every visit feel special. They go above and beyond to ensure that you have a great dining experience, from welcoming you with a smile to checking in on you throughout your meal.
What truly makes Frankies feel like home is the warm and inviting atmosphere.

If you want an unforgettable pizza experience paired with outstanding service in a cozy setting, Frankies of Bay Ridge is the place to be. I can’t recommend it highly enough!

We ordered three items by phone: (1) Bianca’s pizza, (2) a Brooklyn-style pizza, and (3) the 71st Street salad. I asked whether it was better to pay with cash or card, and the woman on the phone advised paying cash and told me the total would be $48. My husband picked up the order about 20 minutes later.

When we got home, we started with the salad and immediately noticed what appeared to be a gray hair in it. We called Frankie’s right away and were told we could either receive a refund or get a free item on a future order. We chose the refund and said we’d come back in about 30 minutes.

Since my husband was hungry, we skipped the salad and started eating the Bianca’s pizza. While eating his third slice, my husband had to spit out his bite because there was a piece of plastic in the pizza. At that point, it felt like one issue after another.

My husband boxed up the salad with the hair and the pizza slice with the plastic and returned to the restaurant to show them what we found. Unfortunately, the woman who took my original order accused him of lying and implied we were trying to get free food. This was extremely disappointing.

To make matters worse, when my husband asked for a receipt (which he was not given at pickup), she suddenly provided one showing a total of $44—despite having told me over the phone that the total was $48.

It’s a shame, because the pizza itself tasted good. However, plastic in food is a serious choking hazard, and finding hair in a salad is unacceptable. The situation was made far worse by the staff’s response, the accusations, and the inconsistency in pricing. Had the issue been handled with honesty and accountability, I would have rated this place much higher.

Based on this experience, I would not recommend this restaurant. Customers should be cautious about pricing and, unfortunately, hope they don’t find human hair or plastic in their food.

Andrea is always our waitress, and she is fantastic!! My husband and I come here whenever we can so that we can be treated like family. The pizza is exceptional, the hospitality is warm. If you want a real New York experience, you come here. Period. Cozy, delicious, authentic. And so many options! I came here tonight with my vegetarian friend, and there were so many options for her! And scrumptious too. Vegan sausage and pepperoni. Just all around amazing. We love you guys :)

The restaurant is located in the Bay Ridge section of Brooklyn.  They prepare Italian cuisine and have a limited menu.  Servers are available for customers when dining in.  Customers can choose from pizza, salads, appetizers, calzones and beverages.  I ordered a  margherita pizza, salad and meatballs.  The food was very good and well-prepared.  Friendly and helpful staff.

If you’re looking for an old school Brooklyn pizzeria, look no further. From the moment you walk in, it has that classic neighborhood vibe, the smell of great pizza, and the well worn rhythm of people who know how to toss the dough in the air.

The pizza is excellent, but my personal favorite is the family sized calzone. It’s massive, perfectly baked, and packed with flavor. It’s the kind of calzone that comes out of the oven and immediately makes the whole table stop talking. Perfect for sharing, or not.

This is the kind of place that feels timeless, the type of pizzeria you grow up going to and keep coming back to because nothing can compare. Classic Brooklyn style, generous portions, and consistently delicious food. Highly recommend. 🍕

Oh and ask for Andrea as your server.  You will not be disappointed!

I especially enjoyed the pepperoni pizza — it’s the best option on the menu and I definitely recommend it 🍕
However, there is one major downside. I’ve been here multiple times, and the tables are always dirty. Unfortunately, they don’t seem to be cleaned, which really affects the overall dining experience.

used to be my favorite pizza place now the food is always cold and dry, the mozz sticks were always my favorite and now they are just rubber and burnt. very sad. wish it was better, gave them a few try’s after not having it for a couple years but the quality has just went down.

This place is spectacular.

1. The Pizza is phenomenal. Very crispy, nice and hot, so flavorful. Of all my time being in New York , this is easily a top 3 pizza place! Garlic knots are great as well.

2. The employees are very nice and professional. In fact, one time they gave me 2 free slices because it was nearly closing time. If that doesn’t tell you how friendly the staff are at this place, I don’t know what will.

3. 100% recommend to everyone. Lots of families and people come by to eat here, so it can be very busy at times. Make sure to go at the right time that’s all!

Gave This place 2 try’s to redeem itself due to the first issue. The first time, I ordered a plain pie for delivery and received a pepperoni, the second time the pizza arrived late, stale and cold. It’s like they had it premade and just threw it in the oven. You can’t even chew and swallow this pizza unless u take a sip of a drink with every bite. Unfortunately this will be the last time. Btw…it’s a 5 min drive from me.

I came here because of bozo influencers overhyping everything. My buddy and I first ordered a vodka slice and a plain cheese. We were both disappointed, considering all the over promising, and almost left to go someplace else. Pizza Time and Krispy Pizza both make better vodka sauce in my opinion, but we wanted to try the Piccanti.

Those same influencers said it was an off menu item and we had to ask, like it’s a big secret. Wrong, it’s on the menu and has been for years. This isn’t Lucia’s fault at all. Here is the issue though; the Piccanti ($27) has a vodka sauce base, and has pepperoni and hot cherry peppers. I asked for the Piccanti but with regular tomato sauce and one side just pepperoni. Apparently that’s not an option so I had to order a pepperoni pie ($26) which has a tomato base and then add the Piccanti toppings on the other half. Okay I thought, same outcome but it wasn’t until I went to pay that I found out it cost an additional $5 which came out to $31 plus tax.  So basically I had to pay $4 more than a full Piccanti costs and received half the toppings just cause I wanted a tomato base. Mind you, everywhere you go a vodka pie is more expensive than a plain cheese. If anything it should have been less than $27 but I would never assume that. Just seems like a weird system they have in place if you want to customize an order.

Anyway, the Piccanti redeemed the experience. We both agreed it was very good 9/10. We had a third buddy who was at work and we brought him the pepperoni slices. He can’t handle spicy peppers at all which is the reason we needed one side half pep only. He gave it an 8.7. Would I come back here? Probably not, unless I was in the area. L’Industrie, Pizza Time, Luigi’s, and Krispy are tastier Brooklyn options. I’m glad I got to try another Brooklyn hot spot though.

The ingredients tasted fresh and flavorful, and the pizzas were not overly fluffy, which can sometimes indicate a less-than-ideal preparation. Overall, the taste was excellent and very satisfying.

Service was simple, courteous, and efficient. The pizzeria has a steady flow of regulars picking up slices, suggesting it is well-loved by the local community. Prices are reasonable, especially given the quality of the pizza.

In summary, Brooklyn DOP is a reliable spot for great pizza with fresh ingredients, friendly service, and a welcoming, no-frills atmosphere. I will definitely return for more.

Very, very good NYC pizza — a true classic New York slice/pie. The sauce is zesty with just a touch of sweetness, perfectly balanced and full of flavor. The crust hits that ideal NYC sweet spot: crispy on the outside with just the right amount of chew. Simple, traditional, and done right — exactly what good New York pizza should taste like.

Great NY style pizza with fantastic crust. We ate there (seating in the back) but they also have a big to go business. The pepperoni pizza we tried was perfection and they are huge for the price. Highly recommend giving them a try, you can get a slice of pizza also.

My tip is to get a full pie instead of slices because A) it will be freshly baked. B) much cheaper that way. Their pasta is also really good. The penne alla pesto and fettuccine alfredo are what I have tried so far. I will update when I try more. This place has history and a reputation as a solid pizza joint. Dave Portnoy, the pizza guru, gave this place an 8.1. But I round that up and give it a solid 9. There's enough seating area and Tiffany lamps for added aesthetics and a vintage feel. They also have a memory wall with pictures and notes of people who have made memories in this place. And of course, the Godfather references and an Al Pacino portrait 😉

Okay. If you call to order, you might get put on hold - but it’s worth the wait. Joe & Sal’s is a small shop with big flavor. Some of the best, no-frills pizza I’ve ever had. The dough, cheese, flavors, quality and customer service are top tier. Will definitely return.

google_reviews.text:
I just had to share my amazing experience at Joe’s Pizza — it truly exceeded all my expectations!

From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm, lively, and welcoming. The staff greeted me with genuine smiles and were incredibly friendly and attentive throughout my visit. It’s clear they take pride not just in their food but in making customers feel valued and comfortable.

Now let’s talk about the pizza — absolutely phenomenal. The crust was perfectly crisp on the outside while staying soft and chewy inside. The sauce had that rich, balanced flavor that tastes fresh and homemade, and the cheese was melted to perfection with just the right stretch in every bite. Every slice was packed with flavor, and you can really tell they use high-quality ingredients.

Service was fast and efficient even though the place was busy, which says a lot about how well the team works together. The staff were patient, helpful with recommendations, and made the whole experience even better.

If you’re looking for authentic, delicious pizza served by a team that genuinely cares, Joe’s Pizza is a must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommend

Joe’s Pizza (Broadway) is undeniably one of New York’s classic pizza institutions and often one of the first recommendations for anyone visiting the city. Whether you’re grabbing a quick slice or ordering a whole pie, it’s a convenient and iconic stop.

The prices remain reasonable, especially considering the location and popularity. However, be prepared for long queues—waiting times can easily range from 30 to 45 minutes, and sometimes even up to an hour. The line does move, but occasionally slower than expected.

Their classic cheese, Margherita, and pepperoni slices are the clear favorites—simple, well-executed, and consistently satisfying. Inside, you’ll also find plenty of photos featuring celebrities and famous visitors, which adds to the nostalgic charm and history of the place.

While there are certainly other pizza spots in New York that may offer more innovative or elevated flavors, Joe’s stands out for its legacy, convenience, and reliability. It’s less about being the absolute “best” and more about experiencing a true NYC staple.

Definitely worth adding to your to-do list when visiting New York—especially if you want a taste of pizza history.

FANTASTIC low cost pizza!!! This it's my one must hit place in new york and I'm so glad I did. The pizza is affordable and it's light, crispy and delicious. There is definitely a wait to get in, but it's all part of the New York experience!!! I will say that their deep dish pizza was not my favorite and I would not get that again. However, if I return to New York I would definitely, make it a point to go here again.  The staff is friendly and the amount of pizza that they turn out is unreal!!! There is limited seating, so don't be upset if you don't get a seat.

A Simple but Outstanding Classic New York Slice.
One of NYC’s most popular pizza spots, known for its thin, crispy crust topped with rich tomato sauce and plenty of cheese. Slices start at around $4.50, making it an easy and satisfying choice.

Just steps from Times Square and open from morning until late night, it’s a perfect stop anytime you’re craving real New York pizza!

I was surprised how crowded it was during that time but that goes to show how great the pizza is! They say the pizza is great in NJ and NY because of the water. Whatever the reason, I wasn’t disappointed! Definitely recommend!!

document: Totonno's. cuisine: Pizza. located in Brooklyn. with 3.8 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Totonno’s in Coney Island is a true NYC classic. The pizza is excellent — you can really taste the quality ingredients and the care that goes into making it. The staff are wonderful, straight-up authentic New Yorkers, which makes the whole experience even better. The old-school atmosphere feels like stepping back in time, and you can sense the history in every corner. This place is a real gem and such an important part of New York’s pizza story. Definitely worth the trip.

Visited Totonno’s Pizza today. Located in Coney Island, this institution is only open on Saturday and Sunday from 12 to 5 PM. There is a lot to love about this pizza.   The crust was baked just right. Each bite you heard a satisfying crunch unlike other pizzas that are  doughy. The end/crust was puffy and not flat. Lastly, the sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese round out your sensory overload! Coal fired pizzas take on a different flavor vs. wood and gas stoves.

If you are in the area, you must try one of the few remaining coal fired pizza restaurants in New York City. Recent regulations have made it extremely costly for these restaurants to remain in business.  They only sell one size starting at $27 for a margarita. Visit them and check out Coney Island along the way.

This historical gem is located in the heart of Coney Island which is why I gave it one star for atmosphere but the service is pretty good like previously stated in other reviews the owner can be a bit rough around the edges but she's an old school Italian lady and I get it growing up in Brooklyn myself. Most importantly the pizza is really good But like other people said it's a bit pricey for the size of the pie but you get what you pay for and I believe that it's worth it even if you only want to try it once to experience a taste of History.

Totonno’s is a classic. It used to be better back in the early 90s, but maybe my taste buds have changed. The last time I ate there was just before Covid. I think the sauce used to have a bit more zing or something, I recall it lost its luster.

I read in a NY Times article that this place is now for sale. That’s probably for the best. Keep the coal oven running if it’s grandfathered in. It would be a shame to extinguish it.

I’ve always eaten here when it had indoor dining, so that’s why I gave it 4 ⭐️. That being said, I wouldn’t take the train out now just to be told I had to sit on a curb to eat my pizza. (That’s for rubes or pizza nerds, of which I am neither.)

I wanted to love this place due to its history, being on Somebody Feed Phil, and being walking distance to home. However, it’s very expensive for what it is, 2 pizzas (one white and one pepperoni with a few vegetables) was $60. They were between 12 and 14 inches. The pizza is good but not enough for the price. The owner at first can be a bit rough around the edges but I stood in there and chatted with her and the staff with everyone becoming friendly. There is no inside seating anymore, takeout only.

google_reviews.text: Delicious pizza with a charred crust and fresh ingredients. It’s definitely worth the try if you are around the area or thinking about it. Tiramisu was phenomenal. Pizza 10 out a 10 , Gem Caesar best ever had , annelini pasta was incredible and the tiramisu closed the night 💯 must try this spot ! Almost forgot espresso martini 🍸 was perfection !

What an experience! What a gem in Bushwick! The service was so welcoming and helpful - the restaurant was packed, absolutely as busy as it could be and yet staff found time to drop by, help us make decisions, and the fantastic host Kyle even showed us the pizza oven! The food was exceptional - the pizza was ultra thin, the red sauce delicious, and the baked phenomenal. We loved the focaccia in the bread service as well as the hummus and pepper oil. The gem Caesar was also a major highlight - inventive, interesting, and yet nostalgic and classic. I’ll have to come back very soon, and I am so happy to have tried this place!

On a snowy night in Bushwick, Brooklyn we made our way to this small outpost which is all the buzz in the local pizza world. As a lover and aficionado of Italy’s finest creation this was an essential stop. We got there early since they don’t take reservations and long lines form quickly. We were seated and then tended to in a very friendly manner throughout our meal. They have a nice selection of wines, cocktails and beers which includes Italian and Sicilian lagers. We started with the chef’s specially selected antipasto plate that included excellent quality, prosciutto, mortadella, salame, cappicollo, mozzarella, provolone, parmeggiano, olives and a wonderful marinated fresh artichoke hearts. We also had fresh, warm, housemade foccacio bread to go with our antipasto that also included a selection of the chef’s anchovy, spicy tomato, Sicilian hummus and pine nut spreads, that were all amazing. The foccacio was cooked in their special and unique coal burning oven, which brings me to the reason this place has become all the rage in the Brooklyn and New York pizza world. This is not just any coal burning oven but the oldest coal working oven in the western hemisphere according to the owners. It was built into the foundation of the building in 1890 and is located in the downstairs basement. The oven works overtime to help create magic in the form of bread and pizza. Now for the pizza, we went with their classic pie and their red pie, the classic had fior di latte cheese, San Marzano tomato sauce, pecorino and Sicilian olive oil, the Red pie has all the same but minus the fior di latte. The oven created a thin crust masterpiece with the edges charred by the intense oven heat. Only some of the best pies that I have had in Napoli or New Haven could come close to matching the cripyness of the dough, the wood flavors and the blending of tomatoes and seasonings. The Red pie really stood out for me for being so primally perfect. I imagined for a moment, my Calabrian ancestors making these early Italian works of wonder. This place did not disappoint and  deserves all of the special attention and raves that it is receiving.

google_reviews.text: Super helpful,  wonderful selection.  Crispys are awesome.  Oat milk hot chocolate is out of this world. They can custom make almost anything in a day. Crispys are awesome! I take stuff to my office every week. Help keep this small business here in park slope

Very Good beautiful spot for chocolate 🍫😋 lovers  make you love more with these chocolates 🍫 its beautiful experience and delicious unforgettable taste I got fresh chocolates I really love the way they display I just want to eat all the flavors thier cold chocolate coffee wow cookies 🍪 and toppings beautiful made different designs and plates of 5% of love with chocolate hm hmmm I 100% recommended this place very professional and also very nice and clean taking good care of hygiene and health follow all the rules of social distancing and not allow more people in the store to be crowded because of Covid-19 pandemic thank you for such a lovely experience of Brooklyn chocolates

Not Just Chocolate is the embodiment of a Brooklyn small local business. Two people with a dream and an amazing skill trying to make it. They have become a regular morning coffee/breakfast stop for me on the way to work every morning. Always greeted with a smile, and good service, my coffee is ready the way I like it before I even say a word. However, the coffee is only a blip of what this shop really is!

It feels like I am walking into an art gallery every time I step in. Their sculptures are literal pieces of handcrafted art. It makes for the perfect thing to celebrate a big moment or a big event. Easily one of the best gift ideas out there, as they'll have a beautiful sculpture for almost any type of person.

If you're in the area I would highly recommend stopping by and checking it out. Support Local Business!

When I first walked in I was truly amazed of the decorations, I had honestly thought that I had found a place where I could buy great chocolate treats. Unfortunately, I was deceived- I got a nice gift for my friend but when she took a bite of the chocolate she called me to tell me it was hard as rock. I went to the shop again and tried to see if there was a reason for this. But none were given -the person there said it was freshly made- so I decided to give it a try and asked for an Oreo and Rice Krispie chocolate and had it outside my car. It was definitely hard, unoriginal and it seemed like my treats were just covered in chocolate- which I could make easily at home by melting Belgium chocolate. I wouldn’t recommend at all- I’ve learned my lesson. I’ll stick with edible arrangements for now.

Went in today and met Sergio (sp?) and Helen, the husband and wife team behind this amazing store!  The store is small (no seating) so the focus is on the extraordinary chocolate figures and items in the case.  I have never seen such beautiful, detailed and unique chocolates, such as the adorable hedgehog, dogs, rabbits, cars, "5 oz", "wildcard" and other figure offerings along with amazing hot chocolate.  They also serve other coffee drinks.  I bought a small hedgehog which is so adorable I don't want to eat it but have just deprived the hedgehog of one of its apples...delicious!  This is a place with special offerings which will soon be available online as well as in-store.  Welcome to the neighborhood and good luck, Sergio and Helen!

google_reviews.text: Tried the frozen donuts. I got birthday cake flavor pretty good. Should have let it defrost before eating as they suggested, so it wouldn’t be too powdery as rn. Staff has always been so nice. Def coming back

I ordered the new Caramel Macchiato and the double scoop of Dubai chocolate with the toppings, prices are really reasonable, and the topping of Dubai chocolate were def the cherry on top, I love every flavors of the ice creams, best Ice cream shop and welcoming staff

Came across this cool ice-cream shop while driving. We were immediately drawn to the name of the place. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted. Inside is nice and bright and very spacious. I loved the decor of this place. There are two areas for you to sit and enjoy your ice cream.

There are plenty of interesting ice-cream flavors to choose from. The worker at this place let us sample any ice cream we wanted to try. The worker was super friendly and patient.  Of course, we ordered the stuff ice cream. Which is ice cream placed in between a donut. They use a glazed donut and slice it right down the middle and put the ice cream in between the donut with any toppings you may want. The ice cream is delicious, but the glazed donut itself is delicious. The donut is nice and fresh.

I sampled the red velvet ice cream that was delicious. The cones look really good as well. There are plenty of ice-cream options here, from flavors, different cone options, milkshakes, ice-cream cakes, and plenty of toppings.

This place is great for adults and for family outings with the kids. Overall, I had an amazing experience here. Friendly and helpful staff and the place is kept clean. I will definitely be returning.

The black sesame and coffee flavors are really good. They really go well together in the cake.

Edit: Went back for another cake and the mango and almond flavors are good too. Kind of wish there were more cookie crumbles inside.
No bathroom but boardgames are fun. Some are expansion pack and not the actual game. Good viet coffee drink and ice cream.

name: Junior's Restaurant
document: Junior's Restaurant. cuisine: Bakeries Diners. located in Brooklyn. with 3.7 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: We went to juniors in the early afternoon for a quick meal before heading back to the square and the wife had the burger special D and I had the soup and sandwich lunch special with split pea soup and a Pastrami sandwich. My wife said the burger was good and the fries were actually the highlight of her meal. The burger was a little think for her liking but maybe okay for some. We think a thinner patty maybe even two thinner patties would be better but that is our opinion of course. The meat was good quality. I had the split pea and pastrami and both were very good. The pastrami was in my top 10 which I would say is very very good and the split pea would be in my top 25. It was good but was missing some heavy stock and cream flavor in my opinion. We did enjoy our meal and would go back though. We were too full for cheesecake which we wanted but just couldn’t eat.  Please note they have Pepsi and not Coke products. The waiter told us they had Diet Coke but my wife knew instantly it wasn’t…if you know, you know!!

First night in NYC and came straight to Juniors off of a recommendation and it did not disappoint! I had the steak sandwich which was cooked to a great medium and seasoned well. We also had the pastrami sandwich that was tasty and had a great thousand island dressing to go with it. My boys split the chicken and ribs dish which was super tasty. We also had a crease chicken salad that had great flavor. Overall, great food at a reasonable price and good portions.

Was going to see the Bueno Vista Social Club show on 45thth street in NYC & noticed this restaurant 1/2 a block away and had plenty of time to have lunch.  What a find. The food was exceptional.  It reminded me of my youth in NYC and traditional Delis
We ordered Matzah Ball soup to start and it was outstanding. The Matzah Balls were huge and fluffy. Of course, they had pickles, Cole slaw & beets in small dishes on the table.  For the main dish we ordered Ruben Sandwiches.  My wife ordered a combo of corned beef & pastrami & ordered the pastrami.  They were huge and the bast we ever had. We were stuffed but could not leave without having their famous cheesecake for desert.  We ordered the raspberry swirl and was unbelievably light tasty. We had small bottles of Proseco to top off our meal.  The price and wait to get a table was well worth it. When we left the restaurant,  the line was queuing up for our show; perfect timing.

I liked the warm setting and helpful staff. Even though I had a reservation, I still waited about 15 minutes to be seated, but the food made the delay easier to overlook. The pastrami burger was good, and the chocolate cheesecake was the best part of the meal. Overall, the experience was solid with a few small bumps.

Went to Junior's just for dessert and everything was great. We got their:

- Pumpkin pie cheesecake - this is a slice from a pie that was half pumpkin pie on the bottom with a cheesecake on top.

- Carrot cake cheesecake - a real, hearty carrot cake layered in between cheese cake.

- Fox's U-Bet Brooklyn egg cream - old-timey chocolate soda.

Service was polite, quick and accommodating. Don't sleep on Junior's famous cheese cakes and desserts!

The coconut cream pie is to die for!! The key lime pie is fantastically sweet/tart and creamy. Their muffins are delicious. Expect to pay somewhere in the range of $16 for the mini/personal size pie. Some may find the price steep but it is worth it.

name: Brooklyn Baklava
document: Brooklyn Baklava. cuisine: Desserts. located in Brooklyn. with 4.7 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Updated Review:
I’m back with an update because this place just keeps getting better! Brooklyn Baklava is a true local treasure, and the owner, Mo, is absolute gem. He recently gave us a taste of a special treat they make for Ramadan and took the time to explain all the items I wasn’t familiar with.

This is exactly why you support small businesses—because they truly care and make everything with love. The baklava is, as always, amazing, but I am currently obsessed with the date cookies! Mo explained that they use no added sugar; the natural dates are sweet enough on their own. If you want authentic treats and incredible service, look no further.

Best baklava in NYC. I purchased at the Park Slope location once and they moved to Bay Ridge like 2 years ago. The staff was super friendly. He offered me a sample of pistachio baklava and it was so delicious. It was so fresh and not too sweet. I got a box of assorted nuts. It got 12 pieces and it was $22. Can't wait to go back and try other Turkish pastries.

⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Authentic Lebanese Treasures & The Best Cookies in Brooklyn!

Everyone knows Brooklyn Baklava for the baklava (which is, frankly, excellent), but I’m here to tell you about the "sleeper" hits you absolutely cannot miss: the cookies!

The Date Filled Cookies (Maamoul) are incredible, but the Pistachio Filled Cookies are on a whole different level. It’s like having that rich, perfect pistachio baklava filling inside a delicate cookie. I’ve never had anything like them—they are truly unique and a total must-try.

The shop is small, authentic, and spotless. The owner, Mohammad, is such a friendly guy; he took the time to talk to me and made me a total believer in those special cookies. It’s rare to find a place that matches high-quality baking with such genuine hospitality.

If you’re in the neighborhood, do yourself a favor and stop by. You’ll come for the baklava, but you’ll leave obsessed with the cookies! 🍪✨

Brooklyn Baklava catered for my club event, and they were absolutely incredible! The service was extremely reliable, and the dessert tasted amazing — it was literally gone within seconds. Every tray was so fresh, perfectly sweet, and honestly the best baklava I’ve ever had.

The owner is also one of the kindest people. Every time I stop by, he gives me free treats to try, and every single one tastes amazing. You can really tell how much pride they put into their pastries.

I would HIGHLY recommend this place to anyone. It’s hands-down the best baklava in the area — honestly better than all of the shops around them. If you want quality, flavor, and great service, Brooklyn Baklava is the spot!

We’re the Fort Hamilton High School Football Team, and we want to give a huge thank you to Brooklyn Baklava for their incredible generosity! The owner, a proud Fort Hamilton alum, donated beautiful trays of baklava for our Homecoming celebration — and it was absolutely amazing. Every piece was fresh, perfectly sweet, and full of flavor.

We’re so grateful for the support from a local business that gives back to the community and stands behind our school and athletes. Thank you, Brooklyn Baklava, for making our event even more special — and for being part of the Tiger family!

google_reviews.text: The modern decor was a pleasant surprise after my time away. My friend and I had dinner there, which exceeded our expectations. Came here for a calm and nice time with a couple of friends and we had ordered different dishes. They also ordered different drinks, but everything was as it was expected, which was nice and haven’t been here for a year more but definitely a great place to have fun and eat.

Nice seating, employees were polite.

The food tasted good, except the French fries, which tasted like stale McDonald’s fries.

The menu is a bit misleading—I chose the Ovaltine Crazy cupcake and it look really different. Thankfully, I was able to swap it out with the soy milk one. It tasted pretty good, but there was too much cream compared to cake, and it was a bit too sweet. The glutinous rice paste was a nice touch though.
The chocolate Oreo cream puffs was too sweet, and the pastry felt damp and stale (probably because it was in the fridge). The tiramisu was good, it was creamy and delicate. The chicken was tasty, though a bit oily.
Overall, it is a nice place, despite some foods being hit or miss.

name: Bernie's
document: Bernie's. cuisine: New American Beer Bar Wine Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text:
Bernie’s is a neighborhood gem!  The food and the service are impeccable. Most people come for the chicken parmesan (classic and delicious) but you can’t go wrong with your choice for dinner. We typically opt for shrimp cocktail, the wedge salad (comes with a big juicy slice of thick cut bacon!), the burger and the chicken piccata. The chicken parm and piccata are both large enough to share with multiple people (or a nice portion for takeaway). Don’t sleep on the sundae for dessert - every meal needs a sweet treat at the end!

The service staff are welcoming, friendly, and happy to suggest items if you’re indecisive or need guidance.  Once ordering, expect a short wait for appetizers. The kitchen is quick and efficient.

They don’t take reservations, which is a tad disappointing if you’re a planner but it’s pretty easy & simple to snag a table. They start taking names at 4pm Fri-Sun. We showed up at 4:30, and put our name down for a table which opened up around 6pm.  We chose to grab a drink around the corner while we waited, but you’re more than welcome to grab a drink at the Bernie’s bar if there’s room!

Highly recommend this cozy neighborhood spot for a delicious meal and great martinis.

The food is just okay-not worth the wait time in my opinion. I’ve been a few times, they make good dirty martinis and I do love their drenched wedge salad. I don’t recommend the mozzarella sticks. The burger is fine, as are their other staple dishes like Chicken Parm. You can find better versions of the same food at other more accessible places in the neighborhood. The interior decor is a vibe- but not sure the food and dismissive service is worth it. I think you go for ‘the experience’ and appeasing someone who wants to check it off their foodie list. It also attracts a bit of an elitist and influencer type crowd.

I get the hype around this place now. Bermie’s has a nice casual atmosphere, great service, and generous portions of great comfort food.
I ordered the burger, and it was outstanding—a big, perfectly cooked, juicy patty stacked with fresh toppings and served with some nicely done onion rings. And if you’re there on a weekend, don’t skip the tiramisu. It’s to die for and honestly better than what a lot of Italian restaurants serve. The only downside is how popular this place is. They don’t take reservations, and by the time I arrived around 6 p.m., the wait was already about an hour for a seat at the bar. They were turning away larger parties not long after. So definitely get there early, and if you’re coming with a group, maybe have a backup plan. Overall though, a great night and a place I’ll happily return to.

I love Bernie's. I classic, super popular spot in Brooklyn...but never acts too good for anyone and always tries their best to make room for any visitors.

I had such a fun time here.
Granted, I mostly came for some pre-gaming activities before going into midtown Manhattan, so I don't have any personal experience with the food here, but from as far as I can share, I had an amazing time when it came to the drinks and vibes.

The service itself is impeccable - everyone is so friendly, accommodating, and hospitable.

I also love the selection of brews here, and....yeah!
You know, I just had a really great time!!
Good drinks, and amazing vibes!

I highly recommend!
And yes, I would love to return in the future and try out the food.
Either way, my advice for now is a resounding YES for visiting!

One experience here just goes to show that food influencers on Tik Tok and Instagram taste with their eyes. Everything at this restaurant is fine. Photogenic first, fine second. It’s gussied-up adult junk food. The wedge salad is admittedly tasty and dressed to look sort of like a birthday cake — fun, but also $25. It sort of foreshadows the visual appeal of the sundae (again, photogenic and fine). The onion rings are highly executed too — no onions slithering out of the coating which shows care and attention to detail. But this burger people freak out over? It’s okay. And I care much more about the way a mozzarella stick tastes than the way the cheese looks when you pull it apart. The eggplant parm is crispy but has no real opinion. Chicken with vinegar peppers, again, fine. In order to get in without waiting for hours, you have to stand in line to wait for them to open. And THEN the servers rush you through dessert courses to make room for the next seating? Folks gotta calm down on this spot.

document: Ten Ichi Mart. cuisine: Bubble Tea International Grocery. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: Lots of reviews mention inconsistency but stopped by to grab lunch, salmon nigiri was very good! A bit pricey at $11 each but good quality and understandable at this location. Would definitely check out the discounted end of day stuff if I was in the area at night.

Love this place. There are hot steam buns here !!! Felt like I was in Japan for a moment until reality kicked in that pricing was not in Yen🤣. But it's ok.  Still great pricing for NYC in the boxed bento and sushi sections.  Very yummy with discounts after 8 pm.  Mus visit. I got extra sushi for late snacking.  Perfect 👍

Bento Boxes,

large variety of Asian condiments,
and
Daifuku Mochi.

Clean, Well organized shop.

Enjoy!

Thank you for reading!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Ten Ichi Mart and Deli isn’t actually a restaurant, despite what the name might suggest. Instead, it’s a small Japanese market tucked right in the heart of Midtown NYC — and when you put that in perspective, a visit here feels like a blessing.

The space may be tiny, but it’s impressively stocked with all kinds of Asian food essentials. It’s surprisingly complete, and best of all, very affordable.

Sure, the food quality can be a bit inconsistent at times, but the prices more than justify those shortcomings. Most of the items are more than satisfying, and I especially enjoy their assorted sushi rolls and chirashi bowls. Honestly, I’m just grateful this mart exists.

Get all your Japanese stuff here:

- Candies and snacks
- bento boxes and sushi
- soft-drinks and beer
- frozen meats and fresh veggies
- sauces, condiments, instant ramen
- skin care and toiletries

Even stickers and toys.

name: Sweet Polly
document: Sweet Polly. cuisine: Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: We have been to Sweet Polly many times and always enjoy.  We recently did a private event here as well, which was excellent and so much fun. The staff is accommodating and very attentive. Just as important, the cocktails are well made and super interesting. Just a great experience overall.

It's a cozy bar near Barclay's which is great for concerts. It's small so getting a table can be tough. The drinks are spendy, but really good.  Would skip the food cause nobody in our party really enjoy what we ordered. Nice enough staff, but they were a bit overwhelmed cause there was only one server onsite. I would go back but only for the drinks.

It's great for evening dates (dim lit), or solo at the bar. Bartenders are friendly. Tables are small (for a date). The menu is share-friendly/small plates and leans into Mediterranean flavors. You have a good mix of classic cocktails + new-age bar techniques (milk punch, carbonated). It's a solid spot  + they have tables out front on the sidewalk - good for people watching.
Delicious cocktails after the Stevie Nicks concert. Highly recommend the whipped coffee cocktail if it’s on the menu.

I really liked it here! At first I thought it was too noisy but I realized I was just being silly. It's a very cozy environment to bring your partner or some friends to chat and have some drinks. Our waiter was very friendly and very attentive. I originally was going to eat anything but then I decided to order the grilled cheese and I'm really glad I did. The bread was pretty crunchy but overall it was really good and it was great with the pesto sauce on the side. Would definitely recommend coming here! The drinks were pretty pricey but overall good.

name: Chip City
document: Chip City. cuisine: Bakeries Desserts Coffee & Tea. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: Hands down the BEST chocolate chip cookies you will EVER eat! Gooey, soft in the middle, melts in your mouth. The perfect Chocolate Chip cookies. Recommend getting the smaller chipper one for the best cookie. Will definitely keep coming back for any occasion.

I came here for the very first time and thought the place was the cutest.

When we entered the place, the gentleman did not greet us, no pleasantries by any means. I was taking pictures and videos of the place and stated to my mother which cookie I would like. We decided to get 3 cookies, which we  split them with each other. We ordered the Chocolate Chip, the Smores cookie, and the Cookie Butter Cookie. They smelled absolutely heavenly.

Once it was time to pay the cashier who was given money in their hand, he thought it was a great idea to place the money on top of the box instead of my mother's hand the same way she gave it to him. I observed the transaction and stated never again would I come to an establishment where we did not feel welcomed, no pleasantries, and money given on a box and not your hand.

In my opinion, the 3 cookies we ordered were absolutely delicious. I love how they were hard on the outside but soft on the inside. The cookies themselves weren't hard as bricks but hard in a sense of freshness and soft and gooey on the inside. Again, the cookies smelled heavenly, and I definitely thought these are some of the best cookies I've had in a long while.

I would visit again if the customer service was better. The cookies are delicious but a little on the pricier end.

This place is very unassuming but their cookies are really good. Super thick and gooey with just the right amount of crunch. My girlfriend and I came in and got the Brookie and it was amazing! I wholeheartedly recommend checking this place out if you like cookies.

Discovered this location and stopped ina do I must say it was a pleasant experience! The two you ladies both greeted me and walked me through the different variety of cookies they had to offer —also shared their personal favorites and why, my cookie selection was a great one - I enjoyed my cranberry white chocolate cookie! They also have weekly features! The establishment was very clean and welcoming and definitely worth a visit next time you are in the area or just to come by and grab a delicious cookie or two! The cookies are very moist and filled with delicious types of chocolates - they even have an oatmeal cookie!

We heard about their cookies several years ago but it was not easy for us to go to New York for the cookies especially during the pandemic, so we ordered on line to give them a try and really liked them.
Recently we found out that they have a new branch around DC, so we wanted to see if they were as good as we remembered, or was it the $100 price tag for overnight shipping.
We already knew how delicious their cookies were so we grabbed 6 cookies.
The fresh cookies are much better than the frozen ones and you can eat them immediately.
We are so glad to have this store much closer to us now.
We would highly recommend going and getting some especially as they have weekly cookies coming out. So there should always be a new one out to try. We love the cookie butter one.

name: The Bearded Baker
document: The Bearded Baker. cuisine: Macarons Coffee & Tea Desserts. located in Brooklyn. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Hi- I don’t leave reviews frequently but I wanted to offset some negative reviews. I just met the owner on his way back from the farmers market while he visited a friend at a local shop. He was so friendly and passionate about his cookies. He’s been baking with his mother and grandmother since he was 2 years old. He was talking about nearly selling out and I asked what he had left. I bought a single cookie and wow!! Blueberry lemon cheesecake-based cookie. Quite amazing. Definitely a thick cookie and gooey, but I love it that way! I haven’t been to the cafe, but definitely bring a little patience and joy wherever you go and life is good. Imagine trying a new experience of opening a cafe and being a small business owner. It’s scary, takes a lot of courage and hope, and hard work. People make mistakes and need to work out the kinks.

Encountered his stand at a nearby farm and purchased a mixed box.  The cookies are huge and taste delicious.  You can tell these are high quality and not sugar bombs. Absolutely recommend checking their cookies out!

I’m not exaggerating when I say that the brown butter chocolate chip cookies at The Bearded Bakery might just be the best I’ve ever had in my life.

From the moment you open the box, that warm, buttery, straight-from-the-oven aroma hits you and instantly makes you feel at home. love these cookies so much, I couldn’t resist signing up for the weekly subscription — now they’re a highlight of my week!

And I have to mention Toby — the kindest owner you could imagine. He greets every customer like an old friend, taking the time to chat and share a smile. You can tell he genuinely cares about the customers he serves. His passion for what he does isn’t just about baking — it’s about making people feel welcome and cared for.

Recommend!

Toby is the best cookie guy around! His cookies are always fresh, delicious, and even got a weekly subscription. Great variety, creative flavors, and super convenient—highly recommend for anyone who loves treats!

As a First time customer my experience was not good.  Went in and was told by owner, Toby that the cookies were coming out of the oven and they needed to cool about 5 minutes.  No problem I'll wait.  His friends and family came in after me and ordered same cookies.  While I'm still waiting and I went to counter to pay he said he only had 3 left. I was First to order and was given service last after his friends and family.
As a First time customer I will not be going back.  His friends and family will also support him. He needs the rest of the community for support.  He won't have mine or my friends and family.  Plus after all that his cookies were just regular not special.  And not worth $12.00 for 3 cookies.
Lynn

name: Brix Haus
document: Brix Haus. cuisine: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt. located in Brooklyn. with 4.6 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Such a gem of a place in the neighborhood! Very unique flavors and you can tell ice cream is made in house because the taste is incredible!!! Brix trax is our go to flavor and their recent new cheesecake fig flavor is just so so good!

Super cute local ice cream shop , lots of original flavors , wish there were more of basic selection too ( vanilla, chocolate , strawberry) . Very thoughtful Service they even sell Lactaid at the counter for the of us who don’t do dairy.

So happy that this wonderful ice cream shop has opened in our neighborhood. They also have new flavours to try and I love that there are a lot of seasonal, fruity and unique flavours!
The staff are always very welcoming and are great at giving recommendations. My challenge now is not to visit too often!

During our recent trip to amazing prospect park we decided to get ice cream. This place is conveniently located on routine between the park and our Brooklyn home. So of course we had to stop in a try their ice cream.
I love traveling and trying new places and I always try to be honestly in my reviews. So here we go…
The ice cream shop, aesthetically, is a really cool spot. It’s small but does an ice cream shop really need a lot of space? We loved the decor behind the register, especially the neon sign. It is definitely the focal point for the place. It’s just lovely. Everything in the shop just works together to create a cool atmosphere.
Unfortunately when we walked in the shop there were a few flies hanging out, being flies flying around and unfortunately one was in the ice cream display. I don’t know if the fly was in there prior to us ordering our ice cream or if it were in there while the ice cream display door was open. Nonetheless the flyer was pretty big but we ordered the ice cream anyway. I told myself that the fly flew in there because the door was open fora while because I took so long to pick a favor.
I ordered one scoop of the Brixtrack and he ordered the vanilla bean and a chocolate favor. The ice cream was creamy. Very creamy it was perfect as far as ice cream texture goes but the flavor just ok.  It was ok. There was nothing wrong with the ice cream. The taste was ok. But that is where it ends.
They do have great looking waffle cones but we did not try any.
This is one that you definitely have to try yourself.

It is a small little ice cream shop with a really impressive selection of original flavors. I had the popcorn (yes popcorn) flavor, and it was fantastic. The prices are pretty appropriate, and the staff is very friendly. Definitely stop by if you are in the area.

name: Saraghina Bakery
document: Saraghina Bakery. cuisine: Bakeries Desserts Breakfast & Brunch. located in Brooklyn. with 3.9 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Cozy Bed-Stuy bakery gem—Saraghina Bakery nails that perfect morning stop! Food was great: almond croissant flaky and buttery with nice filling, bomboloni filled with rich custard (addictive), sourdough loaf crusty outside/soft inside—ideal for to-go. Coffee strong and smooth.
Service was warm and quick (friendly staff, good energy). Atmosphere is welcoming and relaxed—bright, airy space with plants, communal tables, outdoor seats when nice out—feels like a little Italian neighborhood escape, though it can get busy on weekends.
Love y'all, will line up out the door for you anytime. I've been coming here for years and the coffee/baked goods are always so good. Everyone here that I've interacted with has also been super kind!

Nice bakery to have in the neighborhood! Small spot with bread, coffee, and Italian products. Friendly and helpful staff.

🍪✨✨Chocolate chip cookie was probably my favorite thing from them! It was a thin style with soft and chewy texture and slightly crunchy edge. Taste was well balanced and outstanding.

Chocolate croissant was classic, nothing go wrong but not a lot of filling.

Sesame long bread was neat as well. Like a sesame-flavored baguette!

Yikes, I wish I’d read the reviews before getting the Fellini sandwich. It used to be my go to order! I haven’t been here in like a year and was craving it today. Saw the bread was different which is fine, but I’m just now eating it and there’s like no filling - like three slices of mortadella, barely any condiments or arugula. What happened? I wouldn’t have paid this much for a sandwich if I knew I was just getting bread! I feel swindled :/

Focaccia here is still great though.

When we searched for the best Almond Croissant in the neighborhood, Saraghina Bakery popped up on the result list.

The decor is adorable and narrow-spaced with no indoor seating, only 4 people maximum are allowed at one time. Their options of pastry were limited and we had their Almond Croissant, Scone & a bag of Granola.

Everything was amazingly delicious, especially the Almond Croissant . The filling was creamy and the texture was crispy & layered.

Their Italian restaurant Saraghina is located right next door and it also looks really popular with great reviews and we would like to give it a try in the near future.

Court Pastry Shop is an Italian dessert establishment founded by the Zerilli family in 1948, located in the heart of Carroll Gardens. It has become a longstanding neighborhood fixture. The interior decor maintains its traditional charm, reflecting the timeless ambiance from my childhood, alongside consistently high quality desserts and cakes. Their offerings include renowned pastries, cookies, cakes, and classic summer favorites such as custard ice. Highlights include the cannoli birthday cake and their Italian Butter Cookies topped with jam and sprinkles. Please be advised that during holidays and summer weekends, the shop may experience extended lines; however, the quality of the treats makes the wait worthwhile.

google_reviews.text:
Do not order from Raaka if you are looking for any type of customer service if an issue arises.

Ordered a 3 month  subscription (3 bars each month/shipment). I received the 1st shipment on 12/2/2025; this shipment arrived in a sealed padded envelope with a sealed box inside.

The 2nd shipment arrived on 12/22/2025. This shipment was received as an unsealed box (no sealed padded envelope like the first shipment). This seemed rather unsafe as the contents of the package are food items. I contacted Raaka support to report the issue; did not receive a response. After a week or so of not receiving a response I tried contacting them again; still no response.

The 3rd shipment arrived, again in an unsealed box. This package was also chewed open, likely by a rodent (see pictureS). I contacted their support again and again received no response.

You’d think for $84 they would ship their items in safe packaging and respond to customer inquiries.

5 Stars!

Raaka is a chocolate lover’s dream come true! I got to make my own chocolate from scratch, and it was such a fun, hands-on, and educational experience. From roasting the beans to pouring my own custom bars, every step gave me a deeper appreciation for the craft.

The staff was welcoming, passionate, and made the process easy to follow. I walked out with delicious, handmade chocolate and unforgettable memories.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a sweet and unique adventure!

Our instructor Esteban was incredibly knowledgeable and gave clear and easy to understand instructions. The entire experience was so enjoyable and we went home with tasty chocolates to share with our friends and family. Would 110% recommend doing this class!!

I’ve been coming here once a week and trying something new every time, and I haven’t been disappointed yet. Everything I’ve ordered has been consistently fresh and full of flavor.

The burgers are absolutely incredible — easily the best I’ve ever had. Pair one with their homemade lemonade and it’s on another level. You can really taste the quality and care they put into their food.

If you’re looking for an amazing lunch spot, this is it. I highly recommend it to anyone who wants a standout meal.

We tried this new burger spot and absolutely loved it! 🍔🔥
The burgers were juicy, full of flavor, and made with fresh ingredients. You can really tell they care about quality. The service was excellent—everyone was kind, attentive, and made us feel welcome. The atmosphere was clean and inviting.
This place is definitely a new favorite, and we’ll be coming back again. Highly recommended!
