name: Ramen Danbo
document: Ramen Danbo. cuisine: Ramen Noodles. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
I recently visited Ramen Danbo Robson and really enjoyed the experience overall. The ramen was rich, flavorful, and perfectly customizable to my preference. The broth had great depth without being overly salty, and the noodles had that ideal firm texture. The chashu was tender and satisfying, and the portion size was just right.

The service was efficient and friendly, and the atmosphere felt lively and authentic.

The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is the ventilation — it wasn’t quite strong enough, and the space got a bit stuffy during peak hours. With better airflow, it would easily be a 5-star spot.

Still, a solid place for a comforting bowl of ramen in downtown Vancouver!

I had a great experience at Ramen Danbo. I tried their seasonal Curry Ramen, and it was so good. The broth was rich, creamy, and full of curry flavor without being too heavy. The noodles had the perfect texture and everything in the bowl paired really well together.

If you like ramen with a deep, comforting flavor, the seasonal curry ramen is definitely worth trying. I’d happily come back again!

Heard about this place and had to try it out. Tried the classic tonkotsu ramen which is one of my favourites. You can customize the type of noodles you want as well as the firmness. You can also choose add-ons such as seaweed, extra pork, ramen egg etc. The ramen was delicious and would recommend to give this place a try. It always seems to have a line up outside and for good reason. The line moves quickly and the ramen doesn’t disappoint. Worth the wait even in the rain.

The very first bite of the ramen at Ramen Danbo Robson made me feel warm inside like I had wrapped up in a cozy blanket. The bowl was full of steam and rich flavour that tasted like it was made with care and patience. The noodles were springy and fun to slurp, and every spoonful of broth felt like it gave my body a little boost. The people working there were friendly and made sure everything arrived just the way I liked it. Even though the restaurant was busy, my meal came quickly and tasted worth every bit of the wait. By the time I finished, I felt full and satisfied and was already thinking about what I would order next time. I would tell anyone who loves tasty noodle bowls to try this place at least once.

Danbo Ramen is a small and very popular spot on Robson. We went in the evening and the place was packed, which gave it that cozy Japan ramen shop feel. Seating is low and compact but still comfortable, and the warm lighting made it feel inviting. It can get noisy because of the tight space, but the restaurant is clean and well kept.

I ordered the Negi-goma ramen with kikurage and karashi takana. Presentation was beautiful, flavor was about 8/10, and the portion was just right. The eggs were cooked perfectly. Service was quick and efficient.

I love the thoughtful design, especially the storage space under the seats. They do have high chairs, but the shop is very tight, so not ideal for strollers or large groups.

Overall, it’s one of the better ramen bowls I’ve had in Vancouver. I’d return if I’m in the area, but I’d also love to try other ramen spots in the city.

name: Kyuramen - Park Slope
document: Kyuramen - Park Slope. cuisine: Ramen. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Tried Kyuramen in Brooklyn and had the shrimp tempura, a ramen bowl, and a bento box. The shrimp tempura was crispy and light, while the ramen was comforting with a flavorful broth and fresh noodles. The bento box was a nice combo option with good variety. Overall, a solid casual spot for Japanese comfort food and a satisfying ramen experience. 🍜🍤🍱

So so good! The broth of the Tonkatsu was so luscious, as was the chicken broth which was surprising. Normally the chicken based ramens are not as good but this one was excellent. Service was extremely fast and very polite. The Choya plum wine was a lovely end to our meal. Might recommend a res is you are more than two people. We will definitely be back!!

As a designer, I’ve always believed that the best experiences engage every sense — and Kyuramen does exactly that. The space feels thoughtfully curated: warm wood textures, soft lighting, and geometric details that echo their signature honeycomb booths — all blending into a modern, comforting aesthetic that immediately sets the tone for a cozy meal.

We all ordered the Steak Ramen, and it was outstanding. Each bowl was a beautifully balanced composition — rare steak slices melting into a rich, flavorful broth, with corn, bamboo shoots, wakame, scallions, nori, and that perfect half-marinated egg. Every ingredient felt intentional, balanced perfectly to create something simple and satisfying.

We also shared the Honeycomb Platter, and it was pure joy to look at — a vibrant arrangement of color and texture that tasted just as good as it looked. The chili garlic edamame, shrimp tempura, eel, scallops, and lobster & chashu salad ball were small bites that told their own stories — playful, satisfying, and full of personality.

To drink, I tried the Kyuramen Lemonade — bright and refreshing, maybe a touch sweet for my taste, but it paired beautifully with the savory ramen.

Overall, Kyuramen Park Slope was a memorable experience — thoughtful, flavorful, and visually delightful. Perfect for sweater weather and slow conversations.

📍 Definitely plan to visit again — and explore their other locations soon.

This is the best RAMEN in NYC ! It’s delicious and basically an explosion of flavors in your mouth. OMG - you all definitely need to try it at least once in a life time ! That’s the first time in 57 years , that I ate a full bow and wanted more ! A must go place in park slope !

I went a few months ago, and the staff forced me to tip. The food isn't even authentic japanese food either, don't go! False advertising from paid influencers to get you to spend money. The food tastes like a 5/10 at best. If you wanna get authentic or even decent ramen, go to Naruto Ramen just a few blocks away from this awful place. Just to let you know tips aren’t deserved they’re earned from good service and good quality food. So don’t force customers to tip!

name: Karazishi Botan
document: Karazishi Botan. cuisine: Ramen. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: This place hits the spot on a cold evening, the vibe inside is cozy and intimate. We loved some of their happy hour specials, both their food and drinks. The iron man was very filling but a bit too rich and salty for my taste, still very delicious however. The coffee dessert was okay, I’d definitely skip that next time. Our service was great and I’m very interested in coming back to try some other ramen options. Come hungry because the portions are generous!

The inside seating area is rather small but they also have a heated patio. The service was excellent. The wings were crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside. The ramen was great, rich and super flavorful broth, nicely cooked noodles (and a larger amount of noodles than typical in a ramen), tender pork. They have a lot of unique ramen on the menu and I look forward to try more of them.

Incredddddible ramen spot. I will definitely be coming back. I’m not vegan or vegetarian but ordered Captain Brooklyn III for the spice factor and loved it. It’s a sichuan style ramen with vegan meat. Highly recommend it.

Point Blank ramen was delicious as well, the broth is lighter than the Captain Brooklyn III and was a medium-spice.

Staff was friendly and service was quick. There are also cocktails / drinks. Ambience at night was nice and makes for a great place to bring friends or a date.

Recommend making reservations if possible but there’s also most likely room at the bar for walk-ins.

We had a great time.  The food was tasty, but I’d recommend against ordering the Iron Men IV if you prefer things less salty.  When we ordered, the waitress did mention that the broth would be “very rich,” but I was not deterred and curious to try it.  It was tasty, but I’d probs have preferred what my gf got, which was the Showa Classic.  We shared and enjoyed the INEZO Peach, a jelly-based sake drink. The servers were extremely courteous and responsive even though it took some time to get our orders in.  If you’re dining here, expect a cozy experience since some tables are positioned quite close to one another or the bar seating to maximize utilization of the small space.  I’d def come back the next time I’m on smith street.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ My fiancé and I finally decided to try this place after walking by it on Smith Street for a few weeks and noticing it was always packed. There are no reservations, so we walked in, left our name, and killed the 30-minute wait with a drink at Zombie Hut on the next block (an awesome bar if you haven't been!). When we came back, we were seated very promptly.

For appetizers, we started with the brown dumplings and the eel sushi. The dumplings are probably the best bang for your buck here—$9.50 for five is a great deal these days. My fiancé really liked them; I wasn't the biggest fan, but they were still pretty good. The eel sushi hand rolls were the complete opposite price-wise ($20 for two), but we both agreed they were delicious. They were large, generously filled with eel and rice, and had great accoutrements. It was honestly sad to see them go down in two bites (I take big bites!), but I will 100% order them again.

The main event, of course, was the ramen. We both ordered the Showa Classic, which has a chicken, pork, and anchovy broth. If you aren't a fan of umami, you might want to skip this, but I loved it. The anchovies gave the broth such a deep, complex flavor. I’m rarely impressed by ramen joints in the city—they often feel hard to distinguish from one another—but I haven't had a broth this flavorful before. The pork was melt-in-your-mouth amazing, and the noodles were delicious.

Overall, a great experience. I’d definitely recommend it and will be going back (though I'll probably add a few extras to the bowl next time!).

google_reviews.text: I've been going here for over two years straight, and the food remains consistent and hearty! Decent price and the service was good, but the food was okay. Maybe it was an off day, but the spring rolls we received were cold in the middle. The staff immediately corrected it and got us a new order of spring rolls. I would try again because everything else was pretty good.

Always one of my favorites. The ramen portions are amazing. So many additives and for spicy lovers, it’s SPICY!! The desserts are the shizz. Get the mixed berry sticky rice. Tip your waiters! They are the bartender, the server, the waiter, dressing plates. They work hard!! Green book approved.
Everything was so delicious and I SO appreciate how above and beyond the staff went when there was an issue with my order. Please come here and enjoy!! I can’t wait to come back and try the ramen

Excellent food experience. We ordered form uber eats on Saturday night spicy chicken ramen, fried wings and spring rolls. The food was so tasty and specially the ramen the broth is so delicious it has good spice (if you don’t like spicy it can be too much) but we personally enjoyed it. Will definitely go eat there next time.

name: ICHIRAN - Brooklyn
document: ICHIRAN - Brooklyn. cuisine: Ramen Noodles Soup. located in Brooklyn. with 3.8 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Highly recommend to ramen lovers looking for a cozy and chill atmosphere to enjoy a decently sized bowl of ramen! You can get a refill for just a few dollars, but make sure to save some of the soup for that. Ramen firmness and broth spiciness level can be customized while ordering. Staff usually provide a clothing basket to stow away jackets underneath the table to keep aromas from tainting clothing. Def recommend bringing friends or even a date to this place during midday as there is not much of a wait and the atmosphere is more intimate!

Delicious ramen but a little overpriced. You only get one choice of broth which is pork, but can customize the spice level and your toppings. The ramen was good but for the price I was hoping the portion size would be a bit bigger. Sitting at the private booths was also a really nice and unique experience, I highly recommend.

Ichiran is hands down one of the best ramen spots I’ve ever been to and easily my #1. The ramen is on another level—rich, perfectly balanced, and packed with deep, authentic flavors that burst in your mouth with every bite. The chashu is incredibly tender and flavorful, literally melting in your mouth and taking the ramen to the next level. From the broth to the noodles, everything is done to perfection. The employees are respectful, attentive, and quick whenever you need something. This place is an absolute must-try for any ramen lover. 🔥🍜

Went to Ichiran Brooklyn
Honestly, it’s exactly what you expect from Ichiran — super consistent, same flavor every time, and still hits the spot.

We sat at a regular table this time, not the booth, so it felt a bit more chill and less “exam mode” lol.
The broth was good, noodles were on point, and I like how you can customize everything.

BUT the toppings are still kinda tiny 😂
The pork, the green onions, everything feels like “sample size.”

A little pricey, but I still end up coming back.
This is hands down one of the best ramens I have had. Yes it’s popular but FOR A REASON. It is beyond worth it. The broth is 10/10, the chashu is the best I’ve had in NYC.

name: Za-Ya
document: Za-Ya. cuisine: Ramen Izakaya. located in Brooklyn. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
Zaya didn't disappoint! Came here for a Valentine's Day Dinner with my daughter and everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. The cucumber appetizer was super fresh and perfectly seasoned, with just a tad of spice that gave it a nice little kick without overpowering it — such a great way to start the meal. The saikoro steak was tender, juicy, and packed with flavor.

We also tried the shoyu ramen and the gyukotsu ramen, and both were incredible. The broths were rich and flavorful, and the noodles had the perfect texture. You can really tell they put care into every bowl.

And to top it all off, the chocolate tart dessert was divine — rich, decadent, and the perfect not too sweet ending to the meal.

The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and the service was friendly and efficient. Definitely a nice ramen spot— I’ll definitely be back! 🍜✨

Homemade tofu was delicious, very delicate! The ramen was also good. The atmosphere, however, could be improved; the lighting was way too bright, so lowering it a bit would help guests relax. Unfortunately, the utensils were dirty, and there was something inside both my cup of water and my partner’s as well. We also needed new chopsticks but couldn’t get the server’s attention, she was probably busy, and it looked like she was working alone

Genuinely one of the best ramen experiences I’ve ever had. And I don’t say that lightly. I ordered the Gyukotsu ramen, and it absolutely blew me away. The broth was deep, rich, and perfectly balanced, and you can immediately tell it’s made with real care and passion.

The karaage on the side was fricken amazing. Perfectly crispy with just the right amount of breading, insanely tender on the inside, and honestly some of the best I’ve had anywhere.

The atmosphere inside Zaya is super cozy with an amazing vibe. Everything is spotless and well kept, which just adds to the overall experience. The service was fantastic, and the owner is an incredibly kind, hardworking, genuinely amazing guy. You can feel how much heart he puts into this place.

On top of all that, the prices and value are outstanding. This ramen easily beats spots that are way more expensive and way more hyped.

This is an absolute must try in Brooklyn. Food made with love, passion, and pride. I’ll definitely be back!

Beautiful space but would never eat here again. I did like that the karaage portion was large and the sauce was very delicious + spicy! Was looking forward to the niboshi ramen most and was completely disappointed with it. Broth was very bland, wasn’t spicy at all (like it states) and the noodles felt cheap, similar to cup ramen. The pork in the ramen was also burnt so it tasted charred and bitter. I was very disappointed. I’ve had ramen all over the city and in Tokyo and this was not satisfactory at all to me. I just didn’t feel comfortable because the male server there when I went was not exactly friendly. Blank faced, monotone, and didn’t crack a smile once. Even when I said thank you when leaving he turned around halfway to look at me and then turned back around… the woman server seemed kind, though I didn’t interact with her much.

Delicious food; excellent service; clean, warm, cozy atmosphere. Really loved the poké - the salmon and tuna were super-fresh as were the tomatoes, avacado and cucumber. Also loved the edamame appetizer; a very nice sized portion; salty and plump! Quiet, super clean and classy place.

name: Okonomi
document: Okonomi. cuisine: Japanese Seafood. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text:
Finally got to try this spot. Truly enjoyed food, service, and the atmosphere. They serve Japanese home cooked meal that makes you feel cozy inside. We went for a dinner on a Sunday evening. Reservation is definitely hard to get since they have small dining space. But it felt intimate and it was nice not yelling across the table to talk to people. My husband and I felt satisfied after the meal—we got the large breakfast.

The choice of winter greens on this plate was complementary to the fish they served that evening (miso marinated mackerel). Miso soup had a pleasant note of smokiness. They give you good amount of soup and rice too.
We’ll be returning in the future for sure.

Amazing hidden gem. As someone grew up in Busan, KR, which is pretty close to Japan and is having lots of high quality Japanese restaurants. I can say this place serves a very authentic Japanese comfort food.
Never expected, but surprisingly satisfied after having a long day.

japanese is my favorite cuisine and I love simple, ingredient forward dishes. Having said that I feel like good japanese restaurants are very detail oriented and take great care in their choice of rice (both in terms of quality and taste) and I noticed this was not the case here. The fish also tasted a tad unfresh. The meal definitely gave a home cooked feel, but the lack of attention to detail for the price and what they seemed to be going for did not make this experience worth it for me.
Absolute JOY eating here. Most authentic Japanese meal I’ve had since being in Japan. Extremely fresh, unreal flavor, impeccable vibes. I cannot wait to return asap!!!

Food 4/5
Service 3.5/5
Ambiance 3.5/5

Okonomi serves a traditional Japanese breakfast for $30-$38. The experience is intimate, with only 12 seats, so reservations are a must.

Don't expect to leave completely full, as the portions are on the smaller side, but it's definitely a unique experience.

I enjoyed the miso salmon, but found the pollock a bit dry and underseasoned. It seems the fish quality can vary, as my friend's pollock was juicier.

name: The Garden At Ditmas
document: The Garden At Ditmas. cuisine: Ramen. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: Love this place! Great ambiance, amazing service and delicious food! Just came here for some drinks and ending up ordering a bunch of food. Sooo good! Love their Yellow Jalapeño - soooo fresh and absolutely delicious. I killed the Philadelphia roll (I forgot to take a pic) - there’s something about the rice they use for their sushi that really heightens their overall texture and taste of it.  Left the restaurant full and happy!

Absolutely fantastic! This spot offers a genuine taste of Japan with fresh, high-quality ingredients and beautiful presentation. The tonkotsu ramen was impeccable, and the service was warm and attentive. A must-try for any Japanese food lover—I'm already looking forward to my next visit!

Loved this place! Super chill vibe and really friendly staff. The food was so good.fresh sushi, tasty ramen, and everything came out fast. Definitely one of my new favorite Japanese spots in my neighborhood. I’d totally come back again!

I know the Garden is fairly new-ish to the area, but I’m going on record to say it’s probably the best spot on Courtelyou since Purple Yam. I ordered pieces of the yellowtail and tuna sushi and honestly can’t be sure if I didn’t receive 2 pieces of yellowtail but it was still delicious. My tonkotsu ramen was equally tasty, the broth 100% worth slurping even once your noodles are long gone. Hot without being scolding, the flavors of the pork, egg, and vegetables fairly balanced. This might sound like ‘table stakes,’ but I’ve been to some shops that completely butcher the ramen with too hot (or barely warm) broth.

What might’ve been most surprising were the spicy yuzu margaritas. I had a couple and almost walked out without my tote bag. “It was those 2 margaritas,” the server and I said at the same time.

Crossing my fingers the quality sustains as I’m excited to come back and try much more of the menu.

Honestly, I was really impressed with the food. we ordered gyoza, tonkatsu ramen, karrage japanese fried chicken and some rolls. Love the ambient too. deff.this is a go to spot if you looking for a good japanese ramen in brooklyn. will deffinately come back.

name: Warude Crown Heights
document: Warude Crown Heights. cuisine: Ramen Japanese Curry. located in Brooklyn. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
The curry and brown rice is AMAZING. I’ve had a good amount of Japanese curry and this is my favorite I’ve had. I saw on instagram they use dark cocoa and it adds this beautiful richness. Not too salty either. Love!

Also got the salmon bowl. The kale salad is really hearty and flavorful. Salmon is good but curry is the standout.

Great for a flavorful but clean dinner!

Online order.

The cod fish and the curry sauce is good. They give brown rice more than anything.

Not enough pieces of fish for the price and an option for veggies in the brown rice would make it enjoyable. Lastly, the consistency of the sauce could be a little more loose (it came fairly hot).

It was my first time trying one of the Japanese bowls. I got warude curry which came with brown rice, fried veggies, fried cod, chicken and curry sauce. Loved the way they packaged the curry separately to prevent the fried stuff from getting soggy. The food was delicious, portion size was huge. Nice flavors, they can go slightly lower on salt though.
Will definitely go back again for their chicken teriyaki! The chicken skin nicely charred and crispy. Yummy teriyaki sauce!
So good. A total vibe. The staff are so nice. Food was great. Saki was decent. Music was great! Very cool intnl mix. Just a cool cool vibey place. Love it. ❤️

name: Toyo Ramen Bar
document: Toyo Ramen Bar. cuisine: Ramen Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: Our favorite Ramen spot in this area closed so we decided to try this place and so glad we did. We had sake, bang bang shrimp, edamame, he ordered a chicken Ramen and I got veggie tomato Ramen. He added on bok choy and kimchi, which came in side dishes, but you can get it in the Ramen as well. I liked the sake, even though I am new to the sake experience. We both enjoyed our Ramen. He made his extra spicy, I like that they have the spicy sauce at the table so you can add more if you like. The Ramen dishes were excellent with lots of flavor. The staff was friendly and attentive. The prices were really reasonable, for all that food it was $60..

Came in for ramen n it did not disappoint. The broth was flavorful & honestly it did not need any additional toppings. I was just being greedy adding more. It was perfect as is.
The cucumber lime juice was super refreshing. I love that the container it comes in is reusable, such a nice little bonus.

The shrimp tempura is not the traditional light tempura style. It is more like fried shrimp. Still good, just different from what I expected.

Vegan options! Loved this place, the staff is so friendly. We got the edamame, fried brussel sprouts, impossible bun and the spicy creamy yasai ramen which the broth and noodles were 🔥. Got spicy for the ramen and it was so yummy. Definitely try this spot!

I’ve just finished eating here today. I was in the neighborhood and had a want for ramen and was surprised I’ve not been to this place as I’m familiar with some of the other Ramen shops in the area.

I have to say this was a pleasant experience at this particular ramen spot.

I will say the only downside is the pork was very few considering that some of the other places are a little more generous with pork for what you’re paying.

However, the atmosphere for the most part is very inviting and calm which is very different from other places that seem busy and super loud.

I also do appreciate that they do not give me the bums rush and they let me sit and relax after eating their good food and was even attentive to my want of water and refills.

I didn’t eat their good food brown shredded stuff that was in the ramen as it is my first time trying it and my stomach wasn’t comfortable with it (Google just showed me that this stuff is called Wood ear mushrooms. Definitely not for me. I’ll ask them to leave it out next time).

I definitely recommend this place if you’re in town or just wanting a different atmosphere to relax and eat.

UPDATE: I am not a fan of bubble tea. However I tried this Milk Green Tea they shared with me and I have to say it’s quite delicious! I actually like it more without the bubbles! document: Izakaya Ajimi. cuisine: Izakaya Ramen. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Okay, I just got back from Ajimi and I had to immediately write a review because this place is fantastic. Seriously, every single thing we ordered was great.
The highlight for me was hands down the Ajimi Kuro ramen. I could eat that stuff every day. It was just perfectly savory and delicious. If you go, you HAVE to get it.
What really blew me away, though, was the value. The food was exceptional, and the portions were actually really good. I was expecting less given the price, and other reviews so that was a huge plus. We definitely left full and happy!
And finally, the service was on point. Our server was attentive and great, checking in on us when we needed something but never hovering. It was that perfect balance where you actually get to enjoy your meal without constant interruptions.
Bottom line: If you're looking for fantastic ramen and great Japanese food that won't empty your wallet, go to Ajimi. You won't regret it!

We ordered ramen, fried rice, and teriyaki, and everything tasted amazing. The ramen was hot and flavorful, with a rich broth and perfectly cooked noodles. I would definitely go back and recommend it to anyone looking for good ramen and Japanese food.

name: Afuri Ramen Plus Dumpling
document: Afuri Ramen Plus Dumpling. cuisine: Ramen Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: I absolutely love it—the cozy environment, top-notch service, and the food is also good. I am not a ramen fan in general, but this is a pretty famous ramen place from Japan that changed my mind! I personally like their dipping sauce, so I am a fan of their yuzu-tsuyu. Also tried their softshell crab tempura; it is very Japanese style, actually fresh, light, and not oily at all. They use Local by Toast and have a great birthday deal, so definitely use it! Love it 😍

Afuri Ramen is hands down one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in Brooklyn.
The gluten-free ramen was rich, flavorful, and shockingly better than most traditional ramen spots.
The crispy bok choy alone deserves its own fan club, and the fried ramen egg should be mandatory everywhere.
The sushi was incredibly fresh  especially the soft shell crab roll, which is a must-order.
The open kitchen and bar create a relaxed but elevated vibe that makes you want to stay longer than planned.
Their cocktails, especially the cherry margarita, are dangerously good.
If you’re looking for authentic Japanese flavors with modern flair, Afuri Ramen is absolutely worth the visit.

I’ve been to Afuri several times in Japan, but this was my first time trying one of their overseas locations. I was pleasantly surprised by the wide range of appetizers here, unlike the Afuri shops in Japan, which are more quick dine-and-go spots with just a few ramen options.
For the ramen, the toppings were fine, nothing that particularly stood out, but the broth and noodles were amazing.
The space is bright, clean, and much larger than I expected, with a variety of seating options that work well for both solo diners and groups. The staff were also very friendly and welcoming.
Overall, a great dining experience and definitely worth the trek to Greenpoint!

The tonkatsu shio ramen was so rich and thick, it is definitely delicious and worth the price!! We loved the sauce for the karage! Crispy dumpling was very mediocre but sauce was good! yuzu was clear and sweet!

The hazelnut tan tan (plant based) is still my favorite from here and sometimes I’d order delivery to have it! Really creamy and flavorful 😍

I was surprised to see the sports bar theme here because it’s totally different from the vibes in Japan. Looks like it’s blending in with the local culture, though!

If you visit,you absolutely cannot miss their new dish,MAMA J’O.This incredible bowl of tom yum is loaded with seafood,crispy pork belly,and delicious Wava  noodles.The broth is perfectly balanced with the classic bold tom yum flavors that you’ll instantly fall in love with.

My friend also ordered a small bowl of soup that we had never tried anywhere before.if was a traditional clear broth tom yum soup,rich yet refreshing,with the bright aroma of fresh lemongrass and thai herbs.it tasted incredibly authentic.

Every thing about today felt perfect.the food,the cozy atmosphere of the restaurants,and the comfort of enjoying such amazing dishes on a rainy day.

The service here is also excellent.All the staff are friendly,attentive,and very welcoming.The restaurant includes an 18% service charge, which clearly communicates.When we paid,The staff kindly explained that tipping extra was not necessary,which I thought was very thoughtful of them.

This place has truly become one of my favorite restaurants, and i will definitely come back.

I recently visited this place and it absolutely exceeded my expectations! Everything—from the food to the atmosphere—was genuinely impressive. If you’re looking for fresh, clean, and high-quality dishes, this spot should be at the top of your list.

I tried the Mama J O and the Dug Roti, and both were outstanding.
•	Mama J O: The noodles were perfectly cooked—soft, springy, and full of flavor. Every ingredient tasted incredibly fresh, and you can tell the kitchen puts real care into selecting high-quality produce. The flavors are bold but well-balanced, making every bite comforting and satisfying.
•	Dug Roti: This was a total highlight. The roti was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, with a wonderfully fragrant aroma. Paired with the rich, flavorful sauce, it was absolutely addictive. I would go back just for this!

The overall atmosphere of the restaurant is warm, clean, and welcoming. The place is well-organized, and you can feel the attention to detail as soon as you walk in. It’s the kind of spot where you instantly feel comfortable and confident about the food you’re about to enjoy.

In short:
Great food ✔️
Fresh ingredients ✔️
Clean environment ✔️
Friendly vibe ✔️
Totally worth the visit ✔️

I highly recommend coming here—once you try it, you’ll definitely want to return.

Went to Misc two days ago and had an amazing time :) We loved everything, the chill vibes, the drinks, the food, and the desserts. Huge thanks to Kate and Obee for organizing everything for us. We’ll definitely be back whenever we’re in Crown Heights :)

I had such a great experience at MISC, and the Mama J’O dish was absolutely outstanding. The flavors were bold, comforting, and perfectly balanced — you can really tell how much care and thought went into this dish. If you’re visiting MISC, Mama J’O is a must-order. I’ll definitely be coming back just for this dish alone! ❤️❤️❤️ Service is really good too!!!!!!

¹Khallikote Unitary University, formerly known as Khallikote Autonomous College, is a co-educational state university situated in Brahmapur, Odisha on the eastern coast of India.
²One of the oldest educational institutes in Odisha, it was founded as Union College in 1878, and became a university in 2021.
³It was renamed in 1893 as Khallikote College in the honor of the RAMA CHANDRA MARDARAJ .

document: Samurai Papa BS. cuisine: Ramen. located in Brooklyn. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Compliments to the chef at Samurai Papa! I ate the best ramen I have ever had tonight. The food came out so quickly and tasted fresh, flavorful, and sooo delicious. The service was fantastic, as well, and the music was great. We will be back!
This place is so cozy and adorable, plus the ramen is one of the best I’ve had in the city after years of searching. Very Japanese vibes. They have great vegan/vegetarian options as well.

Some of the best ramen I’ve had outside of Japan. The ramen is light and the broth flavourful. The food menus accommodates for a lot with both cold and hot options. Extensive drink menus too. It is a small space but so worth the wait

I was doing my Sunday walk about when I stumbled across this restaurant hidden in the cut. I scratched my head because I don't remember seeing it ever. I walked in it was a small place but  small place means that I might have a chance to get a seat during a mid afternoon. And I did.  I do wish it was bigger perhaps if we continue to support this place The owner might decide to find a larger space and who knows what will happen there after, hint hint. I really liked the friendliness of the gentleman behind the bar and it seemed as though I was not the only one who was new to this place as a customer stated the food is really good. So now that cause me to have to try it. I checked the menu and to my surprise they had the brussel sprouts that I have only tried once at another restaurant. Need I tell you that I ordered it of course I don't need to tell you that but I'm telling you I ordered it and omg what fabulous flavors. I also ordered the  spicy  Dandan however I didn't order it dry I ordered it as a soup which was absolutely wonderful. As you can see in the photo great presentation. My mouth was tingling with fire just the way I like it not overbearing at all. Little baby bok choy was nice and clean and fresh throughout the leaves. If you're coming here make sure that you look for this place right at the corner because you can miss it it's in front of the bus stop. I'm glad I went out on my Sunday walk and I'm glad I chose this restaurant. The price was reasonable and I have room for dessert but chose to take a dessert somewhere else that I've never tried before perhaps next time. As I always say you could take my advice or you could try it out for yourself please step into this restaurant and enjoy.

Tasty food, good cocktails, and a unique setting. All the seats are bar/counter in the front, and there’s a small enclosed back seating area—they can accommodate about 20 people at once indoors, which is impressive in the space. Varied menu with assorted options of soba and ramen. Lots of vegetarian options. The lychee cocktail was nice. People seemed to like the canned Hi Chus, too. The ramen and soba both had a good amount of noodles and were filling. The flan was nice, not super sweet with strong cha flavor. Friendly staff. There were some people hanging out for quite a while and they didn’t rush anyone out.

name: Enerugi Ramen Cobble Hill Restaurant
document: Enerugi Ramen Cobble Hill Restaurant. cuisine: Ramen Noodles. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
Visited for their ramen and rice Bowl, their Tonkotsu ramen was flavorful and their noodle is flesh.  The Eel rice bowl portion is big, eel doesn't look like frozen eel.     Thick cut and has rich charcoal grill flavors.

Staffs are polite and attentive, serve provided as their best.  I will be back to try different food.

A really great choice for ramen, katsu and donburi. The Tonkotsu ramen was flavorful and the char su really good quality. The pork gyoza are also the best I've tasted in a long while! Friendly and prompt service, good prices. My only feedback would be to turn up the background music as it was a little silent in there!

Great new high quality ramen joint in the neighborhood. It’s small and cozy inside but the service is friendly and attentive.

If you order to go, they pack everything up well and separate the soup from the noodles so it travels well. You would be surprised how many noodle shops are too lazy to do this.

Fantastic new & cozy neighborhood spot! Their ramen bowls are delicious, offering the perfect soothing satisfying comfort food. Broth is delicious, noodles perfectly cooked. Nice and clean, and kind, courteous service. Weekday lunch special is a win!

We came here about 3 months ago while they were opening and my family and I loved it 😎. I meant to leave this review a long time ago, but never got to it. I highly suggest this spot as I got a rice and curry plate and my parents got them some ramen. Every dish was amazing 🙏🏼. Awesome atmosphere and service as well!

name: Ramen Thukpa- Brooklyn
document: Ramen Thukpa- Brooklyn. cuisine: Ramen Noodles Asian Fusion. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
This ramen spot was absolutely amazing — every single ramen we ordered was delicious.

The noodles were excellent quality: great texture, great flavor, and honestly everything we tried was outstanding. You can tell they take their ramen seriously. It completely lived up to the hype we saw on Google Reviews, and now I understand why it’s so highly rated — it truly deserves it.

Service was also exceptional. Our server was incredible and had an impressive memory. My friends were visiting from out of town, and they’re not used to the NYC style of ordering (where you’re expected to know exactly what you want as soon as the server comes over). He was extremely patient, explained everything clearly, answered all of our questions, helped us confirm everyone’s order, and made sure we got everything quickly — especially because my husband requested fast service since we were heading to a basketball game that was starting soon.

The restaurant was very clean, and even though it was busy, it’s clear the staff knows how to manage the flow of guests efficiently.

I’m a total ramen addict, and I will definitely be coming back any chance I get. Highly recommended!

AMAZING!!!!! Service and Food were excellent. He was patient with us as this was our first experience. Explained the menu down to our likings, respected food allergies, and didn't even need a pen n pad to remember our personalized orders. 10/10 recommend, WILL BE going back. I forget the gentleman's name who served us, but he also created the mural on the wall as you walk in. Beautiful soul of a man. Our dishes were as follows: Tantankamen Ramen, Spicy Miso Ramen and Shrimp Chow Mein. Pork and Crab Soup Dumplings, Crab Rangoon and Aloo Momo. We also had Thai Iced Teas.

Frankly, I don’t know enough about ramens so take this review with a bit more grain of salt the you usually would.

The food, price and service are all checked for this place. And that’s all a foodie needs and wants.

The Tantanmen Ramen with Chicken was fab. The Laksa Curry was good too.

The standout for me was the service. The servers were very sweet, and accommodating to all my taste preferences. They made it a great experience.

The ambience and vibe is lovely too.
Delicious lunch special ramen 🍜, with pork dumplings. Worth trying their food. Very cute restaurant to hangout with friends. Very kind serves. 🙂‍↔️

My friends and I went there during lunch time on Wednesday. We were seated right away with no reservations. We ordered 2 miso ramen, 2 dry noodles from the lunch menu. They have good appetizer menu. I do not recommend the spring rolls, they were just dry and fried flour. The dumplings and the edamame were wonderful, def go for the dumplings! The ramens were pretty decent with good amount of flavor.

name: Ten-Ichi Ramen
document: Ten-Ichi Ramen. cuisine: Ramen Poke Comfort Food. located in Brooklyn. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Delicious ramen in a cozy little restaurant. I got the Spicy Veggie Ramen, it was deliciously sweet and spicy at the same time (spicy because of the miso, sweet because of the coconut milk). The restaurant is small but cozy and warm, the waiter was nice and friendly. I used the toilet and it was very clean. Great value for money too, for lunch they run the lunch menu.

Absolutely delicious ramen with great service and a friendly atmosphere. I am no ramen expert but I’ve had my fair share and this tasted authentic. I will absolutely return. Cash-only but they also allow Venmo/Zelle.

I got the chicken ramen with added spicy beef. It was absolutely the best ramen. I also got the shrimp tempura which was amazing as well. The ambiance here was calm and modern with beautiful bowls on the wall. Definitely a spot that I would recommend to people who love ramen.

I wondered why the Ramen shop across the street was full while this one had two people. Nevermind the ravings reviews. Maybe I’m spoiled by good Ramen in Bellevue, WA. But NYC should have great ramen. This is pedestrian ramen.  The flavor is bland and the serving size meager. I added pictures so you can appreciate the deceitful nature of the chicken serving. Match stick size so that an already poor serving size looks bigger. Can’t be more than 2 oz. Hope this review prompts management to be better people.

I think I am missing seaweed+taste in my ramen - this is my personal critique, ramen must have seaweed (maybe it was probably on the “add-on” list). I got the tenichi ramen, chicken ramen for the kid, and spicy beef ramen for the wifey.
Delicious.

name: South Slope Ramen
document: South Slope Ramen. cuisine: Ramen. located in Brooklyn. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: This is my first time coming here. I got their signature ramen and it was great. Speedy service. Our server was good at always checking in on us. Great atmosphere. I would definitely recommend this place to a friend!

I ordered from door dash tonight- the ramen came with the broth separately, when I unwrapped the plastic wrap- the lid for the broth wasn’t secured properly- and the broth spilt all over my lap, down my leg, and even onto my cat who just got home from having surgery. The broth was insanely hot- I have raised welts on my leg and knee that I’m hoping won’t blister, my cat is fine thankfully, but this should have never happened ???

Love this spot! It’s easy to miss but definitely worth it. Laid back atmosphere but quick and smooth service. The food was amazing. Very flavorful and well made.

I got the katsu curry ramen, definitely recommend. Veggie Gyoza was also fantastic.
My experience was amazing. The birra ramen was such a great choice and having the birta buns was a great add one. This is a great place to sit down and chat
I've been here many times and this is one of my favorite ramen places!

name: Tamashii Ramen
document: Tamashii Ramen. cuisine: Ramen. located in Brooklyn. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: So this was my first time visiting a Ramen house and I loved it.  I enjoyed how it was decorated , we only had a 20 min wait on a very busy evening. I had some chicken as well as tried some octopus and both were really yummy !  The decor was a nice touch and the staff were very friendly ! I enjoyed myself and will be back.

I've been to a different location and this is the same. There was a new item they added to their menu and it was really good. The sticky buns. In all still great service and great food. I had the curry ramen and it dis not disappoint. My kiddos love the karage and the edemame. Great job Tamashii

My order was wrong and not very good because of it.  I'm not a big ramen person to begin with , but my son and daughter in law love it.  Of course their place they used to go in Las Vegas they liked better and I have to agree.  I ordered the Spicy Ramen and they gave me the Miso soup , not the broth.  It was too sweet and thick and took away from the jalapenos and even when I put the Choo Choo Kara in it which was Level 2 it just didn't do it.  My son even order a side of Spicy Pork which I added a little too and the sweet corn soup was just too overpowering.  We live in Mustang , so I wasn't going to drive all the way back to get it corrected of course.

My son got the Spicy Miso Ramen and it was essentially the same as mine except for no jalapenos.  My daughter in law got the Ninniku Tonkotsu ,  which I didn't get to try since she didn't get off of work till late.  I had thought about getting that one instead of the Spicy Ramen.  We also got an order of Karaage Chicken with Lemon and Golden Sauce.  It was pretty good.  I wanted 2 of the Chicken Thigh Skewers that was on the menu , but they said they no longer sell those.  I would have rather had those than the Karaage Chicken.

The cashier seemed to be new and maybe that's why my order got messed up.  I did get a 10% Military Discount that she had to call a Manager over to give me.  It was still $60.00 and my son and daughter in law both said it's not as good as our place in Las Vegas , but they haven't found a better ramen place to go to yet.  They also said they haven't found a really good Chinese place yet , but found a good Thai place.

If you’re looking for some good, yummy Ramen; this is your place in OKC! Full of flavor, great portions & quick service. We definitely plan to go back the next time we’re in OKC👍🏽
We both got the Spicy 🌶️ Ramen that had a little bit of a kick but was so good! We added our own extras.

UPDATED REVIEW on 2.9.26.  Yes, I still frequent this amazing restaurant. Everyone is so friendly and the food never fails. I had a sore throat today and the hot green tea with honey and lemon was perfect. I can't wait until the one by my house is built.

This spot is right next to my job. Its become one of my favorites. The food is wonderful, the service is always wonderful and the atmosphere is good. They are remodeling so you'll have to overlook it but once they are done it will be amazing. They have a ton of business each day.

google_reviews.text: Unreal coffee! Traditional dark roast Italian coffee. I ordered both espresso then a cappuccino to try both. Top it off with attentive customer service!! Will be coming back here as an after lunch date with my wife. Highly recommend this place!
cute spot to grab a coffee in the area! been meaning to try for a while and finally was able to stop in. coffee is great!! and the service is quick as well.

I recently visited this new charming cafe and was delighted by the exceptional coffee and inviting atmosphere. The indoor seating exudes a cozy ambiance, making it a perfect spot to unwind. Matilda's warm hospitality added a personal touch to the experience. Whether you're in a rush or seeking a tranquil moment, this cafe is a fantastic choice for both grabbing a quick coffee on the go and savoring a relaxing sit-down session. Highly recommended for coffee enthusiasts and those looking for a delightful escape.

I was just doing laundry near by and thought of getting coffee..used Google maps to locate a good rating coffee shop near by and this cafe popped up. I had a little chat with the lady manager. I love how cozy and cute the cafe shop is. Had a little chat with the manager and she seemed very friendly and caring! Would love to be here again! Just loved it!
Nice and quiet. The coffee is delicious, better than Starbucks

name: Forest Cafe
document: Forest Cafe. cuisine: Cafes. located in Queens. with 4.6 stars (exceptional). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: Very good! The python pasta was delicious. Very garlicky, so beware if you’re sensitive to garlic. I loved it! Drinks were delicious and ambiance is unmatched. Servers are fun and energetic.

Love Rainforest. We try and stop whenever we’re in town. Chris N took great care of us. Helpful with the menu, patient with our kids, was super friendly and made the meal so wonderful and memorable. The menu offerings are great for kids and adult. The atmosphere of the restaurant is so fun. It kept the littles entertained while we waited for the food. We walked up and waited maybe 10 minutes for a table. Reservations are recommended, especially for larger groups!

I’ve been dying to go here for so long and had it very hyped up in my head and it was absolutely worth it! Of course the pricing is high but that’s to be expected for the location but I think the food quality was worth it! I have only tried the quesadillas and Mac n cheese and they were both amazing! The entire experience was so cool as well with all the decor and sounds! Absolutely worth it!!! PSA- make a reservation or be prepared to wait.

The Rainforest Café at Disney Springs is a fun and lively spot, especially if you’re visiting with kids. The restaurant is decorated exceptionally well — the jungle theme, animatronic animals, and periodic “storms” make the whole experience feel like an adventure. It’s definitely one of the more entertaining dining options in the area.

The menu is surprisingly diverse, with plenty of choices for just about any taste. The food itself was tasty, though I’d describe it as elevated bar food rather than anything gourmet. Still, the portions were solid, and everything we tried was flavorful and well-prepared.

Overall, it’s a great place for families or anyone looking for a unique atmosphere and a wide range of menu options. Just don’t go in expecting fine dining — go for the experience, and you’ll have a great time.

We had a great time at Rainforest Cafe in Disney Springs. It had been years since we’d been to one, so it felt like a fun throwback and very nostalgic. Our older kids especially loved it. The atmosphere is really what makes this place. It’s immersive, lively, and entertaining.

Our server, Jill, was fantastic. She was very nice, attentive, energetic, and genuinely helpful, which made the experience even better. The food was pretty good. Not amazing, but solid and enjoyable. Overall, it was a fun experience and a great stop for families, especially if you’re looking for something nostalgic and unique.

google_reviews.text: The Chef Shamy Garlic Butter with Parmesan Cheese and Basil is the best butter by far!   I have used this butter on all types of steaks, salmon, vegetables, baked potatoes, shrimp, scallops and garlic toast.   By far the best.  I would promote this company more if I could...I love this butter!

I got the the blueberry butter and was so excited I tried it right after getting home. I was shocked at the overpoweringly sweet, slightly chemical taste. The butter and blueberry flavors were almost non-exsistent. No hint of honey like the package says. It's most similar to the shelf stable Walmart frostings you can buy in a tub. It was definitely not as I expected and bad enough I threw it away almost immediately, especially after seeing my husband's reaction to it.
I don't like to leave a bad review, but I know others would like to see an honest review to set their expectations for the product. Just be aware it's sweeter than your average honey butter and more chemically tasting than fruity.

Love Love Love their garlic butter and honey butter, but only downfall is you can’t find other flavors in the stores besides those two! I want to try a few more flavors and don’t want to spend almost $50 to get 4 butters. That’s the only downfall! I really wish it was easier to find because it is so damn good. name: Matari Coffee
document: Matari Coffee. cuisine: Coffee & Tea. located in Queens. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: I don’t normally write reviews, but this café deserves it. I’ve been here multiple times and the staff especially are always incredibly kind and welcoming, staff member anas was super kind giving me a free matcha. The location and seating are perfect, and their late-night hours are unbeatable for studying. On top of that, the pastries and drinks are consistently delicious.

How many places can you hang out and grab a coffee at 1:00 a.m. in Columbus?   Nice chill spot to grab a treat, coffee, or tea.  Many traditional middle eastern teas and food items to grab.  No full service food, but some small, varied things like cheese pie. Nearby restaurants have take away if you want food, great Indian food next door.  Service is great, everyone is very friendly and accommodating. They will customize however you like for their beverages. Everything I’ve tried is well made, authentic, and tasty.  Just a really great little spot.

Absolutely loved this Yemeni café! The vibes are amazing and the whole place feels so luxurious and cozy. Their drinks are incredible, and they offer a big variety of options—from traditional Yemeni flavors to unique specialty drinks. The desserts are just as impressive and so delicious.

Everyone there is extremely friendly, helpful, and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better. This café has definitely become one of my favorite spots!

My experience at this Yemeni café was totally on point. The ambiance is seriously cool and the whole establishment feels like a luxurious cozy retreat. Their beverage selection is wildly impressive, with everything from traditional Yemeni flavors to unique specialty drinks. I almost fainted from the pure deliciousness of those desserts, a true culinary masterpiece.
The staff’s dedication to a welcoming atmosphere really elevates the entire experience, which makes the whole experience even more enjoyable. This café has definitely become one of my favorite coffee shops. ☕

This was a very cute cafe that is great for meeting up or catching up with friends, to sit and get work done, or to just pick up a coffee or tea. They have your typical yemeni flavors and other seasonal varieties. The iced Adeni is what I got with sugar - it was definitely tasty and curbed my craving for chai. The yemeni latte had similar ingredients but the cinnamon rather than the nutmeg definitely changes the flavor and I prefer the Adeni.  I didn’t try the desserts, but they definitely look aesthetic and are made for instagram. The honey comb dessert (bready dessert with a cheesy filling) was a popular order.

name: GREY Cafe
document: GREY Cafe. cuisine: Cafes Coffee & Tea Sandwiches. located in Queens. with 4.6 stars (exceptional). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: Really nice and pretty cafe. Indoor and outdoor seatings. Service was really good. Pretty good drinks. I got a lavender cream foam cold brew. It can use a bit more lavender flavor imo. My friend got the pumpkin foam cold brew and said the same about that. But overall a really cute place to grab and coffee and sit abs chat.

Atmosphere depends on the crowd and day, would definitely bring nose cancelling headphones if you are coming to get work done because the noise levels can get a bit high sometimes! The workers are all pretty nice and friendly, The açaí bow the had was really really good and even had overnight oats at the bottom which I didn’t expect but was a pleasant surprise! I live about an hour and a half from here but come back once in awhile when I feel like I need a change of scenery. would recommend to a friend for sure! (The guy who made the açaí bowl that I ordered today genuinely must have put his blood sweat and tears into it because not only did it look good it was also one of the best ones I’ve had recently haha)

A true community staple for anyone to seek coziness and comfort in! I have sought refuge here many times and the staff here is nothing but friendly. I'll never forget when the owner one time approached me in the outdoor seating area as I was sitting with my puppy and he started a conversation involving my studies and how him and his wife started Grey.

They have plenty of seats, fast wi-fi, and a lot of outlets. My favorite drinks here include the iced grey latte (big fan of black sesame) or the lychee iced organic tea! There is also an assortment of pastries and hot food to choose from.

I also love that they partake in the app 'Too Good To Go', which both combats food waste and makes food accessible to students and those in need! A neighborhood gem.
The strawberry matcha is the best! Is very matcha and strong strawberry ( kinda taste like the pocky ) the almond crossitant is very light overall and crispy on top! Highly recommended!

Yesterday was my first time going to GREY. I was a bit nervous but I was not disappointed. They had an adorable section where you can leave a post it note and I had to haha. They were also very accommodating & cut the crust off my sandwich :*) will definitely be back !

document: The Duo Coffee Bar. cuisine: Cocktail Bars Coffee & Tea Wine Bars. located in Queens. with 4.0 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
The drinks and desserts are decent, about average, not disappointing but not impressive either.

What truly stands out is the space. The café has a soaring double-height layout, as if two floors were opened up into one, paired with a full glass wall that creates a cool and expansive atmosphere. Because it faces away from the sunlight, the light that filters in is not warm or bright but a soft gray-blue tone, carrying a metallic calm and a touch of detachment. The overall mood feels slightly decadent yet effortlessly relaxed. In the evening, the place transforms into a bar and the night comes alive.

The products are ordinary, but I would still pay for a space like this.

Not sure when this opened

but was visiting flushing for my seasonal oil change at brothers on 137th and needed a place to work while my car was getting done. Sweet cafe was closed at 8am so I googled around and found this. Walked over and I’m so happy.

Wifi, tons of seating, quiet, Honey latte & giant cookie for 15$.

Only one outlet so that’s not helpful at all but thankfully no one was here so that so works just for today.

Keepin it real out here on Main Street
Very surprised to find a cafe like this on super crowded Main Street. Drinks aren't cheap but they're worth the price, all very unique. Limited food selection but still have some. Clean lounge space, decent wifi, 1 ish outlet, clean bathroom, very nice spot for me to take a break in between work appointments. Hope they stick around

Great space to do work, there's free WiFi, but like others have mentioned, very few outlets, so come charged up. They had relaxing jazz music playing when I visited on Saturday morning; not a ton of people at 10:30am. Coffee is great, have yet to try their baked goods.

It is a coffee shop that appears to turn into a bar at night. The coffee and pastries were excellent. Some if the sandwiches they had looked interesting. Price wise it was on par with Starbucks, but maybe a little more price depending on what you got. I feel that it was fully justified by the quality. If I ever am in the area again I will definitely have to stop in again.

name: Florist Bar
document: Florist Bar. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Florists Cocktail Bars. located in Queens. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
I’m honestly a pretty serious coffee and matcha person, and I’ve been coming to Florist Bar Co. for a long time. I’ve never left a review before, but I felt like I should this time.

I’ve seen them make real efforts to adjust things based on customer feedback. People have mentioned laptop users taking up seats, and they’ve clearly tried to reorganize seating and add time limits for Wi-Fi and table use.

The service has always been good whenever I visit. And as someone who pays attention to flavor, I can tell they’ve adjusted their coffee beans and matcha over time. The quality has improved, and even the way drinks are prepared feels more intentional now.I almost never leave reviews, but I hope Florist Bar Co. gets more attention and support.

Ps their crepe is really good.

A cute, wfh-friendly cafe! They offers fresh flower bouquets, preserved flowers, and asian-inspired drinks in Downtown Flushing. Best of all, their specialty coffee and tea are surprisingly affordable—most drinks are only around $5 to $7, which is a steal compared to many boba and tea shops.

The space is spacious, comfy, and beautifully decorated, with free Wi-Fi and clean bathrooms. Their playlist is very nostalgic, playing songs by Jay Chou, Khalil Fong, and Fiona Sit. Perfect for working, grabbing a coffee, and picking up flowers all in one stop.

＊Golden Osmanthus Jasmine $6.5
I love light, floral teas, and this one was perfect. It is a blend of jasmine tea and osmanthus topped with cream foam. Delicate, refreshing, and not too sweet.

＊Black Sesame Latte $6
The black sesame cream foam was so nutty that I literally scooped it up with a spoon. The flavor turned mild once mixed with the espresso and milk though.

＊Matcha White Chocolate $7
A Christmas special! I was so excited to see they serve “matcha donut latte” which is quite popular last year. The vibrant green matcha latte is topped with a ring of whipped cream and funfetti. A very warm and cozy drink.

＊Warm Tofu Pudding $6
This tofu pudding comes with either ginger or osmanthus syrup. I added lychee jelly, mixed fruit jelly, and red bean. Warm, cozy, and especially comforting on a cold day.

I have been here since the first or second week that it opened until present. I usually study here, but I order around two drinks and a snack (if I take a while) so they still generate revenue as my thanks to them for being wonderful 💕

And honestly, it’s easy to do multiple orders because their coffee is amazing. It tastes so good and strong but it doesn’t make my stomach hurt.

Other things that I would like to note:

1. Their aesthetics are top notch. I’ve seen some influencers and models take actual photoshoots here. I also did some myself during halloween (see pictures) and the staff was so helpful. They even provided me and my friend with props to use (taking out flowers from the back to help us.)
2. Their restrooms are constantly cleaned.
3. I think this cafe is run very well. Kudos to the staff and the management. I might want to be a shareholder haha
4. They have unique craft drinks that fit the season! And they’re so delicious! Me and my friend are constantly looking forward to their new menu!
5. It may look like the place is full, but a spot usually opens in a few minutes. Even with laptops on sight, trust me, I’ve been here for a few months every single day 😂

There is just one staff that doesn’t smile or acknowledge your existence, but I wouldn’t hold that against the cafe. Maybe that’s just their personality, or they’re going through a rough patch in life.

I go to several different coffee shops because I have to spend a lot of time studying, but theirs is really superb out of all of them. Even compared to the coffee shops in the city, LIC, bayside, you name it.

I have gotten my drinks wrong (which is entirely my fault), but they have remade my drinks with no fuss, just graciousness. I love the staff here, they look after you. Also, the drinks and snacks here is one of the most affordable in flushing.

So like I said, a place as amazing as this, it gains popularity with the people. My advice is to go early when they open. You’ll be sure that there will be plenty of seats for you 😂💯 they’re usually free early mornings then it picks up around 11am onwards until 4pm then it slows down. I wanted to gatekeep this place, but decided to do a google review for all their hard work ✨ I hope you love this place as much as I do 💖

This is such a cute place! Good lighting, spacious, and clean. The vibes are so chill here.

They have ample seating with tables that are for working and those for chilling (no laptops/tablets). Basically whatever your vibe, this place can cater to it.

Their Sea Salt Latte was a hit for me, definitely will be my go to in the future. I also saw other pastries and sandwiches on the menu to try next time for sure.

Overall, definitely recommend this place for anyone wanting a low key place to chill.

Grab your choice of beverage and grab a seat and get working. This is a beautiful cafe that does a little bit of everything. They also have a little flower shop area towards the street facing front. Their decorations are always cute. They have really nice space and restrooms. I have tried a couple of their tea options and my favorite has been their matcha stuff. The matcha with tofu and red bean and their yuzu matcha. It’s very good.

google_reviews.text: I’ve had a lot of great lattes over the years. But this one might be the best one I’ve had. Absolutely stellar latte. Sweet potato latte. I don’t remember a lot of lattes because I’ve had so many. But this one and a lavender latte I got New Orleans. I will forever remember. Excellent job and without a doubt worth the visit. Food was awesome too.

I want to start off by saying the staff here is great. I’ve been here many times and always had a great experience. However today I was very disappointed when I ordered 2 Acai bowls to-go and when I got home, they were basically half empty. For the price you pay ($15 each, $30 total) I would expect the cup to be full. There was barely any food in here.

I’m not the type of person to go back and demand a refund and argue but felt the need to express my disappointment.

My husband and I were in Queens yesterday morning and decided to try out The Well Coffee. We were one of the first customers in there, as we arrived shortly after they opened. The space was spacious and bright with plenty of seating, which I loved. The woman who took and prepared our order was so friendly and knowledgeable. I ordered a vanilla latte with a croissant and my husband got the chai latte with a slice of banana bread. The banana bread had an earl grey cream drizzle with crushed pistachios on top. Fancy! The pastries were just okay but we both really loved our drinks. It was nice and quiet in there since it was still pretty early but there was a steady stream of people coming in to grab their coffees to go. Something else I loved was that they had a kids playroom, with toys, books, and kids-sized tables and chairs! I'm always so delighted to see establishments make space for kids, a rarity these days. We'd definitely come back to The Well Coffee!

The perfect cafe!! I love everything about this place. Been going here since it first opened. The menu is so unique. The food and drinks are super delicious and prepared with a lot of care. Staff is always super friendly. The atmosphere is cozy, with the modern decor and calm music. God bless.

An amazing experience! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed by the warm atmosphere and charming decor. Definitely my new favorite café. I can’t wait to go back! ☕✨

name: Mighty Oak Roasters
document: Mighty Oak Roasters. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Coffee Roasteries. located in Queens. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Cool coffee cafe. Mighty Oak Roasters is not your typical shop. They care about the earth and practice sustainability. Instead of roasting their beans conventionally with fossil fuel they utilize a wood burning method.
So how’s the coffee? It’s damn good! Smooth, not bitter and full of flavor. They also offer tea if you’re not feeling coffee some days.
You can also have something to eat with your beverage as they have a variety of baked goods.

Mighty Oak is such a gem!!! the moment you walk in, you instantly feel the charm of a small roaster’s café that’s both cute and effortlessly hip. It has that cozy, modern vibe that makes you want to linger with a book or catch up with a friend over a perfectly brewed cup. The design details and warm atmosphere really give it an uptown Astoria feel!! stylish yet approachable, neighborhood-driven yet elevated. The coffee is smooth, rich, and clearly roasted with care, and the whole space has a character that feels unique and special. It’s one of those spots that makes you fall in love with the local café scene all over again

Loved it, and it was a totally surprise find while jogging to Astoria Park on a work visit. The wood roasting adds an element you'll never find at a big chain. I didn't see vegan signs, but the scones were perfectly dense and crumbly. Friendly, relaxed staff. Plants and lifting set a classic coffee shop vibe.

I want to give this place 5 stars and I will tell you why.
But first I would like to describe the atmosphere. Came here on a cold fall day around 3pm. I have passed by before and noted that I needed to check this place out. The name of the shop 'Mighty Oak' intrigued me. I like how the shop looks from the outside. Earthtones, corner door. Very welcoming. I go inside and feel the vibe. Very quiet. Very studious. Very chill. Kinda bohemian.  Like everyone has their head down in a book or on their phone why music plays in the background.
The order: Latte (Hot) 2% no sugar as always. Taste:  I like the rich taste of the espresso beans. The temperature is on point. Not too hot, not too warm.

So I like everything about this place. Down to the stickers and the choice of complimentary sparkling water or fresh. I could see myself sitting here next time with the book and a cold brew perhaps. Looks enticing in the jugs on the counter.
Alas, there was no seats so I left. Even the bench outside had people.
5 stars for the Atmosphere/ vibe, and the excellent coffee.

Speaking as someone who worked in other neighborhood cafes, Mighty Oak has no doubt the best espresso and general coffee around. I particularly love that all the utensils, cups and straws included are compostable and how warm the interior of the shop is (and that the staff tends to mask!). Although the other day I brought some beans and had the barista grind them for me only to have them end up a bit too coarse. I hope this can be remedied some way.

Bee Café in Woodside is a very cute, unassuming spot with lovely decor — though it is a bit odd that it opens directly into a laundromat. Once you’re inside, though, the space feels cozy and thoughtfully designed.

document: The Barn - Merrick. cuisine: Coffee Roasteries Coffee & Tea. located in Queens. with 4.0 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: It’s a drive thru barn selling cute coffee but only cute no taste ❌ think it’s just cute for pictures but the coffee itself wasn’t worth it especially for 2 coffee’s for $17. They even beat Starbucks prices. Tasted watered down and just wasn’t it. Got the rainbow cookie latte and they ran outta rainbow cookie so the guy gave me a brownie instead. The menu is tiny to see

If you’re heading to The Barn in Merrick for their TikTok-famous pumpkin lattes, here is the lowdown on what to expect.
I visited around Halloween specifically to get my hands on one of those lattes served inside an actual pumpkin. The decorations were 10/10. The whole place was decked out in a fall theme that I absolutely loved. It’s a drive-thru only spot, and while it’s known for getting incredibly crowded, we went right when they opened on a Thursday morning and were able to breeze through with no line.
While it is a fantastic place for photo ops, keep a few things in mind before you go:
• The Drink: Honestly, the coffee itself wasn't spectacular. You’re definitely paying more for the presentation and the "cool factor" than a high-quality brew.
• The Cost: It is very expensive. Make sure you ask for the price before you order, as it can be a bit of a shock when you reach the window.
Final Verdict: Go for the aesthetic and the cute photos, but don't expect a life-changing latte. If you want the experience without the wait, try to visit on a weekday morning like we did!

The Barn has a great atmosphere and a lot of potential, but unfortunately the beverages really missed the mark during our visit. We tried several drinks—the ginger, snowman, cookie dough, and Christmas-themed drinks—and sadly, none of them lived up to expectations.

The flavors felt unbalanced and underwhelming, especially for specialty and seasonal beverages that should be warm, comforting, and memorable. A few tasted artificial, others lacked depth, and overall they just didn’t feel thoughtfully crafted.

That said, the place itself has a nice vibe and the concept is solid, which makes this more disappointing than anything. With better attention to drink recipes, quality, and consistency, The Barn could be much better. For now, though, the beverages definitely need improvement.

Not only were the drinks amazing, but the staff was warm, welcoming, and made the whole experience even better. Between the cozy vibes, tasty treats, and friendly service, The Barn really made my fall day special.

google_reviews.text:
Qahwa Cafe, located inside a mosque in Sterling, VA, offers a warm, well-lit environment. It features tasty espresso beverages like Dulce de Leche and Matcha Latte, along with a selection of teas, baked goods, and sweets. Both the Dulce de Leche and Matcha Latte were flavorful and not diluted, demonstrating quality, and the homemade-style brownie was enjoyable without being overly sweet. However, drink preparation times were quite long, even though no other customers were waiting. Cleanliness was an issue due to food on the floor.

Additionally, there was no signage indicating the cafe's location in the area or outside the building, which appears to be a mosque from the exterior. We had to drive through the parking lot to find the entrance, and more apparent signs could help visitors locate the cafe more easily.

Great atmosphere and rich drinks!! If you see the other pics of the iced drinks you know how mouth-watering they look. I was so happy with my iced Cherry Blossom Latte, which has the hint of flavor without overpowering the coffee!

Again, for those who are non Muslims, don’t come here!!!!!

name: Under Pressure Coffee
document: Under Pressure Coffee. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Sandwiches Breakfast & Brunch. located in Queens. with 4.4 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
This sunny corner cafe is the perfect spot to catch up with friends, sit and get some work done, or grab delicious pastries and coffee to-go. There are usually meter spots nearby on 31st St which makes it my go-to spot before I hit the highway in my car.

The staff is always so friendly and there is always good chill music playing which adds to the vibe. I also like that there are lots of regulars who engage in friendly banter with the staff which also makes it feel like a cozy neighborhood locale.

My go-to order is a Cheese Koulouri and cappuccino but there are lots of decadent sweets if you aren't in a savory mood.

This is a lovely coffee shop in Astoria with a wide variety of options—not just great coffee, but also sandwiches, pastries, cookies, and even coffee beans. The interior is bright, clean, and spacious, with both indoor and outdoor seating available. Food is purchased from a self-serve machine just inside the entrance—just tap the screen, pay by card, and your item is dispensed. I ordered a coffee, and it was fragrant and absolutely delicious. The calm atmosphere makes it perfect for getting some work done or catching up with friends. I’d definitely love to visit again☕️😉!

Absolutely decadent croissant filled with Valrhona pistachio praliné cream filling.
There is a large offer of homemade pastries, as well as savory sandwiches. Coffee is great too!
The space is spacious and cosy, with many tables to sit down. The staff is very welcoming too.

This place is super cute, with a really creative and modern menu. The coffee is absolutely top-tier—especially the freddo cappuccino, which reminded me of the cold foam drinks I used to make back when I worked as a Starbucks manager. Honestly, they make it even better here. I was told it’s a Greek-style drink, which I had no idea about, but I loved it. Most of the crowd seemed to be Mediterranean, and honestly, I get it—the coffee quality is excellent and the prices are fair.

However, the downside is how crowded it gets. They have very limited staff, which means there’s no one available to clean the tables regularly. People come and go for coffee, but often leave their mess behind, and as a customer, you end up having to grab napkins and clean the table yourself. It also turns into a bit of a game trying to “hunt down” a clean spot to sit.

This was my first time visiting, after my best friend recommended it, and we went together. I didn’t get a chance to try their pastries (which looked delicious) because I was waiting for lunch—but I definitely plan to return at a less busy hour to enjoy things at a more relaxed pace.

Their furniture is new and the overall space is clean. The bathroom is fine, and the facilities are solid. They just really need more staff. They’re clearly very busy all the time, and it shows in how hard it is for them to keep up with customer support and maintenance outside of the bar.

In summary: amazing coffee, great vibe, worth visiting—but go with patience or at a quieter time if you want to truly enjoy it.

It seems to be busy all the time since this cafe is located at the corner of the street.
I had dicaf flat white with oat milk and it was nice!
My daughter had americano and cinnamon roll, she said it was good as well.
Over all it was pretty nice cafe and I’d go back when I visit Astoria again!
