google_reviews.text: It’s not very often I am thoroughly impressed with a pizza place but Frank’s has become my go to. From my initial visit to my last I look forward to it as they’re consistent, the Pizza always has that same classic taste I’ve come to love. The sauce is very flavorful and generously applied, the cheese melted to perfection. A one topping tray will run you $23 which is fairly priced. I look forward to it week after week. I would highly reccomend giving it a try if you haven’t already. Thanks Franks! 🍕
They have one of the best pizzas I've eaten in many years - thin crust, tasty real sauce and lots of cheese. The servers were all extra nice and made sure we got everything we need when we needed it.

we stayed at great wolf lodge and found this hidden gem. its a family owned shop with everyone working. my kids loved the pizza, sub and honey wings! this is a much better food option than at great wolf lodge.

We are staying at Greatwolf Lodge, and this was very close. Ordered for pickup and was presently pleased with the experience.  The pizza crust was good and held up well. The wings were good but soggy once we got them back to the room. That seems to happen with all to-go wings. It was a good experience and would recommend to anyone staying in the area. If you found this review helpful, please give a 👍

We wanted a good sub so we tried Franks for the first time. We were welcomed very warmly by the owner who helped us with the menu. We decided on a steak sub deluxe and a deluxe cold cut. These subs were very large , fresh, delicious and filling. I very much recommend this place and look forward to visiting again to try the pizza and wings.

name: Jerry's Pizza
document: Jerry's Pizza. cuisine: Pizza. located in Bronx. with 4.6 stars (exceptional). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: We’ve been going to Jerry’s since they were at their old location, they have upped their game!  Tonight we had the jalapeño poppers, cheesesteak egg rolls, veal parm dinner, and the ribeye and pear and cheese fiocchetti in a Gorgonzola cheese sauce. The veal was so tender, the steak ordered med rare and cooked perfectly, the pear and cheese fiocchetti were cooked perfectly and the flavors complemented one another so well, the cheesesteak egg rolls were light and crispy with a well seasoned cheesesteak filling.  This unexpected pizza place easily contends with fine dinning establishments and surpasses some.

It’s a great place to come grab dinner I really have no major complaints. We ordered their regular pepperoni pizza with black olives on half, and it was good overall. Nothing particularly mind-blowing, but enjoyable. If I had to be a little picky and I say this as someone who really knows my pizza the sauce was a bit on the sweet side, which gave it a slight alphabet soup flavor. The pizza was also pretty greasy, with some grease actually pouring off the slices, so maybe switching to a higher-quality olive oil could help balance that out. Lastly, the crust didn’t have a ton of flavor; fermenting the dough overnight might add some nice depth and texture. Just a few friendly suggestions! Other than that, it was pretty good definitely better than Little Caesars!
I'm a delaware county snob. I could not find a decent pizza here till now. Large portions all homemade and fresh. Real good!!
Always a wonderful experience no wonder buisness is booming. They truly care about their customers. Lots of tables to dine in, extensive menu. Drinks! Take out, great service.

Their new place is great! Plenty of seating and they expanded their menu to offer new items!

The clams casino appetizer is AH-MAZING!! These are so difficult to find, and it's the real deal.

The spaghetti with meat sauce has a lot of flavor and they offer plenty of meat, too.

Their pizza is the BEST!! It's really difficult to find good pizza in this area. Most use cheap cheese that makes it really oily or flavorless. Not Jerry's! Get the pizza - you won't be disappointed.

Highly recommend.

name: Pizza Fenice
document: Pizza Fenice. cuisine: Pizza. located in Bronx. with 4.8 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: I’ve only been here once and I’m declaring it my favorite pizza in all of New York State. All i can say is WOW! I had the sfincione, which has onions cooked in sauce for over 12 hours, talk about a flavor bomb. Their classic cheese slice is to die for. The white slice is the best I’ve had in a while, and their meatball is very delightful. Do yourself a favor and get over here!

Fantastic pizza flavors. Definitely a top 3 contender for best pizza in Westchester County. Great consistency in quality and flavors. Reasonable prices for the level of deliciousness. One bite and you taste what you're paying for! I highly recommend the Detroit-style pizza squares. Cash and credit are both accepted. Metered street parking is nearby. No public bathrooms are available at this location. They do offer indoor seating that can seat 2 people comfortably or 3 people tightly. They usually have slices ready to go in front but rolls, calzones, and other appetizers are made to order. 06/2025

A family favorite! I can't believe that we have this world class gem of a pizza place in our neighborhood! Every single slice is mouthwatering. The owner does not skimp on ingredients, even with inflation attacking us each day. Plus, they do a wonderful gluten-free pizza that is just perfect, which passes the mama's insanely high standards. Love this wonderful place. Can't wait to go back for more!

Might be our new favorite spot in Westchester!

We're a big fan of detroit style so this has been on our list for awhile. They unfortunately don't deliver, but we decided to stop by at open on a random Saturday. They did open a bit late and the detroit pizza's weren't ready until ~25 mins are so after opening (they had some NY and grandma styles ready). Unsure if this is a common thing but might be easier to call ahead at opening.

Each style of pizza was amazing! Our favorite was probably the pepperoni detroit (followed close by the grandma) which we ate so fast there wasn't enough time for a picture. The NY slice was also solid. Can't wait to come back to try their other toppings.

Been here almost a dozen times - most times when I'm in the area.  My son's favorite!  One of the best and most creative Pizza shops around.  This guy does an outstanding job with his creations.  The French Dip Pie and the Thanksgiving Pie were specials but absolutely awesome.  The traditional slices, especially the Sicilian Slices, rate at the top of the charts.  The crust is perfectly cheesed and crisp (something I have never come across anywhere - even in New Haven!).

name: Joe's Pizza
document: Joe's Pizza. cuisine: Pizza. located in Bronx. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
I just had to share my amazing experience at Joe’s Pizza — it truly exceeded all my expectations!

From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm, lively, and welcoming. The staff greeted me with genuine smiles and were incredibly friendly and attentive throughout my visit. It’s clear they take pride not just in their food but in making customers feel valued and comfortable.

Now let’s talk about the pizza — absolutely phenomenal. The crust was perfectly crisp on the outside while staying soft and chewy inside. The sauce had that rich, balanced flavor that tastes fresh and homemade, and the cheese was melted to perfection with just the right stretch in every bite. Every slice was packed with flavor, and you can really tell they use high-quality ingredients.

Service was fast and efficient even though the place was busy, which says a lot about how well the team works together. The staff were patient, helpful with recommendations, and made the whole experience even better.

If you’re looking for authentic, delicious pizza served by a team that genuinely cares, Joe’s Pizza is a must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommend

Joe’s Pizza (Broadway) is undeniably one of New York’s classic pizza institutions and often one of the first recommendations for anyone visiting the city. Whether you’re grabbing a quick slice or ordering a whole pie, it’s a convenient and iconic stop.

The prices remain reasonable, especially considering the location and popularity. However, be prepared for long queues—waiting times can easily range from 30 to 45 minutes, and sometimes even up to an hour. The line does move, but occasionally slower than expected.

Their classic cheese, Margherita, and pepperoni slices are the clear favorites—simple, well-executed, and consistently satisfying. Inside, you’ll also find plenty of photos featuring celebrities and famous visitors, which adds to the nostalgic charm and history of the place.

While there are certainly other pizza spots in New York that may offer more innovative or elevated flavors, Joe’s stands out for its legacy, convenience, and reliability. It’s less about being the absolute “best” and more about experiencing a true NYC staple.

Definitely worth adding to your to-do list when visiting New York—especially if you want a taste of pizza history.

FANTASTIC low cost pizza!!! This it's my one must hit place in new york and I'm so glad I did. The pizza is affordable and it's light, crispy and delicious. There is definitely a wait to get in, but it's all part of the New York experience!!! I will say that their deep dish pizza was not my favorite and I would not get that again. However, if I return to New York I would definitely, make it a point to go here again.  The staff is friendly and the amount of pizza that they turn out is unreal!!! There is limited seating, so don't be upset if you don't get a seat.

A Simple but Outstanding Classic New York Slice.
One of NYC’s most popular pizza spots, known for its thin, crispy crust topped with rich tomato sauce and plenty of cheese. Slices start at around $4.50, making it an easy and satisfying choice.

Just steps from Times Square and open from morning until late night, it’s a perfect stop anytime you’re craving real New York pizza!

I put this place on my ‘want to visit’ list when I knew I was coming to Gettysburg. Today was my first day touring the battlefields and I broke off for a lunch break at Tommy’s. It was almost 3pm but the place was hopping.
I want to say that everyone I’ve encountered in Gettysburg has been very friendly and the staff at Tommy’s was no exception. Very nice people.

The taste of everything reminded me of the Round Table chain back on the west coast, which is my favorite pizza chain. It was a good pizza. The things that stood out to me on the pizza were the cheese (very, very good) and the sausage. It had nice seasoning and good flavor. The sauce was a little lacking in oomph, but it was decent. The crust, while cooked about as crispy as you could get it, was a little overwhelmed by the amount of ingredients that a supreme carries. It would have been perfect with a two or three topping pie.

google_reviews.text: Our visit to emilios was amazing! its such a cute hidden spot, the interior is clean and has plenty of seating. This pizzeria is located in a Little corner off of Shaw Road. I found it by using Google maps when we arrived we were promptly greeted politely and professionally by the gentleman behind the counter Emilio‘s brick oven pizza smells exactly like a pizzeria. The brick oven is very neat. I decided to try a pizza of theirs and some chicken kebabs from their appetizer menu. Both were very delicious and made for a full portion serving. I wish I would’ve known about this place a while ago will definitely be back. Highly recommend.

I highly recommend Emilio's for catering.  Today,  I had another great experience with a catering order from Emilio's for a work party.  This is the second time I got them to cater a party.  The pizza was fantastic!! I ordered several of their signature pizzas. Everyone complimented the pizza and asked where I ordered it from. I  also ordered a couple salads. I couldn't believe that I  also got compliments on the salads and dressing! Everything was freshly made and delicious.

Please consider Emilio's for your next event.  Don't forget to add them to your eating out rotation. We need to continue to support our local restaurants.

Overall 7.6/10
This takeout experience featured a well-maintained dine-in area that, despite its slight messiness, upheld a high standard of presentation reminiscent of a classic pizza shop. The brick oven added a cool touch. The website was user-friendly, with clear descriptions and an easy checkout process. Service was efficient with a friendly and hardworking staff member, ensuring the food was ready on time.

Chicken Kabob 7.9/10
The chicken kabob was exceptional, featuring perfectly charred, fresh meat and vegetables. It was complemented by a tasty sauce, all at a reasonable price, delivering excellent quality and flavor.

Cheese Pizza 6.9/10
The pizza had good flavor with less flop, benefiting from the option to order it well-done via the website. The crust was tasty, and the overall lack of excess oil made for a pleasing eating experience.

Mozzarella Sticks 7.9/10
These weren't your average mozzarella sticks; they were uniquely made and fresh, topped with Parmesan cheese for an extra touch of flavor. They were high quality, delicious, and well-priced, reflecting great care in their preparation.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A Slice of Italy in the Heart of Sterling!

From the moment you step into Emilio's Brick Oven Pizza, you're transported straight to a peaceful corner of Italy. The ambiance is warm, relaxing, and authentically charming — perfect for a quiet dinner or a family night out.

The hand-made pizzas, baked to perfection in a traditional brick oven, are nothing short of culinary art. Each bite bursts with flavor, and you can truly taste the craftsmanship in every slice. The menu also boasts an impressive selection of wines, spirits, and kid-friendly beverages, making it a great spot for all ages.

Service here is world-class — attentive, friendly, and genuinely welcoming. The cook even came out to greet us with a smile, adding a personal touch that made the experience even more memorable. Clean restrooms and ample parking are the cherry on top.

If you're looking for an unforgettable dining experience that blends top-tier service, delicious food, and a serene Italian atmosphere, Emilio's is the place to be. Highly recommend — this gem is a must-visit!

google_reviews.text:
Food Review — Patricia’s, Bronx

Time to try Patricia’s in the Bronx. This restaurant has already made a strong name in the area, and it certainly didn’t disappoint us. The ambiance was warm, and we felt welcomed as soon as we stepped in.

We visited just before New Year’s, and the restaurant was at full capacity, yet everything ran smoothly. Our orders arrived on time, and the server was very attentive, always smiling and checking on customers.

The food was fresh, flavorful, and well presented. The soup portion was generous and comforting. The salad was perfectly balanced, not too salty, and the beets were tender and well cooked. The steaks were juicy, tender, and cooked exactly as ordered. I had the salmon, which was moist and flavorful, paired perfectly with fresh vegetables—light, healthy, and not heavy at all.

The pizza was light, not greasy, and very satisfying. Authentic Italian-style pizza, simple and delicious.

After seeing desserts served at nearby tables, we couldn’t resist ordering some ourselves, and they were delicious and a perfect way to end the meal.

Overall, it was a very good and memorable dining experience.

The dining area has a beautiful ambiance. The pizza is absolutely delicious. You can't go wrong with any one that you choose. The dough is somewhat thick which I love but also soft and pairs great with the olive/garlic dipping oil. The garlic bread is fantastic. I will definitely be a regular from now on. If you don't like the food here, then you don't have the taste palate for fine dining. Just stick to domino's!

It was a Saturday night, and there was a big party at a rectangular table in the center of the restaurant, which was very noisy. After they left, I realized the noise level was really high, even without them. The waitstaff were not overbearing and knowledgeable. The food was excellent and the mocktail’s equally so. In the higher pricey side. $90pp
The bathrooms downstairs were clean and spacious and I noticed they had a private room in the wine cellar where there was a party of women, maybe 12 or so, that looked like a nice private space

Wow, horrible experience. The only reason they get a 1 star is because of Maria’s service. Truly disappointed never in my service industry career/costumer experience have I dealt with dining in a establishment that puts removing decor when in service especially when you dine in at 09:30 pm and they close at 11 pm . They had 45 min until closing, food wasn’t ready and they decided to turn on the lights, bring in their ladder, take off decor, and bring my experience to a low. Not to mention mediocre drinks which had to be fixed by myself. Stick to beer. This place is no better than a simple pizzeria. No less I was so disappointed I told the waitress to pack my food and give me my check since I felt like I was being kicked out. Please do better.

Server was fantastic too. Her was paighton. Very attentive and very friendly. Overall awesome spot highly recommend you have to check out for some great authentic Italian food.

name: Niccolo Pizzeria
document: Niccolo Pizzeria. cuisine: Pizza Gelato Italian. located in Bronx. with 4.8 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
I wanted to try Niccolo Pizzeria attracted by their claiming of the use of Ciao San Marzano tomato sauce and actual Italian ingredients. One thing that I liked was some variety on the pizza menu so I tried their “Margherita” (a first must try when you’re discovering a new pizzeria, because it sets the basics), the “Bambola” (with Prosciutto Di Parma, arugula and fig jam) in which the sweet and savory balance was not bad but the flavor of prosciutto was completely nonexistent, way too light and an American classic, their “Pepperoni” pizza that, not surprisingly, was the best amongst these three. They’re only a few blocks up from my apartment so I thought the delivery would have been a better and quick solution. I was sadly wrong! The delivery took more than one hour, which is unacceptable and pizzas arrived ice cold with a super hard and dry crust. This is not Italian pizza, the Margherita (probably due to the extreme coldness) was at the edge of being inedible and their marinara sauce came with garlic (not the authentic Italian tomato sauce, especially if you’re using “San Marzano” tomatoes, which you’re most probably not). I loved the idea for the “Bambola”, the ingredients were well combined but the Prosciutto was really tasteless and completely overwhelmed by the sweetness of the fig jam, also it was oddly dripping oil in quantity. Their “Pepperoni” was tasty and with a mildly flavored pepperoni quality but overall it was really good!
I should mention, in order to better understand this review, that I’m a floor manager in an authentic Neapolitan Pizzeria (and we import Ciao tomato sauce from San Marzano as well, Prosciutto Di Parma and probably 97% of our ingredients straight from Italy) and I’m also a born and raised Italian.
They definitely have a potential but there’s a lot to do here.

At Nicole Pizzería, every bite is pure Italian magic — you can truly taste the authenticity in every ingredient.
✨ pls tell me about the crust? 🤤Absolutely next-level crunchy; I even ate the part of the pizza we usually leave behind! The garlic knots were heaven. And the cherry on top: a warm, gooey bombolone for dessert that oozed creamy goodness the moment I opened it… just WOW. This isn’t just pizza, it’s an experience.

I cannot express to y’all enough how incredible this pizza is! Cleber is the kindest guy and is so passionate about all the ingredients (organic flour from Italy, great olive oil and tomatoes). The best thing about this pizza is you don’t feel like trash after eating it. Everyone must go! My roommates and I can hardly go a week without having this pizza and we are not the type of people to be eating out every week, but this pizza is an exception. Our fav order is a large margarita with pepperoni and pesto.

Friendly staff! Full knowledge of the menu and did a wonderful job explaining what’s what. Greeted every customer that walked in. While dining in I overheard staff interviewing someone and they were polite while doing so. They also ask another customer if she wanted the entire piece of cheese on each slice of her pizza or placed as they normally do which may result in the cheese being shared between slices. I thought this was very attentive detail. The food was hot, visually appealing and delicious. They’re so proud of their fresh ingredients and meatless options. They garlic knots were a lil more crispy than I’d prefer but still delicious and the marinara tasted fresh! Oh before I submitted that staff is now explaining the process of the marinara….I’d definitely recommend this place. Manager-Cleber and Joe

A pizzeria with great style, amazing flavor, and outstanding service. From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed warmly and given a clear explanation of their new menu. They were patient and helpful while we chose the best option. We ordered a whole pizza, and it arrived surprisingly fast.

The place is small inside, with room for about eight people, but they still made space for us indoors since it was freezing outside — something we really appreciated. We also had the chance to chat with the person in charge, who explained the style of their pizza and their preparation process. Honestly, we were impressed by how good the pizza tasted: perfect crust, fresh ingredients, and incredible flavor.

Everyone on the staff was very friendly and attentive. Overall, an excellent experience. I’ll definitely come back on my next trip. Highly recommended.

I will return and recommend for others to try it - just try ordering ahead to avoid the 15-20 min wait.

Update: I didn’t know that Dino (the owner) is actually the one making the pizza. He’s a great guy and the pizza is fantastic. Definitely recommend stopping by if you’re in the area.

FYI - it looks like grease on the pizza, but it’s really just the spicy honey that was put on top 🌶 🍯

Looking for hand-rolled cigars, a beer hall, amazing delis, and specialty cheese and meet shops? The Arthur Avenue Retail Market is your one-stop-shop for all of these, along with all the charm that Arthur Ave has to offer!

Arthur Market is a true neighborhood treasure, blending authentic Italian flavor with a lively, old-world atmosphere. The selection is fantastic—juicy Italian sausages, all kinds of meats, buckets of flavorful olives, and some of the freshest fruits and vegetables you’ll find anywhere. Their pizza is made fresh and full of flavor, perfect for a quick bite while you shop.

There’s also a little bar and café inside where you can enjoy a glass of wine, a cappuccino, or just take in the vibe of the place. It’s warm, welcoming, and full of character.

One of the most unique touches? The cigar shop, where you can actually watch cigars being hand-rolled right in front of you. It’s a rare sight and adds even more charm to an already special spot.

Arthur Market is more than just a place to shop—it’s an experience. If you’re in the area, it’s absolutely worth a visit.

google_reviews.text: Love this place and have been stopping by whenever I visit the city since 2014! I did notice a change in quality during my last visit; the churro was thinner and crispier than before. The older version had the perfect balance of texture: firm on the outside, soft and chewy inside. It was sweet and savory. The one I had recently was still enjoyable, but it has lost a bit of that original magic.

I got the Oreo Churro with Black Sesame Ice cream. The churro itself was nice and fresh, the cookies and cream complimented it really well. The black sesame soft serve was not bad, but could use a little more black sesame in my opinion, it was leaning a bit too much towards just a vanilla flavor.
Also got one of the Korean Corndogs with sausage and mozzarella cheese inside and a potato crust. The potato added a nice texture and was extra crispy. They had an arrangement of sauces to choose from. I drizzled honey mustard and spicy mayo on mine!
Overall decent snack for the price! The staff was very friendly and welcoming which is much appreciated!

I absolutely loved this Korean corn dog from Sweet Churros. This is street food dreams come true. From the second I took a bite, I knew it was going to be something special. It’s completely cheese-filled, no sausage, just warm, stretchy mozzarella that pulls like a dream. The outside, perfectly golden with that signature panko crunch that makes every bite ridiculously satisfying. You can literally hear the crisp when you bite in, and then you’re hit with that molten, melty cheese that just keeps going. What really stood out is how well-balanced it was. The sweetness from the light sugar dusting on the crust played so well with the savory richness of the cheese—it’s that sweet-salty combo that makes it impossible to put down. I didn’t even use any sauces, and honestly, I didn’t miss them. It was that good on its own. It’s simple, it’s comforting, and it’s everything you want from street food—hot, fresh, handheld, and ridiculously indulgent. Whether you’re a cheese fanatic or just looking for a snack that hits all the right notes, this one’s a must-try. I’ll 100% be back for another.

name: Zhongzhong Noodles - Bronx
document: Zhongzhong Noodles - Bronx. cuisine: Chinese Noodles Ramen. located in Bronx. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
2/10 (only because the chicken was good)

I went here recently and honestly I’m never going back. The menu didn’t clearly show what comes inside the ramen, which is a big deal because what if someone has food allergies? When I asked the employee what was in it, she just kept telling me to look at the picture instead of actually answering my questions, which felt kind of rude.
Also… what kind of ramen place doesn’t even have corn? That’s wild to me.
The timing of the food made no sense either. The fried chicken was okay, but it didn’t even come out first like an appetizer should. I was already halfway through my ramen and then the appetizer finally comes out… oh ok….
On top of all that, the food ended up giving me diarrhea. Definitely not worth it. Never going back.

Zhongzhong Noodles is the place that got me into mapo tofu, so much so that I've tried it at other places only to realize that it's either Zhongzhong, homemade, or nothing. Zhongzhong does it best!

I've also had their beef rice bowl and dumplings, which I would also recommend! I've gotten a few friends into the place, and these same menu options are typically their top picks as well!

Definitely drop in if you're in the area or looking for an adventure!

This place has become a staple for me .. first time dinning in vs ordering out .. have to say imo it's better to dine in vs ordering out ( food taste better on the spot ) the warmth of the shredded Chicken noodles were great the noodles are semi firm .. broth delicious, the marinated chicken banger   service was quick.  thank you .. 🤤🤤 guys

Really cool find with great service! The place is pretty small, but we were there around 7pm and we were able to get a table. We got the Szechuan style braised beef noodle, tomato noodle soup, vegan beef dumpling, and wonton in chili sauce!! I really love spicy food and to me they weren’t that spicy, but my friend is a bit less tolerant and says it was… take it for what you will. Really good food, good service, and good price!

What an amazing experience! I'm from Florida visiting and this food was absolutely delicious.
Small businesses here in NYC are the back bone of the city and culture. Service was on point and attentive, ambiance was very welcoming and professional. The Bronx clearly has a hidden gem!
Also tons of friendly people coming in and out throughout my visit.

Totally worth it, must try!!!

name: Roc N Ramen
document: Roc N Ramen. cuisine: Ramen Noodles Desserts. located in Bronx. with 3.8 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
I saw this place on Instagram and instantly added to my “”must try”” places… came here on a Sunday afternoon, parking was not hard since we found the last parking spot available right outside of Roc N Ramen. We were seated right away and the girl explained how is the process to order to us and offered drinks first…

We shared some appetizers and had two entrees and everything was made to perfection!! Loved the combination of flavors and loved the size of each plate!!!

Definitely a must try, specially for those who are acquainted with the Caribbean culture and love oxtail!! Such an interesting combination of flavors in their dishes, really loved it!!!

Food was great.  Ramen is the star of this restaurant.   Perfect especially on a cold day. And the oxtail bao buns were delicious. Loved the laid back vibes and the music.  Make sure you ring that bell and let them know you are enjoying the ramen.

Delicious and spicy ramen in a casual setting.

I tried the Karage Chicken, solid appetizer with dark meat chicken, breading that was a bit too crunchy (vs crispy) with really yummy dipping sauces.

The jerk bbq chicken (ordered spicy) was awesome.   It was presented beautifully and really hit the spot on n a cold day with a warm, savory comfort.  Spice was not overpowering, but did make me a sweat just a bit.

Highly recommend.

The ramen was just SO good. Definitely recommend.
I don't love that they add gratuity and the restaurant is not spotless. I have no problem leaving a larger tip but the tables must be clean.
Don't like much ordering food with the app but at the end of the day what matters is the food.
I will return and definitely recommend giving it a try.

Ughhh. I wanted to love this place so bad because I love ramen and Caribbean food so I was super excited to try it only to be disappointed. You have to order everything through your phone, a lot of the items on the menu were missing pictures so if you’re a novice to Caribbean or ramen good luck figuring it out. The karaage was dry, overcooked, borderline burnt. The oxtail was overcooked and fatty. The oxtail bao buns was decent definitely has so much potential, if the oxtail is made better. I ordered the oxtail ramen with tonkotsu broth, it was decent, but the amount of fat on the oxtail and how tough it was, messed it up. I tasted the grilled chicken ramen, OMG! It was so badddd, it was basically tasted like charred water. The Arnold Palmer tasted like Arizona half and half. Lastly, the jerk chicken ramen, the mild had a little kick to it. Overall the broths were pretty bland. The food wasn’t really hot, like my corn was literally cold. The seating options are limited so if you sit by the door, you’re gonna freeze. And vibes were meh. The music selection was good though. Spent like $110 which wasn’t bad for the amount of food we ordered.

name: Ramen Matsu
document: Ramen Matsu. cuisine: Ramen. located in Bronx. with 4.8 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
I finally got to try this ramen spot after craving a good shio (salt) ramen for so long. Most places only serve tonkotsu pork broth, so I was excited to find a place that offers something different. The restaurant is small with mostly bar-style seating. When you walk in, you write down your name and party size, and once your turn is getting close you place your order on a tablet.

We waited about 30 minutes, and there was already a big line out front, so we knew right away this place had to be legit. The ramen did not disappoint — the shio and shoyu (soy sauce) broths were flavorful and comforting, something you really can’t find at most other spots. It even felt a bit like home for my Japanese wife.

Overall, great ramen, worth the wait, and a perfect spot if you’re craving something other than the usual tonkotsu. Highly recommend!

i think this is the best ramen i’ve ever had. other places i’ve tried over salt their broths so i was hesitant to order a soy sauce broth. to my surprise, the taste was so well balanced. you order prior to sitting and it is SO worth the wait because as soon as i sat down my food was ready. this was just what i needed to warm me up in this cold weather. i can’t wait to go back!

I’ve always noticed this ramen shop packed with people, and today I finally made it in right at opening. The menu is ordered through tablets, and the limited seating fills quickly. We tried the shoyu ramen with pork fat and the tsukemen—both wonderfully light yet flavorful, with great chashu toppings.
My only regret was missing out on the egg, which has to be ordered separately.
Definitely recommend this place.
Worth the premium

Everything was surprisingly good, especially considering the location. The broth was flavorful and the overall quality exceeded expectations. The only downside was that the noodles were not handmade, but it was still a solid and satisfying bowl of ramen overall.

Again, the best Japanese Ramen place in NJ for sure.💗🌟✨️💛💚 When you get in, you need to place an order using a tablet by the door. It's an open kitchen. The master makes the ramen right in front of you. They only serve until the preparations sell out. Soooooooooomg good😆🌟

document: Taichi Bubble Tea. cuisine: Ramen Bubble Tea Poke. located in Bronx. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful experience here! The bubble tea is absolutely delicious with so many flavor (our favorite is their signature Taichi Milk Tea 🧋)and topping options to choose from. The Japanese ramen was rich and flavorful 🍜. and the sushi bowl was fresh and beautifully prepared. 🥗.   I really love that they offer a wide variety of ingredients, so everyone can customize their meal just the way they like it.🥙🍆🍑🥒🥑🥚🧀🥔🥝 🥦

The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel comfortable from the moment we walked in. The dining area was very clean and well-maintained, which made our visit even more enjoyable.

One of the best parts was the fish tank inside the restaurant. My son absolutely loved watching the fish while we enjoyed our meal! It made the experience extra special for our family.

We will definitely be coming back again. Highly recommend! 💯

I absolutely love Taichi Poke Bowl, and it has quickly become one of my favorite places to grab something fresh, flavorful, and satisfying. Every time I visit, the ingredients are impressively fresh, and you can truly taste the quality in every bowl. The salmon, in particular, is consistently delicious—tender, clean-tasting, and full of flavor. You can tell they really care about keeping everything top-notch.

The service is also reliably quick. My orders rarely take long, even during busy times. The inside of the restaurant is clean, organized, and nicely decorated, which makes picking up food or dining in feel easy and pleasant.

I’ve also tried their red curry. It was okay—not bad at all—but personally, I would stick to the poke bowls. The curry seems more like the same veggies over rice with a sauce on the side, and I’m not sure if the sauce is made in-house. It’s fine for what it is, but the poke is absolutely the star here.

One tip: skip ordering online because it’s usually about five dollars more expensive. Just go inside and use the kiosk; it’s quick and you don’t have to talk to anyone if you don’t want to. Highly recommend!

This place was absolutely amazing and I'm honestly pretty disappointed that there weren't more people here. The staff was nice and when I accidentally ordered something that I was allergic to they remade it for free which was super kind of them.

For the price is poke bowls are totally worth it and very filling. I was extremely happy with what I ordered. The quality was fresh. They don't charge you extra for the avocado or seaweed salad or other things that most Poke places do which I think is absolutely insane

This place is absolutely everything right it's a cute vibe they make sure that you are happy

We have a cute little memory from this place a little panda and a bubble tea plushie! They have a wide selection of bubble tea and yummy food. This place is a must, it will not disappoint.

name: Umi
document: Umi. cuisine: Sushi Bars Seafood Buffets. located in Bronx. with 3.9 stars (good).

google_reviews.text:
I had 1 concern out of my entire experience! There is a fee to use a card, which is abnormal for the guest to pay unless it's a small charge. $9 card fee on top of a $300 bill didnt really make sense..

Aside from that..
I had a great experience at Umi Seafood Buffet and chose to celebrate my birthday here with my family.
We came as a table of 10, and everything from start to finish was smooth and enjoyable.

The host, a young male, was very kind and accommodating, which made arriving with a large group easy and stress-free. Our server — a friendly woman with short hair — was especially great: attentive, efficient, and welcoming without being overbearing. She handled our table really well and made sure everything stayed on track.

The restaurant itself is very easy to navigate and self-explanatory, which I appreciated. Everything was clearly laid out, accessible, and simple to move through, even with a big group. The space felt comfortable and relaxed, making it a great place for a family outing or celebration.

Overall, the experience was fun, smooth, and well-organized. I left feeling happy and well taken care of, and I’d definitely return.

Umi Hotpot is such a fun spot to eat at. There’s a wide selection of food, including sushi, seafood, hot dishes, desserts, and more, and everything we tried was fresh and tasty. The ramen surprised me in the best way… super comforting and really good for a buffet. The place is clean, the staff is attentive, and you definitely get your money’s worth. A perfect pick if you’re craving variety and want to leave full and happy! 🍣🥢🍜

I came here for weekend lunch with my dad and overall had a really good experience. The food quality was solid and there’s a huge selection, especially if you love seafood. Tons of options across the buffet — although I was a little sad there weren’t any scallops.

One thing to note: many of the buffet items aren’t labeled, so it can be hard to tell exactly what you’re picking up. Also, not every tray has its own serving tongs, so sometimes you have to borrow from another dish. That could be a downside if you have food allergies or strict dietary preferences.

The atmosphere is really cool — lots of Asian-themed decor and calming music that makes the space feel relaxed rather than chaotic. The restaurant and bathrooms were both clean, which I always appreciate.

Service was adequate. The staff were polite, just not especially warm or chatty. They charge a 12% service fee and tips are not expected.

It is on the pricier side (and even more expensive during dinner and weekends), but honestly, I think it’s worth it for the amount of selection and quality. If you want to try it at a lower price point, I’d recommend going during weekday lunch first.

And side note: they include unlimited boba tea with the buffet, which is kind of amazing. At other places, that alone can cost close to $10 each. Here, it’s included — and yes, I had multiple.

Overall, I’d come back. If you go in knowing what to expect price-wise, it’s a fun experience with a lot of options.

Honestly the best buffet around. But of course, like with every buffet, there are hit and miss dishes but most of them are very good. Only down side is the wait time. Just be prepare to wait 1-2+ hrs depending on day and time you go. You can use a kiosk upon entering to add your party to the queue and they text you when it’s ready. Highly recommend to pay attention to where you are in line so you can come back if you do decide to leave.

**Now I decided to add this part in but just know it’s not part of the buffet food.** They had this Facebook promotional event where they’ll ask you to post their flyer on your Facebook page and each person who post will get steak and lobster for free. They didn’t seem to be opening advertising it in the restaurant, seems to be an ask to know basis. We only found out about it after another table personally told/show us. Now, that was fun and all, steak was good but lobster was RAW. We notified the server, he told us to cook the lobster in the hot pot broth if we need it more cooked. Not the response we expected but it’s free so I won’t complain. I figured these would be helpful for others to know.

UMI Hot Pot & Seafood in Rockville, MD is amazing! 😋🔥
They have fresh seafood, sashimi, sushi, hot pot, fried rice, and so many options to choose from. 🦐🐟🍣

The seafood tastes super fresh and high quality — you can tell right away when you take the first bite. The sashimi and sushi are delicious, and the hot pot broth has a lot of flavor. 🍲✨ The fried rice is also really tasty and pairs well with everything.

The place is clean, service is fast, and the food comes out quickly. ✅
Perfect restaurant for family, friends, or group hangouts — you will leave full and happy. 😄

name: Ramen Azuma
document: Ramen Azuma. cuisine: Ramen. located in Bronx. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Small confession: I don't like ramen. But I had a lunch date friend with a friend here, so I was elated to find an entire page of the menu dedicated to curry entrees.

Here's the short end of it: if you're on the fence about ramen, you can still have a great meal here.

I ordered the Karaage curry, which came with four chunky pieces of fried chicken between a mound of rice and an impressive pool of beef curry. I love curries, and this was no exception. There's just nothing like that characteristic smokey, flavor-blasted blend of spices in Japanese curries. On the slight downside, there wasn't a ton of beef in the curry, but it sure made it exciting when I happened upon occasional bites with meat chunks.

The Japanese iced coffee is a presentation unto itself. A small pourover sits above a cup, ensuring a fresh brew. That drips onto a small puddle of condensed milk while a cup of ice stands ready by the side. It's a zazzy, interactive process toward a cup of iced coffee that tasted just fine.

There's a lovely, cozy vibe to this restaurant that the warm, non-hurried service just accentuates. Service was attentive without intrusion throughout. There's a small, free parking lot right in front, which is certainly a boon in the parking-less void that is this part of Englewood.

A good find ramen place. They have these combo deals and it's a really good value. Very creamy and rich broth. I got the spicy sesame ramen, I think it could be a tad spicier imo. A good size portion too. We all came in hungry on a cold night and we left satisfied.

This is one of my top five places to go when I’m having a bit of a bad day and need some food to fuel me up. Food is refreshing, atmosphere is very comfortable, the prices are just right and the portions are so filling. Customer service are right on top of it and are very nice!!! 5/5 stars!

If you're in the area, this place is a MUST. I've had a lot of Ramen, and this is hands down the best I've ever had. The broth is thick, rich, fatty, deeply umami, the homemade noodles are delightfully chewy, the yakiniku is super flavorful, and you HAVE to get the cucumbers. They're super good. The space is beautiful, the staff is friendly, and the food is all incredibly tasty. You also get a rather large portion for the price, so it's a good value overall. If I ever find myself in the area, I will definitely be coming back.

Ramen Azuma is very delicious! My dad got the lunch combo and it came with so much food. There’s a lot of seating inside. The parking lot is huge. There’s a lot of things to do in the area so stopping by Ramen Azuma for lunch is a good idea.

google_reviews.text: Truly, one of my favorite places to eat, and as they continue to expand, it’s just giving me more places to explore so I can get my favorite meals. The staff was very friendly. I believe I got there around 8 PM, and there weren’t too many people inside. I guess 8 PM on a Monday, yeah, maybe not gonna be the busiest spot. I was quickly seated, got to look over the menu for maybe 2 to 3 minutes before a woman came and took my order, wasn’t sure about my drink, and by the time she came back, I was. Everything moved very smoothly, and I was probably inside the restaurant for about an hour, of which after I paid the check, I did sit for a little bit just drinking water. Really appreciated the vibe of them not kicking me out, they technically didn’t close until 10. But I was still one of the only people in the restaurant so I’m surprised that they weren’t just like a get a move on.

I’m so satisfied,delicious food and super affordable.
In the beginning I was up for the (Matcha Tiramisu)
But Andre end up giving me the (Mochi Trio) which I loved even more! Thanks for the excellent service. Also don’t forget to try the (SAPPORO BEER) highly recommended. Enjoy!
Had lunch here during the blizzard. The ramen soup had a really nice taste. I enjoyed it.
Very good miso ramen and karage chicken. And has a few vegan options for my fiancé and she loves them.
Love this place food is amazing & service is great. Love Jason & Andre best servers

name: JBC Rice Noodles Ramen
document: JBC Rice Noodles Ramen. cuisine: Noodles Chinese Seafood. located in Bronx. with 4.8 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Ok this place is incredible!!! Service was great! The owner was so nice and attentive, the mala spicy soup was delicious (I got chicken) but prepare for the spice! I also got the pork and shrimp and spicy pork dumplings and definitely recommend the spicy pork, they’re the best I’ve ever had! Explosion of taste in each dumpling!! Cucumber salad was fresh and crunchy and the strawberry green tea was amazing as well. Please give this place a try and some love you won’t regret it 🥺 prices are also very reasonable!

Hidden Gem for noodle lovers!

This is hands down the best rice noodles in the DMV area! We stopped here during our road trip to DC and it turned out to be the best meal of the whole trip.

The rice noodles were absolutely delicious: fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. I also highly recommend the ramen, the spicy mala noodles, and the fruit tea. Everything we tried was fantastic.

What made the experience even more special was the service. The manager Jessie was incredibly kind and thoughtful. She even took great care of my baby by bringing some fresh vegetables and soup, which we truly appreciated while traveling.

Amazing food, warm hospitality, and a memorable stop on our trip. Highly recommend!

I have been here multiple times now and have to say it has become one of my favorite spots! The spicy pork dumplings and the scallion pancakes are my ultimate favorites! Everything is made with such care and even to go orders are packaged amazingly so they won’t spill. The service is friendly and quick. They are always willing to explain something you and answer your questions! There are multiple tables with plenty of space to bring friends. 10/10 recommend!

We came here for an early dinner on a Friday night. There was plenty of seats and we were seated immediately. Very unassuming place playing upbeat Asian music! I wanted to order everything! We started with the cucumber salad with garlic and vegetable dumplings. The first bite of the cucumber was fantastic! The garlic sauce was so good and complimented the cucumber. The vegetable dumplings were really nice. The crispy bottom was great texturally!  I had the golden spicy soup with brisket. The sour and spicy was so good. The spice made my nose run a little and at some point I had to blow my nose but in the best way. The brisket was nice and tender. The noodles kept a bit of texture. This was such a unique dish and I thoroughly enjoyed it. The bathrooms were clean. Take the time to come here! We will definitely be back.

Big shoutout to JBC Rice Noodles & Ramen!!
The food, perfectly executed (soup noodles, garlic cucumbers, takoyaki, udon, tom thom, ramen)
Prices, affordable and huge portions.
The star of the show was the hospitality... we were warmly greeted and had the sweetest, most down to earth waitress! The restaurant was immaculately clean and menu had lots of fun options.

She was even so patient and nice, she helped with my horrible attempts at speaking the dozen or so Mandarin phrases I know in addition to the other little things she did (check with my son twice to make sure not too spicey, the candys, tidying up the table, and several other things).

10/10.

name: Kailani Shave Ice & Ramen
document: Kailani Shave Ice & Ramen. cuisine: Ramen Shaved Ice Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt. located in Bronx. with 4.8 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
My wife wanted a soup with a lot of vegetables in it, so we chose this place based on pictures and reviews.

This is a nice place and we like their food.

Nice vibes here. Prices are acceptable and I will definitely visit again.

My family and I love this place. The shave ice special is big enough to feed our family of 4. So far we've tried the strawberry shortcake and the chocolate and both are very good. Everyone is very nice too. God bless you all!

I drive out of my way to have their Shaved Ice and Spam Musubi because there's no other place like this.  They also have ice cream, ramen and hot dogs.

Its hard to decide what to get with all the options but for me and my husband, we both agree that Purple Dream is the best flavor.  If your are an Ube Lover, this is probably the best Ube dessert you can have. You can choose between Coconut or Ube Ice Cream for the middle.  It's so good with the Ube ice cream.

I tried The Cold Brew for the 1st time and it was also really good too but I still like Purple Dream the best.

The Halo Halo is also pretty good.  Next time I will try the Matcha Mauna Loa. I'm also looking forward to trying the Dole Pineapple and Ube soft serve ice cream one day.

The place is very cute and there's a good amount of seating.  You have to eat the shaved ice there.  It melts too fast for the ride home. My only complaint is that they don't have packaging made for the Shaved ice to enable you to bring it home in tact. I tried to take home Shaved ice last month and they don't have covers to fit the bowls, which I was surprised, so I had to hold it in the car while my friend drove. Even with AC on full blast, it melted fast and got messy. I ended up spilling some in the car.

Please come up with packaging to enable take out.

Great Ramen, fun shaved ice and attentive service

I loved this place!
As ice cream lovers, we drove out from NYC to try the shaved ice and also tried some ramen.
They have so many fun options, and the shaved ice is amazing. We also had some ramen: again, great quality! Even my husband, who does not usually like Ramen, really enjoyed it.
The decor is also cute - we'll definitely be back

If you are looking for a warm treat or something to cool you off in the weird weather of NJ? Then Kailani gets your back!
EASY 5/5 comfort spot that provides unique flavors and taste you would have a hard time finding even in New York!! The place is not a full dine in restaurant and serves as a great lunch spot or quick casual dinner for cravings.

Kailani makes their ice cream from stratch and I can say it's absolutely phenonmenal. Their shaved ice combines a beautifully shaped and flavored ice with their ice cream tucked underneath a glorious rounded dome. It's definitely their main seller and it shows! Every bite of the shaved ice is flavored and that is hard to find in of itself.

I only had one of their ramens but I had their staple Hawaiian ramen. I would say it works really well as comfort food. It's warm, has a unique flavor profile and the spam is a nice touch!

Decor is gorgeous and the place is well-kept. You can tell they are passionate about their storefront and I love it. The owners were lovely people who will give you recommendations. In that regards, service is quite impeccable as they ask often how is everything.

Highly recommend if you need a bite or some mad good shaved ice.

document: Dumpling + Noodle. cuisine: Noodles Pan Asian. located in Bronx. with 3.5 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Me and my wife were visiting uncle Charles in Charlottesville. He took us to this amazing place Bambu dumpling house. We ordered Tonkatsu Ramen, General T’so chicken, Vegetables dumplings, and Rice Noodle. Omg, everything is so delicious, even the bubble tea is decent. Counter service was great too, staffs were very polite. Definitely hope we have a restaurant like that near our house.
First time eating here and it was delicious 😋. Great service. I wanted to try the chicken pan fried dumplings and it was delicious. Great quantity for Prices. Will definitely be back. 🥰

Talk about being transported to my childhood in New York City with their phenomenal dim sum. Perfectly steamed dim sum and oh so fresh. And the takoyaki was delightful too!  The flavor is authentic and absolutely worth the price. I’m beyond thrilled for this delicious new place so close to us!

We ordered the (ha cao) shrimp crystal dumplings, the pork and shrimp shumai, and the takoyaki octopus balls to start, with traditional Hong Kong style (mild) wonton noodle soup for me and Japanese shoyu pork ramen for my hubby. I could hardly wait to get home as the food smelled amazing from the takeaway bag.

My hubby devoured his shoyu ramen. The jammy eggs were exactly as they should be, the pork decadent, the noodles springy, and the broth balanced and hearty. I also enjoyed my very mild by contrast traditional wonton noodle soup, which was as I expected and I added some dumpling sauce to it to bring out the delicate flavors. Tasty wontons too!

The bright, cheerful, welcoming ambiance created a great atmosphere. There were already 3 groups dining in and 2 folks in line ahead of us. And still very spacious the way the seating area was laid out. The line moved very quickly too. The owners greeted me and immediately recognized me from my engagement with their social media. They’re so friendly and warm, taking a few moments to chat with me. Their menu is clearly displayed on two screens on the wall and is easy to read.

No boba yet but they should have it available in a few days or so. We can’t wait to get boba with our meal next time!

For a soft opening, this smooth running team and delicious menu is hard to beat. We rate it 10/10 stars and know you’ll love it too!

Excellent counter service ramen and dumplings restaurant in 5th street station. General Tso chicken was fantastic, mix of dark and white meat and it was not overly breaded. Shrimp and pork shuma was really great as well. Looking forward to eating here again.
Best ramen spot in the area! Food was ready in 7 min... cooked to sheer perfection. Tender chicken, tender pork belly, perfectly cooked shrimp! Great service, great meal!

name: Panda Restaurant
document: Panda Restaurant. cuisine: Chinese. located in Bronx. with 3.7 stars (good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: Panda Express is my first American Chinese fast food chain (I just recently moved from Bali, Indonesia). What can I say? I’ve been here almost once every week, they always stuff your box to the fullest, great food and always have limited menu which I like to try everytime I come here. Beijing beef, honey walnut shrimp and orange chicken are definitely my trio go-to (and when they have the spicy orange chicken)

Our young grandson introduced us to Panda. Since then I'm we go on a regular basis when we want quick service and good food. Good variety of choices, freshly cooked. A change of pace from fast food burgers. You won't be disappointed.

The sign inside reads " American Chinese Quisine." That it is, so don't look for authentic Chinese food. To me, everything was too sweet, hiding the veggie and meat flavors. But it was fast, inexpensive,  and filling. Typical American cuisine.  The staff was accommodating.  This is not a buffet. Pick your main entrée and side. There is not a lot of vegan choice, just the sides. Dishes were beef, chicken, or shrimp based. Perhaps tables need to be cleaned more often as most are large and you may share a table with others. If you want fast, cheap, and filling, it's a good place.
Got lunch here to go, very delicious orange chicken and noodles. Friendly staff, easy accessibility, plenty of parking, clean restrooms.  Not far off of I-66.

Ordered the family style meal. Got home to find the boxes weren’t even filled up all the way. For what you pay you’d think you’d get your money’s worth. Complained online to Panda Express and still haven’t heard from anyone in management.

I've ordered here a few times now, the food has been great every time. Their bubble tea is delightful. So far, I've only had the mango and peach because I just love those flavors. The mango is very sweet, which I personally prefer, and the bubbles themselves are so chewy. The cups are also cute; they have a few different designs. Both the food and the drinks have been consistent between ordering in restaurant or delivery. Their orange chicken is wonderful, the flavor is on point, it comes with orange zest for extra tang, and the sauce is nice and thick. Just for a warning, it does come a bit spicy but it's nothing you'll need a drink for. The General Tso's tofu is my favorite. It's far from bland, keeps its structure even with the sauce, the broccoli is cooked well, and the portion is fulfilling. The only complaint I have about this dish is that sometimes there will be a lot more air and crust than actual tofu but that's been uncommon throughout the times that I've ordered. There are seats in the restaurant should you want to stay for a bit. Overall, great place to order from with good prices.

My friends and I are African so our parents are adamant on respect so we use all of our manners, please and thank you, etc. Everything was going well until after we ordered appetizers and my friend and I who don’t eat pork realized that my appetizer platter that I ordered came with pork. As soon as I realized, I got up and went and spoke to the older lady at the front desk and told her like” hey due to religious reasons, I don’t eat pork. is there anyway we can just switch out The pork items with a non-pork option so the spring roll for a vegetable spring roll and the spare rib for a chicken sate. I even apologized and said it’s my fault for not triple checking before I ordered. Pork is one of the cheapest meats in the world and I think the spare rib plus the spring roll maybe cost them $.50 in total because it was one piece each. When asking for an alternative the lady kept saying oh “it’s already made” “it’s ready”, “what do you want us to do?” I kept telling her so you want me to eat it and it’s against my religion like I’m confused. Another younger lady joined her and I told her the story as well and they continue to tell me that EVERY restaurant has pork in their appetizer and I should’ve known that about combination platters. I said I’ve never been to this restaurant, but I do go and frequent other restaurants a lot and not every restaurant has pork on their combination platte.  I’m proud that I stood up for myself and told them that to their faces because it was the most awkward situation ever. I felt like I didn’t even want to eat there anymore and just out of place. Honestly, it was just an odd experience.  This back and forth went on for at least 10 mins before they agreed to switch out the non pork items.

google_reviews.text:
The Green Dragon Tavern is a unique destination that is equal parts traditional American restaurant and museum dedicated to the founding of the US. It is a passion project that pairs New England comfort food with a stroll through history.

The Food:
🦞 Connecticut Lobster Roll: Pure comfort. It is served warm inside a brioche roll that is baked fresh daily. The buttery lobster and the soft, slightly sweet bread were an impressive pairing.

🐟 Ahi Poke: A refreshing appetizer. The avocado and fresh ahi were excellent, but the standout was the crisp taro chips - their saltiness really brought out the flavor of the fish.

🐑 Shepherd’s Pie: Arrived piping hot in a cast iron skillet. Beneath the creamy mashed potatoes lay a thick, savory meat and vegetable sauce.

🐠 Fish & Chips: Three large fish pieces were accompanied by a tartar sauce with a robust dill profile. Note: Eat quickly because the deep-fried coating is tasty but tends to soften/lose its crunch faster than expected.

Service:
Jason provided excellent, attentive service throughout the meal. He steered us toward the chocolate lava cake, which was a delicious recommendation.

Museum and Atmosphere:
• The Vibe: Walking through the museum on hardwood floors to see the historic artifacts (and seasonal decorations) makes for a memorable entry and exit.

• Parking: Plenty of free parking available.

• Facilities: Includes a full bar and large guest halls for events.

Overall:
A great place for a family-friendly meal and an informative walk through US history.

Again our date night took us to the Green Dragon Tavern & Museum in Carlsbad, CA.  What an absolutely amazing place to go for dinner!!  Food is always wonderful, and it’s nice learning something new about history each time!!   We’ll definitely be back!!

A very sweet and cozy little Chinese owned cafe that is reminiscent of a warm living room kind of setup. The owner was friendly, kind, and receptive towards listening to feedback to continue to improve and provide diners with the best experience possible! document: Janooon Cafe. cuisine: Cafes Pakistani. located in Staten_Island. with 5.0 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: We stopped by Janooon Café with friends and had a really nice experience overall. It’s more of a self-serve style café rather than a full restaurant, but they still bring the food to your table which was a nice touch. We ordered quite a few things to try, the Anday Wala Slider came as a sub sandwich, which was surprising since it’s called a slider, but flavor-wise it was okay. The spicy chicken sliders came with two buns and were good, though a bit basic. The real winner for us was the Katori Papri Chaat fresh, tangy, and perfectly spiced, definitely a 10/10! The Gol Gappy, on the other hand, lacked seasoning and didn’t taste very authentic, so we weren’t too impressed with that one. The loaded fries were crispy and topped with seasoned grilled chicken, cheese, and their special sauce it was good. We also got a pot of Karak Tea, which was nicely presented in a glass teapot with golden cups and had a rich, flavorful taste. Overall, Janooon Café is a cozy spot with good food, good service, and affordable prices. It’s not too expensive either for all these dishes, we paid around $50 total, which was very reasonable for the amount we got. I also loved that they have games to play while you hang out, like American cards and traditional Pakistani games — it adds such a fun, chill vibe. Definitely a nice place to relax and share snacks & drinks with friends.

One of the best food places I’ve been to in NYC.

If you’re looking for a place with amazing coffee, delicious food, and a welcoming atmosphere, Harvest Table is a must-visit. document: Best Coffee Shop. cuisine: Coffee & Tea. located in Staten_Island. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
Before & After Café is an absolute surprising delight nestled in the small town of Sperryville. We stopped by didn’t know what to expect and were seriously impressed. The croissant breakfast sandwich was perfectly flaky, buttery and perfectly seasoned, the quiche was hearty and came with a fresh, crisp side salad.

The espresso drinks are also beyond expectations. We ordered a latte and a hot chocolate, and both were beautifully crafted and rich in flavor—honestly better than many cafés in NYC. In a world of burnt beans and sad milk foam, this was a much-needed reset.

The café’s quirky charm adds to the experience—vintage decor, cozy seating, and lots of duck-themed personality (thanks to SperryFest).

Highly recommended for Shenandoah travelers.

Wonderful cafe located just ~30 minutes away from the entrance to Shenandoah National Park! I stopped by Before & After while driving up to Shenandoah for a weekend hiking trip. It started to rain in the late morning, so I figured I might as well take a beat to grab some food and read until it was possible to get outside again. I was super impressed by Before & After -- the space is super cozy and was filled with hikers who had my same line of thought, as well as a bunch of locals enjoying their weekends. The staff was incredibly friendly, and I loved chatting with them and browsing all the merch they had around the store, including a book about the Shenandoah Valley written by a Sperryville local (who one of the guests sitting next to me apparently knew personally!). I cozied up next to the fireplace with a latte and ginger scone, and it was a delightful way to spend the late morning. The latte was solid, and the scone was giant and super tasty. It had a great gingery kick and wasn't overly sweet at all, and it was buttery, slightly soft, and moist in the center with a nice crunchy exterior studded with ginger sugar. They also have a rotating seasonal scone, so I'm sure it'll be a hard choice between the ginger scone -- their all-time best-seller -- and whatever seasonal item they have in stock the next time I visit.

Nice little cafe right in front of the Shenandoah National Park. One thing I noticed right away was that they use Intelligentsia Coffee beans. Their Black Cat Classic is one of my favorites, and I was pleasantly surprised they were using this particular brand.

Oftentimes, local cafes tend to use their own roast or locally sourced beans, which can be hit or miss. Don't get me wrong, there are lots of great local coffee beans in Virginia, but I was so glad to see a coffee taste I can just feel safe with.

So naturally, I ordered an Iced Americano, and it was delicious.

For a quick lunch, I ordered a Sausage Quiche, and it was great. The quality of the sausage in the quiche was amazing. It didn't feel salty, and the quiche itself had a little seasoning, so it balanced out nicely. The side salad that came with the quiche had a mango white vinaigrette dressing, I believe, and it offset the heaviness of the quiche.

They have a cute little river walk right behind their storefront, so you should definitely check that out as well.
Amazing place to go grab breakfast or coffee. Scones and bakery were great. I really liked the outdoor sitting space with river. Plenty of parking. Definitely go here.

Beautiful gem of a place, the atmosphere was lovely and the coffee was perfect. The food was solid but packaged in a way that was not great to eat on the go. We got icee Honeysuckle and Black Bear Lates as well as the breakfast sandwich, breakfast burritos, and a cinnamon roll coffee cake muffin. The black bear late was a perfect raspberry mocha. It had great seating inside and riverside seating out back with a decent amount of parking.

name: Velvet Honey
document: Velvet Honey. cuisine: Coffee & Tea. located in Staten_Island. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Quaint, cute, fresh and an  absolutely delightful romantic café. The atmosphere inside is lively and just the perfect vibe, especially for brunch. It is very unassuming for its outside appearance, but its food is full of flavor and life. The BLT was fresh and added a new spin. The Marsacpone French toast was heavenly, not too sweet and the perfect texture. The fruits were great even concerning the weather, making it feel just like summertime. The drinks were just the right amount of sweetness and bitterness, you can tell that the barista knows what he is doing! Absolutely no complaints and we were surprisingly surprised by the beautiful interior, service, and food. Definitely stop by!

I had such a wonderful experience at this café! The presentation of the food was absolutely beautiful, and everything tasted just as amazing as it looked. The toast was perfectly soft and flavorful, paired with fresh fruits and cream — simply delicious. The matcha latte was smooth and rich, with just the right balance of sweetness.

Great impression.
As a Brooklynite, I appreciate the service, quality, and speed of the food.

Good workspace (especially the quiet).

Perhaps the only downside is the price, but this could improve depending on the support and consistency this place receives.

Great business! 🙌

New coffee shop in the area! I ordered a cortado to stay. A patron came after me but ordered hers to go so they prepared hers first, which I thought was a bit odd. But they brought the drink to my table, which was nice. The drink was balanced, not acidic, though they steaming could have used some more technique, but it tasted fine. The environment is very dark, so it’s not quite as nice to sit in, but it’s good for a quick morning drink!

Absolutely loved my experience at Velvet Honey Café! The Bath Avenue Roast Beef was incredible—so flavorful and perfectly prepared. The non-alcoholic champagne is such a brilliant idea, refreshing and elegant without the alcohol. The desserts are absolutely delightful—each one feels like a little work of art. Excellent service, cozy atmosphere, and truly unique offerings. Highly recommend this place to everyone!

name: Kaffe 1668
document: Kaffe 1668. cuisine: Coffee & Tea. located in Staten_Island. with 5.0 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Small cute coffee shop with good products overall. First of all, the drinks are directly made to go, without the waiter even asking, which I didn’t expect. The atmosphere is nice, but the vibe overall is not cozy and the staff is not very attentive. People come in and go all the time, it is not really the right place to enjoy a cozy coffee and/or to study. I liked their coffee though, and the bowls are good too.

Kaffe Åre is a cozy Scandinavian-inspired café in Tribeca that feels like a little calm escape from the usual NYC rush. The space has a warm, minimalist vibe with wood accents and comfy seating — great for a relaxed morning coffee or a casual catch-up. Their espresso drinks and pour-overs are well crafted with clean, balanced flavors, and the house-baked pastries (like cardamom buns) are tasty and a bit healthier than your typical café sweets.

I also appreciated the fresh, simple food options — sandwiches and juices — and the friendly staff who make the whole experience feel inviting. It’s perfect for a slow coffee break or a light breakfast, though it can get busy during peak hours and seating fills up fast. Overall, if you’re in Tribeca and want quality coffee with a laid-back, Nordic-touch vibe, this spot is worth a stop.

TLDR coffee, pastries and food are great. Service is very slow. If you are in a hurry, don’t get your coffee there. If you are sitting, be mindful that it will take a while.

This is my second time at this coffee shop. My first time was at a casual Wednesday around 3pm. The place wasn’t too busy. I ordered a cookie and a latte. I got the cookie pretty quickly but the coffee took forever. I was the only one in line, I was meeting a friend with had already ordered her coffee. It took mine nearly 15 minutes to be ready. Again, I was the only one in line.

Second time was today, a Sunday at 3:50pm. I had 15 minutes wait for the bus so I thought to grab a coffee. I was waiting for 10 minutes with 2 other people that were waiting for their coffee as well. I almost missed my bus. Was thinking to give up on the coffee, but I got it right on time as I saw the bus arriving the station.

I really want to love this place and go there more. But with the service being so slow as if there is only one person giving service to everyone, is such a bummer.

I do want to mention that the staff odd being nice and welcoming. It is just very very slow.
The flavor of my latte was good. However theres multiple flies inside the pasteries. Theres no way the staff doesn’t know, so I can’t give this place above 1 star.
Reliable spot to take a break. Very good coffee and tasty pastries. Haven't sampled food menu. Spare interior, but clean and tables a generously-spaced, a NYC luxury.

name: French Pastry House
document: French Pastry House. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Desserts Patisserie/Cake Shop. located in Staten_Island. with 4.0 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
We recently stopped by Maison De Viennoiserie, an Algerian-style coffee shop that brings together the best of North African hospitality with a French pastry tradition. The café serves lattes, coffees, soft drinks, and a lovely assortment of Algerian cookies and specialties.
The highlight is undoubtedly their French pastries and viennoiseries. The showcase was filled with beautifully presented treats, from tarts and éclairs in several flavors—chocolate, coffee, vanilla, and more—to the classic mille-feuille, here called “Napoleon.” Everything looked fresh and inviting.
We ordered a coffee and a latte, both excellent and clearly made with quality beans. My wife tried the coffee éclair: while not the very best we’ve ever had (we’re admittedly picky), it was still fresh, tasty, and enjoyable.
During our visit, we overheard someone ordering a sandwich, possibly tacos or another light option, which the staff seemed to prepare in the back. It’s nice to know they also offer savory items beyond pastries.
The atmosphere felt warm and authentic, and the service was excellent—professional, attentive, and welcoming. We’re happy to add this new Algerian spot to our list of go-to places in Brooklyn and look forward to returning to explore more of their menu.

It’s not my first time coming here, but it’s definitely going to be the last. The wait time was excessive and completely unexplained, we waited for over an hour for just two sandwiches. After all that time, they even gave us the wrong order. To make things worse, someone who came after us was served before us, and when we complained, the cashier had no explanation.
Totally disrespectful.

I have been to this place many times but yesterday 03/5/2026,  I ordered 3 napoleons and asked the cashier (Zineddine) is this fresh, he was like yes yes just came now. Liar.  Today my son and I are feeling nauseous all day with bad feeling of vomiting. the taste was awful.
Last time, I asked Barista to pick for me those cakes and he was "are we selling tomato here. they are all the same". Unfortunately, bad costumer service. The guy (Zineddine) was very defensive and rude and has bad attitude. please do not sell old pastry to customers.

I’ve been coming here every weekend to try a different type of dessert from this place. Everyone I tried has a unique taste, and they all taste delicious. The macaroons taste like they should. I felt like I was back in France with every bite. They make fresh croissants and some with chocolate inside. The Coffee is really good and they offer indoor and outdoor seating. When the weather is nice, they open up the doors and when you’re sitting outside, you get that fresh smell of baked goods.

I recently had the pleasure of visiting Maison de Viennoiseries at 8101 5th Avenue in Brooklyn, and it’s safe to say this place is a pastry lover's dream! The moment you walk in, you're greeted by the delightful scent of fresh-baked goods, and it only gets better from there.
Their selection of pastries is absolutely top-notch. The croissants are a standout—perfectly flaky, buttery, and golden brown, just as they should be. The pain au chocolat is equally impressive, with just the right amount of rich, melty chocolate that complements the light, airy pastry.
What I love most about this place is the authenticity. The quality and care put into each pastry are clear in every bite. Whether you're enjoying your pastries with a cup of coffee or taking them to go, you can tell you're getting the real deal.
The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, making it easy to ask for recommendations or get a little insight into the ingredients and process behind each treat. It’s a cozy spot that offers a little slice of France right here in Brooklyn.
If you’re in the area, do yourself a favor and stop by Maison de Viennoiseries—you won’t be disappointed!
