name: Qahwa Roots
document: Qahwa Roots. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Desserts Juice Bars & Smoothies. located in Staten_Island. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a quiet spot to study, this is a great option. When I walked in, it was calm and not crowded, and it stayed that way the entire time. Everyone who came in seemed mindful of others—either studying themselves or respecting the atmosphere.

My friend and I ordered the iced caramel golden shaken espresso, an ube latte, chocolate cake, and honeycomb bread. I would definitely come back for the drinks—they were enjoyable and well made. The pastries, however, didn’t taste very fresh. There also weren’t many pastry options when I visited (which could have just been due to the time), and overall they felt okay but nothing special. The honeycomb bread was decent—good, but pretty average.

I did appreciate that they had a prayer room available, and I used it while I was there. That said, the room was extremely cold with no noticeable insulation or heat, so I ended up praying quickly and leaving. There was also Christmas decor in the room, which felt a bit odd while praying. I understand the space is meant to be inclusive for everyone, but it still felt slightly uncomfortable.

Overall, it’s a nice, quiet place for studying with solid drinks, but there’s room for improvement—especially with the pastries and the comfort of the prayer space.

I went there 6pm and the place was quiet. Perfect for anyone that wants to read or study.it is large, bright and clean. I ordered a pistachio latte with almond milk and 2 extra shot of espresso. The latte was perfect! The cake in the picture tast so good, like a large rocher chocolate.

Great neighborhood joint. I had a qishr—coffee cherry husk with ginger—and a delicious pastry filled with cream cheese and drizzled with honey. Service was excellent. Super nice staff. Nice murals on the wall!

I like this place overall, but there are a few things that bug me. Let’s start with the good stuff: the cashier is super nice and always smiling, which makes the vibe really welcoming. The café itself is clean, has big tables, plenty of outlets, and the music isn’t blasting, which I love. The bathroom is also spotless and even has a bidet, so that’s a plus.

Now for the not-so-great parts: $9 for a small oat milk latte is just too much, especially for students. I got the pistachio latte a few times; it was amazing at first, but then it started tasting either way too sweet or too bitter, like they’re not consistent with the recipe. I also tried the caramel macchiato (the one in the glass), and honestly, it wasn’t good; way too sweet and no real coffee flavor. Even after adding an extra espresso shot (so basically $11 for that drink), it still tasted off, and I couldn’t finish it.

Overall, it’s a nice spot to hang out or get some work done, but I really wish their drinks were more consistent, and a little cheaper. If they fix that, it’d easily be one of my favorite cafés.

Upon arrival the cafe is cute. Once you reach the counter to order that’s where things get messy the worker doesn’t really understand English (which is ok as long as the drink can be understood) we asked for 2 pistachio latte with oat milk and a honey comb pastry. The lattes weren’t made with oat milk therefore they had to be remade and the lattes didn’t at all taste like pistachio they tasted like regular lattes. I asked the person working there is this a pistachio latte and he said yes. I showed him the cup and said it taste like a regular latte. He said that’s just the way we make the lattes it’s not suppose to be green?? That didn’t make any sense I’ve been to many coffee shops and never had this type of experience he didn’t want to help or address the issue whatsoever. I wouldn’t come here again.

name: The Coffee Mill Roasters
document: The Coffee Mill Roasters. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Coffee Roasteries. located in Staten_Island. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: The coffee was great. I just think you can improve this shop. People usually come to coffee shops with a laptop and notebook to do work. You can get larger tables that can fit about 2 laptops and install more outlets for customers to charge their items. There was free working Wi-Fi though! These tables are very tiny and easy to spill your drink. The coffee was good but you can add to your drink selection. The decaf coffee was unavailable. Which is surprising because its a popular drink for people who don't need caffeine in their diet.

We visited this coffee shop multiple times in the past. But always ordered familiar items like halva and baclava.
But one day we got a surprise bag thru GoodToGo and we amazed at the tast and flavors of various  wonderful bakery items in our surprise bag. The muffin was the best we had in a long time; the “everything “ bagel was  soft and delicious, the danish with cardamom was sumptuous, raspberries tart is soon good! And it was not all - almond croissant, golden raisins danish etc. And Adel added a slice of rose water halva! Now , that we tasted some of his goodies, we will be stopping at this shop more often for amazing , unique sweet treats!
This is a really cute shop. The pasties are soo so yummy and the coffee is amazing. If you want fresh non generic coffee. Then here would be the place for you.

Such a nice spot for coffee and desserts!

They have many options for drinks I wish I could have tried all of them but I was only passing by. The cashier, who I assume is the owner based on other reviews was very lively and took care of my order quick.

I sat outside in the closed off section where the town hosts live music.

Had a lovely experience at Coffee Mill Roasters. First off, the road directly in front is blocked off for the restaurants to have outdoor seating which is AMAZING! The interior was a little small and crowded, but felt like a proper coffee shop.

When we walked in the owner (presumably) greeted us and asked what he could get us. I ordered a medium coffee with cream and had witty/sarcastic & fun banter with him. He explained that his coffee was sourced from better roasters than the big chains and that I wouldn't need a lot of creamer, to which he was right! I didn't use as much creamer as I typically do and the coffee was smooth with no bitterness.

My gf ordered a tea latte with oat milk and after a little more banter, she received her drink as well. We looked at the many deli cases full of delicious baked goods but ended up not ordering anything. We realized too late that there were gluten free options but were in a rush and had to leave.

We also noticed there was a case for gelato which we would love to try!

All in all a great experience! Will try to come back next time we're in town!

They will be keeping their Emerson location open and we will continue to order all our cakes from them we’ll just have to take a bit of a longer trip to get them. Thank You Rispoli of Ridgefield ~ JC & Family 💖

I just wanted to add pics ( took pics in two different types of lighting )of my mother’s birthday cake we got a few days ago.
Thank you for another beautiful birthday cake! You did such a lovely job with my mother’s strawberry shortcake cake, the roses are beautiful!!

August 2024

A Huge thank you to the Rispoli staff (in Ridgefield) for the amazing cannoli birthday cake you made for my father David that we picked up today (along with a few fig bars I really love) it was perfectly decorated and absolutely delicious as always!
My family and I have been customers for many years especially for special occasions and have never been disappointed.

Congratulations on recently earning the title of Jersey's best and the number one must-try bakery. I recently came across this in an online article.

Very friendly polite and accommodating staff, it’s always clean, everything always looks fresh  and neatly displayed, there are tables if you want sit and enjoy a coffee and pastry.

I’ve heard great things about Rispoli’s but haven’t tried it yet until my friend brought over some sfogliatella (aka lobster tails) and some other pastries. The pastries were good but that sfogliatella was something else. It was so light and crispy. I loved it so much that I decided to go the following Saturday and pick some up for my family. It was around 10 am on a Saturday and there were only a couple of people there, but I was told it can get packed. Most of the cookies are by weight, and the pastries are a set price (ie. Lobster tails are $5 a pop).

Overall, a great options if you’re looking for some Italian sweets. Next time, I’ll be trying their pignoli cookies.

Today, I tried their pistachio lobster tail. Very delicious and flaky! They have a wide array of Italian pastries and I always come here to pick up a box of pastries to bring to the office. From their tiramisu to bombas to their sfogliatella, which is a must try. This place has been making pastries for decades. You must try it.

Love their lobster tails; pastry is flaky and chantilly cream is so light and creamy! I tried their tiramisu, eclair and sfogliatella for the first time today and was underwhelmed. I would go back for their lobster tails any day though.

name: Flagship Brewing
document: Flagship Brewing. cuisine: Breweries. located in Staten_Island. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
True to its name, The Flagship Brewing Company lives up to its "Flagship" status with a remarkably spacious and comfortable venue.

Its location is a major highlight, being just a short walk from the St. George Terminal of the Staten Island Ferry. For anyone looking to escape the hustle and bustle of Manhattan and enjoy a relaxed beer, a ferry ride over to this spot for a drink or two would be perfect.

As for the beer itself, I tried their Blood Orange IPA, and it was absolutely outstanding. This place is a definite must-visit for beer lovers and those seeking a laid-back atmosphere with great brews.

One of the best breweries in NYC.

The blood orange IPA is amazing.  All of the cocktails, wines and beers are NYC made.  Live music on the regular.

You can have food delivered to Flagship and I highly recommend Pier 76 pizza.

Very family and dog friendly.

I am not a beer drinker at all and I don’t even like the smell of beer however my boyfriend loves a good IPA and he loves Flagship! I join him and I actually enjoying coming to flagship because of the awesome people like one of the owners Sam the cool bar tenders Oliver and Mike always great to talk to ! Great vibe! They have a lot of comedy nights, open mic nights as well as open the place up as a venue for rent for different occasions  !  They recently also started serving frozen drinks which I love like the Arnold Palmer and now they have local bourbon and vodka. They have great games to play check out the photos ! They also
Have light appetizers available. :)

What a gem! I went here because I found this address of another brewery that may or may not exist (Mad Love?). Anyway, DAMN these are some great beers. Pictured is the nitro blood orange wit and a (really damn good) classic Italian Pilsner.

The beer menu didn’t look too interesting but it’s clear these are some special beers. There’s no “triple oat cream dry hopped with citra conditioned on fairy dust” nonsense here (and don’t get me wrong, I love that style too). These are just really classic, incredible well crafted brews. Worth the ferry over, any day of the week.

Just a short walk from the Staten Island Ferry  you can find this lovely brewery with their amazing selection of beers.

I Czech-checked 🇨🇿✅ their Pilsners and also tried couple other beers and I can assure you that you gonna enjoy them.

Their Tunnel to Tower Brave Golden Ale beer has a great story, so ask for details.

Great, knowledgeable, passionate and friendly staff even took me to the actual brewery for a micro tour with explanation.

So next time instead of running from the ferry to catch the same one just calm down and enjoy Flagship Brewing products!

We love comin' here! The vibe is usually upbeat and inviting. The slow roasted wings are juicy and delicious. The staff are a lively, attentive, and charming bunch. We'll be back again and probably soon after that!

Overall Score: 7.4/10 – A solid tavern-style restaurant with generous portions, good food, friendly service, and a clean, casual atmosphere that delivers a satisfying experience.

Atmosphere and Service: 7.3/10 – The interior follows a classic tavern setup with high-top tables and a straightforward, no-frills style. Outdoor seating was available and decent. google_reviews.text: We had the most fun we have had in years. Hunter was incredible and made us feel as we were a guest in his home. What a cool place!  Been wanting to try this place out for a couple of years and finally got there.  You have to enter from the back alley way off Main St in Franklin near Mellow Mushroom.  In order to get inside, you have to pull a Frankenstein switch which activates a green light and someone will come get you and escorted you inside.  So cool!  Inside the place is dark and cozy, decked out prohibition style.  The cocktails are undeniably creative and amazing.  The bartender staff is friendly, and will walk you through the menu to answer questions and to offer their favorites.  The snacks are good, too.  Will definitely be back as there so many cocktails to try!

Amendment 18 in downtown Franklin is an absolute gem. Tucked right into the heart of Main Street, it brings a sophisticated speakeasy vibe that feels both elevated and welcoming at the same time.
The cocktail program is exceptional,thoughtfully crafted, beautifully presented, and perfectly balanced. You can tell the bartenders take real pride in their work. Whether you’re in the mood for a classic or something inventive, every drink feels intentional and high-level.
The ambiance is intimate, stylish, and ideal for date nights, meeting friends, or winding down after dinner downtown. Service is professional, knowledgeable, and attentive without being intrusive.
If you’re looking for one of the best cocktail experiences in downtown Franklin, Amendment 18 is a must-visit. It consistently delivers an upscale yet comfortable atmosphere that keeps you coming back.

I’m now a regular! I love, love the speakeasy vibe. The drinks are fabulous, the bartenders are talented and the management and team are very observant and quick to protect their patrons from unwanted attention. I always recommend them to customers. Tyler is my #1 bartender followed closely by Dave.

This was my second visit to The Amendment, and unfortunately the experience was far from decent.

I came on a Thursday night after my friend filmed his comedy special and arrived early with a group of about 10 people. We showed up around 8:00 PM, and at that time there were only about four other guests in the entire place. You would think a group ready to sit, drink, and spend money would be welcomed.

I arrived early specifically to grab a table, and from the start we were met by an extremely unfriendly host who genuinely seemed like she didn’t want us there. I suggested we take two side tables since people would be sitting and standing, socializing, ordering drinks, and spending money. I was immediately told this “wasn’t a standing bar” and that if we wanted to stand, we should go to a dive bar down the street. This was odd considering we fully intended to drink premium liquor and order food.

It took at least 10 minutes before anyone even approached us. Eventually the bartender came to the table, but ordering was slow and awkward. At one point he started speaking in what felt like a fake accent, to the point where I genuinely thought he was speaking Spanish to me, which was uncomfortable and confusing.

Drinks took 20–30 minutes to arrive. I also ordered appetizers for the group, but after waiting quite a while, I asked about the food and was told the order was never put in.

As the rest of the party arrived, their drink orders weren’t taken until nearly an hour into being there.

When it came time to close out, things somehow got worse. Items appeared on my check that were not mine. I was told they were removed, but the reprinted check still showed the incorrect charges. I was then told the items would be “moved to someone else’s tab” and that I wouldn’t be charged, but I refused to sign anything without a correct receipt reflecting only my actual order. That should never be an argument a guest has to have.

Despite all of this, we still stayed, drank multiple rounds, and spent a significant amount of money. I tipped, but honestly felt like I shouldn’t have.

I’ve worked in the bar industry for over 10 years, and this level of service was shocking. Between the attitude, the delays, the forgotten food, and the billing issues, the entire night was poorly handled. I wanted to like this place, but based on two visits, I won’t be returning.

Amazing experience at JC Tavern and Table!
This place has held stories and memories for many years, and under the new ownership they’ve kept the true, welcoming feeling of Joe’s Place while elevating the entire experience. Now as JC Tavern and Table, you have the opportunity to enjoy a delicious menu that feels like dining in a luxury restaurant.

From fresh salads and comforting soups to perfectly cooked ribeye, roasted chicken, and mussels, the kitchen truly has it all — and the bar is just as impressive. The service is excellent, making every visit feel special.

Local bar atmosphere at it's best. It was my first time at JC's Tavern and I'll be going back. It has the Cheers atmosphere where everyone knows your name which is what I've been looking for close to home for 15 years. This area doesn't have this kind of a local bar. Local homey bars seems to be something from the past. From the apps to the entrees, the food was good. The staff was great. Super friendly. Bonus points for having red bull.

We were suspicious of 25 reviews and all 5 stars, and all fairly recent.  However we were VERY pleasantly surprised. It is a fabulous local bar, with very good food. A step up from the chain restaurants . This location has been a local bar since it was a speak-easy during prohibition according to one of the locals eating there. More recently know as Joe's, we were told It was recently bought by the gentleman who has been the Chef there for 2 years. The menu was very interesting and full of great sounding options. We shared the Brie and. artichoke hot dip, served with toasted good size cubes  of very good bread. A change from spinach and artichoke dip you see everywhere, and delicious!  We also split as Bison Burger topped with pepper jack cheese, red onion, tomato and lettuce, and a chipotle aioli.  Bison burgers can be very dry and ordinary since there is so little fat in the meat. These were perfectly prepared, at medium, juicy, but not so sloppy they dripped everywhere. The flavor was great! We also had sweet potato fries and a side salad that we split. A very well prepared, excellent meal. I wish they were located near me  in Portland Maine. I'd be a regular.  Our one complaint was there were no local beers on tap. We love to try local IPAs as we travel the country. We were told they are coming soon.
We are not related to anyone who works there. Found them on Google maps while visiting family in Maplewood. They are worth a stop.
This place is AWESOME! The food is UNBELIEVABLY GREAT and the bartender is AWESOME as well...It's karaoke night every night that she is there! I will DEFINITELY be back!

google_reviews.text: I’ve eaten here twice and been incredibly pleased both times. This time we tried the Johnny and the Joey and both were great. Not your traditional sandwich shop as the sandwiches are served on focaccia rounds but the bread is perfect and the flavors are incredible. Such a great addition to the neighborhood!

The sandwiches are different, but awesome.  Cut from a giant round, so you want about an 1/8 or 1/4 per person. Really nice, almost flat bread, good toppings. I was very impressed and keep thinking about that sandwich.

There is a childcare part in the back (paid) so it can get pretty loud inside, but if you ait up front or outside, not too bad.

More like a 3.5.

My wife and I ordered a hot coffee, an iced vanilla latte, and a few sandwiches. The food was solid—the sandwiches were expertly made, with flavors that blended perfectly without any single ingredient overpowering the others.

I ordered the sausage egg and cheese sandwich but I preferred my wife’s egg and cheese only.

However, I did have a mishap with my order, and I have to say, it likely wouldn’t have happened if the young lady at Shorty’s wasn’t wearing AirPods while taking orders and preparing food. In a food service setting, attention to detail must be the highest priority, and being fully present with customers should be the bare minimum.

While the food was remade, the follow-through service wasn’t great. I won’t share exactly what happened, but after a mistake like that, I would’ve expected something overwhelmingly valuable to make up for the mishap. Instead, it felt like an afterthought.

Customer service at the café needs to be a priority—there’s no excuse for distractions when handling people’s food. I’d love to give this place another shot, but they need to step up their service to match the quality of their food.

I crave no sandwich like I crave these sandwiches. They are so, so good. Fluffy, varied, fresh, moist rounds. 1/8 is enough for lunch. 1/4 is pure decadence. Due to my schedule, it is hard for me to hit them during their open window. When I miss it, I lean on the window peering inside trying not to cry.

I really don't love giving this place a dismal review but we came on Sunday evening (opening weekend) at 5:30pm and they were out of sandwiches and coupons that were advertised in their announcement e-mail. All of that is totally fine though, I ended up ordering a salad for takeout. The salad was completely wrong thought--what I thought was bacon (for a California sun salad) ended up being beets, there was no avocado or egg, and no other ingredients except for a bitter iceberg lettuce and a few cherry tomatoes. It was not only the wrong salad but just an overall bad-tasting meal. I do have photos of the salad (and of the salad in the trash) so that the owners know I'm not just trying to get free food.

I sent an extremely polite e-mail telling them I was rooting for them and that I love their sister restaurant Hi-Fi but that this was a pretty big mistake and I'd appreciate a refund. No response, so now I get to waste my time with the credit card company. Not my favorite intro to a restaurant.

Blue Rock made our first wedding anniversary an experience we will cherish forever. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that every detail had been thoughtfully planned with care and intention.

Head Chef Aaron curated a beautiful five-course menu for us in advance, and every single course was exceptional. The flavors were perfectly balanced, creative, and comforting all at once — each dish flowed seamlessly into the next and left us genuinely impressed. It was one of those meals where you pause, smile, and truly savor every bite.

Pastry Chef Ebony not only created a custom anniversary cake for us — which was absolutely delicious — but she was also our server for the evening. Her attentiveness, warmth, and genuine care made our night feel even more special. She anticipated every need and added such a personal touch to the entire experience.

We were also deeply touched by the personalized menu designed for our celebration, which read, “Happy Anniversary — cheers to one.” That simple yet thoughtful gesture meant so much to us. Sous Chef Diego and the entire team contributed to an atmosphere that felt warm, intimate, and welcoming. The ambiance was beautiful and private, and the complimentary sparkling wine was the perfect way to celebrate such an important milestone.

This was our first anniversary — the beginning of many more to come — and Blue Rock made sure it was unforgettable. Every detail, every flavor, and every gesture reflected genuine care. We cannot recommend this place enough and are already looking forward to returning.

A Pint of Shelter: Dodging D.C. Storms at Kelly’s The Irish Times

Kelly’s The Irish Times on Capitol Hill was the perfect place to swerve into to avoid an incoming storm approaching Washington, D.C. (Fri, May 30, 2025). The Irish pub had caught our eye during our earlier visit to D.C. the previous weekend.

Not only was it smaller than the surrounding buildings, but it had a much bigger Irish-looking neighbor that somehow made Kelly’s look more authentic, and that told us it had character - and we were right.

Kelly’s The Irish Times was a lively, atmospheric bar, self-described as “sometimes boisterous.” It was established in 1978 and is presumably named after the owner, Mr Brendan Kelly.

We sat at the bar and ordered:

🍺 Black & Blue = $8.62
🍺 Blue Moon x 2 = $16.36
⛔️ Alcohol Free Heineken x 3 = $21.00
😢 Tax = $4.60
💰 Total = $50.58

We left a gratuity that reflected the swift and attentive service. We enjoyed our time there and it was the kind of place we could’ve stayed all night, but the next day we were flying out of D.C. so needed to get some sleep.

Noticing a slight lull in the rain, we took our leave, pleased to have found hydration inside rather from the storm outside!

First time here and though it is a tribute to the men and women in blue, we probably won’t be back. The staff wasn’t very engaging and the atmosphere needs a major renovation. We did enjoy looking at all of the police badges from around the country.

The cost is a little high but it is so worth it for the freshness. They serve some alcohols but they offer good pairings for the meals offered.
I am so happy to have been able to enjoy this meal I had waited so long for.

Imagine a simpler time. You’re at your Italian friend’s grandmother’s house, where dinner is made the slow way because there’s nowhere else to be. It’s a long weekend, time is generous. You’ve already had her signature tipple, the one she still argues about with her doctor, and a little wine she schlepped back from Napoli.
Her Trini friend drops by, bringing family recipes and big energy, sharing stories and food with her adopted New Yorker grandkids (you and your goober friends). This table is everything: cozy, welcoming, eclectic.
You eat a hearty meal. She teaches you how to eat lamb brains, how to get every last bit of meat from the head. When you finish, she tells you she’s proud of you.
Then the bill comes, and some of the magic slips away. You take a little home with you.
This is what the world is supposed to be: a place where people are welcomed in, where differences are shared, and where you leave more open, more curious, more human than when you arrived. There’s plenty for everyone. We just have to learn how to share.

I was somewhat near City Centre and had been wanting to try Brother’s Pizza. I was intrigued because NYC style pizza is one of my favorite pizza styles. Also, they serve pizza by the slice, and that’s a rarity nowadays

The interior reminds me of a New York pizza parlor, but more spacious. It’s nothing fancy, just tables, cut-outs and pictures on the walls, and an open seating layout

The staff were fine. It felt more like a New York experience than a Texas/kore southern experience, but not in a bad way. Sort of added to the overall ambiance and experience

I ordered the Brother’s special which was practically a supreme pizza. It was good. The crust was crispy on the outside, but not too delicate or tough. They’re open 10am-11pm most nights, but they’re closed on Sundays. It looks like their online menu doesn’t show which ingredients are on the signature pizzas like the Brother’s special, so, you might want to call and order just to confirm

I had gone there prior when Sam was owning it- but it's currently under what appears to be new management and they are fantastic.

That said- they serve Pizza and it's really good- but you're missing out if you only order Pizza from here. They offer a variety of good Italian-American food, but now they've got options for Indian food on the menu, some of which includes a fusion of all three cultures which is really interesting and tastes fantastic, if you give it a chance.

The staff is all kind and friendly- willing to talk with you, explain items on the menu, and the portions are generous and more than enough.

If you are in the market for a Pizza choice, the new Primo Chicken is great. The chicken is well seasoned and juicy, and the vegetables are similar to a Supreme Pizza without the olives- but there's an addition of tomatoes which, trust me, is just really great.

If you want something from the Indian menu and have no clue where to start or what to do- just get the Butter Chicken and Maybe some Extra Naan bread. They make it fresh, in-house just like everything else on the menu and it's not remotely like the stuff you get pre-frozen or made at the store- it's perfectly crisp and light, yet so pliable and hardy for the meal.

Some other person commented negatively about the aesthetic on the inside- I'm not sure what they are on about. It's well lit, they have some kind of movie going to watch while you enjoy your meal, the tables are clean (as is the restroom), and the staff offer extra silverware, napkins, or whatever you generally need as you need it without question. The fluorescent lights definitely aren't like a neon-white shade like new ones but that hardly matters when the inside has people who greet you with a smile and immediately come over to help you once you walk up to the counter.

google_reviews.text: THEIR SFINICIONE PIZZA IS OUT OF THIS WORLD!!!  It’s worth coming from NJ for it!   I also loved their sun-dried tomato and olive Sicilian!  The other slices I tried were all very good!  They excel at making Sicilian pizza!  I highly recommend Mangia in Staten Island!

My husband and I ate at Mangia the other day for lunch. It was delicious. My husband ordered the Filet of Sole Oreganata and I ordered the Fusilli all a Sandra (Pasta with Artichoke, sun dried tomatoes, olives, garlic and oil topped with toasted marinated breadcrumbs) Yum!
The Filet of Sole Oreganata, was also delicious I had a little piece of my husbands. Besides the food being great the owner Pete is also very welcoming. We enjoyed a cold corona with our lunch. I definitely recommend this place for lunch or dinner. I almost forgot they serve garlics knots and toasted bread with sauce instead of bread. You’ll see it in my pictures.

Mangia is a great spot! The pasta dishes and panini were fresh and flavorful — the chicken parm hero and penne alla vodka were both delicious with good portion sizes. Service was friendly and efficient, staff was attentive without hovering. Nice, clean, casual atmosphere — perfect for a quick lunch or takeout. Solid Italian comfort food!

Mangia, Mangia, Mangia just added to the rotation. New to the area and wanted to try this place out. Heard all the locals go there. And now i know why. Pizza fantastic. Service was perfect they played nice Italian music while we ate. Perfect on pricing. Heres some photos of our time here.

name: La Bella Pizza
document: La Bella Pizza. cuisine: Pizza. located in Staten_Island. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
After months of passing this pizza place, I finally decided to give it a try—and I’m so glad I did! From the moment we walked in, we were warmly welcomed. Our server, who impressively managed everything on his own, was quick and efficient when taking our drink orders.

Now, let’s talk about the pizza—delicious! We ordered the supreme, with half meat lovers and half pepperoni, and it did not disappoint. The crust was exactly how I like it: thin, crispy, and perfectly well-done.

Overall, a great experience, and I can’t wait to come back for more!

La Bella Pizza Review

This was our second time ordering from La Bella’s, and both experiences were great! We ordered a large supreme pizza (no black olives, swapped ham for bacon, and added extra sauce). They got the order perfect both times, and the pizza was absolutely delicious.

For our second order, we added mango habanero wings — asked for extra crispy. The flavor was really good, but they weren’t quite as crispy as we hoped, so we popped them in the air fryer to finish them off (trying not to burn that tasty sauce!).

Overall, La Bella’s has definitely become our favorite pizza spot since moving to Virginia almost a year ago. 🍕

This was our first time trying this place.  And, since we spent almost $60 for two Sicilian pies that were insultingly small, plus the one cheese pie was supposed to have double extra cheese, for ~$6 extra, that was not covered in ~$6 extra in cheese, and the other pie didn’t have extra cheese, it will be the only time we patronize this establishment.
The young lady behind the counter was pleasant, and the interior was clean and inviting, but that’s not going to bring me back.

Ordered on doordash bc the pics looked really good. I would arrogantly consider myself a pizza expert and this instantly went to #1 pizza in town. I am a huge Brothers pizza fan and always will be, this is definitely different so there's room for both in my life. Excellent char on the pie, excellent garlic knots. Already texting my friends telling them about it. Well done!

Bought two specially pies (white and New York style).  Zero complaints. I’ll be going here over the chain pizza joints from here on out. About the same pricing as papa John’s. If you want cheap mid pizza go to little Caesar’s. If you want authentic home made pizza La Bella is the place to go.

name: Crispy Pizza
document: Crispy Pizza. cuisine: Pizza. located in Staten_Island. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: My Fiance and I decided to try this place for our Friday night takeout and we’re so happy we did because this pizza is SO good. And we are big pizza people! The guy at the front was also super nice and personable, this will be our new go to pizza for sure! Thank you crispy crust :)

Crispy Crust Pizza in Easton is under new owners and it is fantastic!   You can really tell they care about what they are doing. The food is top quality with fresh ingredients, perfect crust, and everything cooked just right. The service was warm and welcoming and they treated everyone like family. It is rare to see owners this involved and passionate about their customers. Easton is lucky to have them. If you have not tried Crispy Crust Pizza yet, do yourself a favor and stop in. Great people, great service, and amazing pizza.

I have a lot of opinions about the lack of quality and care when it comes to restaurant food these days—few and far between are the mom and pop shops with self-made and handed down recipes, and plentiful are chain restaurants and places who have given in to the Sysco-ification and homogenizing of food (have you noticed that many restaurants have food that tastes the same? Every place has the same kind of French fries, mozzarella sticks, etc.?)

Every town in MA has a bunch of random pizza places, usually a pretty doughy pie with low quality ingredients that is meant to get you full for a reasonable price. What I like about Crispy Crust and what distinguishes them is that there is very clearly care and intentionality put into the food, from the recipe for the dough and sauce, to the quality of the ingredients (pepperoni that curls into cups!), to the final presentation.

Ultimately, the food tastes good—at least two steps above a regular “house of pizza”. The quality of the food is better than other places at the same price. The owner seems to be a very nice guy who is putting in the work since taking over in October of 2025. I’ve ordered pizza here twice and also had a catering order for a birthday party and was very satisfied each time. The catering prices, especially the Greek Feast sampler, are really amazing. This is undoubtedly my go-to neighborhood pizza spot.

Congratulations to the new owner, Nick Arone, of Crispy Crust Pizzeria, Easton! We had the best time and most delicious meal. This was the first opportunity we had in the 3 weeks since you took over the business to visit.

Thank you for creating the BEST Gluten-Free pizza for us!!! (Hubby doesn't need to be Gluten-Free, but really enjoyed this one.) The melding of salty/spicy/sweet flavors was perfection! The grilled chicken on the salad was, per your recommendation, flavorful and tender. Can't wait to visit again 🍕🥗😋

We highly recommend you take the time to speak to Nick when you visit, to feel his passion for serving you his most delicious  creations. (Forgot to take pictures...)

This was my first order from Crispy Crust. I just met the new owner Nick, who seems like a really nice guy, and his daughter. Nick said that he's owned the place for about a week. My medium ham pizza was very good. Good cheese, good sauce, nice crispy crust, good ham. I look forward to ordering again. I suggest anyone else in this area give the place a try.

name: Mona Lisa Pizzeria
document: Mona Lisa Pizzeria. cuisine: Pizza Italian. located in Staten_Island. with 3.9 stars (good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
A Staten Island Pizza Gem – Creative, Delicious, and a Must-Try!

Staten Island has no shortage of great pizza, but this spot takes it to another level with some of the most creative specialty pies around. They don’t just experiment—they nail it every time. Whether you’re a traditionalist or looking for something unique, their flavors are always on point, with high-quality ingredients and perfectly crisp crusts.

The must-try? Their award-winning (or gold medal) pie—I wish I remembered the exact name, but trust me, it’s a winner for a reason. Every bite is packed with bold flavors, and you can tell they put serious thought into their combinations.

If you’re in Staten Island and love great pizza with a creative twist, this place is a must-visit. You won’t be disappointed!

I’ve been coming here for years.  The food is fantastic. Must try rhe mortadella on focaccia bread with pistachio pesto.  It’s amazing.  The pizza specials of the day are interesting and good.  The food from the kitchen is fresh and made to order.  If this place is not on your list, you def have to add it.

When we dine in, the food is always fresh, and the staff is super friendly. When we order online, delivery is often very fast; the food is hot and made to order. The drivers are kind and friendly. Highly recommend Mona Lisa Pizzeria. Thank you to Jeffrey, our driver, for being such a nice and kind human being.

We love coming to Mona Lisa Pizzeria and Ristorante! It’s a great spot for the whole family. My kids always enjoy their regular slices—fresh, tasty, and just the right size. As for me, I can’t get enough of the Buffalo Rolls. They’re packed with flavor and have just the right kick. The food is consistently great, and the atmosphere is welcoming. Highly recommend for a casual meal with delicious options for everyone!

Completely underwhelmed by their gluten free Sicilian pie. Firstly, it was VERY small compared to other pizzerias. Most gluten free pizzas fit the size of a small pizza box. As you can see in my photo this was a tiny pie. There was hardly any sauce and practically no flavor. Lastly, this was a premade crust and expensive at $19 for practically nothing. I can say delivery was quick, but that’s the only positive and why I’d give any stars.

document: Cookies N Cream. cuisine: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt Desserts. located in Staten_Island. with 5.0 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Great local ice cream shop serving up multiple flavors of ice cream (I didn’t count but I would say at least 31 flavors) in just about any combo you can think of. There is also a selection of sorbets. We had regular cake cones with red raspberry sorbet, rainbow sherbet and mint chip. All creamy smooth and delicious! They also offer custom sundaes and custom ice cream sandwiches in addition to the regular scoops plus they offer more substantial food options from their sister restaurant Ghosted Concepts. Servers are fast and friendly, keeping the line moving. There are picnic style tables outside as well as indoor seating. Highly recommend!

This is our go to ice cream place in Haymarket.  Haven't tried ghosted Concepts yet.

Get their coconut ice cream and thank me later!

This was a cute old house turned into an ice cream shop. As you walk in, you smell the old wood then the cookie smell hits you. We enjoyed out cookies and cream ice cream and also tried vanilla bean and monster. It was all really good. It wasn't the best I've had but if you're in the area, you should certainly stop by.

This is a great ice cream shop and the perfect stop on the way back to DC from hiking around the Shenandoah. The staff is friendly and helpful with the enormous selection. There's a Pac-man arcade game, although at the time it was broken. The atmosphere is very cool with plenty of seating inside and outside on the patio. The shake I got tasted great! I really wish I could give them 5 stars, but unfortunately my last bite included a piece of plastic which I believe probably fell off the stirring machine.

If you ever find yourself in Haymarket, do yourself a favor and check this place out. The shop is in a home they moved from the town. The staff is friendly and there is plenty of seating inside or out. They serve a variety of Giffords ice cream. Giffords is an iconic ice cream shop in the DC area. Yes, you can really tell the difference. You can taste the quality with every bite! They do offer shakes and cookies among other things on their menu. The Mint Chocolate Chip is always good!

document: Yallah Habibi. cuisine: Desserts. located in Staten_Island. with 4.1 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: I had a really good experience at this location. Would highly recommend them over Bora Bora. I was immediately greeted upon entering. I asked for the Strawberry cup as pictured below. The pistachio was amazing not artificial. I also ordered a coconut matcha was I believe is one of the best matcha. Not overly sweet and perfectly made. Would highly recommend!

I like going to this place for the strawberries in a cup (16 dollars), it's a nice treat to have, especially if you're going for a walk. Moreover, I love how the strawberries balance out the sweetness of everything else. In fact, the chocolate in it is actually surprisingly warm, perfect for the cold weather in Staten Island. The crepes are also good, I had one with my mom, we both agreed it was sweet but the fruits help with the sweetness management.

The portion size is good, maybe a bit pricy, but it surprisingly filled me up and I had some leftover. It's very sweet, and I feel like there should be more strawberries. So, that's why I took off one star. I tried a crepe here before, and they loaded it, so you get your money's worth, but it's very sweet.

I'm a teenager with a huge sweet tooth occasionally, so maybe my review is biased, but I like this place! However, I don't go daily, still I recommend to try this place!
Best dessert spot on Staten Island. I come here later in the night to satisfy my sweet cravings and they do not disappoint!

A darling place as soon as you enter, met with  smiles and sweets!

Knafe was delicious, Class Crepe was perfect & of course the ice cream. Superb! Thank you for a lovely dessert trip.

Yallah Habibi is an amazing dessert spot and definitely worth the visit. We ordered a crepe and the Yallah Habibi fruit salad, and both were absolutely delicious. The crepe was perfectly made—soft, fresh, and filled generously—and the fruit salad was incredibly fresh, colorful, and refreshing. You can really tell they use high-quality ingredients and take pride in their presentation.

On top of the great desserts, the atmosphere is welcoming and the staff is friendly and attentive, which makes the experience even better. It’s the perfect place to stop for something sweet, whether you’re craving a light dessert or something more indulgent. Highly recommend, and we’ll definitely be coming back!

document: Laza Dessert Cafe. cuisine: Desserts Middle Eastern. located in Staten_Island. with 4.1 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: Laza Dessert Cafe in Astoria is such a great spot if you’re in the mood for something sweet and refreshing. They have a really nice variety of desserts, and the coffee menu is surprisingly big with a lot of different drinks to choose from. What I really liked is their selection of lemonades and virgin mojitos super refreshing and perfect if you don’t drink alcohol. Everything was well made and the place has a nice vibe to sit and relax. Definitely worth stopping by if you’re in the area.

Laza Dessert Cafe is an absolute gem! Their kunafa, crepes, and Dubai chocolate are incredibly delicious, each item tastes freshly made and full of flavor. The prices are very affordable, which makes enjoying great desserts even better. The cafe has a cozy, well-lit atmosphere that makes it the perfect place to relax with friends or family.

On top of that, the staff are friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help. Highly recommend Laza Dessert Cafe for anyone looking for amazing desserts and a warm dining experience!

To be honest not a bad place to go. The place has style for one. I mean the color scheme of the restaurant and the branded bags and boxes are really something special. Not to mention that this spot is the 2nd place owned by the famous influencer “The ocky way” or as he is known Mohammad Rakim. He got famous for doing sandwich collabs with celebrities that come out to Brooklyn to his deli and order absurd sandwich combos mostly just chopped cheeses and the basics. This place however was pretty cool. They had a released party where everyone online would get a free kunafa ice cream sandwich desert in the summer on Friday. I stayed for about 40 mins before leaving because people were skipping the lines and nothing was moving. The prices for the food selection is pricey. I paid $15 for a small kunafa and pistachio filled ice cream sandwich bar topped off with Oreo chocolate chip bits. The taste was phenomenal I mean downright dreamilicious. However they did take about 10-20 minutes to make which felt like an awful long time for such a simple desert option and I can’t get behind the prices. Everything was about $10 over and the only things that weren’t were the signature drinks which I didn’t try granted. Overall not a bad place to visit for the onetime but I wouldn’t recommend coming back here because it can get awfully packed and busy.

Laza desert Cafe was so INCREDIBLE!! Staff was helpful and kind. The Laza special was something I cannot describe but it’s Amazing.
Ma one of the employees gave us some eclairs with different sweet and scrumptious sauce. This place is a 10/10

Honestly, Laza is one of the best spots I’ve tried. Their Adeni tea is perfectly made with a rich, authentic flavor, and the kunafa is super delicious and melts in your mouth. The place is clean, cozy, and has a nice atmosphere.

I also want to thank the staff, especially Mohammed. He’s very polite, friendly, and provides excellent service that makes you feel valued as a customer.
They truly deserve a high rating 👌🏼✨

google_reviews.text: I have no words!!!! This cake was a show stopper!!! Angie is more than a cake decorator, she is an artist and brings to life your vision! This cake was absolutely delicious too.  I will never go anywhere else for my cake needs. Angie is the real deal and absolutely incredible!! Look at this cake she made!! It’s out of this world!!!

Alfonso's Pastry Shoppe is a Staten Island classic and still going strong after 55 years! Stopped by the Victory Blvd spot and everything was fresh and delicious—the cannoli were creamy with that perfect crisp shell (filled right, not soggy), rainbow cookies layered beautifully with just the right almond flavor, and the tiramisu cup was rich and coffee-forward without being too sweet. Grabbed some 7-layer cookies and a slice of chocolate mousse cake too—top-notch quality and generous portions for the price.
I loved the cake. Even when this was my first time ordering a cake the person explained it very well on what goes on a cake, filling etc. loved the result and process. Priced very well too (~60)

Ordering a custom cake is the only option here as of recently, any other premade pastry taste like freezer burn. At first I thought it was one or maybe 2 instances where I got a bad tasting freezer burn cake, but it’s been like the last 4x every pastry , cake , even cupcakes that are in the fridge display taste like the fridge air it’s gross. google_reviews.text:
I have been eating Rispoli cake: vanilla, with strawberry, cannoli, rum and whipped cream for over 50 years...its the best. Love the pasteries...all legit.

A true gem.  I also heard they had a pop up shop in Ridgefield for Thanksgiving 2025.

Enjoy.

Rispoli Bakery
25 Emerson Plaza East
Emerson NJ 07630

Chocolate Éclair
Lobster Tail
Chocolate Mousse Bar
Tiramisu
Napoleon

Appearance: 10/10
Taste: 10/10

Before I learned how to make reels, I previously posted about this locally owned  bakery on Emerson Plaza East across the street from the Emerson Train Station.

I enjoyed the desserts so much that I wanted to explore more sweets and treats.

Explore the small pastries or indulge in the large desserts.

Chocolate Éclair:
This dessert was filled with creamy vanilla custard.

The only problem was I ordered the smaller size, but I quickly learned my lesson and will definitely purchase the larger éclair next time.

Lobster Tail:
This pastry has a flaky crust with crunchy exterior and is filled with chantilly cream.  Due to its shape, it is  definitely a perfect dessert version of the popular seafood

Chocolate Mousse Bar:
Calling all chocolate lovers!  The chocolate sponge cake has a layer of mousse with ganache on top.  It’s so chocolatey, you’ll start to crave chocolate the same way Chocolate Boy yearns for this sweet treat.

Tiramisu (not pictured):
If you are a fan of coffee flavored desserts, the tiramisu is right up your alley.  In addition to coffee flavor, there is also  a perfect amount of mascarpone cheese with chocolate cocoa.

Napoleon (not pictured):
You won’t find any black and white swirls on this napoleon, but the taste is still phenomenal.  The spongy cake is soaked in rum.  It has a crusty texture and layered with vanilla custard cream.  There is definitely more than a fair share of powdered sugar sprinkled on top

It was a pleasure re-visiting this bakery and further exploring more desserts.

The only miss for us was the lavender latte—the floral notes were a bit too strong for our taste. Everything else, though, was beautifully made and clearly high quality. It does get busy and seating is limited, but it’s still a great stop if you love matcha-forward desserts. We’d definitely come back to try more from the menu.

The best cream puffs in NYC! 🧁 The Earl Grey flavor is a game-changer—crispy on the outside and overflowing with silky cream inside. Their specialty lattes are also fantastic and beautifully crafted. Super cute vibe and great for anyone with a sweet tooth. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re near the Theater District!

Will be revisiting this dessert shop after 2-3years which was about 3years ago. Love to drop by and have a piece of heaven whenever I visit NYC. Bought the matcha cream puff and it exceeded my expectations! Crusty on the outside and generous with the fillings! Super yummy for dessert lovers like me 😍 (pic were taken during my first visit).

Bibble & Sip is easily one of the best little café gems in NYC. Everything here feels thoughtful—from the beautiful pastries to the perfectly crafted coffee. The cream puffs are absolutely outstanding: light, airy, and filled with rich, flavorful cream that isn’t overly sweet. You can really tell the ingredients are high quality and made with care.

The coffee was just as impressive. Smooth, balanced, and expertly prepared, making it the perfect pairing with their pastries. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and the staff is friendly and efficient even when it’s busy.

If you’re anywhere near Midtown and love great coffee and unique pastries, Bibble & Sip is a must-stop. Definitely a place I’ll keep coming back to whenever I’m in the city

I have wanted to try this place for ages. Their desserts are super cute. Visually they are appealing  but they miss the mark on flavor. A lot is for the visual appeal and adding elements that do not need to be there. I had the everything croissant, panda cake and black sesame cream puff. The panda cake lacked flavor and the base was dry. The cream puffs choux was overdone, so was not fluffy. The everything croissant was not flaky/buttery and overbaked as should be. I also ordered a peachy lechee tea and asked for less sugar. That translated to less flavor, not just less sugar, was like  drinking a lightly flavored water. But the woman at the front was very helpful at accommodating - cannot fault the service. Kind and attentive.

name: Gigi's Cupcakes
document: Gigi's Cupcakes. cuisine: Bakeries Cupcakes Desserts. located in Staten_Island. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
We cannot say enough good things about our cake and cupcake vendor! We received so many compliments from our guests on how absolutely delicious everything was. You could truly taste the quality—every bite was rich, fresh, and clearly made with top-notch ingredients.

On top of that, the service was flawless—professional, responsive, and genuinely kind throughout the whole process. They really listened to what we wanted and brought our vision to life beautifully.

Our wedding cake turned out gorgeous—it was almost too pretty to eat (but of course, we did, and it was amazing!). Some of our favorite wedding photos are with the cake, that’s how stunning it was.

Highly, highly recommend them to anyone looking for something that tastes as incredible as it looks.

The cupcakes were really bad. I tried the oreo. The cake itself was good, frosting was sickly sweet so I took it off. The cookie dough cupcake was either supposed to be actual raw dough or it was underbaked, I’m not sure. The red velvet cake was ok, frosting too sweet. Chocolate with chocolate frosting was the best one I tried. The berries one was odd that it had lemon cake rather than yellow/vanilla. Also the strawberry jam inside the berry cupcake was very artificial tasting and texture. Overall it was a lot of money to pay for 6 cupcakes when I threw out most of them without finishing the whole thing. I probably should not sample 6 cupcakes in one day, but this is what the Patriots of ‘76 died for.

I have seen this place forever but never stopped. Found out they had gluten free options so decided to give it a try! I was excited! However I was disappointed. The emphasis seems to be on the tall mound of buttercream or cream cheese icing on each cupcake rather than the short little flat cake. It was also extremely expensive. We paid $50 for a variety of about 6 cupcakes (a mix of regular and gluten free). The buttercream was too sweet for me but I know a lot of people like it. Please give it a try, though, because you might like it!

Similar review to another failed wedding in September. We chose Gigi’s early in our wedding process, paid in full on the day we signed our contract. Had multiple phone calls confirming our order all the way up to the week before our wedding. Our order was supposed to be delivered at 3pm on our wedding day. Our coordinator waited until 3:30/4pm to start calling inquiring about our order. Took several calls and was told the baker quit and they did not have our order. My coordinator asked them to bring something asap- they arrived after 6pm. Gigi’s brought a $12.98 Walmart cake and completely frozen and the wrong flavors of our contracted cupcakes. We spent days after our wedding attempting to get in touch with the (now previous owner) Shane. We finally received a callback and were told we would be fully refunded from him “personally”. After over a month of fighting we received around $200 (half the amount of our order). We are not longer pushing to receive any additional funds because it is not worth the fight. But this review serves as a warning to the community and brides out there. I would NOT RECOMMEND in anyway to use this business.

$5 seems kinda pricey for a cupcake to me, but they are what I consider "boutique cupcakes" and priced fairly for what they are. Definitely for a "treat yourself" or celebrate moment, not everyday. The staff was friendly and the shop was very clean. It looked nice inside, with everything arranged in a visually appealing way. It is nice to have this here as an option. I would go back again for cupcakes for future celebrations.

document: Nana Baking. cuisine: Bakeries. located in Staten_Island. with 4.8 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
So there was a snafu with my order and while I wasn’t exactly happy as it happened in Christmas Eve, the staff/owner were all very nice and they’re a small business doing what they can on a holiday with their family. Plus their baked goods are delicious!

Two stand outs are the black sesame Swiss rolls and the durian cream puffs. It’s been a year since my last review, and I think they improved the black sesame flavor. A full Swiss roll was $28 and so worth it. The durian cream puffs has a chunk of durian in it and the choux was crisp. Durian cream puffs sell out often.

The chestnut mini cake is super cute, and honestly, it’s hard to find chestnut flavored things here anymore.

If I had to label this bakery anything, it would be the Chinese bakery that has all the nostalgic flavors with modern takes. Most Chinese bakeries by here don’t do black sesame, durian or chestnut anymore. And this place does it well, and they’re nice.

NOTE: to order, they prefer WeChat. My ordering snafu happened bc I tried calling and there was a language miscommunication between WeChat/text messaging. WeChat is the easiest way to place orders.

Love the quick turnaround for my order. I put in an order for 400 macarons for my event and they really delivered. I loved that the macarons were not too sweet and fresh. Delicious durian pandan cake! The pandan spongecake was really complimented the 2 THICK layers of durian in between. The fondant outer design of billards was also perfect 🤩

name: Blue Pearl Staten Island
document: Blue Pearl Staten Island. cuisine: Seafood. located in Staten_Island. with 4.2 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
We came here for Sunday brunch at noon. Although we had a reservation, the restaurant wasn’t very busy. We were greeted promptly by the hostess, and the atmosphere was modern and nicely updated.

Our waiter was attentive, and the rest of the staff also made sure we were well taken care of. The food arrived fairly quickly, and while the quality was good, nothing really stood out as exceptional in terms of flavor. Portion sizes were generally ok.

Prices, however, felt higher than expected for both the setting and the dishes we ordered. The crab Benedict, for example, had a very small crab cake—essentially one patty split between two eggs. The tuna was cooked properly and had good flavor, and the teriyaki salmon was also quite good.

We ordered a few drinks, which were just okay. Like many places, they add a surcharge for non-cash payments, but they also suggest tips based on the total after tax and fees, which feels a bit out of place for a restaurant aiming for an upscale experience.

Overall, the food was good and service attentive, but the value didn’t quite match the high prices.

I have been dining at Chef Peter Botros restaurants for years! Blue Pearl was absolutely exquisite. The inside of the restaurant was beautiful, the staff was very welcoming and friendly, and the food was spectacular! Our waiter was Manny and he really provided such a lovely service! We started out with the oysters and shrimp cocktail, the octopus, and the New England chilled lobster rolls. Our entrees were the Angry Ramen and crab Cavatelli. Everything was perfection and we had a great time!!

To say blue pearl is amazing is an absolute understatement! My husband & I just had our wedding there & we couldn’t have chosen a better venue. From the ambience, to the view of the city, to the drinks, the food & the service and staff, we were absolutely BLOWN AWAY!!! Everything was pure perfection. The drinks were delicious and the food was just outstanding. We were beyond impressed by the service and staff, especially Alex who took care of us all night!! And a big thank you to Nastacha who helped plan this event and helped make it so wonderful! She was so easy to get in touch with and just an absolute pleasure to work with!! We truly can’t thank Blue Pearl enough for making our wedding so special. Our family and friends cannot stop raving about it and neither can we! Thank you blue pearl!!!

Blue Pearl is a gorgeous restaurant; that is perhaps where the pleasantries end.  I was tremendously disappointed with the food; raw bar items were good, apps, mains, and dessert, were incredibly bland and completely devoid of taste. Service was neither good nor commensurate to the price-point.  Check this place out, hopefully you will have a better experience than I did.

Glad to know that my favorite area in Staten Island got the perfect seafood restaurant.
The service we received was outstanding, beyond professional and welcoming, and cozy at the same time.
I, personally was happy to discover the availability of Kumamoto oysters.   Which I always struggle to find even in the City.
All over, we had amazing experiences and truly tasty and fresh dining.
Every dish has a harmony of notes and smells.
Everything was freshly cooked and tasted great.
The price is fully understandable and reasonable.
So, if you have a special celebration or are just up for a delicious food experience - that’s the place!

google_reviews.text: Aunt Butchie’s Desserts is absolutely amazing! Everything we tried was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly sweet. You can truly taste the care and quality in every dessert. The service was friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere made the experience even better. This is definitely my go-to spot whenever I’m craving something sweet. Highly recommend!

Chances are if you’ve ever had a slice of chocolate mousse cake at a restaurant in the N.Y. area it came from Aunt Butchies. (Not necessarily from this location) The mousse cakes here are amazing. They also have a variety of other cakes from red velvet to various cheesecakes & a sample cake with 3 slices each of some of their most popular cakes. The cakes are perfect for office parties as they come pre sliced. Typically 14 slices per cake separated by a piece of wax paper. Keep in mind these cakes are Never fresh & always frozen. As they are not baked at this location. So I would recommend buying your cake the day before and placing it in the fridge. Probably because I can be impatient at times but it just feels like they take forever to defrost. They also have cheesecake cones & an interesting assortment of cookies. Including some as large as a cupcake. They have three small tables that seat two. Two of which are outside & one indoors. Other than cookies or an ice cream shake all the other desserts in the display case (freezer with glass door) are frozen & should be defrosted before serving. Next time your craving something sweet give Aunt Butchies a try.

Amazing dessert selection. I’ve been here multiple times and have loved everything I’ve tried so far. My favorites are the rainbow cookies and NY style cheesecake. You can tell everything is baked in house and fairly fresh. Cookies are delicious too. Well worth the visit.

Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for delicious treats and a warm, welcoming atmosphere!

​🏮 Tokyo Vibes in the City: A Must-Visit Ramen & Boba Spot!
​After my partner first surprised me here (knowing how much I love cooking ramen at home!), I knew I had to bring my sister and her partner back for a family catch-up dinner. Even on my second visit, Kinya Ramen & Sushi continues to be a standout "critic’s pick" for me.

​🍜 The Experience
​Walking in, you are immediately transported. The decor gives off a distinct Tokyo, Japan vibe that makes the dining experience feel like a mini-vacation. It’s the perfect backdrop for a cozy dinner or a special family gathering.
​🥤 The "Must-Try" Drink
​If you visit, you cannot leave without trying the Brown Sugar Boba Tea.
​It was so good that it turned my sister into an instant fan!
​In fact, she loved it so much she has already gone back with her partner just to get it again. It’s rich, perfectly sweet, and the boba texture is spot on.

​👩‍🍳 Exceptional Service (The "One-Woman Wonder")
​During our visit, there was only one server on shift, but you would never have known it by the quality of service.
​Efficiency: Every dish was delivered exactly on time.
​Energy: She was incredibly positive, full of energy, and checked on us every chance she got.
​The Personal Touch: She even went above and beyond to take a group photo for us on my Polaroid camera so we could have a physical memory of our night. That kind of hospitality is rare!

​🍣 The Verdict
​Whether you are a ramen enthusiast who cooks it at home or a first-timer, Kinya Ramen is the real deal. Between the immersive atmosphere and the top-tier boba, it’s a 5-star experience all around.

google_reviews.text:
Don’t think, just go! This establishment deserves all of its flowers and then some! I’ve had a fair share of Korean cuisine in the States — including high-end Michelin rated restaurants in NYC and the typical Korean fare often found suburbs. I’ve made my own Korean food. But nothing compares to the kindest server/host who takes your order and makes you feel at home immediately when you step in, showers you with lovingly prepared banchan (Korean side dishes), and envelops your taste buds and senses with expertly prepared food from what feels like her own home kitchen.

The Korean fried chicken rivals, if not bests, the quality and flavor of the chicken in Osamil — crispy light exterior that shatters in one bite with a flavor explosion of savory, sticky sauce and tender chicken. I would love to see a soy and/or garlic based sauce one day, but this one was excellent!

The beef (meat) jeon is something I never had before — a delightfully marinated bulgogi fillet enveloped in a light eggy crepe-like batter that blew my mind. How could something so seemingly simple remind me of a banquet style roast duck?

And the kimbap — just a perfect fresh Korean-sushi package affectionally made for your perfect bite.

I will most definitely be coming back, for the food and the hospitality!!

document: Yasuo Ramen And Sushi. cuisine: Ramen Sushi Bars. located in Staten_Island. with 3.6 stars (good).

google_reviews.text: The spicy miso ramen was absolutely amazing—rich, flavorful broth with the perfect amount of heat. The shrimp and vegetable tempura was equally decadent and tasty, crispy and light, and a perfect complement to the ramen. On top of that, the customer service was fantastic—friendly and attentive. Every bite was satisfying, and I can’t wait to return for more of this deliciousness!

The food from this restaurant is absolutely incredible! I’ve ordered delivery several times, and the quality is always outstanding. I’ve tried the pork gyozas, the California sushi roll, and the hibachi fried rice with pork — every single dish has been delicious and full of amazing flavor. Even through delivery, the food arrives fresh, well-packaged, and perfectly prepared, which says a lot about their quality and attention to detail.

What I love most is that the flavors are truly memorable — you can tell they use fresh ingredients and really care about their food. It’s rare to find a place where everything tastes this good every single time. I’ve tried other restaurants, but this one has definitely become my favorite in the area.

The portions are great, the food arrives hot, and the taste is unbeatable. For delivery, they are fast, consistent, and everything always arrives just as ordered. This restaurant absolutely deserves 5 stars — highly recommended if you want delicious food and reliable service!

I’ve ate at this restaurant several times and highly recommend them. The food is delicious and the service is exceptional. The restaurant is usually pretty quiet and calm. The food arrives quickly and the employees are attentive. The price is reasonable. My husband and I usually share the 3 roll special (salmon avocado, spicy crunchy crab and shrimp tempura) with a side of hibachi chicken fried rice or chicken teriyaki.

Went for an early solo dinner and had a great experience! Clean and quiet atmosphere, attentive wait staff, and delicious food. Recommended to sit at the sushi bar if you're solo eating or with a friend, the sushi and sashimi dishes get handed to you direct!

First time having Ramen & OH what an experience!!
My fiancé, God daughter, & I had all never had a true Ramen experience / meal. On a random Friday we decided to try it & this was the closest location with the better quality reviews. So why not?!

Hands down the best idea we had!!
Myself & my fiancé are vegan & my God daughter is a 4 year old shrimp & noodle loving foodie.

Let’s just say that we were ALL satisfied with our meals. The vegan ramen was 10/10 & the tofu in it was seasoned to perfection. Based on how my God daughter devoured her shrimp ramen I’m going to assume that it was also 10/10!

We got the scallion pancakes & terryaki tofu as an appetizer which came with a small side of white rice & broccoli. Everything was absolutely delicious and FRESH!!

The location was extremely clean & at that time we were the only ones seated for service. However, they seemed to be pretty busy with online orders which further proved the quality of this place!

The service was great! Not overwhelming but not too distance to where we felt forgotten.

We will definitely be returning!

name: The Cheeky Chicken
document: The Cheeky Chicken. cuisine: Chicken Wings. located in Staten_Island. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
The Cheeky Chicken seems to be a more reasonably priced, local-business version of the popular Korean fried chicken establishments that have been showing up over the last few years.

I learned from one of their co-owners that this place (one of a few they’ve recently opened) is their own business learned after years of franchising experience. They wanted to have quality sauces they controlled, rather than ingredients shipped from Korea.

I ordered a wing box with spicy soy garlic, with a side of honey butter fries, and a Korean pear drink.

The honey butter fries are one of the more unique things they offer, with a sprinkling of a savory sweet powder on top of lightly crunchy fries.

They’re located in a small strip off of RT-22 but seemed to have decent traffic while I dined in at the small window-facing seating.

Would come again, thanks!

The food was really good! I ordered the chee-gam chicken over fries. The cashier looked like he was the owner, but incredibly friendly polite and professional, he was also very helpful to explain things for me. He even helped me pick a sauce to my taste liking. I wish every business had this guy working their register! Would definitely come back to try the dumplings!

Food is lit! Good korean find with a twist! Bar seating. About 8 seats on approximation.  Clean and good airconditioning. Quick service. Ample of parking space. Just watch out for the signage so you don’t miss the entrance. No high chair seen or koala kare on restroom. See attached for reference.

Didn’t have time to take a photo cause I was too hungry.

That was scrumptious!!! The owner/server was very nice and offered help in our choices.

We loved the chicken - it was truly a delight. The Sweet & Spicy sauce is great - I had it on the side. I ordered with spicy soy garlic and it had a nice kick but not enough spice, personally.

Tried The Cheeky Chicken for the first time and I definitely need to come back. I ordered the Chee-Gam, chicken dumplings, a strip box, and a strawberry refresher with mango popping bubbles - everything was fresh, flavorful, and just so good. The food presentation was just as amazing as the taste.

I think the cashier noticed it was my first time (I was busy taking pics of everything lol) and was super friendly and welcoming. The menu has a lot of great options too - can't wait to come back and try their Ddukbokki next! Definitely recommend if you love bold, delicious food

Foosing
Beaver Bank

Consistantly good here. Combo comes with an egg roll as well.  I always order an extra so I get two meals. My son however, usually finishes his😆.
Chicken fried rice, egg roll, beef and broccoli, chicken balls, the combo is under 17$

Adding a few extra pics from a previous order too.

First time eating here, we've not been able to find a place that made canadian Chinese food that we liked since long dragon closed 😕 but we're told to try this place , as it was comparable and good. And we were not disappointed.  Their was lots of food, The only thing I found different was the chicken balls, the batter was a bit over cooked and tough , but that could be because it's new yrs day, and they are very busy,  so I definitely would not hold that against them. And will definitely be back. Everything was delicious and fresh. It would be great if you could eat in.

After reading some reviews I thought we would give Foosing a try. We ordered wonton soup (I like to compare with previous ones I have tried), Combo 11, pan fried dumplings, Singapore Noodles, BBQ Pork Lo mein.

The wonton soup was tasty. The broth was mild and not overly salty. The wontons were quite large with a decent portion of nappa and sliced BBQ pork. Their pan fried dumplings were delicious. Combo 11 was good but honestly different then what I expected. Their spicy beef was tasty but I wouldn't call it spicy beef. It was more sweet than spicy but still very tender and good which is why I will still keep the 5 star rating. The pan fried dumplings were very good and the portion was large which was great. The Singapore Noodles were good with a little spicy kick, but not over powering.

Area of opportunity: I would recommend advertising that the dining room is closed. Honestly we were a bit disappointed that the dining room was not open and almost left but decided to take the food home and give it a chance.

Overall, Foosing has good food and has a lot of potential for increased business if they did dine in especially where all other restaurants are open to the public now. If you haven't tried Foosing I would recommend giving them a try. 👍👍
Amazing food. Amazing service. Amazing family.  Was great meeting you yesterday and having a brief chat! Look forward to many more meals!

Update: as of July 4, 2025 - I ordered there again and the odor was gone! Food was excellent as was the service. Modified the rating to reflect positively.

I'm so torn about this place. I do really enjoy the food - closest to Long Dragon that we've found in Sackville. The people are nice, the portions are generous.

What gives me pause is the state of the restaurant. It's very unclean feeling, but the food inspection reports are ok. What keeps me from ordering there is the unbelievably strong sewage odour that never goes away. I don't know if there's a plumbing issue or something but the stench makes me gag and I just don't wanna eat food prepared in an environment with such a strong sewage odour.

Perhaps I'll try them again in a few months.
