Authentic Greek pastries of all kinds. I had to ask my Greek friend what some of the treats were. I got the Baklava, I have not had good Baklava in years. It was sweet and flaky as it should be. My Greek friend got one I couldn't pronounce, she said it is supposed to have more syrup.

During my midday walk, I stumbled upon this fantastic Greek bakery. Walking inside, you are transported to what feels like a combination of a European bakery, and a New York coffee shop.

What lies inside of the glass pastry cases are jewels so beautiful that the sight they behold cannot be understood merely by seeing or smelling (much like one’s first experience on the Subway). One must taste to fully understand. Now my experience was somewhat limited by what I ordered, but it should not deter you from the fact that I was an adult in a bakery (just as dangerous as a kid in a candy shop imo) limited by my cash situation and not my desire to eat more.

The savory meat pastry was one of the best things I’ve had in New York City. It’s really hard for the average person to understand how impressive it is to achieve what they are doing. The meat pie I had was simply perfect. Flaky phyllo throughout without any gumminess, juicy and flavorful filling stuffed generously inside the buttery layers of dough.

I’m not one for transcendent experiences, but I was just out of my mind shocked how good this was. I actually had to stop what I was doing to focus on eating this incredible meat pie.

Follow your dreams, follow your taste buds, don’t count the calories, try everything, enter that food coma, have an espresso to get back after it, maybe another, sleep (if you can), repeat.

I’ve read online that this is one of the top-rated bakeries of the city. This an amazing Greek bakery that sells all kinds of sweet and savory baked goods. My best friend loves when I get her the pineapple cheese strudel because I know she loves pineapple. When she ate it for the first time she was pleasantly surprised that it had real pieces of pineapple in it. I love any baked that’s custardy or cheesy and this bakery has lots of those. I try to come to this bakery from time to time.
I visited Poseidon Greek Bakery today, Wednesday, August 13, 2025, at 12:00 PM, but unfortunately the shop was closed. The owner should update the opening hours to avoid wasting customers’ time.

The space is very small and minimalist — think a cozy, dimly lit spot with only a handful of counter seats. It’s more of a serene tea nook than a café where you can hang for hours. That intimacy creates a nice ambiance, but also means it gets crammed quickly when there’s a line out front.

🍵 Matcha Quality
Sorate clearly uses high-quality matcha — rich green color and earthy flavor — and many drinks are hand-whisked right in front of you. Drinks like the superior matcha latte were smooth and well-balanced, leaning more traditional than overly sweet latte-style places.

If you like authentic matcha with depth rather than a sugary drink, this place hits the mark — but expect a bitter edge if you don’t add sweetener. I add Extra Extra Sweetener

☕️ Service & Wait
The service can be a mixed bag. Some staff are informative and friendly, explaining matcha prep and sourcing.

Lines are common, especially in nice weather or late mornings, and since seating is limited, you might end up standing outside waiting for your drink.

🍵 Drinks & Extras

Matcha latte and seasonal matcha are solid options.

Iced matcha also has great flavor but smaller portions — common complaint for the price.

I recommend recommend pairing your drink with wagashi (Japanese sweets) for a fuller experience.

💡 Pros
High-quality, authentic matcha
Unique hand-whisked preparation
Great ambiance if you get a seat

⚠️ Cons
Small space, often crowded
Lines & limited seating can be frustrating
Some service inconsistency

📊 Overall
If you’re a matcha enthusiast looking for a more traditional, mindful cup in SoHo, Sorate is worth trying — just plan ahead and go during quieter hours if possible.

Here is some pictures of the Snacks
Delicious high quality matcha. Suited for people who really love the early, umami, nutty notes in matcha. They also lightly sweeten it which is just the right amount. Hojicha also so good!

One of the best and must try matcha in NYC! It’s worth the price. If you prefer kinda bitter matcha, this one will be your favorite! They don’t really have any spacious space to sit or hang with large group, but they provide small seating area in front of the building that you can use (it may be useful during good season tho)

If you’re seeking an authentic matcha experience, Sorate is the place to go on your next trip to NYC. It’s a gem. They offer the best matcha — the cup is rich, creamy, and full of character. And, they'll whisk it fresh before you in a well designed space with a serene and intimate ambiance.

google_reviews.text:
Loulou is a charming bistro & bar that makes for a delightful brunch spot. We visited for Valentine’s brunch and overall had a lovely experience. Our server was warm, candid, and genuinely helpful in guiding us through the menu — always a great start.

The cocktails deserve a special mention. The Remy, Bloody Affair, and Daily Green were bold, punchy, and beautifully balanced — easily the highlight of the meal.

On the food front, it was a bit of a mixed bag. The French onion soup was hearty and comforting, though the onions and cheese leaned slightly too far into a charred, almost burnt flavor that didn’t quite hit the mark. Updated:  My family has shopped in the W56th Store 2 - 3 times a month for years. Yesterday, I purchased three pieces of salmon sashimi from this store, each priced at $34.99/lb and labeled as weighing 0.27 lbs. Each package was charged at $9.44.

Piece 1: 111g
Piece 2: 113g
Piece 3: 108g

A coworker and I stopped at Little Ruby’s Cafe in Williamsburg to grab a bite to eat and get a little work done while we waited for our hotel rooms to be ready. We asked for a slightly bigger table to accommodate a working lunch and promised to move if the restaurant became crowded. The staff was very kind and sat us at a 4-top.

The food was delightful. I had the chicken burger (not a burger, just a chicken sandwich, it’s an Australian thing) and it was perfection - crispy and flavorful. While the sandwich was great, the fries stole the show. I would absolutely go out of my way to get those amazing fries again.

Our food came out super fast and they assured us it was fine to keep working after we finished eating. They even kept offering refills of our tea and water. It’s like they could tell we were weary from traveling all day.

Between the friendly staff and the great food, I would highly recommend Little Ruby’s Cafe.

Overall a great night out although the pace at which your table is turned around means it’s probably not the best place for a leisurely dinner. We were in and out within an hour, which for a three course meal is pretty fast.

Apologies for the lack of photos but we were too busy eating. The starters of calamari, truffle fries and salad were tasty and well done. The mains were fabulous. Three of us had pasta, the other had chicken schnitzel with what I would say was some of the smoothest mash potatoes I’ve ever seen!

Everyone was satisfied—me included as I savored my Ruby’s ragu, which was simply delicious.

We all shared a sticky date pudding to finish off. The starter and main servings were all of a good size, so good that no one thought they could manage a full dessert on their own!

So, where did the fifth star go. The one thing that knocked a point off of service was my pet hate, servers removing plates before the whole table has finished a course. The other, we had to ask several times for some additional cheese to top one of the pastas, which left one of our party sitting and watching everyone eat and her food getting cold for some time.

But those two slightly negative comments MUST NOT deter you from enjoying a meal at this great little bistro in Brooklyn. I’d definitely return.

I’ve been to nearly every Ruby’s Cafe location across New York, and in terms of food quality alone, Bronte here is the best I’ve had. The meat was exceptionally juicy, well-seasoned, and noticeably more flavorful than other branches.

However, the operational execution does not match the food quality. I visited on a Saturday shortly after 10 AM. The dining room was not fully occupied, yet the food took an unusually long time to arrive. It was evident that to-go orders were being prioritized over dine-in guests. I fully understand peak-hour pressures, but even at much busier Soho and West Village locations, I have never experienced this level of delay.

This is not a staffing issue—it is a workflow and prioritization issue. If dine-in guests are made to feel secondary to takeout traffic, it directly impacts the in-store experience. Given how strong the food is at this location, it’s disappointing that operational inefficiencies detract from what could otherwise be the best Ruby’s experience in the city. Management should seriously review order sequencing and kitchen flow to ensure dine-in service is not compromised.

We came here for brunch just now and ordered 2 simple dishes. One sandwich and one burrito. I didn’t know how big the portion was so wanted to wait till the food arrives before deciding if I want to order additional side dishes.

The 2 simple dishes took 40 mins to arrive. During that time, the party next to us had ordered, finished eating and paid. By the time the food finally came after the bartender followed up with the kitchen twice, my mood was beyond spoiled that I just wanted to finish the food and leave. Absolutely had no mood or patience to order any additional dishes and risked waiting for another 40 mins for the food to come

Ps/ the bartender was very apologetic and offered coffee for free, which was appreciated.

name: Maison Provence
document: Maison Provence. cuisine: French Wine Bars Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 5.0 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Amazing experience! We celebrated my birthday brunch here and they owner treated us lovely (even brought a surprise crepe and prosecco)! The food was amazing and the decoration brought me back to France. I loved the experience and would certainly recommend to everyone.

I absolutely loved this place! It was very cozy and the decor was great. I liked that they had French products for purchase as well. The food seemed very authentic. The service was great as well. The woman who waited on us was very knowledgeable, sweet and personable.
We got the pâte de campagne to start. My husband and I never had it before and absolutely loved it. It reminded me of summer sausage. We ordered a bottle of Malbec which was divine. My husband got the steak and I got the duck and mushroom fettuccine. The portions were not super large and the price was very reasonable. For dessert we had ice cream with home-made chocolate sauce. I only wished there was more chocolate sauce because it was soooo good.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience and we will most certainly be back.

Super cute and cozy spot! Clearly it’s a popular dinner stop for the neighborhood because it was pretty full on a Saturday night, but there’s enough space to where you don’t feel like you’re right on top of the other guests. I loved the decor and the food was yum, authentically French cuisine. I had the Snail Crepe and it was a pretty generous portion! The service was lovely as well, very genuine and welcoming energy all around :)

When you enter La Maison Provence, the 'Patron' (owner), who is from Nice I believe, welcomes you as if you're family. He is very friendly and chatty. The place is not big, but the decoration is great and charming,  full of french memorabilia, and it feels very cozy. The food is rustic and excellent (some would say the potatoes are 'fantastique!'), strongly influenced by the Mediterranean coast in the South of France. Many crepes or pasta options, a vast selection of varied appetizers, and of course, desserts! It will warm up your soul. For a minute, helped by the music, you forget you're in NYC. This place has been around for many years, but re-opened recently under this new name after a 4 year hiatus. And I am so glad it did. Definitely my favorite French restaurant in NYC.
Note: this restaurant offers a few options for vegetarians!

I literally did a happy dance after having the best crêpes of my life, plus all the brunch items are only under $20!

I’ve been craving french galettes and sweet crêpe, but finding something both authentic and affordable in NYC isn’t easy…until I found this cozy french restaurant in Williamsburg.

Chef Lolo is the most passionate and friendly owner I’ve met. He puts thought into every detail, bringing the true taste of Southern France, using only top-quality ingredients, and genuinely caring about his customers' feedback.

No surprise that they have a flawless 5-star rating on Google and Yelp!

＊Onion Soup $11
I was told this is a crowd favorite, and it instantly stole my heart. The onion soup may have looked modest, but the savory richness of swiss cheese, caramelized onions, and the baguette all came together beautifully.

＊Crepe Normandie $18
Instead of using wheat flour, they opted for buckwheat flour as it was more nutritious and gluten-free. It was generously topped with a creamy chicken, mushroom, and cheese filling, enhanced by a touch of white wine. I loved the crispy edges of the crêpe.

＊Croque Raclette $19
We enjoyed this rich sandwich, especially the oozy swiss and raclette cheese, the savory prosciutto, tangy pickles, and a runny egg yolk on top.

＊Strawberry Banana Flamee $11
Absolutely amazed from the first bite. The orange liqueur (Cointreau) added an exquisite note that elevated the flavor. Chef Lolo even came out to proudly show the premium Cointreau. Unlike many places, he insisted on using top quality liqueur–the secret behind why it tasted like something straight out of a high-end french bistro.

The caramelized banana added sweetness to the flambéed crêpe, served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. I need to come back for every sweet crêpe they offer!

Great people. Ranger cookies were delicious. Got some beers from the store and drank them upstairs post Old Rag.
Cute, well featured array of breads , cookies,  cheeses and wines! Also a great deli display! A must stop to browse the different assortment of goods and products!!

google_reviews.text: My experience at Blossoms Brunch Bar was pretty cool overall. The atmosphere was inviting and had a nice brunch vibe that made it easy to relax and enjoy the visit. The food was decent — not mind-blowing, but satisfying and well-presented. The service stood out the most; the staff was friendly, attentive, and made sure we were taken care of throughout our meal. It’s a solid spot to check out if you’re looking for a laid-back brunch with good service and a welcoming environment.

After a disappointing experience elsewhere, we decided to try Blossoms, and I am so glad we did. I’ve now been here twice this week for breakfast, and they have not disappointed once.

The atmosphere is absolutely beautiful, warm, and welcoming. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with genuine smiles, friendly energy, and impeccable service. Everyone makes you feel comfortable and appreciated.

The food? Chef’s kiss.
One day I had the chicken and waffles, and today I ordered the shrimp and grits, which were beyond delicious. The breakfast menu has endless options, and everything is clearly made with care and flavor in mind.

The music alone deserves a shoutout—it has you singing along at the table while enjoying your meal, which just adds to the entire experience.

As a Black-owned business, this place truly gets it: great food, great vibes, and great service. I honestly have nothing negative to say. Blossoms has gained a loyal customer for life, and I will absolutely continue coming back.

The picture of the catfish and grits do it little justice. You're just going to have to head on over and try it for yourself. This is one of those places where everything on the menu sounds like it'll be good and you'd probably be right. This place gets what matters right and first and foremost the food is good and came out as it was ready. The service was fairly good as well (but our guy forgot to get the wobble out the damn table). The atmosphere is cool too, place is a little small but they make best with what they have, nice big windows that let plenty natural light in. You just have to be careful getting up so you don't bump the other parties around you. I will make it my business to visit again as there's some things on the menu I need try.

For being my first time at Blossoms Brunch Bar, our experience was 100 percent great. The atmosphere was superb. The service was excellent & very pleasant. Freddy was attentive & friendly. I had the Cajun Mac & Cheese which was super flavorful & the cheese pull was so satisfying along w/ creole fried pork that was fried to perfection & crispy to the crunch & just YUM!!!! My sister had the pancake flight & it was DELICIOUS!! The flavors complimented each other. The pancakes were soft & fluffy. Will definitely be back again VERY SOON.

The service/staff here is amazing. So kind and helpful. Got the brussel sprouts, philadelphia cheesesteak omelet, avocado toast and lamb chops. Definitely choose what cooking you want for the lamb though. They said a lot of ppl who choose medium send back to cook more. The medium well then was actually well done. But still good and tender. Flavors all good. Their chipotle or chili is not spicy. They have 4 kinds of bagged tea and various kinds of hot/iced coffee. They have music for a birthday and bring out your cake. BYOB for mimosas and prep/provide oj.

document: Ubani. cuisine: Georgian Cafes. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
Ubani is an NYC gem. Excellent, inviting ambiance. The staff here are professional, excellent, top-notch. (Georgian) wine, beer and global cocktails entirely on point. The food is incredibly fresh, flavorful and beautifully presented.

On top of all this, they perfectly weave in a bit of education about their food and culture, one which is beautiful and unique.

Highly, highly recommend dining here, and more than just once at that.

A++++, 10/10.

Where to begin, let’s just say when you go to Albani it’s more than just any other restaurant. It’s almost like becoming part of their family. The OWNER, Manager and every person that works there makes you feel right at home. The food is delicious, the service is exceptional. The experience is unlike any other. And let’s face it, there’s not many Georgian options in NYC. This is one of the best! And let’s not forget there’s always live music on Saturday nights to make this a special evening for friends, family, or a special date. Highly recommended.

I rarely if ever am surprised by new foods and flavors these days. Holy cow did that change with Ubani! The atmosphere is great, w live music and low lighting. Wait staff are all actual Georgians, and they were supremely helpful in ordering (needed because we had zero idea what to get). Food was incredible. I cannot recommend this enough. GO!!!!!

There seems to be a new Georgian restaurant every month these days. Ubani is a fine dining establishment with excellent service and great ambiance.

The wine list is extensive and varied, tried a terragon lemondade unique taste. A variety of cheesy Khachapuris on the menu to share, the sides are more typical american, Kharcho soup hit the spot in this cold weather. Waitress pushed the appetizer platter, but probably would have been too much for our table of 5 as many of the ladies needed doggie bags for their entrees.

The roasted chicken with pomegranate instead of blackberry sauce was delcicious, crispy skin, moist and sweet. Honey cake is not too sweet, nice and layered without needing to be soaked in syrup.

Our experience with Mariam was absolutely wonderful! She greeted us so warmly and made us feel right at home. Her service was perfect — friendly, professional, and full of care. You could feel her positive attitude in every little detail.

The food was fantastic! Everything tasted fresh and homemade, and the presentation was beautiful. The whole place had such a nice, cozy atmosphere, and Mariam’s kindness made it even better.

document: Terre. cuisine: Italian Wine Bars Breakfast & Brunch. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text:
An evening at TERRE BK is a reminder of how special true Italian cooking can be. This beautiful, intimate Brooklyn restaurant offers a genuine farm-to-table experience, with so many of their ingredients crafted in-house.

We began with a classic Burrata e Prosciutto, the perfect balance of creaminess and salt. For our main courses, we enjoyed the handmade Pasta "Terrelle" al Ragù, a Mediterranean branzino wrapped in a delicate potato crust, and Gnocchetti served with burrata and porcini mushrooms also adding a secret menu creamy dish!

Each dish carried the depth and freshness that only house-made ingredients can provide. Paired with their own homemade Sauvignon Blanc, the entire meal felt thoughtful, warm, and beautifully executed

an evening filled with great attentive service, authentic flavors and a truly comforting atmosphere.

I walked by here the other day and really liked the ambiance so I decided to check it out. Service was good but they were just opening for the evening so it wasn’t busy at all. I found the pasta to be decent but not memorable. I didn’t like that the shrimp wasn’t deveined. The boar pasta was a bit better but I think the beef ragu would’ve been just as good or even better. The portion size is small so you may need to order a couple of apps though almost all menu items are overpriced. We paid $80 for two pastas which included tax and tip. The specials offered were $42. Because of the price and what you get, I’m not sure I’d go back but it is a very warm and charming spot.

We visited Terrell Pasta and Natural Wine with two friends and my wife, and the entire experience was exceptional. We tried the squash risotto and the beef lasagna, and both dishes were outstanding—beautifully prepared, rich in flavor, and perfectly balanced.

The restaurant itself is extraordinary. It has an impressive amount of space extending toward the back, and the rustic fan system creates a unique, charming touch that sets the tone from the moment you walk in. The soft, warm lighting adds to the atmosphere, making it ideal for a relaxed and intimate meal.

One of the highlights is the wine-selection experience. Instead of choosing blindly, they offer small tastings so you can find the wine you truly love. It’s simply masterful and elevates the whole dining experience.

Prices are on the higher side, but the quality, ambiance, and overall experience make it absolutely worth it. Highly recommended for a memorable night out. 🍷✨

Super Italian place 🤌🏼 🇮🇹
Wine is great! We tried red and white!🍷
Pasta was nice 🍝

Sounds weird but I loved the vintage fans on a ceiling 👏🏼

Very cute place for a date 🌹

This is our new favorite Italian restaurant hands down! The delectable dishes (all 5 dishes we had including dessert were 10/10), cozy beautiful ambiance, and unmatched service made for a truly magical evening despite it being a rainy, dreary day. My husband and I love experiences and good food, and this restaurant offered both. You can always tell when people take pride in what they do and this was consistently palpable across all elements of the experience from the restaurant owner to the staff - thank you Daniele and team. Go! You’ll leave with your belly and hearts so full!

Our waitress Jen was a real delight!

Wanted to try the tuna tartare but sadly came with raw onions which couldn’t be substituted out. Oh well. I’ll return to try the entrees

This place is underrated!!!
The food is amazing, scallops melt in your mouth. The sweet potato fries are the best I ever tried. Jennifer is the best host ever, so nice and helpful. The atmosphere is 10 out of 10 here. I highly recommend this place.

google_reviews.text: I was excited to find this opened up so close to me. I was even more excited when I recognized the owner from another one of my favorite spots in the neighborhood! Go check out Hart for an intimate dinner experience.

Amazing! Our favorite restaurant in the area. We had a very attentive waitress last night and every dish we ordered was executed beautifully.

name: Brooklyn Kolache
document: Brooklyn Kolache. cuisine: Coffee & Tea Bakeries Cafes. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: This quaint little bakery will definitely surprise you with just how flavorful their unique kolaches are! Not to mention the delicious coffee that pairs wonderfully with their pastries. Next time I visit I'll definitely have to try their savory kolaches!

I’m on a mission to find a decent matcha in the neighborhood and Brooklyn Kolache was my first stop. Unfortunately, they let me down.

The baristas are nice and the Ube latte is quite good. The kolaches are good in theory but rarely hold up in reality due to their lack of flavor and fluffiness once they’re warmed up.

Back to the matcha! I commend their effort to make homemade pistachio syrup and macadamia milk. However, if you’re going to make a matcha latte, please make sure there’s a healthy amount of matcha in it. Ended up with a $7 lukewarm cup of milk with a slight hint of matcha.

I am happy that they have a location here. Besides the bread, their drinks are amazing too. I personally recommend their savory options a lot.

🍫☕️🥛Mocha is a YES! Super creamy with their housemade chocolate sauce. Coffee tasted good too.

Coconut kolache was a solid one.ight not be impressive but a classic one.

Brooklyn Kolache is great! The kolaches are really good (sweet cheese and lemon curd are my favorites) and the coffee is fantastic. The people who work here are always super friendly, too. The backyard is wonderful in nice weather.

My friend and I are originally from houston and currently living in Brooklyn. So we were of course super excited to try Kolache Brooklyn for a taste of food that reminded us of home. And Given that it is Mardi Gras season we were also seeking out Kolache Brooklyn to try their King Cake bites that we saw on TikTok.

Unfortunately we had such a terrible experience we will not ever be stepping foot back in the cafe again. I arrived around 11:45 and attempted to order the Chaider (Seasonal Apple Cider Chai drink) advertised on the menu along with the Mardi Gras bites - only to be told they were sold out of both items for the day. Which was not only completely ridiculous but outright frustrating. I tried to order the Houston Style kolache and they were ALSO out of them. I proceeded to order a regular Sausage, Cheese, & Jalapeño kolache + Hibiscus tea - which I can at least say was pretty good. When my friend arrived at 12:20 we decided we would go elsewhere for King Cake but still wanted to grab more food. But by the time she got in line they were all sold out of ALL the kolaches with meat. All that was left was the Vegetarian kolaches - which again, were decent - but it was more of a Danish than it was a traditional Kolache. It is completely asinine that a place known for their KOLACHES is sold out of KOLACHES by 12pm on a Saturday.  On top of all that, the staff rude and took 10 min to give me my second order of the Spinach and Cheese Kolache because they forgot about it.

3/10 experience. And the 3 is generous because the food that I did get to try was decent. Never going back.

document: China Garden. cuisine: Chinese. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text:
China Garden is a solid choice for a local meal with a pretty good food selection and impressive variety. Whether you are craving classic fried chicken, various stir-fries, or lo mein, they have the staples covered. It’s also great to see sushi offered as part of the spread.
To top off the meal, they have soft serve ice cream, which is always a hit. A standout feature of the service is their hospitality; on your birthday, they bring out a delicious dessert to help celebrate. It is an enjoyable spot for a casual lunch or dinner with plenty of options to satisfy everyone.

I rarely put in a review but I cannot recommend anyone going to this place. I had to apologize to my wife for suggesting we try this place. I did try a little bit of everything but the only hot item I could enjoy was egg drop soup. The fruit all came out of a can.

If I could give zero I would. The egg drop soup was good. But that’s about the only thing. Did not like the plastic plates and cutlery as well as styrofoam cups and bowls. The buffet has a large selection of very bland food that was cold by the time we got to the table. Don’t waste your time and money here.

I've eaten at Chinese buffet restaurants in virtually all 50 states, and China Garden ranks up amongst the best. Buffet is constantly maintained and has a great selection  of dishes to choose or mix and match from. The dishes are very well cooked and very fresh. I was shocked to find such a gem in little old Culpeper VA. Do yourself a favor
and check it out. They are in the ALDI shopping center. I'm going to try the takeaway next, but if it's anything like the buffet, I'll be happy.
5 stars.

document: Kings Co Imperial. cuisine: Dim Sum Noodles Szechuan. located in Brooklyn. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: We had a date night here after a long time. It was a weekday right at opening, so we were able to snag a table for two without reservations. I love the traditional touch in the interior decorations. The classic Dan Dan noodles and soup dumplings were delicious. The five-pepper rib-eye and Kung Pao chicken were also on point. It was a delicious and fun Chinese food date night.

Kings Imperial serves up a delicious variety in a cozy and quaint atmosphere.

Our server was quick and friendly. The food was all delicious, as you can see we all started eating before I could snap pics. The regular dumplings were huge! The chicken dish was a small serving (wish it had more chicken).

Favorite dish was the cold sesame noodles, this dish changed my mind on peanut sauces.

The fried rice didn't look like the usual fried rice (pale, seams like they don't stir fry it w/ soy sauce) but was very tasty all the same.

The service was absolutely perfect, warm, attentive, and genuinely caring.
The food? A solid 10/10 - every bite was on point.

Huge shoutout to our waitress, Clair - she was beyond amazing. Professional, kind, and made the whole experience feel special from start to finish.

This place truly exceeded all expectations. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be back.

A great spot! The food is really good - while the presentation was just slightly sloppy for the dishes we ordered, they were punchy, fresh, full of flavor. We particularly enjoyed the soup dumplings which are much larger than regular soup dumplings - they were delicious, with huge servings of pork and broth. The Dan Dan mian was good, but not all that special - I would probably get the hanging pork noodles in future. Finally, the Mo’s General collaborative sandwich, BBQ Hanging Pork, was just amazing and one of the best things I’ve eaten this year. The prices are a little higher than you might expect but the portions for what we ordered were large, we ended up with leftovers, and the meal felt very homey. The service was solid, and the vibe of the place is really fun - low lighting, very moody. It’s a great place for a date, with several different dining areas and a mixture between louder and quieter tables. Cocktails looked great and we’ll definitely come back to try them!

ANOTHER REVIEW INCOMING!

The atmosphere and service at this place is just so welcoming. Amazing restaurant design with long lengthy hallways and plentiful outdoor seating in the back. That alone made me want to come back.

The dishes were all tasty, but I did not try any pork or beef dishes so I feel as if this review is incomplete. Everything was tasty but besides the chicken dumplings I think I would order completely new items next time.

Make sure they get you started with the pickled spicy cabbage. It was delicious.

The popcorn chicken were perfectly crunchy on the outside with tender, juicy inside, coated in that crunchy seasoning, and came with a generous side of creamy, slightly spicy dipping sauce. The pork sandwich was phenomenal; it was tender and packed with savory goodness, fresh greens, and just the right amount of sauce to make it messy in the best way. The bread was flaky and toasted perfectly. The large iced horchata milk tea was creamy, not too sweet, perfectly balanced, with mini biscuit bits and that signature Hong Kong-style richness.

google_reviews.text: We dined here the night before lunar new year and were impressed by the hosts hospitality. We didn’t have a reservation and instead of giving us the usual snobby rebuke, the hostess added our name to the list & gave us nice hot teas to enjoy while we waited. Wait was around 30 min which felt reasonable, we got sat at the bar. Lovely bartenders, they all conversed with us and made us feel welcome, even provided helpful input on the menu. I felt like I was invited over someone’s house for dinner. The dishes were truly flavorful & unique, and the jasmine hot teas was exceptional. We recommend beef with green chili & the fried fish. I would not leave without trying the Dan Dan noodles & a dumpling of some kind (spoiler theyre all good.) I’ll have to come back for the cocktail list, it’s a treasure hunt! Could not have asked for a better dining experience. I hope the owners & staff are successful in all their endeavors, because they put their heart & soul in this place.

What can I say? Delicious food, great,  attentive service. We had the spicy tofu pudding, the eggplant, the Kung pao, the spicy fish, and purple rice. Do yourself a favor and get the celtuce.

The rice pudding was the perfect end to the meal, rice and bean paste with raisins and pumpkin seeds in a warm syrup. Will definitely be coming back again, the food was next level.

Birds of a Feather is a beautiful spot tucked away in Williamsburg that really stands out for its atmosphere and design. The space has this perfect balance of industrial and modern décor exposed brick, soft lighting, and elegant touches that make it feel both stylish and welcoming. It’s one of those restaurants where you notice the details right away, from the furniture to the way the dishes are plated.
I stopped in for their lunch special, which I thought was a great deal. The prices are fairly affordable considering the quality and the portions the servings are actually quite large, so you definitely won’t leave hungry. I ordered the chili fish, and it was excellent flavorful, fresh, and just the right level of spice. The food came out quickly, which I really appreciated during lunch hours.
I also tried the egg and scallion stuffed pancake, which ended up being one of my favorite parts of the meal. It’s crispy, savory, and full of flavor the kind of dish that makes you want to come back just for that. Overall, Birds of a Feather is a great place for a relaxed but elevated meal in Williamsburg. Highly recommend checking it out, especially for lunch.

I’ve ordered from here multiple times, and somehow it always tastes like it just came straight out of the kitchen and onto a dine-in table. The Cantonese spicy dishes are bold, layered, and packed with flavor — that perfect balance of heat, aromatics, and depth that keeps you going back for “just one more bite.”

The consistency is what really stands out. Whether dining in or ordering out, the quality never drops. The spices are vibrant, the ingredients taste fresh, and every dish feels thoughtfully prepared rather than rushed.

If you’re craving authentic Cantonese flavors with a proper spicy kick, this spot delivers every single time. Reliable, flavorful, and absolutely satisfying.

Birds of a Feather never disappoints. I’ve been here multiple times, and each visit has been consistently excellent. The restaurant has a chic yet comfortable vibe that makes it suitable for both casual dinners and special occasions.

The food is outstanding — rich flavors, high-quality ingredients, and thoughtful presentation. Their Sichuan-inspired dishes are full of depth and complexity, with just the right amount of heat. Even simple dishes feel elevated, and everything we ordered came out perfectly cooked. You can tell the kitchen pays close attention to detail.

Service is another strong point. The staff are professional, welcoming, and efficient, and the timing of the dishes was spot on. We never felt rushed, which made the dining experience very enjoyable.

If you’re a fan of modern Chinese cuisine or looking to try something new and memorable, Birds of a Feather is a must-try. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be returning.

document: PO Lee Chinese Restaurant. cuisine: Szechuan. located in Brooklyn. with 4.0 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
Yeah I don’t know if the other reviews here are bots or people who haven’t had good takeout chinese (aka hood chinese).
I got pepper steak and veggie fried rice. Charged me extra for fried rice and gave me about 4 spoons of rice (I could count in how many bites I finished it). google_reviews.text: Stopped here for dinner after a day in the caverns.  The place it’s small inside but cozy, offering a nice outdoor area for sitting and enjoying the weather while dining.    The lady up front was amazing w/ her service taking care of new orders and all the to go orders.   We got lucky to get a table inside (it was cold outside 40s) and they had a trivia game in tv.  Gave us entertainment while we waited for food to come out.  Now let’s talk food.  We all order a different meal but we all tried each others foods.   No plate was bad, they all were amazing, rich in flavor and feeling fresh.  If I’m ever back in Luray this is where I’m coming back for food!

To the person who complained that they closed early, this cute retro nook sits 20 people max indoors and is locally run by a family. This isn’t a chain restaurant. Maxing out the restaurant space and patio was probably stressful for staff of 2 people.
We stopped in for dinner tonight around 6:15. Business was brisk with in house and carryout orders but that didn’t stop the service from being friendly and attentive.
The portions are very generous and affordable. I got the tofu pad see ew with a regional beer and my husband got the chicken basil rice and Thai iced tea. We could have probably shared the one dish! (Check out the photo gallery for this restaurant for more.)
This is a great casual spot. I’m glad we found it!

I’m visiting this area and was really craving Thai food, but I was honestly a little worried it wouldn’t taste truly authentic. I’m so glad I decided to try this place!

The food was absolutely delicious — truly authentic Thai flavors, just like back home. Every dish was perfectly seasoned and full of flavor. You can really tell they care about quality and tradition.

The restaurant is also very clean and well maintained. The tables, seating, and overall dining area were spotless, which made the whole experience even more comfortable and enjoyable.

On top of that, the owner was incredibly kind and welcoming. They even gave me a complimentary drink, which was such a thoughtful and generous gesture.

If you’re looking for authentic Thai food, great hospitality, and a clean, comfortable atmosphere, this is definitely the place to go. I will absolutely be coming back! 🌟

A small restaurant with big flavors! 🍜 The menu was just right — plenty to choose from without feeling overwhelming. Everything we ordered was amazing, with enough left over for dinner too. Loved their green curry the most! Such a cute little Thai/Japanese spot in downtown — definitely worth a visit!

Asian Station in Luray is one of those places that instantly feels real, not corporate, not trying too hard, just genuinely good food made by good people. Every time I come here I leave happy, and that is rare these days. The menu has so many comfort winners, but my personal favorites are the Thai Basil Chicken and the Pad Thai, flavorful, satisfying, and consistently on point. The Crab Rangoon is dangerously addictive, perfectly crispy with a creamy filling, and their sushi rolls are also a solid yes when you want something fresh. And please do not skip the Thai iced tea, it is basically happiness in a cup.

What makes this place special though is the heart behind it. The owners, Nat and Gift, are truly kind, hardworking, and you can feel that they care about the food and about people. It is the type of spot where you can tell they are putting love into every order, whether you dine in or take out. If you are in Luray and want a meal that tastes great and also supports a local business run with real integrity, Asian Station is the one. Highly recommended, and I will keep coming back. 🥰

google_reviews.text: The restaurant was clean and nice. The food was beautifully presented and delicious. Everyone has their own taste. In my personal opinion, the roast duck was too greasy. The skin wasn't crispy. Except for that dish, the other dishes were all good.

Astonishingly good.  Can’t go wrong with this order:  beef chow fun, Chinese broccoli with garlic, salt fish fried rice with chicken.  Always read into the reviews before you dine… this place has bad reviews because of service…which I’ll agree is average.. but the food is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING.  We ordered a to go order 30 minutes before closing and it came out perfect.  You see this sear on this garlic clove.. I can’t begin to describe the attention to detail to cooking surfaces, heat, and the right amount of oil to sear garlic in this way.  Nothing was burnt, veggies were crispy, everything was fresh, beef in the Chow Fun was a melty tender ribeye.  Superb… just flawless execution here.  This is attentive cooking in high temp woks using fresh ingredients and clean oil.
Will certainly look to dine in next time we’re in Virginia. If you want good service with mediocre food, visit Peking Gourmet… last I checked nobody is ordering Chinese food for the service.

The menu feels more refined, with carefully crafted dishes that highlight both flavor and presentation. Their dim sum is especially noteworthy – beautifully made, delicious, and served with attention to detail. If you’re in the mood for a premium Chinese dining experience, Han Place is highly recommended.

google_reviews.text: This late night dining restaurant is a gem in the heart of Williamsburg.  The food was delicious and the service is with a smile.  We sat at the bar and vibed out to the great playlist and chatted with the manager/bartender Will.  Make sure you try the signature Golden Monkey cocktail and the salt n pepper fish or shrimp are my personal favs!

Such an amazing experience here! Everything we ordered was delicious, so fresh and full of flavor. The steamed dumplings are light with a flavorful juicy filling, and the wonton soup was perfect and comforting. The peanut chili wontons also had the perfect kick, and the scallion pancakes were crispy, warm, and super satisfying. I ordered The Bird of Paradise cocktail which was on point. Beautiful calm/ cozy atmosphere. Great service 💯💯. Can't wait to come back to try the sesame chicken.

I can’t recommend Wei’s enough. I’ve been coming here for years, and it continues to be one of those rare neighborhood spots that gets everything right. The ambiance is stylish, yet cozy, with a warmth that makes you want to settle in and stay awhile. It works just as well for a relaxed weeknight dinner as it does for a weekend outing. They're also one of the only late night food spots in the neighborhood.

The food is consistently excellent. Expect seriously delicious Chinese dishes that feel high quality without being overpriced. I honestly love everything I’ve had here. They even have gluten free options! Add in a strong cocktail and wine list, and it’s easy to see why this place is perfect for group dinners, date nights, or even just grabbing a seat at the bar and treating yourself.

The service deserves its own applause. The staff is attentive, incredibly kind and you never feel rushed. Even when there’s a line out the door, they let you enjoy your meal at your own pace, which is increasingly rare and deeply appreciated. Between the food, the drinks, the service, and the welcoming atmosphere, I can't recommend this place enough.

name: Yummy Chinese Restaurant
document: Yummy Chinese Restaurant. cuisine: Chinese. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: We found this from a Valpak coupon and decided to try it. The spring rolls and hot and sour soup were phenomenal! We also had the lo mein and Mongolian beef which were excellent. Everything was piping hot and fresh. We also tried the Thai tea which was unlike any I have had before but I really loved it, would be perfect for a summer day treat! Rachel, our server, was soooooooo kind and professional. She was hustling the whole time but still checked on us and gave us her recommendations. Absolutely incredible service. We will be back!

Excellent food, huge portions, hot and fresh. When they say some dishes are spicy- believe them. Waitress and staff were friendly and professional. Our waitress showed attention to  detail and got it all right. Busy place but quiet enough you could have a real conversation.

Love this place. We have been going here since it was Hunans. The staff is so friendly and nice. The service is fast and good.
We also love the take out. The take out is always busy. They have never gotten our order wrong.
I love the won ton soup. The soup cups have gotten larger and I appreciate getting more than 2 wontons. It pairs well with crispy noodles.
Crab wontons are great with sweet and sour.
Sesame chicken is my go to. You can get white rice or fried rice with any meal. Always too much food so you can take some home.
If you are in the Greeley area and have not tried this place yet, what are you waiting for? If you have not been in awhile, order some tonight!

My wife and I have eaten here a number of times over the last 4 or 5 years and the food is always great. I usually get Chicken amd Garlic Sauce or Sweet & Sour chicken and she gets Hunan or Schezwan Chicken. The dishes noted as spicey are nice and spicey but not overly spicey. I remeber at in the past asking for extra spicey which was too much for me, but if you like it stupid hot they can do it. The crab cheese wontons are a little on the sweet side but still tasty. The prices are good, service is great, and I always have leftovers for tomorrow's lunch.

The staff is very friendly and helpful. There are gluten free options listed on the menu (gf label next to the item)-I’d say about 15 by my estimation. There are vegetarian options as well. The atmosphere is great. Honestly I was a little afraid of going to a restaurant called “Yummy”, but it is actually really nice and professional. Highly recommend.

name: Hibino
document: Hibino. cuisine: Japanese Sushi Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Fun spot with changing daily specials - their $8 obanzai is the main attraction. We had the pork shiokaji which was incredible, so smoky and just the right amount of fat. Their roasted veg dish and salmon tartare don were also delectable. Their barley tea was also superb with unlimited hot water refills. Their sushi however - somewhat underwhelming - average fish quality but fair price. I would come again for hot dishes

I love this place, I did not expect for the sushi rolls to be so big with so much fish! Also it is so amazing how they have a large variety of options. The pumpkin croquettes were great. Service and atmosphere is like a diner almost, but with Japanese features.

This small neighborhood gem has been around for years and I've visited a few times for lunch and dinner. The food is consistently good and high quality, made with fresh ingredients. They've developed such a local following that you can always expect a line of patrons waiting to dine.

This time I went with cousins who are near weekly regulars. Their trick is to visit Hibino midweek before the restaurant opens to ensure immediate  seating. We waited for about 20 minutes before they opened their doors and were the last group of people to enter before they were completely full.

My cousin always gets the Grilled Salmon Collar Bento and raved about it, so the rest of us got the same and promptly cleaned them out of their stock of salmon collars. One of us had to choose a different menu item, so the Beef Short Ribs was selected. We also ordered some tuna and uni sushi to start.

Everything we ordered had good flavors and textures, and gave me comfort food vibes. It was like eating Japanese home cooking, but what also stands out is how fresh everything tastes. The high quality ingredients and freshness is apparent in every bite, and I think this is what keeps people coming back for more. I daresay they'll make a regular out of me too.

It's no wonder why Hibino is always so packed - the sushi is simply outstanding! We had the tuna tataki salad to start, which was flavorful and generous enough for two. We also shared a sushi special, along with two pieces of heavenly toro. The fried eel roll was scrumptious without being greasy or heavy. And to top off the evening, we enjoyed a Cloudy House sake that was not too sweet. All in all, it was a delicious date night experience that reminds one why they fell in love with this restaurant in the first place. Highly recommended!

The food is amazing. I ordered salmon sushi roll, spicy tuna roll (recommended), tuna sashimi, salmon belly sashimi.

The servers are nice and quick to serve. Recommended if you loved sushi.

document: Wasan Brooklyn. cuisine: Japanese. located in Brooklyn. with 4.1 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: went here to celebrate my friend’s going away. Ordered the lunch special sashimi bento box and it was just delicious. Very generous portion I must say. The fish tasted fresh. service was great. 👍

First time here.  Found it on the Infatuation. We were not disappointed. This is a neighborhood Japanese restaurant run by Japanese people.  The food is excellent and reasonably priced.  The service was great. Plain decor, but pleasant atmosphere. I had a sashimi bento box. A good portion of fresh sashimi for lunch along with salad, miso soup, spring roll, burdock. $24.50. My wife had two rolls.  Very happy with everything.  Will go back.

We came for an late lunch. The food is amazing as well as the services. I would give a 6-star if I can. When are sat down, the lunch menu was still served. As soon as I saw "Croquette" is served, I know this is an authentic Japanese restaurant. This is one item that I only typically see in a Japanese-owned Japanese restaurant. The waitress confirmed it for us. She is so sweet and friendly. After my wife placed her order, she actually suggested a different way to order the same set and we loved it! The way the sushi rice was prepared is so authentic, the Croquette was delicious! I ordered Nabeyaki Udon noodle, the best I ever had. The experience brought our memory back to a Japanese restaurant in Victoria Island Canada, one of the best we visited. The item prices also surprised us, the could be more expansive for sure. A bottle of Sapporo Beer was only $4, I will definitely come back!

Disappointing Experience

I was disappointed with my recent order from the curry outpost connected to the restaurant. I paid $16 for the chicken cutlet curry and was shocked by the portion size—it filled only half of the container. In addition, the chicken wasn't even a chicken cutlet, which was a big letdown. A warning to others to check the order before going home…

We dined in for dinner and had an amazing meal. The salmon sashimi and spicy ikura rice bowl was so fresh the fish melted in my mouth and my partner loved the tonkotsu ramen! Angelo was a great server and everyone working was very kind as well. Can't believe we haven't been here before, but we'll definitely be back.

name: Cavatappi NYC
document: Cavatappi NYC. cuisine: Italian Desserts Salad. located in Brooklyn. with 4.7 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Delicious food from start to finish. This charming corner spot delivers exceptional service and an impressive selection of fresh, homemade dishes. The eggplant parmesan was perfectly prepared—flavorful, tender, and beautifully balanced. To top it off, the cheesecake was truly outstanding, easily one of the best I have ever had. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for quality cuisine and a welcoming atmosphere.

My wife and I came here for a date night, and everything was absolutely wonderful. They started us off with complimentary bread and olive oil, which was a nice touch. Then came a huge portion of fried calamari — crispy, flavorful, and perfectly cooked with a delicious dipping sauce.

I ordered the pork chop, which was tender, juicy, and served with vegetables and potatoes in a cranberry-style sauce. The sauce was unique and added a nice, slightly tangy flavor. The portion was generous and very satisfying.

My wife ordered the cheese ravioli with jumbo shrimp. This dish was rich and comforting, and there were plenty of perfectly cooked jumbo shrimp. She loved it.

The only downside was that we were too full to try dessert — the portions were so big that we simply couldn’t fit anything else. But we’re definitely coming back next time just for the dessert!

The service was excellent — the staff were polite, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed without ever making us feel rushed. The atmosphere was cozy and romantic, making it a perfect spot for a lovely evening out.

You need to come here to this restaurant to experience the best food! The pork chop was amazing. It was juicy and brimming with flavor from the spicy sauce. The calamari was done to perfection. The mussels Normandy was tasty with the white wine sauce and the sweetness from the onions elevated the flavor. The cheesecake is light and airy not too heavy. Excellent place to enjoy Italian fare!

A delightful dining experience! The portions were generous and reasonably priced, offering great value. The food was delicious—full of flavor and clearly made with care. Service was excellent—friendly, attentive, and efficient. The place itself is small and cozy, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Perfect for a relaxed meal. Will come back for more😎
The pasta with pesto base was ok but everything with the marinara sauce was so so good!! Their cheesecake was not overly sweet so definitely recommend it. I almost ordered one to take home!

I came here for dinner recently and had a pleasant time! This cozy Italian spot in Brooklyn is the perfect spot for a date night with it's intimate and warm setting. Service here was pretty quick and very nice.

We ordered their olives, brocollini, and chicken liver to start and their seafood pasta, oxtail ragu, and wild boar ragu for mains. Everything was delicious. I loved their chicken liver and thought that it was a great pair with their olives, bread, and brocollini. I was pleasantly surprised by their wild boar ragu as it was so flavorful and didn't taste gamey at all (sometimes wild boar does). Overall, great spot for some pasta and I would love to come back!

Very pleased to have found this place. We didn't have a reservation on a busy Saturday night, but luckily there was a cancelation and we got a table. Service was fast and friendly. Our group tried the 2 specials: the meatball appetizer and oxtail risotto as an entree, while others tried some of the pasta dishes from the regular menu. Everyone was happy. I had the mushroom paparadelle--pasta was cooked perfectly and the mushrooms were very fresh. Would definitely visit again.
Great atmosphere, gives cozy Italian vibes. The pasta was clearly homemade and the sauce was absolutely amazing. I only wish that there had been a bit more oxtail on it.
Been here 3x, really solid food. The rigatoni alla Norma is by far my favorite thing to get and it’s amazing. The fried seafood app is also really great and perfect to share

name: Forma Pasta Factory
document: Forma Pasta Factory. cuisine: Pasta Shops Italian Salad. located in Brooklyn. with 4.6 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: My boyfriend and I come here quite often. Service is always super fast and the staff is very friendly. Forma is everything that you could want out of a small, casual pasta spot. Serving sizes are on spot every time, I finish every last bite feeling perfectly full. Pasta is always cooked to perfection AND their sauces are so amazing. I am a HUGE fan of spicy vodka and no one does it like Forma. Genuinely have not found another place that compares, we always find our way back here. Affordable pricing for the quality of food that you’re getting! Hands down one of my favorite spots!

Affordable and delicious pasta but buckle up friends no tip means you gotta do it by yourself 🤞 Be brave when you’re looking for the table; took me almost 10 minutes to get one and there’s no server so GOOD LUCK. I wish they had cold water too, but al least they have room temp water. Aranchini was EXCELLENT. Spicy aloli tasted great with nice amount of heat and aranchini was crispy and creamy. All of their pasta was very delicious and they know what they’re doing bc pasta is perfectly al dente and sauces also taste great. Portion size is also decent, but its goona be hard to finish if you nibble on their focaccia too much;bc their focaccia is DELICIOUS. Springy texture with amazing olive oil taste, YUM. I jsut have awesome memories from this place and can’t wait to go back.

Hands down the best pasta ever! My boyfriend and I make it a point to come here at least once a week! Their pasta is made fresh in house, and there are plenty of options to choose from. Their daily special on Saturdays is one of our favorites! The staff is always welcoming and attentive! Finding a seat may be hard on busy nights however, the turnaround is very fast so you won’t wait long! I wouldn’t suggest coming with a large party of people because the seating area is small and can’t really accommodate larger parties of 4 or more. It’s definitely a must try! We come
So often they know our order when we get to the counter to order!

Excellent pasta dishes perfectly cooked al dente with delicious sauce and a nice piece of focaccia. Reasonable prices and friendly service. Very narrow interior, small tables. Good for a quick bite, you will not be disappointed. Looks like a lot of people order delivery from here since there were quite a few DoorDash staff picking up, but I think the quality would degrade if you don’t get it fresh from the kitchen so I recommend eating in if you can. If the weather is good, they have a couple of tables outdoors in front or you can sit in the public space on the other side of the sidewalk. Recommend!

Late fall and winter is the best time because they have their tomatoe soup! I usually frequent the other location, but this one is just as good as the other one. I appreciate their constant quality of food. Definitely never disappointed when I eat here.

name: Scottadito Osteria Toscana
document: Scottadito Osteria Toscana. cuisine: Italian Venues & Event Spaces. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: One of my favorite old school Italian restaurants. I’ve been here for both brunch and most recently Valentine’s dinner, and had great experiences both times. Prices are standard, and the food was excellent. Even for a busy night, the workers were really on top of service. I’d definitely recommend and visit again!

Excellent service and great food! The Pappardelle Al Funghi was comforting and full of flavor, while the Ribeye with mashed potatoes and truffle shavings was cooked perfectly. Would absolutely recommend to friends.

From the moment we arrived we felt like family. The service was excellent! My husband and I went for a quick bite after work. The food was so delicious and fresh. The waiter recommended the Fisherman’s stew. Each bite was like a burst of the ocean with all the Italian spices. The seafood was fresh and so delicate!!! Thank you Chef for an amazing meal!!!
If you would like to have a terrific time dining, this is the place for you and your guests. Excellent food, fantastic service and an ambiance to boot. Thank you ... we will sure be coming back.

Excellent food, staff were very kind and helpful, and the service was very fast. I had a pasta with meatballs, top-notch.

My wife accidentally ordered the wrong meal, and they were kind enough to take it back and replace it and didn’t charge us for it. We didn’t even ask them to waive the cost, but they did it anyway.

Just goes to show their service to customers. Highly recommend it 100%.

name: Mama Rao Cucina Italiana
document: Mama Rao Cucina Italiana. cuisine: Italian Party & Event Planning. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: I reached out to two friends who have been rather busy lately to see if they would be able to make lunch this Saturday. They said that they wouldn’t be able to spare the time to go anywhere too far but if we stayed in Brooklyn they could make it. One of them suggested this restaurant whose food & service were amazing. They got a little carried away with the appetizers & ended up ordering the fried calamari, shrimp oregaganta, bruschetta & arugula salad. All of which were delicious. They had seasonal cocktails as well. I was the only one to try one & went with the whiskey cider which was very flavorful. For my main I had the rigatoni bolognese which was delicious & satisfying. The freshness of the pasta & the meat in the sauce was truly delicious. My friends ordered the linguine with clams & the chicken bruschetta. They both enjoyed their meals. Unfortunately since we went overboard with the appetizers we weren’t able to have dessert. I can’t wait for my next visit. The food & service were a true delight.

If there was ever a place that deserves every scrap of hype it gets, it's Mama Rao's. Everything was perfect from our appetizers to our drinks to our entrees to our desserts. We went on a Saturday night and had a group of 10. It was loud, boisterous, and joyful. Everything you expect in an Italian restaurant. The veal chop Milanese is not to be missed. The whipped pistachio dessert was otherworldly. 14/10 would recommend.

All I can say is wow, first time taking my family here. The food is unbelievable priced fairly fresh and portion size is good. So much better then all these run of the mill Italian places in bay ridge. Staff is great, place is really nice and clean, I’ve been missing out for years by not eating here. Everything is home made - they make their own pasta. Last night was easily one of the best meals I’ve ever had. Staff was excellent. Skip the other places and just come here. I can’t wait to come back. This place truly is a hidden gem. Very reasonably priced. One of those places you just have to try!

Just had another fantastic meal on Friday night- I had to take my mom to try it.
Is it possible to give higher then 5 stars???
Food is so good fresh and legit.
The staff is amazing
The prices are more then fair
The space is spotless clean
I can see why they been here over 20 years.
It’s hard now to find good legit Italian food in Brooklyn. I feel so lucky to have this close by. Such a great place. Full bar and reasonable as well
Private party room next door
And fresh pasta cheese store to the right, something you would see on Italian enclaves. Just wow. Even all the patrons in the place are all nice, just all around phenomenal

Prospect Park is a fantastic urban escape! The paths are scenic and well-maintained, the lake area is peaceful for walks or renting boats, and there are plenty of playgrounds and open spaces for kids. Loved the picnic areas, dog runs (very dog-friendly), and the variety—zoo, carousel, Audubon Center, and even some quiet wooded trails. Restrooms are decent and spread out. Only downside: it gets very crowded on nice weekends, and some areas could use a little more upkeep. Still, one of the best parks in NYC—highly recommend!
Very fresh and tasty. service are good!!!

name: Osteria Brooklyn
document: Osteria Brooklyn. cuisine: Italian. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: Had a wonderful Thanksgiving dinner here! The food was delicious, the atmosphere warm, and the service truly outstanding. What made the evening even more special was the owner and the chef personally greeting us on our way out — such a thoughtful touch. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for great food and genuine hospitality.

What an amazing late lunch with my daughter and girlfriends! The Cacio Pepe and the Osteria fettuccine, fried cauliflower and beet salad were to die for! The crème brûlée with strong coffee perfect!! The service was exceptional! Will be back!
Food is amazing and  the ambience feels like an Italian kitchen. This is a hidden gem, large portions, delicious food and excellent waiter staff. Don’t hesitate❤️

Love this place! It’s my go-to restaurant for my birthday, brunches with friends, or when my family comes into town. The food is delicious and I almost always get the Calamari and Crab Ravioli.  The staff are incredible and take care of all the little details. They clear the plates in a timely manner, always make sure your cup has water, box up your food for you and they’re just super sweet. When I go with my grandmother they’ve held her arm and walked her to the table like family. Highly recommend this place!

I am so disappointed to write this review because this was one of my favorite spots for some delicious pasta. My cousin and I decided to go here to celebrate the new year because they had a special. We were so excited because we came specifically for the Fettuccine Osteria. The pasta is described as “House specialty "Table Side" red wine infused pasta, white truffle sauce, seasonal truffle”. The first red flag was the customer service that night. We understand that servers and waiters are busy and it is New Year’s Eve, but we were shocked at the wait and the lack of acknowledgment from the staff. Multiple customers were crowded at the door and none of the waiters acknowledged us unless they needed to get wine or some other item being blocked by patrons. There was no update from staff as to when we would be seated or any greeting. We waited about 30 minutes before we were seated even though we had reservations.

Once my cousin and I were seated at the table, our waiter Christian acknowledged us once because the Christmas tree kept getting tangled on my cousins hair. Christian moved us to a more comfortable seat and we were thankful but maybe we should’ve kept our original spot because we became invisible to our server as the night progressed. This was the most aggravating experience because I tried multiple times to get his attention and I just kept being ignored. Our appetizers and food took about 30-40 minutes each to come out. When the main course arrived it looked like Alfredo! If I wanted Alfredo I would’ve made it at home. Where was the regular red wine infused pasta, white truffle sauce, and the seasonal truffle on top. My cousin was super disappointed and the first to notice  because she knew the pasta was not supposed to look the way it did. At this point I asked for a manager—they took the food back but when it came back out it was the same Alfredo pasta but with truffle sprinkled on top.

Lastly to make matters worse gratuity was included in the bill—which baffled me. I’ll never be back to this establishment. Please do not believe their hyped up instagram page.

name: I Cavallini
document: I Cavallini. cuisine: Italian Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Hard to find anything wrong here. If you didn’t know that this place is the sister to FH, you could probably figure out on your visit. The interior is beautiful, warm, and a little quickly. We enjoyed every dish we ordered. The focaccia is a must, the bluefin tuna curation (special) was great, and though I don’t normally care for them, the best beets I’ve ever had. The farfallone was rich, spicy, and deep and the gnochetti was layered and balanced. Of course, as expected all of their wines are delicious but do NOT pass on their cocktails (loved the house martini). And if you like tiramisu, theirs is a must. I think it’s the best I’ve had in NYC. The service is impeccable, the ambiance is inviting, and they have a nice, funky playlist (just like 4H) playing at just the right volume. Again, really struggling to fault this place for anything. Great experience! Highly recommend hunting for a reservation or making the effort to walk in!

Absolutely divine meal from start to finish. There was not a single dish I was not impressed by. We started with the razor clams, which had a lovely, fresh citrusy flavour, and the focaccia as starters. This was an amazing focaccia by the way. It was fresh, warm, and buttery, with the crust being nicely crispy but the inside being extremely soft. Then we moved on to the pasta. We got the farfallone, which was just perfectly al dente and had the right amount of spice and texture from the breadcrumbs while being extremely flavourful. Then we had the beets and the chicken. Honestly the best beets I’ve ever had. The burrata was not too heavy and had amazing seasoning which went well with the beets and the chicken was very tender and had a great gravy to go with. The desserts were also splendid. Special mention to the thyme gelato with candied lemons. Overall a delightful dinner.

Quite surprised — not in the best way. Overall it was good, but nothing mind-blowing, especially the pasta. You can skip the cucumber salad, but the focaccia with whipped ricotta is a must-order. The highlight was the tiramisu (truly the best I’ve had in the city — not even exaggerating), which is what made the experience feel a bit uneven. On the plus side, the wine selection is phenomenal. The service is top notch as well.

Absolutely amazing dinner at I Cavallini! The focaccia with whipped ricotta and roasted pumpkin was unreal—so fresh and flavorful. The trofie with pesto and parmigiano reggiano (hands down my fave) and the gnocchetti sardi with shrimp, zolfini beans, and herb butter were both knockout dishes we couldn’t stop talking about. And the grilled Berkshire pork chop with the preserved cherry glaze? DELICIOUS. Perfectly cooked and bursting with flavor. Truly an amazing experience from start to finish. We’re already excited to come back!

***updated! 02/2026
went back again and the second is just as memorable as the first time!

I Cavallini was a major letdown.

Service started off meh. Sure, they filled our glasses at the beginning but after that, it was sparse at best. Our table felt largely ignored by multiple staff members, and long stretches went by without anyone checking in. It wasn’t attentive or polished; it just felt disorganized.

Meal pacing was painfully slow. Courses dragged with noticeable gaps in between, and the evening felt unnecessarily drawn out.

The food and drinks were mediocre across the board. Nothing memorable, nothing particularly well-executed…it was really just average. At this price point and being part of the Four Horsemen group, “average” is not acceptable.

The value is honestly the worst part. Overpriced and low quality is a tough combination to justify. The Four Horsemen has phenomenal food, service, and overall experience. I Cavallini doesn’t come close.

Brooklyn has far too many strong dining options to spend this kind of money here. Not worth it.

name: Lillo Cucina Italiana
document: Lillo Cucina Italiana. cuisine: Cafes Italian. located in Brooklyn. with 4.7 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Where do I begin, the cozy interior, the kind hospitality from Lisa or the pasta cooked to absolute perfection? The place is small and there will likely be a wait but my goodness it is SO worth it. Every item we had was delicious and we didn’t feel rushed to hurry up and finish even though there was a line out the door. I highly highly recommend this spot for lunch or dinner, or a cute date night. The prices are very reasonable and the owners are so charming. My boyfriend and I went for Valentine’s Day and we will definitely be back!

Order: sautéed artichokes, lobster ravioli, cacio e pepe, and the meatballs with tomato sauce. Finished with a cappuccino and tiramisu. Everything was 10/10!!

This cute little Italian restaurant is pretty awesome in a quiet little neighborhood. The staff was super nice and made the vibe feel like a chill place to hangout and enjoy your meal.

I got the cacio e pepe which was great. The fresh cracked pepper and the pasta was very fresh and more al dente the way I liked it. This place takes cash only so make sure you have some on you to pay.

We're from Oregon visiting our daughter here.  We went to Lillo's with her who had eaten here many times and swore by it.   The service and surroundings couldn't be any more charming.   By the time you get to the food you're in a really good mood.  All the appetizers and main courses were excellent and very unique.   The artichoke appetizer, for example, was the best artichoke ive ever eaten.  We capped it all off with two desserts (Affogato/Tiramisu) which were also excellent.   The owners were both so accommodating and engaging.   We'll be eating here every time we visit.
This intimate gem of a local Italian restaurant is 👌👌👌 every dish we got were amazing. The pasta was delish, so were the salad, artichokes, and tiramisu. Super kind Italian owner and service

Cash only and a small place - there’s only 5 tables inside. One of the most genuine Italian restaurants I’ve been to. They perfectly prepared the clams so they didn’t have sand in them which is pretty hard to do. Everything was great. Got hot chocolate to go. Seems like they make a lot of things from scratch.

Update: I come here all the time still and my favorite thing to order is the spaghetti and meatballs. The tiramisu is really good too. They offer sparkling water at a really cheap cost.

name: Joe's of Avenue U
document: Joe's of Avenue U. cuisine: Sicilian Seafood Burgers. located in Brooklyn. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
It's definitely one of the best places left for Sicilian food. The food here is super delicious, preserving the original flavors, style, and taste of its origin.  Service is friendly and on point . The rice ball special is everything.
Iykyk panel is severed here, and it's done  perfectly.  I've been enjoying this place since I'm a kid.  Stop by and treat yourself before it's gone .

Awesome spot. I ordered calamari, pane panelle, and a chicken parm hero. It was delicious. They truly carry the tastes and recipes used in Palermo. I’ve had a few of the “Sicilian” spots in NYC and they’re at the top. The staff is actually Sicilian, and even the menu is in Sicilian. This is a proper spot to go if you’re missing a taste of home. 10/10 recommend.

The restaurant is located in the Gravesend section of Brooklyn.  They prepare Italian cuisine.  They have tables for dining-in and servers.  I ordered a rice ball.  It was small and not much larger than a mini-rice ball.  The filet of fish was flounder with some tomato on the top.  It included a choice of several vegetables.  I chose the fried cauliflower.  The food was average in taste and flavor.  My order totalled approximately $30 and was higher than similar food in other restaurants.

Finally made it to Joe's for lunch...    We ordered the octopus salad..  Fried calamari.. baked clams.. panelle  and seafood linguini..  all items were fresh and delicious.  Service perhaps could've been quicker but I didn't care.. well worth the trip here.   Old school joint in the italian holdout of Ave U.

Dropped by this place to grab a bite before work and found it to be a really nice spot for some good Italian standards. I've since visited a few times and enjoyed items such as stuffed artichoke, chicken parmigiana sandwich, arancini, and more. Definitely a reliable place for a hearty meal and friendly service.

name: Mariella
document: Mariella. cuisine: Italian Gluten-Free Salad. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Really fantastic food with incredibly attentive servers. The atmosphere was a hearth during the wintery weather. In a small quiet residential part of Park Slope.

I went to this restaurant with my boyfriend, and we had a great experience. The food was really delicious, and the portions were big. We ordered pasta and chicken parmesan, and both dishes were full of flavor. The pasta was creamy and had a nice mix of ingredients, while the chicken was crispy and covered with melted cheese.

The service was also really good. The staff was friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. The place had a cozy and romantic atmosphere, with candlelight on the table.

The food was high quality but not too expensive, which made it even better. They also gave us fresh bread with olive oil, which was a nice touch. Overall, I would definitely come back. It’s a great place for a nice meal without spending too much.

Really cute cozy spot with amazing fresh Italian food. I really enjoyed the fried fritters (arancine) which were so nice and crispy over a bunch of delicious butter cooked mushrooms. The lobster ravioli was really flavorful with the cream flavor being extremely rich. I also really enjoyed the squid ink pasta with salmon, capers, olives over white wine tomato sauce. Extremely fresh tasting and you can really taste the great ingredients.

Definitely will come back to try more of the nice little menu.
Great to go in a date, you can talk and enjoy the delicious food

I love this spot! Family friendly ! I messed up and was 30 minutes late to my reservation - this neighborhood spot is my kids’ fav spot. But the owner took pity on me and we had a blast!! Thank you !

Always get the penne with the Mariella sauce !
