name: Leland Eating and Drinking House
document: Leland Eating and Drinking House . cuisine: Wine Bars Mediterranean. located in Brooklyn. with 4.1 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: Been coming here for years and it never disappoints. The food is delicious- flavorful, high quality ingredients, and original flavors. Staff is always friendly. And it’s a lovely neighborhood gem. My husband I say it’s one of our favorite restaurants in all of NYC!

This place is just not up to the standard I expected - I’m wondering how they got so many high reviews. Maybe for the neighborhood the food is slightly above decent but still, it’s not worth the cost of the quality and portion size. First off we had a reservation but had to wait outside for about 20 minutes because the previous table wouldn’t clear, this is fine but there should be a standard for seating duration. The food was mediocre and I’m being nice here. The focaccia was cold on the bottom and warm on the top. The fish fritters had a cold and weirdly uniform consistency. The half chicken was good but it’s just sous vide chicken with salt and pepper. I liked the yu choy, that was the only redeeming point of the evening. Our waitress gave us a dessert for the long wait which was nice but the whole evening was just disappointing. I highly recommend going somewhere else, there are better options in the area.

Excellent food in a refined, airy space where you can actually hear your friends. What more could you want?

The Asian influenced food is outstanding. The Chicken Jook is warm, delicious and soul-filling. The Japanese Sweet Potatoes and Yu Choy are unique and delicious. Add a great soundtrack and it was the perfect Friday night dinner in brownstone Brooklyn.

Great food and service. From the get go the staff was really accommodating for our reservation making sure some of the guests' allergies where considered. The chicken joop porridge is worth the repeat!

Fantastic dining experience. Each meal is thoughtfully crafted using fresh local ingredients. You can tell that the chef has a personal connection to everything on the menu demonstrates mastery. I appreciated that the meals were simple and didn’t have unnecessary “fluff” - everything on the plate was intentional and had purpose.

We tried 7 or 8 items from the menu and loved everything. Our favorites were the mussels, eggplant fries, and cured mackerel. Highly recommend and will be back.

google_reviews.text:
Cute little coffee shop offering a limited pastry/food menu as well.
I popped in for a takeaway coffee the other day. The prices are fair and the latte was made quickly. The desserts looked delicious although I did not partake in them.
There is a small seating area indoors and none outside (but maybe there is in the summer).

Lovely little cafe! They made me an amazing latte and I tried the lemon fennel cake — scrumptious! Cozy with seating for about 10-12 people. Lovely for a little work, reading or journaling. It’s bright and music isn’t too loud. Will definitely be back!
Great place to sip some coffee and take some "shelter from the storm" . The coffee is good, pastries are top-flight, and the atmosphere is "double- plus good."

Nice coffee, decent drinks, good wifi.

When I went, the barista seemed overwhelmed and the dude in the back running the kitchen was just sitting there not helping or even talking to her. It was odd and made service much slower than I imagine it needed to be.

I went there to work on my laptop but it was too cold and loud to get anything done. Fair enough. It is more of a meet up, eat, and chat cafe. AFAIC they may as well just ban laptops. Anyway, I will definitely be back...but not to do any "heads down" laptop work.

Kinda cute with lots of spacing some outdoor tables which is delightful. There could be more lighting inside.

There are outlets but u have to bring own charger.

Prices r normal if not a big high for the area

Would still come back though!

name: The KOVA
document: The KOVA. cuisine: Breakfast & Brunch Coffee & Tea. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: My fiancé and I visited that restaurant, and I can't wait to go back there to try their other dishes.  We ordered mushroom & onion omlette, eggs royale, pancakes with blueberries (that were served wth fresh fruits), hot chocolate, and the KOVA coffee. Everything was delicious! Also, the staff was very nice and the atmosphere was very cozy.

Had brunch here during my stay on the Island. It was a very cozy little shop, but don't let that fool you! The food was very flavorful and the coffee was excellent. I had the eggs benedict, which was wonderful and the home fries were very well prepared (with some peppers and onions). Would definitely come back again in the future when I'm in town! Recommend!

A small but cozy place to have a brunch. Came with a friend and we enjoyed our food. We ordered cheeseburger and egg Benedict. Cheeseburger was good but definitely the fries were the bomb. The egg Benedict came with grilled potatoes which was also delicious!

We went for breakfast. It’s a very cozy restaurant with few tables. The food was delicious. We got onion and mushroom omelet, jalapeño omelet and breakfast royal. The omelets came with home fries. They made the home fries crispy for us. The waitress was very pleasant.

I visited two days in a row and was really impressed with the food it was consistently delicious. While there was minimal interaction with the staff, they were efficient, and the service was quick. The menu offers a great variety of both food and drinks. I highly recommend this place! Some of my favorites were the crème brûlée latte, cappuccino, beef roti, hash browns, turkey bacon, and iced coffee.

name: Wildberry
document: Wildberry. cuisine: Desserts Patisserie/Cake Shop Breakfast & Brunch. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: One of the best breakfast spots around. Quite a bit of a wait on the weekend and in Valentines Day. But their turn around was fast. The staff defiantly busy their butts. However they don’t rush you and make you feel very welcome. The food came out exceptionally fast. But it wasn’t like it was thrown together so fast that the quality lacked. So good that we came back a second time. Definitely recommend the cinnamon roll and berry pancakes. Flipping amazing. Not overpriced either

Had a few minutes of a wait but not too long. The food was good. Pancakes were okay. I didnt go all out and oot for the special pancakes. Maybe I should have. Still food was good and I'll try again if there's no line. Didnt really see much of the atmosphere but the coffee was great.

This place is perfect for those mornings when you wake up craving a really good breakfast and a warm, cozy atmosphere. It feels like the kind of spot you’d go to every day if you lived nearby. Everything was truly delicious, but I highly recommend the slow-roast brisket hash — it absolutely amazed me. I’ve tried similar dishes before, but none like this one. The coffee was also very good, and the waffles were delicious. The service was very attentive as well. Overall, a great option for breakfast.

The food was excellent — fluffy pancakes, fresh ingredients, and everything tasted exactly as good as it looked. It was the perfect start to our day and a great spot to sit down, slow down, and enjoy quality time together as a family.

What really made the experience stand out was our server, Daniel. He was friendly, attentive, and incredibly courteous to my girls, which meant a lot to me as a parent. His service made us feel genuinely welcomed and taken care of.

Between the food, the atmosphere, and the service, this was an all-around great experience. We will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend

Went for breakfast around 9 am on a sunday and only waited about 10-15 minutes but if you get there later you'll be waiting a lot longer. I have a gluten sensitivity and almost all oancake and waffle flavors can be subbed for gluten free batter. I ordered a skillet meal and it was delicious. It came with a side of pancakes so I ordered the cinnamon roll pancakes and they were some of the best pancakes I've ever had. Service was awesome as well. Would definitely recommend!

name: Terra
document: Terra. cuisine: Modern European Wine Bars Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 3.9 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Terra Gaucha is a noticeable upgrade over other Brazilian steakhouses. The decor is beautiful, the service is truly superior, and the staff is incredibly friendly and attentive from start to finish. The food quality is excellent across the board, and the service is fast. You never find yourself waiting for meat. If anything, you are overwhelmed in the best possible way.

They offer around 18 different cuts, and it just keeps coming. Everything feels well paced, energetic, and genuinely fun rather than rushed or chaotic. You can tell they are still new and really focused on delivering top tier customer service. Definitely go now while they are firing on all cylinders.

We celebrated my wife's birthday at Terra Gaucha last night. We are regular Fogo de chao patrons, but we have not received good service and food lately.
We decided to give Terra a try, we were pleasantly surprised with the service and food quality since this location is new.
Whe were seated promptly, the waitstaff immediately came to us and from that moment on they were attentive and accommodating. The Gauchos brought food around frequently. The quality of the meats were amazing. The temperature of the meats was perfect.
The Salad bar is amazing and has something for everyone.
I will definitely return!

We celebrated a special friend’s birthday at Terra Gaúcha this past weekend and had an amazing experience! 🎉

Reservations & Seating: Booking for our group of five was effortless, and we were greeted and seated right away.

Atmosphere: The restaurant has a modern, elegant vibe, warm, serene, and perfect for special occasions.

Service: Our server Michael was attentive, professional, and welcoming, always available to answer questions. The manager (I believe his name was Zack) also checked in throughout the meal, ensuring everything was seamless. Truly outstanding.

Food & Drinks:
The hot/cold bar was fully stocked with a wide variety of fresh/warm options.

Cocktails were tasty, though a bit strong for my liking.

The meats were excellent. I thoroughly enjoyed the shrimp, salmon, filet mignon, chicken, and lamb, which were all flavorful and well-prepared.

Also, the  parfait is a must-try!

One disappointment: I was looking forward to the cheese with honey, but it wasn’t available due to a supplier quality issue. While I appreciated their commitment to quality control, I was a little bummed.

Birthday Touch: The staff surprised the birthday celebrant with a complimentary dessert and a cheerful song, which made the celebration extra special.

By the end, we were all happily stuffed and couldn’t have asked for a better brunch. I’ll definitely be coming back with my family!

Terra Gaucha Steakhouse was an outstanding experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely amazing—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. Every bite was tasty and delicious, truly what you expect from a top-tier steakhouse.

What really set this experience apart, though, was the exceptional service. Everyone was friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Lucas and Washington deserve special recognition—they were wonderful, helpful, and made us feel truly cared for throughout the entire meal.

Great food paired with exceptional service made this a memorable dining experience. I highly recommend Terra Gaucha Steakhouse and can’t wait to return!

I had a phenomenal dining experience last night celebrating my cousin’s birthday at Terra Gaucha Brazilian Steakhouse. I was honestly a little nervous going in since it is a steakhouse and I am a vegetarian with seafood and nut allergies, but I was completely blown away!

From the moment we arrived, the staff was attentive and incredibly accommodating about my dietary restrictions. The cold and hot bar was fresh and filled with impressive options. I never once felt limited. Everything I tasted was beyond delicious. Divine is truly the best word to describe the food.

The drinks were amazing, the atmosphere was vibrant yet elegant, and the entire evening felt celebratory and special. It was the perfect place to mark such an important occasion.

I will absolutely be back and highly recommend Terra Gaucha to anyone celebrating something special, regardless of dietary restrictions. Truly a five star experience.

document: Secret Garden . cuisine: Cafes Tea Rooms Vegan. located in Brooklyn. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
The food & service was excellent. We had the baked artichoke dip with fresh sliced bread as an appetizer and Rosa linguini as an entree. We shared the food together and were impressed by how amazing it was. There were many items I wanted to try that I never had like the warm goat cheese pecan salad, the bourbon bread pudding, and the turkey jelly sandwich.  The ambience was clean & spacious despite how small the area was inside and the tiny bathrooms.

The only thing I was not able to have was second filling of coffee. It was still brewing when it came to our time to leave.

Delicious! We've been here twice now, and both times were superb. Staff was VERY attentive, our drinks never ran dry. Food is served quickly, and they are happy to make accommodations (I love French toast, but I prefer to add my own syrup, they were happy to put it on the side for me). Highly recommend ❤️ pictures don't properly convey how flavorful everything was.

Cutest little spot for brunch with a friend or your significant other. The service was great all around. Each employee came around to check on us and make sure we were okay. Potato bacon soup had great flavor, but could have been a lot warmer. Breakfast sandwich was delicious. Shrimp & grits were tasty, but the sauce was too much and just okay. Next time I’ll ask for it on the side. The one thing I will say is to educate your staff on wine so that when we ask a question we won’t get an answer that I know isn’t correct about a particular type of wine.

The breakfast is delicious. The Salmon was cooked to perfection. It's team service environment so you may have multiple servers but all of ours was great 👍🏾. The outside is cool to have breakfast if you're ok with bees...we moved inside. Inside is typical... nothing amazing as far decor. This is in a cute town to walk around after breakfast. The pecan salad was delicious.

Brunch at The Secret Garden Cafe in Occoquan was absolutely wonderful. The atmosphere is warm and charming and it feels like a true hidden gem in the heart of town. Our brunch plates were fresh and flavorful but the highlight of the entire meal was the Coconut Cake. The slice was a very generous portion and so moist and rich with perfectly sweet coconut frosting. It is easily one of the best coconut cakes I have had anywhere. If you come for brunch this dessert is a must order.

((4.25 stars))

For the main we tried the burgers, cod, and risotto and all of them were very delicious options. From the three the burger was the best in terms of flavor, portion, and price. The dark chocolate brownie was a great way to finish this meal and the staff helped make this moment special for a family birthday gathering. I highly recommend and will be coming back here soon!

Great brunch spot in Williamsburg with quite the scene. The menu is limited but there are still plenty of options to choose from.
The Shakshouska was perfectly balanced and served with huge pieces of warm toast. My friend was happy with her salad but wished she ordered the burger once we saw it.
When the burger and potatoes came out for the table next to us I think we both drooled a bit. It was quite the show stopper.
Definitely need reservations and should specify inside or out.

This review is about sustainability!

I was so grateful to find a spot in the neighborhood where I could come to read, write, and enjoy a coffee without making any plastic trash.

By 2050, there will be more plastic in the ocean than fish, so it means a lot to me to support local businesses that are walking the talk when it comes to protecting both Brooklyn‘s waterfront and our global waterfront.

I love the real mug, plate, and glass of water! And of course, the delicious cappuccino. It does not go unnoticed or unappreciated, your efforts to provide a comforting, welcoming space. So thank you!
Serenico has a great brunch menu. The food is fresh and delicious. But I mainly come for the bartender. Sofia makes a great espresso martini and amaretto sour with egg whites.

name: Nowon Bushwick
document: Nowon Bushwick. cuisine: Korean New American Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
We did the coursed menu which for the price, was a decent amount of food. But despite being advertised as the best way to fully experience their food and Korean-American fusion, most dishes were just an American dish with an “Asian” ingredient, that sometimes worked, and other times felt like it was just thrown in arbitrarily without any regard for how it would blend with the other flavors.

The marinated cucumbers were good, they’re exactly what you’d expect.

The Caesar was okay. Just okay. And I feel like unless you’re a random diner with a billion menu items and plan on just serving your Caesar as a pile of chopped romaine and bottled dressing, you can not have an “okay” Caesar on your menu. It needs to be great. Especially if you believe it is good enough to have it on a prix fixe menu that you claim to be the best way to experience what your restaurant has to offer. It was a mediocre classic caesar dressing that randomly had nori and black sesame, neither of which added enough color, flavor, or texture to be noteworthy.

The chopped cheese rice cakes were very good! The rice cakes are fried a bit, which gives them an amazing texture. The sauce was cheesy and the ground beef was delicious. It all blended together very well, and felt very intentional.

The kebabs were just kebabs with a very sweet gochujang sauce, nothing to write home about. I suppose you could dip anything in gochujang and write it off as “Korean-American”.

The burger was fine. It was a burger, and it was juicy and cheesy and the bread was soft. There was kimchi on it. That’s the “Korean” part. That’s it.

The tater tots were the dish I liked the most but also had the biggest issue with. Honey glazed tater tots— a genius idea, and pair amazingly with the salty burger. However, a ton of furikake is dumped onto the tater tots, with seemingly no regard as to how it tastes on the tater tots themselves. It is fishy and briney in a distracting way, and its fragrant toastiness is totally lost. It just doesn’t make sense with the present flavors.

A prix fixe menu is often tells a story, and is usually designed to let you experience the best the restaurant has to offer. Enough said!

I recently visited the Brooklyn location of this restaurant and was a bit surprised by how quiet it was. The place was nearly empty, maybe one or two tables occupied, despite the fact that their Manhattan location is usually booked out well in advance. This location had plenty of reservation availability, which made getting a table easy.

The restaurant sits in a more industrial part of Brooklyn. There isn’t much happening in the immediate area, and the streets nearby are a bit rough around the edges. That said, once you step inside, the atmosphere is completely different. The interior was extremely clean, music was playing, and the service was attentive and friendly.

As for the food, it was a bit of a mixed experience. The chicken with sauce had good flavor, but I wasn’t a fan of the texture. I had assumed it would be more like popcorn chicken made with breast meat, but it seemed to be made with chicken thighs. That’s more of a personal preference issue, but it definitely affected how much I enjoyed the dish.

The burger was solid and flavorful. I’ve heard people say it’s one of the best burgers in New York City, and while it was good, I’m not sure I’d go that far. A lot of the flavor comes from the two sauces on the burger, which work well together, but it doesn’t quite stand out as a great standalone burger compared to some others in the city.

The real standout for me was the chopped cheese. It was absolutely amazing and easily my favorite dish of the meal. If I went back, that’s the one item I’d order again without hesitation.

The tater tots were also very good. They come with an extra sauce that adds some flavor, but overall they’re more of a solid side than something truly memorable.

Overall, I’d definitely come back. Next time, I’d probably skip the chicken and stick with the chopped cheese, maybe add the tater tots again, or try something new from the menu.

I Did the tasting menu at Nowon Bushwick and it did not disappoint. Everything was delicious the salad was great, the cucumber kimchi was surprisingly amazing, and the burger? Perfect. Easily the highlight of the meal.

The tasting menu is worth it, but next time I’m going straight for the legendary burger. It’s on another level.

Overall visit here went well. It was on my list for a minute and finally planned Saturday brunch. Easy breezy and no need for resys. Here were the CONS:
-Those wooden benches and chairs. Ouch! The cushions were too small and flat and did nothing.
-Entrees WITH NO SIDES! Restaurants really need to stop doing this. It’s not cool…
Food didn’t come out all together. Our burger was the last thing that came out and it took a minute. Have the wait staff explain that.

PROS:
That $21 burger (with NO SIDE) was worth the hype!
That whipped ricotta toast 10/10
Cocktail was a banger
Service was amazing! Wait staff was friendly and full of smiles.
They have a coat check!
The place was a vibe, from the music videos projected on the wall to the music playlist!

Happy I went. May return for the Legendary 🍔

Such a fun dining experience! We came on a Sunday night, so it was pretty quiet. Burger was amazing, one of the best burgers we ever had. The chopped cheese rice cakes were delicious and fun. The cucumber kimchi was the perfect refreshing bite and the general lee chicken was tasty. Since the chicken was dark meat, it was a little heavier than expected. Great time and we look forward to returning.

document: Nerina. cuisine: Greek Seafood Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.8 stars (exceptional).

Had the Greek salad which I’ve been craving for, hummus, baked bread, grilled lamb, grilled fish with lemon butter. Everything was fantastic, and overall the dishes really brought out the natural flavors and fresh sweetness of the ingredients.

We are so happy to find this beautiful restaurant in the neighborhood.  We just moved in and dined here to enjoy the most fresh, and tasty wholesome food. The staff were all amazing accommodating us and our grandson for an early Sunday dinner.
We ordered the whole fish and whole lemon chicken, plus many mezze small dishes. Everything we put in our mouths was delicious, healthy, light and tasty.
Very happy and will return again and again!

document: Kinoko. cuisine: Cajun/Creole Sushi Bars Japanese. located in Brooklyn. with 4.7 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: Stopped by to get some Gumbo Ramen and it was great! Emma greeted me and recommended the dumplings as a small plate. She’s got good taste because it was delicious! I was in a rush so I didn’t get to finish the ramen but I can’t wait to come back and enjoy it again!

Grew up in New Orleans and when a friend of mine from New Orleans visited for the weekend and recommended this place, we had to of course check it out!  The atmosphere seemed lively and friendly.  It was fun to see how the chef weaved NOLA influences  into Japanese fare.  Happy to report that the food here was delicious and did not disappoint.  Would definitely go back to try other items.   Thanks for a great evening!

kinoko is a super vibey & special place with a dope owner, good music, and some of the freshest and best food. hand rolls, fire. gumbo ramen, fire. scallop crudo, amazing. caesar salad, delicious. jambalaya, a must try. (also anything listed as a special for the night should never be bypassed) *every* menu item is truly so good and there are also great vegan options. looking forward to hanging out this spring on the patio and sipping a chilled orange wine and enjoying happy hour soon!

I fear I am never going to shut up about this place. Stumbled in here after having no plans and I’m so glad we did! Most of the time I try sushi I am at least a little underwhelmed on some of the dishes or rolls… well, consider me fully whelmed. Kinoko is INCREDIBLE.

Every employee was super helpful and kind, we got seated quickly, the space was clean with ample seating both indoors and out. The owner/chef Kelseay stopped by to chat, and welcomed us to the neighborhood warmly. This place opened up ~6 months ago, but it felt so cozy and operated smoothly it seems like it’s been a neighborhood staple for years.

Tried the Firefighter Roll, from the special menu - this is to die for. Absolutely sacrifice your soul and spend eternity in purgatory or whatever just to have a nibble. I loved it. It was wrapped in foil and we got to have a small and sensible pyrotechnic moment, as the roll was heated to melty perfection.

The volcano roll was also a star, plated nicely and delicious. One of the things that stood out the most though was how a seemingly ~*basic*~ cucumber & avocado roll could be so tasty. With the addition of the kinoko chili oil which incorporates mushrooms, it elevated it to perfection. Really well priced roll too!

The chili oil made an appearance on another special that we loved: the scallop nigiri with shiitake and the chili crunch. The scallops were perfectly buttery and soft.

I did not have a single bad bite or even underwhelming bite. Every moment of this dining experience was pure taste bud bliss.

GO HERE IMMEDIATELY.
Meal with 4 items fed 2 people to fullness for under $100 😌 Including 20% tip, which you absolutely should be tipping at minimum… tbh they deserve a million dollars.

Update: every single vegan option is amazing. The Mango Tango and the Creole Roll are both so outstanding.

Creative food and nice ambience. Small kitchen and staff, so the food took a little longer than expected. Dumplings were good, the NOLA roll was tasty, just a little more expensive than expected, chicken karaage was a good portion, but maybe should have been sauced, and the jumbalaya rice was comforting.

Their cocktails were so good! My only gripe is that it was difficult to find the opening, as it looked like an apartment door. Maybe clearer signage? Otherwise, great drinks and vibes.

name: Turtles All The Way Down
document: Turtles All The Way Down. cuisine: Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 3.8 stars (good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: This is a fun spot! Divey but not in a pretentious way, good beer selection, shuffle board table, and there are turtles! Cute outdoor patio as well. Every first Sunday of the month they apparently have turtle races? Will need to come back to confirm.

One of my favorite bars in Brooklyn! They have a wonderful shuffleboard table, ATM, water cooler for easy water access, and lots of great seating around the bar. Lots of views, a fish tank at the bar,  great music playing, outside patio and an awesome turtle tank with two very active turtles. Really a treat to visit! They have a great selection from high quality drinks to wonderful deals such as 4 bucks for a 24oz draft Budweiser. 7 dollar boilermakers! It's really a wonderful place! I mean they have turtle races how can you resist!!?!?! Riff was my bartender super welcoming and a breath of fresh air to talk to!

Went here on a Saturday night and there was a terrible bartender (white guy with long blonde hair). Overall I had a really disappointing experience at this bar. The bartender was not only inattentive but also rude. We waited a long time to be served, and when we finally ordered, he seemed irritated. When several patrons politely asked if he could change the music, he flatly refused and made it clear he wasn’t interested in accommodating any requests and directed us to the jukebox. Once we went to the jukebox and requested our songs he would skip over the ones he didn’t like and when I complained, he offered to give me my money back for skipping the songs. Absolutely unprofessional!  The drinks were poorly made, and overall, the service was just terrible. Won’t be coming back—there are much better places with friendlier staff and a more welcoming atmosphere.

Haven’t been back in years and that white guy with the glasses, the beard, and the hat is still working there. He’s always so professional and kind even when the bar is packed to the gills. I’m really reviewing for him, it’s nice to see a familiar face, and to see that the bastards haven’t ground him down yet.

Also drinks are still cheap and the vibe still sleazy 🤘 They didn’t have security guards back in my day, just a bouncer, but it’s for the best now, there used to be quite a few creeps (just part of the experience imo) and I got none of that energy this time.

I liked that the turtle tank was by the bathroom line, made being in the way of the flow of traffic more tolerable. This is a proper dive, be warned or be psyched.

I kind of hate to not be able to leave five stars because I really loved almost everything about this place. Great vibes, fishtank(!), turtles(!), amazing music.

But, to walk into a dive bar and get a really intense bag check and then get a full TSA patdown is extremely jarring and very nearly had me ready to turn back around. I'm sorry if maybe something bad happened here that made this feel necessary, but again, to unexpectedly get a full patdown is a real vibe killer and also really questionable in general? I really dont need a cool nice dive bar to normalize the surveillance state we've got going on outside or to act like our neighborhoods are war zones.

name: Cocktail Bedstuy
document: Cocktail Bedstuy. cuisine: Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Came here with a couple of friends and loved the vibe. The bartenders are very attentive, even if you’re not sitting directly at the bar, and they really know how to make all kinds of cocktails. Everything we tried was absolutely delicious.

We also had the spinach artichoke dip with pita made from scratch, which was so good. The music is at the perfect level loud enough to enjoy, but quiet enough to actually talk and have a chill time without yelling. Such a welcoming spot. I’ll definitely be back with my friends.

Stumbled in here after a Giants game and Brian and Ivan took care of me to the fullest. The mezcal cocktail he made was phenomenal and they also happened to be doing a pop up menu with some absolute supreme African cuisine. I had the pepper soup and feel like a million bucks. Yall should hurry up and go support these guys because this place is great!

This isn't just any bar; it genuinely feels like my own personal Cheers in this neighborhood. The owners have truly cultivated an amazing vibe here.

When it comes to their drink selection, it's top-tier, clearly very well thought out. And the cocktails? Forget what you know – these creations are on another level. They're so creative and unique, you simply won't find better anywhere else, believe me. Oh yeah, and get this – their wine specials are unbelievable! You have to experience them to believe it.

But it's not just about the drinks, though they are a major highlight. This place welcomes everyone with open arms. Good vibes only, you understand?! And just when you think it can't get any better, they have a fantastic backyard space to relax in. Plus, they regularly host some incredible food pop-ups.

Seriously, Cocktail Bedstuy is a true diamond in the rough. You absolutely need to drop in and check this place out. You won't regret it. Trust me on this.
great service and vibes. pretty crowded at 8 pm on thursday unfortunately we narrowly missed happy hours. cocktails looked great so did food but we just drank canned beer. decent selection

Coming from a cocktail queen; cocktail BedStuy is making them well. Alex was so attentive to our group and the cocktails were cold and excellently made. My whiskey sour was one of the best I’ve had.

Food is not really on their menu; it was African food that had some hits (jerk chicken dumplings) and some misses (Suya was gray). You have to cash app a gentlemen as you order more items; this got tedious after a while.

I’m definitely coming back; just not ordering the food. If you are planning to visit, please eat before or afterwards

One of my favorite new places. They have so many great cocktails for any mood you’re in. The bartenders are really friendly and it was nice being in a spot where locals wanted to come again and again. I want to come back next time im in the area!

name: Hide & Seek
document: Hide & Seek. cuisine: Bars Empanadas Coffee & Tea. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
The food here is outstanding. I’ve had the short ribs, the lobster pasta, and even the Caesar salad—everything was excellent. The Brussels sprouts were easily the best dish I had during restaurant week, and I’ve been here multiple times because the food and drinks never disappoint.
That said, the service is consistently terrible. I understand the need to turn tables and stay on schedule, but this goes far beyond efficiency. On more than one visit, the service felt rushed and careless. At one point, while we were still actively eating, our waitress asked if we needed boxes—clearly trying to move us out.
I’m not being nitpicky; it’s genuinely that bad. I’ll likely return because the food is that good, but only if you’re willing to tolerate truly poor service. If great food and drinks matter more to you than the dining experience, then this place is worth a visit—but be prepared for disappointing service.

Also, they add tip onto your bill so just know that you’re tipping that 20% regardless of how anything turns out.

Came here for restaurant week! The mood lighting was cute (which is usually the theme in west loop) and everything we tried was 10/10! Our waiter was so accommodating and nice! Definitely will be back!

Food + desserts we tried:
-Caesar Salad
-Ravioli
-Braised Short Rib + Cauliflower (is spicy!)
-Tiramisu (comes shareable)

Drinks we tried:
-SAFE WORD
-DESPERADO

Tried this restaurant for the first time during restaurant week. The service was attentive and friendly. We ordered the croquetas which were very good 9/10, followed by the Parisian Gnocchi, which could have been better 7/10, and Spanish octopus which came with potatoes 8/10. The ultimate star of the show was the Tiramisu, which was probably the best tiramisu I've tried anywhere, I would go back for the sake of the tiramisu alone.
Great modern/classy atmosphere, great service, great food, ultimately worth checking out if you're in the Fulton market area.

My fiancé and I had the pleasure of dining in and being served by Nick! We were quickly sat, and our coats were taken to keep them out of the way. Nick was quick and knowledgeable about the menu. We went with many of his recommendations and our favorites were the French Onion bread appetizer and the short rib entree! We also enjoyed the hamachi, sticky ribs, and fried artichokes. Nick started us off with celebratory shots for our engagement and we enjoyed some of the seasonal cocktails like the peppermint espresso martini shortly after. The food was OUTSTANDING and the drinks were hard to top! Nick ended our night with a surprise sparkly dessert. We will absolutely be coming back when we return to Chicago. Thank you so much Nick for the wonderful night!

Hide + Seek in Chicago brings that perfect mix of cozy and upscale. The warm wood ceiling, chandeliers, and moody lighting make it feel intimate and stylish the kind of place you want to linger with good company and a glass of wine.

✨ The Food:
The pasta was amazing rich, buttery, and full of flavor, easily one of the highlights of the night. The fries were crispy, golden, and seasoned perfectly classic comfort done right.

🍷 The Experience:
The service was great attentive and genuinely friendly, adding to the easygoing yet elevated vibe of the evening. It’s a spot that feels thought-out in every detail, from the textures on the walls to the creative lighting overhead.

📍 Hide + Seek Chicago
Stylish, warm, and delicious a place that balances ambiance and flavor beautifully.

name: Barbès
document: Barbès. cuisine: Bars Jazz & Blues. located in Brooklyn. with 4.0 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: A place where top-level musicians perform authentic music from various countries and cultures almost every day. You can always count on it—one of the few places in Brooklyn where you can experience truly genuine music. Some performances are weekly, some are not; music schedules are on their website. Plus, the bartenders are nice and fun—it's always a good time!

Such a nice quaint place with live music, the staff is incredibly nice, sweet and gracious. Drink drinks could be a little bit stronger, but aren’t too far off. This is definitely a great place come on a Saturday and Sunday and just chill out.
I love dropping into this place and hearing whatever is being performed that night. Every time the music is a delight. Plus, they have a great drink selection!

Barbes is a small bar that smells a bit funky - perhaps fermenting beer somewhere. It is very narrow and the main hall is dominated by the bar itself with a few seats on the side of the wall. So this is where you start scratching your head, what's all the 5-star reviews about.

This is not an "upscale" place. This is a very blue-collar, down-to-earth, grit and grime friendly type of place. You know it's been around, and you know this is not where you dress fancy but rather comfortingly confident.

The beer is good, the service is good. And there's generally a good vibe. But so are hundreds of other bars. Then what's the secret?

There is a mini music stage behind the bar and it almost feels like you have this massive underground talent that just simply jumps on stage and starts to play amazing music live. The back room fits about 20~30 person tops and some sit in there, others peek from the window or the door, but also, the music flows throughout the bar all the way to the front.

On the day I visited, literally the pianist played classical Chopin. Not jazz. Not some rearranged version that is bar-crowd friendly. She just started ripping out Fantasie Impromptu. I have never been at a bar that is run-down, listenining to top notch classical piano, and having an amazing time.

Barbes is special. Both for the locals, the musical talent in the city, and for everyone in between.

The venue itself is not so memorable, but the programming is refreshingly unique, with quality acts ranging from classical to folk to jazz. Decent acoustics, and friendly staff. Pricing acceptable. In the aftermath of the 'Rona, musicians would perform in masks except for their ensembles' wind instruments, so security theater is part of the entertainment.

name: Yard Bar
document: Yard Bar. cuisine: Beer Gardens Bars Beer, Wine & Spirits. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
The Yard is a popular casual dining establishment that offers a laid-back and family-friendly atmosphere.

The ambiance at The Yard is typically relaxed and inviting, making it a comfortable spot for a casual meal with friends or family. The restaurant often features an outdoor seating area, adding to the overall charm of the dining experience.

The menu at The Yard typically features a variety of American comfort foods, from classic burgers and sandwiches to appetizers and salads. The focus is on hearty and satisfying dishes that appeal to a wide range of tastes.

Service at The Yard is generally friendly and attentive, creating a welcoming atmosphere for diners.

Overall, The Yard in Manassas is a convenient choice for those seeking a straightforward and uncomplicated dining experience. Its casual ambiance, comfort food offerings, and family-friendly atmosphere make it a suitable spot for a casual meal or gathering.

This is a very cool spot that I was surprised to find, since I drive through the area regularly. A brewery, a distillery, 2 restaurants and a pile of food trucks with everything from ice cream to coffee have collaborated to form an open and closed air "park" where you can freely roam from one venue to the next to sample to offerings. Unified invoicing means you swipe your card and open a tab at one register and it follows you through the yard complex. There's corn hole and fire pits and a stage where a live act was performing on Saturday. My only complaint is that the act changed through our visit and didn't do a sound check so one act was much much louder than the other and myself and a few other tables decided to relocate further from the stage to continue listening AND talking. Maybe level set the music but otherwise a perfect day. Will return.

What an awesome concept! Open a tab and order drinks or food from any of the bars, restaurants, or food trucks.

Maybe it was the long work week and the beautiful weather, but everyone in my group was impressed with the venue and loved our time relaxing with food, drinks, and live music!

google_reviews.text:

fries were out temporarily, replaced with chips

Long Island Bar is perfection. The food hits that sweet spot of comforting but inventive, and the drinks flow so easy you lose track of the decade you’re in. Part of me doesn’t even want to write this because I don’t need TikTok mobs storming our neighborhood gem.

Start with the cheese curds and pretend you’re balancing them out with the gem salad. The deviled eggs are a must, and the burger never misses. Even the white Negroni, glowing radioactive yellow, tastes like it was invented here. Every detail is dialed in and the bus boys somehow always know when you are done even if their are fries left?? How??

It’s the kind of place that feels like yours the moment you sit down. No gimmicks, just timeless perfection. Easily the best restaurant in South Brooklyn.

Atmosphere: 7.5/10
Located in Cobble Hill, Brooklyn, The Long Island Bar exudes classic American diner vibes with its neon signage and chrome accents. Inside, the high-backed booths, chrome-trimmed chairs, and laminated menus reinforce the nostalgic theme. While the decor is charmingly retro, the backbar is minimal, featuring mostly glassware without an extensive display of spirits. Music volume was well-balanced, complementing the ambiance without overpowering conversation.

Drinks: 5/10
Recommendation: Improved Pendennis Club
The cocktail menu is concise, presented in a simple, laminated diner-style format. Drinks leaned towards the sweeter side, lacking depth and complexity. Presentation was basic, with standard glassware, no coasters, and minimal garnishes.

Service: 6.5/10
The staff was friendly and attentive throughout the visit. Water was only provided upon request. Prices were slightly below average for New York.

name: The Cat
document: The Cat. cuisine: Cocktail Bars Wine Bars Beer Bar. located in Brooklyn.

google_reviews.text:
I've been here about three times now and it's my favorite cat lounge in the area. It's only $15.20/hour for students and about $19/hour for adults, which is the most affordable I've found. They also have other discounts available. Booking is easy and quick through their website.

The lounge is on the back side of the building, so don't expect it to be in the front. You have to drive around to the back, which can be a little confusing your first time. Parking is free, but the spots directly in front of the lounge fill up fast and the speed bumps are pretty high, so take it slow. If the front spots are taken, there's plenty of parking nearby.

When you arrive, you'll enter a front desk area first (no cats in this room, it's basically an airlock so no cats can escape). You sign a waiver (you can do this ahead of time through the email you get after booking, or sign it there), clean your hands with hand sanitizer, and take your shoes off. If it's your first time, the staff will give you a quick rundown of the dos and don'ts. If you've been before, you can skip straight in.

The space is really well designed for the cats. There are climbing structures, obstacles built into the walls and ceiling, and tons of spots for the cats to hide and explore. It's genuinely cool to watch them crawl around up above you. There's seating throughout, including tables, a hanging chair, and you can sit on the ground too. The place is clean and they have restrooms. They also have a separate kitten room with the smaller babies, but only a few people are allowed in at a time (it's posted on the door).

The cats are cats, so some are super friendly and some do their own thing. I'd recommend going in the morning when they're more active because they tend to be tired by the end of the day. There's a little treat dispenser where you can pop in a few quarters and get treats for them, plus tons of toys lying around you can play with. You can also adopt cats here. I haven't gone through the process myself, but a lot of people come specifically for that.

The staff is always super friendly and welcoming every time I've been. An hour session is more than enough for a fun visit, but if you really love cats you can book two hours. You can honestly just bring a book or your laptop and study while hanging out with the kitties. Definitely recommend it.

I was so sad when it came time to leave the cats. This place was such a wonderful experience. Made my entire day so much better. The cats were such a joy, most were so friendly and sweet. There's a couple spicy ones lol. Bring some quarters for cat treats and little figurines if you want. Staff were friendly and didn't rush us out like other cat cafes in Alexandria. The vibes were chill and relaxing. The cats here seemed more at ease too. I'll probably be back in a few days because I can't stay away!

google_reviews.text: I don't always mind the pricing of drinks if they're delicious and strong and that's what I had here. The rum punch had a unique flavor that I think came from nutmeg (according to the bartender).I feel like the bartenders are good at what they do and the atmosphere was super vibey... especially the outdoor space (so nice). The only downfall of sitting outside is that the music isn't as prevalent. The whole operation is smooth and I was into it all! ... also clean bathrooms make me happy!

It's really annoying that they don't serve any food (despite the pictures of food with prices on their website) or partner with area restruants to deliver food to you there. So you have to use Uber eats or GrubHub which comes with a service charge.  The happy hour drinks were really overpriced in my opinion, especially since theres no top shelf liquor available. There's an outdoor space with heaters that don't really give any heat and they also don't let you smoke outside which was a little confusing because... Aren't we outside? Overall rating...Meh.

I stopped by for a brief visit and I love the entire atmosphere and decor. I was informed that this a black-owned business and the owner is a woman, congrats to her! Alex, the bartender was very helpful and answered all of my questions. This is a definitely a good place to visit, grab a bite to eat, and to enjoy the vibe because this place is a vibe by itself. It has been open since May 2020. They’re open from Tuesday through Sunday, 2pm -10 pm. Happy Hour is on the weekdays from 2pm- 6pm. There is outdoor seating with a tent and heat provided to keep customers toasty,

Amazing time. Came into town for the weekend with my BF who is new to the whole NY scene. We decided to pull up. Got there around 8pm and immediately found seats next to the manager Sharifa. She was so hospitable and made us feel like part of the bar fam. By 11pm it was standing room only. Drinks were amazing. Music was amazing. The whole vibe was dope. We'll see y'all on the next trip. Your Alabama Crew. 💓
Great vibe. The drinks were mixed well and reasonably priced. Live DJ on the weekends & Jerk Chicken hut open on Sundays. I wish they offer some bar snacks throughout the week.

name: The Evergreen
document: The Evergreen. cuisine: Wine Bars Beer Bar Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.4 stars (very good). price level is cheap.

google_reviews.text: Evergreen is an amazing private club located at the foot of the Bull Run mountains in Northern Virginia. The course was in great shape for the month of December and was a good challenge. The greens roll true and fast and the fairways are wide making it a forgiving course with scoring opportunities. This is the most inclusive private club I’ve played to date as one can secure a tee time by staying at the inn on site. The members and staff were very welcoming and professional and made for a good last round of the year. I highly recommend playing this course if afforded the opportunity.

Evergreen Country Club in the fall couldn’t have been a more perfect venue for our wedding! The red maples around the stone garden and the 1st tee and 18th green made for some unbelievable pictures!

Everything was beyond perfect for our special day and that all started with the event coordinator Desiree. She was there for anything we needed all day and made us feel so special! Booking it over a year and a half out, she was great with communicating and answering all of our questions. Leading up to the day, we felt no stress and all of the little details were taken care of!

The entire wedding party stayed at the Inn at Evergreen right on property. It’s an amazingly beautiful historic Inn, and we were thrilled that everyone in our wedding party was able to be together in such a cool place!

The ballroom is perfect for various wedding sizes. It didn’t feel empty at all for our 60-person wedding, but it can still comfortably fit many more guests.
We decided on the buffet option because we wanted a more casual dining experience. We’re still receiving compliments from family and friends about how amazing the food was and how Evergreen was such a beautiful place for our wedding!

We recommend Evergreen CC to any couples looking to have a beautiful wedding in a surreal surrounding with Bull Run Mountains in the backdrop. Desiree was wonderful, we couldn’t have asked for a better day!

Evergreen Country Club is a lovely place to say "I Do." You can have your ceremony in the stunning Stone Garden that overlooks the lush hills and woodland of Virginia's Blue Ridge. The staff is friendly and helpful and are easy to work with. And the photo opportunities are incredible as well. I highly recommend Evergreen Country Club!

Evergreen Country Club is one of our favorite venues in NOVA. The Staff is so friendly and kind, and they really work magic to bring our couples visions to life! Their attention to detail and and care for their couples partnered with their well manicured outdoor spaces, and gorgeous indoor spaces make photographing at Evergreen a dream!
Beautifully maintained and hospitable club. Course was excellent!

name: Rodeo
document: Rodeo. cuisine: Wine Bars Cocktail Bars Venues & Event Spaces. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text: Rodeo’s Mexican Grill is hands down the best Mexican restaurant my partner and I have ever been to—and we frequent a lot of Mexican spots! The shrimp and chicken build-your-own tacos were absolutely melt-in-your-mouth delicious. The guacamole and chips were fresh and flavorful, the perfect start to our meal. We also tried the chicken enchiladas, which were incredible—rich, savory, and perfectly cooked. On top of the amazing food, the service was friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. We can’t wait to come back!

We called the restaurant the day before and asked if they could accommodate a party of 10. They are a small place but they said they could accommodate us.
When we arrived the place was full,  but as other diners finished up they were able to put tables together and get us seated in a very reasonable time.
The service was quick and friendly.  Everyone enjoyed their meals.
We will definitely go back.

The Good:
- The staff seated us right away. Our food came to our table steaming hot and within 15 minutes of ordering.
- The restrooms, dining area, and open kitchen were all sparkling clean.
-The steak on my fajita was grilled, tender, and juicy. The shrimp in my sister’s burrito were plentiful and deliciously seasoned.

The Bad:
- $25 is a steep price to charge for a large daiquiri with an extra shot (that seemed quite short on the extra shot).
- The guacamole and sour cream served with the fajitas barely covered a single fajita. When I brought the extra small portion sizes to the manager’s attention he simply said, “next time.” Seriously????? 🤣🤯😳

I remember way back when this was originally Lovettsville Pizza and Subs, and has changed many different times over the years since. Very happy with Rodeo's setting up shop here.

Our family dines and orders take out from here very often and we have never been disappointed! Felix is very kind and personable, and the staff in general are very sweet and on point with service.

The food is absolutely delicious - I usually order the Mucha Hambre (steak + chicken, rice, and all the fixings). The house margaritas are always a go-to, and not to mention that the fried ice cream blew my mind!!!

We love this place 👍

My child and I stopped in for a late lunch today. We enjoyed the chips and salsa and ordered a tierra del Mar to share.
It was, 100%, the best version of that dish I have had anywhere. Everything was cooked and seasoned perfectly. I'm impressed.

document: The Rockwell Place. cuisine: Cocktail Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Good music and decent drinks, but the bartenders’ attitude is terrible. I’ve been there twice and both times had bad experiences. I asked for a simple lime or lemon, and they said they didn’t have any. Seriously? A bar without the basics?

We had a great experience at The Rockwell Place. Friendly staff who go the extra mile to understand your preferences. Really nice cocktails and a fun selection of different martinis. Reasonably priced as well.

Feels off the beaten path and has a down to earth vibe but it's definitely upscale.  Upscale cocktails and perfect light food ( I didn't have dinner yet).  Prices match the neighborhood, aways a nice time. Staff are wonderful, friendly and sharp

Lovely vibe, great people working, Alex behind the bar is a gem. Great burger, great caulilini, nice chicken, intriguing grilled cheese. And every cocktail I've tried here is wonderful, especially the specials, don't be turned off by the beer syrups! Calm relaxing and vibey music. It's a great spot!

Love this place! Their cocktails are on point. Must try caulifini. It’s the best! The chicken thigh skewers were good too. I liked the cucumber cocktail, it had the right amount of saltiness. Staff is friendly. They do check for vaccination upon entry.

name: Greenwood Park
document: Greenwood Park. cuisine: Beer Gardens. located in Brooklyn. with 3.4 stars (decent). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
Great place overall.
The dog park is okay...
It's a quite small fenced area for the number of puppies in the neighbourhood. And the brand new "real grass" is not that great... It becomes a puddle of mud as soon as it's a bit rainy.
2 baseball diamonds
A soccer field (no lines tho)
Huge Swimming pool
Nice kids playground
Ice rink and ice trail...

But the best is the farmers market on Sundays. Always friendly people with fresh produce, live music and food!!!!!!
100% recommend the Belgian waffles

Great family park with something for everyone to enjoy.
Big children's playground with a splash pad, full-sized swimming pool, sandbox with a water feature and even a firepit.
A roller and ice skating rink plus a hockey area are also available. There is a baseball diamond and plenty of free green space for games or relaxation/ picnic. Adult exercise equipment is also present as well as a community garden.
The dog park is amazing with sections for small or big dogs and has astroturf so the dogs don't get muddy. Lots of water stations and even a dog pool.
However, there is an issue in regard to garbage being left around the park. The playground is strewn with swimming brackets from the pool, straws and other snack wrappers litter the sand and when people have parties they tend to leave all their garbage laying around the picnic tables. It's very frustrating.

Excellent for all ages - adult, children especially smaller kids. This leisure park has everything from a very huge field, it has a swimming pool, splash pad, exercise area, playground and bike or rollerblades circle. For winter, the hills surrounds the field is a great taboggan area and an artificial ice staking rink! All free! My favorite park..
Nice park very spacious it needs more trees hence why rating is 4/5. baseball fields are well maintained it is fairly clean. It’s good for doggos. Overall good park - the 🌲’s.

Great skating path. Good playground for kids in nice weather. Overall a nice area to be in. The skating path and the covered arena are both refrigerated so are easily skateable into early March. In theory the path and the rink are open until the end of March Break, but that is weather permitting. Photos taken March 8, 2019.

document: Friends and Lovers. cuisine: Bars Music Venues. located in Brooklyn. with 3.7 stars (good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: Nice little Friday night party spot. DJ was cool playing an array of music ( mostly Hip -Hop/R&B from the 2000s. Drinks were decently priced and there was an outdoor area in the back for smoking. $20 cover

I went last night around 1 AM for the first time! I was recommended this place by a few of my friends as a good alternative from the venues I usually go. For context, I’m pretty into the EDM scene, but these days I prefer R&B/Hiphop venues or events when I go on a night out. Imagine my surprise when I showed up and they were playing house. I don’t remember which genre of house, but it was similar to the sets I’d catch at festivals when I wanted to wind down. 2010s deep/classic house is the best example I found on Youtube.

I didn’t mind it because it was a genre I still listened to heavily, but it wasn’t what my friends and I were going for that night so we ended up leaving after 20 minutes. I’m sure it was a fluke or something, so I’ll be trying again in the near future. I just wish the music was closer to what was advertised 🥲
Cute cozy bar. Came for salsa night, it was good. Music was good and I appreciate the coat rack. The bathroom gets stuck tho
Loved visiting this Brooklyn club while on vacation. I felt some real local culture getting to experience the newly emerging dance club scene. Hope to come back one day.

I’ve been here several times, it’s always a nice chill calm vibe. Sometimes they have a DJ jamming in the front of the bar, sometimes they open the back for a real party. The bartenders are really cool people but their drinks are a bit pricey in my opinion. We aren’t in Bushwick, we live in Crown Heights :). It was a bit frustrating because the back deck they usually have a smoking spot was closed off this Saturday, but they let us smoke outside in front of the building instead so that was nice.

They have some great dance parties here!

name: The Last Call
document: The Last Call. cuisine: Bars. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good).

google_reviews.text:
Got married on a Friday.  We were doing brunch at one restaurant then College Football & more food at Last Call.

Gina the owner could not have been any more accommodating to our group.  Needless to say they went above and beyond for us.

The drinks kept coming and the food was simple and great!

10/10....would definitely recommend having a gathering there!!!!
Last Call is a great spot to meet up with a friend for a drink. Don't miss out on the on-tap old fashioned! Cell service is limited inside but they have free WiFi (the password is Bottomsup!)

Solid dive bar near union market. Prices are decent, the atmosphere is chill, and there is a bathroom right next to the dart throwing area which makes for some exciting antics. The service was solid even though it was quite busy, and the music wasn't too loud. I would recommend checking this place out if you are in the area.

I'd never been to the soundstage of a 90s sitcom set in a dive bar before! It's an interesting experience.

The beers were cheaper than you'd expect for Union Market. But the place was loud and filled with backwards baseball cap bros.

The cheap Ms Pacman was nice. The guy tending bar was not. He aggressively argued with my friend after she called him out for being a jerk to the woman he was working with.

It was hard to have a conversation because the music was so loud.

And did I mention it's a FAKE dive bar. It looked like the chimera of a dive bar. Dive bar sans dive. We wondered if we'd stumbled into the favorite dive bar of the denizens of the Uncanny Valley.

Go to Jimmy Valentine's or The Pug instead.
A bar you might walk by, but don’t just a book by its cover!  Staff and patrons were amazing.  Are we tourists, sure. Will we come back again? Hell yes!!

name: BierWax
document: BierWax. cuisine: Beer Bar. located in Brooklyn. with 4.8 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text: As the rise of craft beer spots are still coming up I can honestly say this is the FIRST place that I actually felt comfortable because there was a mix of diversity which I don’t see much of in other places and made me feel as we weren’t alone for once! This place is awesome from the vinyls they were playing to the beer/cider selection that they have on tap as well as having cans available. They also have art up for sale and few artist that I know of as well. Nothing but good vibes! Can’t wait to visit again.

Being from the west coast of Canada and visiting New York for my 40th birthday, I decided to walk around Brooklyn and luckily stumbled upon Bierwax! I stopped by early afternoon and can definitely say I was not disappointed.  Tone the bartender was amazing.  The drinks were great and the conversation even better.  He was playing some smooth Jazz and couldn't have asked for a better vibe. Highly recommended, amazing vinyl collection, good people, and the beer selection/cocktails are on point...made my trip to New York memorable!

Sista DJ played a tribute to D'Angelo for 2hrs, then just nutz on 90s R&B, using nothing but vinyl!! She was so dope! The backsplash of the bar are hundreds of actual vinyl records and Star Wars memorabilia. Just really really cool vibe. Met my good childhood friend and his road dog and we had great laughs and great drinks. Will be back!!

A very comfortable place to relax and have a few Beers or drinks with friends. The atmosphere is easy going with great music selection played is moderate tones so your not speaking over the music. The yard is great for groups to gather, talk. The bartenders Antonio and Ari are super attentive. It’s become a favorite spot to relax.

BierWax is such a vibe. From the moment you walk in, it just feels warm, relaxed, and welcoming. The staff is super friendly and down to earth. No pressure, no attitude, just good conversation, great recommendations, and good energy all around, it is the kind of place you do not want to rush out of. If you love vinyl, good music, great drinks and a laid-back Brooklyn spot, BierWax is definitely worth checking out. I will for sure be back.

google_reviews.text: Such a lovely place this is the first place I ever had a spicy espresso martini, and it was absolutely amazing. Special things to mail and her beautiful winter. I highly recommend it. Stellar staff who are very friendly and inviting. Great vibe and energy! They have live jazz music which feels special to have in the neighborhood.

Wonderful way to pick up the evening. We went one night from 6-9pm on a Monday evening. They have a schedule of dates for live jazz which is fabulous!  Cocktails and DJ mixing tunes on some evenings as well. Good conversations and great time. Check it out!

I work close by and this bar has instantly became my favorite spot to grab a pre work drink!

joseph, mel and kd are the best very knowledgeable and inviting theyll treat you well highly recommend stoping in

plus they do events here so definitely check it out!

Very nice, cozy place inside the mall. Always a vibe. Especially with "Dancing For Democracy" event hosted by Rebecca Lynn and DJ Misbehavior! I always attend and enjoy myself around good vibrations. The owner is very nice.

document: Barrow’s Intense NY Tasting Room. cuisine: Distilleries Cocktail Bars Music Venues. located in Brooklyn. with 4.5 stars (exceptional). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
This is truly a neat spot to get a drink or two or three....hehe.

I loved the vibe of this place and the atmosphere is very friendly. I didn't get the name of my bartender, but he was very welcoming and helpful.

If you like or have a taste for ginger then I highly recommend the Ginger Spritz as it is very strong. Anything you sample as a flight is available for purchase including the ginger liquor. Prices here are pretty fair too. Nothing too outrageous.

I never really come down to Industry City for drinks, but now after coming here, I have a reason to visit more often. Definitely recommend.

This week, a colleague and I visited this local bar near our workplace for a drink. We ordered two whiskey flights, each consisting of four tasting glasses, accompanied by written descriptions identifying the whiskey and its region of origin. The glasses were served in a wooden holder designed to accommodate six glasses.

My colleague was unable to finish all of his tastings and offered the remaining whiskey to me. After completing our drinks, we exited the bar. The tab had been paid in advance.

Shortly after leaving, a bartender followed us into the courtyard and asked whether we had taken one of the tasting glasses. This accusation was surprising and confusing, as there were eight glasses left on the table when we departed. The bartender quickly realized the mistake, apologized, and returned to the bar.

While the drinks themselves were enjoyable, the incident was both embarrassing and unnecessary. It left us questioning the appropriateness of the interaction. Potential patrons should be aware that situations like this may occur. Overall, the quality of the beverages was excellent; however, the customer service experience requires improvement.

We had the best time today at Barrows, everything was phenomenal. We had all the drinks. Purple rain, frozen things, hot cider; everything. The team was so hospitable - and they have a resident dog, Chief, who really just made everything so much more spectacular. Red velvet furniture, a very upscale yet laid back atmosphere. Can’t wait to go back and see my buddy Chief. :)

Yummy drink ! Prices are alright. The froze is 12 and really good so I think that’s reasonable. I also think they redecorated the space , have been here in a while. They do events sometimes too! A chill lowkey spot with a good chill versatile playlist. I would go back my myself or with friends in industry city! I originally found out about them on a tipplr. The design was a bit industrial and unwelcoming before , but idk something is new here! If you don’t like dog, beware I think the owner or someone who works here brings the dog to work, idc personally , they don’t serve much food and doggy is not not touching the liquor.

What a surprising discovery to find this delightful everything-ginger-brewed-and-distilled bar in Industry City. The atmosphere inside is an exciting mix of steam punk meets distillery laboratory. I love their shelf selection of ginger beers and bought myself the Belvoir Organic Ginger Beer, which was light and tasty. I yet have to go back for a serious ginger drink, as it was a bit too early in the day for me. This place is absolutely on my must-go-back list and bring friends!

document: Kuun. cuisine: Korean. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is expensive.

google_reviews.text: Kuun is an absolute must-visit for the best Korean food in Downtown Brooklyn! Our dinner was amazing. We started with crispy mandu, delicious kimbap, and savory jeon. The main dishes were spectacular: perfectly grilled LA kalbi BBQ and a rich, comforting seafood tofu soup. Highly recommend this fantastic restaurant for its authentic flavors, cozy atmosphere, and great service!

This restaurant provides quality food and has amazing atmosphere. The ambience is warm and inviting and the staff is super attentive. Our server especially was great. He gave amazing recommendations which added to our experience. Me and my friend tried a couple of cocktails which were refreshing and flavorful. Would definitely come back!

Was excited to try this place. Ordered the japchae and added the bulgogi for an extra cost. Unfortunately, I was extremely disappointed. The portion size was small given how pricey it is, and got maybe 3 pieces of beef. The noodles were okay, but not so good I'd crave it again. Maybe dining in would be a better experience but the takeout was meh and will not be ordering again.

Very good! I've been meaning to check out this place for a while, and finally got around to it a few months ago. We tried the following:
- Korean style chicken wings
- Korean style donkatsu
- Japchae
- Pork jajang myun
- Several lovely cocktails

Would definitely try it again

Bought off Ubereats. The soup was good but it soaked through the ride. I get that it might be more ecofriendly, but for delivery please consider using plastic cups? A third of the soup spilled/soaked through, and the crispy skewer had really little sauce unlike the picture on the menu.

document: Penelope's Mexican Bistro. cuisine: Mexican. located in Brooklyn. with 4.6 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text:
The most charming neighborhood Italian restaurant (formerly Mexican-food eatery)! Truly such wonderful vibes all around. The staff is so friendly and I've really enjoyed connecting with them. The food is DIVINE and an incredible bang-for-your-buck for this neighborhood and quality level!! Homemade pastas and the FRESHIEST ingredients (and tableside bread, duh).

Perfect place for a special night out and/or casual family meal.. this place does it all!

I almost want to keep news of this place to myself but... I'm being a good samaritan. You're welcome :)

My friend I had such a lovely experience here. The waitress was kind and hospitable. The atmosphere was great and everything we ordered was super flavorful. We will definitely be coming back with friends. I also would highly recommend this place as a date spot!

Went here a couple of weeks ago with friends and family and all I can say is WOW. The food was truly exquisite! The pasta was cooked to perfection, and the cacio e pepe was definitely the star of the show, prepared in a wheel of cheese! The drinks were delicious, the service was amazing, and the ambiance struck the perfect balance between fine dining and casual comfort. This is definitely a new hidden gem in the neighborhood.

Went here with friends and wow it was sooo amazing!! Went a second time for last minute dinner plans and wow its was fantastic both times!! Great Italian food, with pretty presentation, & the atmosphere is warm and friendly. Def keeping this spot in my rotation 😋

Best Caesar salad in the area. Great brunch options, and even better dinner options. You can easily go deep Italian or just have a burger and fries and you will be happy either way.

Very kid friendly, very accommodating for allergies and other needs. Strong bar and wine selection.

name: High Lúa Vietnamese Kitchen
document: High Lúa Vietnamese Kitchen. cuisine: Vietnamese. located in Brooklyn. with 4.3 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
I came here for their lunch service and had a good time! This cozy restaurant in Williamsburg offers some pretty authentic Viet dishes from noodles to rice to banh mi. They also have really good sparkling Viet drinks and viet coffee! Service here is nice.

We got their salad rolls, mi quang, and bo kho with their salted lemonade and coconut cream viet coffee. Everything was great. The mi quang was a huge portion with tons of pork, quail eggs, and shrimp. Meanwhile the bo kho had super tender beef and was very fragrant. Loved my Viet coffee and the salted lemonade was so refreshing. Great spot for some casual Vietnamese food in Brooklyn!

Cute NYC-inspired ambiance makes this pho spot stand out. The service was friendly and attentive throughout my visit. The chicken pho could use more chicken, and the special beef pho was served a bit cold. Overall, the flavors were decent but not particularly memorable. Worth a visit for the vibe and good service, but pho lovers may want a bit more from the food.

High Lúa is a cozy Vietnamese spot to enjoy in Willamsburg. The food is good but not amazing. The service is friendly and the space is small but well decorated. Something about their vegetable pho didn’t fully hit for me but I still enjoyed the experience and would come try it again. The space is fairly small so not a good fit for large groups.

I used to come here a lot more often as my hangover cure.  This time was for dinner and it was unfortunately a little disappointing.  I ordered the chicken pho and the portions were noticeably small compared to other viet spots in the city.  The noodles were surprisingly al dente, which is not my preference.  There is def a dearth of solid viet spots in Williamsburg, but would be nice for High Lua to change it up and fill the void.

Cute and authentic Vietnamese spot. We ordered the Special Beef Pho, Grilled Pork Vermicelli and Viet Coffee. The broth was homemade and the portion was big. The pork was grilled to perfection. Would 100% come back and try other items on the menu!

name: Everyman Espresso
document: Everyman Espresso. cuisine: Coffee & Tea. located in Brooklyn. with 4.2 stars (very good). price level is moderate.

google_reviews.text:
For my fellow milk coffee snobs: it's rare to find a place in NYC which knows how to respect both the espresso shot and alternative milk.

Came here on a cold (-17C) sat morn and ordered an oat capp to warm my pretentious soul. Smooth, well-heated milk and even did a bit of latte art despite being in takeaway cup. The coffee had distinctive notes (deeply nutty and a touch of lavender).

The pastries (esp the waffle) are so good. Coffee is #damn fine and great.

Kuddos to Souleymane, the barista for a great service. His hospitality and service makes the winter warm!

Great, calm place to work or meet friends, I saw some comments about bad service but I couldn’t disagree more! Barista was super friendly and quick. Had an awesome cappuccino with not too much milk which I prefer. Overall great vibe, coffee, and spacious seating - thanks!

Lowks they burnt my espresso and then paired with the tonic water it was a no go #havehadbetter… but alas. Great place for a good read or write as they have many seating options. Bar seating is optimal for people watching, 10/10.

The sign outside says it all, "DAMN FINE COFFEE!" And it's not lying!

Great spot for a strong drip with a sweet treat and some remote work - WiFi is excellent. Chilled and welcoming vibes from the baristas.

P.S. Katie Holmes sat at the table next to me today. I'm not sure if she is a local or just randomly walked in, but that was a nice surprise. She must like the coffee here too!

name: Yellow Sun Coffee
document: Yellow Sun Coffee. cuisine: Coffee Roasteries Coffee & Tea. located in Brooklyn. with 5.0 stars (exceptional).

google_reviews.text: This coffee shop is incredible. They have so much attention to detail. They roast their own coffee. The owner was so friendly and is super passionate about coffee. Their branding is consistent and refreshing. I had the olive oil cake and it was incredible. They have such a big selection of single origin coffee roasts. I tried a Yemen coffee. Their espresso presentation is educational with tasting information. 10 out of 10 would recommend this to locals and visitors alike. I will definitely be returning.

I love this place! I can’t wait for warmer weather when the outdoor seating can be used. The atmosphere inside is always calm and peaceful - it’s perfect to sit down and read or do work. I’ve been here a number of times and the service is also wonderful too. The employees put so much care into making and delivering the drinks. My favorite has to be the hot cardamom latte with oat milk or almond milk, it’s great in the cold. I’ve also had the strawberry matcha which was good and some of their pastries which have always been yummy. Love it here & recommend!

Walking into YellowSun feels like stepping into a small pocket of warmth carved out from the city’s noise. The lights seems softer here, the air a little sweeter and the coffee always rich and comforting, it’s tastes like it was brewed with intention.
The quiet kindness of the staff who greet you like they’ve been saving a seat just for you.
It’s the kind of café that’s doesn’t just serve coffee, it’s offers a moment, a pause, a breath, and a little sunbeam in the middle of Brooklyn.

These folks are really living up to the phrase “dedicated to the craft.” If you’re a coffee lover, you absolutely have to check this place out. It’s not groundbreaking, but they consistently deliver top-notch coffee every time. Plus, they have a fantastic selection of coffee beans, some of which you might not find anywhere else.

🌟🌟🌟 YellowSun Coffee offers bright, citrus-forward coffee with a refreshing acidity—perfect if you enjoy a more tangy flavor profile.
They have a great selection of pastries, all very tasty and fresh.
The space has plenty of seating, but laptop-friendly spots are limited. One downside is that the pastries can’t be reheated, which is a bit of a shame.
Still, a cozy spot for a quick bite and a quality cup of coffee.
